-- Cat Hub | Steal An Egg | single-file build (logic + new UI)
do
	local _g = (typeof(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G or shared
	if buffer and type(buffer.create) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			local _orig_fromstring = buffer.fromstring
			local _orig_len = buffer.len
			local _orig_readu8 = buffer.readu8
			local _orig_writeu8 = buffer.writeu8
			local _orig_create = buffer.create
			local _orig_copy = buffer.copy
			local testStr = "\0\1\2\3\4"
			local testBuf = pcall(_orig_fromstring, testStr) and _orig_fromstring(testStr)
			local fromstringBroken = false
			if not testBuf or _orig_len(testBuf) < 5 or (pcall(_orig_readu8, testBuf, 4) and _orig_readu8(testBuf, 4) ~= 4) then
				fromstringBroken = true
			end
			if fromstringBroken then
				buffer.fromstring = function(str)
					local len = #str
					local b = _orig_create(len)
					for i = 1, len do
						_orig_writeu8(b, i - 1, string.byte(str, i))
					end
					return b
				end
			end
			buffer.copy = function(target, targetOffset, source, sourceOffset, count)
				sourceOffset = sourceOffset or 0
				targetOffset = targetOffset or 0
				local srcLen = _orig_len(source)
				local tgtLen = _orig_len(target)
				count = count or (srcLen - sourceOffset)
				if count <= 0 then return end
				if sourceOffset + count > srcLen then
					count = math.max(0, srcLen - sourceOffset)
				end
				if targetOffset + count > tgtLen then
					count = math.max(0, tgtLen - targetOffset)
				end
				if count <= 0 then return end
				local ok = pcall(_orig_copy, target, targetOffset, source, sourceOffset, count)
				if not ok then
					for i = 0, count - 1 do
						_orig_writeu8(target, targetOffset + i, _orig_readu8(source, sourceOffset + i))
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	if type(_g.setclipboard) ~= "function" then
		if type(_g.toclipboard) == "function" then
			_g.setclipboard = _g.toclipboard
		elseif type(Clipboard) == "table" and type(Clipboard.set) == "function" then
			_g.setclipboard = function(text) Clipboard.set(text) end
		else
			_g.setclipboard = function(text)
				pcall(function()
					if typeof(setrbxclipboard) == "function" then
						setrbxclipboard(tostring(text))
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end
	if type(_g.toclipboard) ~= "function" then
		_g.toclipboard = _g.setclipboard
	end
	local _customReq = _g.request or _g.http_request or (syn and syn.request) or (fluxus and fluxus.request) or (http and http.request)
	if type(_customReq) == "function" then
		_g.request = _customReq
		_g.http_request = _customReq
	end
	local _customQOT = _g.queue_on_teleport or _g.queueonteleport or (syn and syn.queue_on_teleport) or (fluxus and fluxus.queue_on_teleport)
	if type(_customQOT) == "function" then
		_g.queue_on_teleport = _customQOT
		_g.queueonteleport = _customQOT
	end
	if type(_g.gethui) ~= "function" then
		_g.gethui = function()
			return game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("RobloxGui") or game:GetService("CoreGui")
		end
	end
	if type(_g.fireproximityprompt) ~= "function" then
		_g.fireproximityprompt = function(prompt, amount, skip)
			if not prompt or typeof(prompt) ~= "Instance" or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return end
			local oldHold = prompt.HoldDuration
			local oldMax = prompt.MaxActivationDistance
			prompt.HoldDuration = 0
			prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 9e9
			prompt:InputHoldBegin()
			task.wait(0.05)
			prompt:InputHoldEnd()
			prompt.HoldDuration = oldHold
			prompt.MaxActivationDistance = oldMax
		end
	end
	if type(_g.firetouchinterest) ~= "function" then
		_g.firetouchinterest = function(target, touchWith, toggle)
			if not target or not touchWith then return end
			pcall(function()
				if toggle == 0 then
					target.CFrame = touchWith.CFrame
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end
local a = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YoxanHub/second/main/ui.lua"
local b = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Cat HubOnTop/Loader/main/main.lua"
local c = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YoxanHub/second/main/pred.lua"
do
	local targetGameId = 10563114921
	local targetPlaceId = 107778070777162
	local isValid = (game.GameId == targetGameId) or (game.PlaceId == targetPlaceId) or (game.PlaceId == targetGameId) or (game.GameId == targetPlaceId)
	if not isValid then
		local ok, info = pcall(function()
			return game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId)
		end)
		if ok and type(info) == "table" and string.find(string.lower(tostring(info.Name or "")), "steal an egg", 1, true) then
			isValid = true
		end
	end
	if not isValid then
		pcall(function()
			game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", { Title = "Cat Hub", Text = "Script only supports Steal An Egg!", Duration = 5 })
		end)
		return
	end
end
-- ============================================================================
-- CAT HUB  |  headless control layer (replaces the old UI library + adapter)
-- Every Create* call from the worker code lands here and becomes a plain
-- handle backed by a Lua value. The new UI (bottom of file) and the CatHub
-- table both read and write these handles.
-- ============================================================================
local CatHub = {
	Steal = { Enabled = false, CarryUid = nil, Active = false, Carrying = false },
	SafeCarry = { Enabled = true, LineDrop = false, InstantV1 = false, InstantV2 = false, DeliveryMode = "Base (Default)" },
	AntiGuard = { Enabled = true, Mode = "Anti Guard", ShowPanel = function() end },
	Place = { Enabled = false },
	Hatch = { Enabled = false },
	Fuse = { Enabled = false },
	Sell = { PetEnabled = false, EggEnabled = false },
	Favorite = { Enabled = false },
	Treadmill = { Riding = false, Wanted = false, Target = "Auto Best" },
	Mutation = { Enabled = false, Mutation = "Nitro" },
	Halloween = {},
	Butterfly = {},
	Webhook = { Url = "", Enabled = false },
	Filters = { MinRarity = 0, MinValue = 0, Priority = "Highest Value" },
	Stats = { BootTime = os.clock(), EggsDelivered = 0, TotalEarn = 0 },
	Config = {},
	_H = {},
}

do
	local H = CatHub._H
	local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
	H.Controls = {}
	H.ByName = {}
	H.ByPath = {}
	H.TabOrder = {}
	H.Tabs = {}
	H.LogLines = {}
	H.Values = {}
	H.Canvases = {}

	local CONFIG_DIR, CONFIG_FILE = "CatHub", "CatHub/controls.json"

	local function dummy()
		return setmetatable({}, {
			__index = function(_, _k)
				return function()
					return dummy()
				end
			end,
			__call = function()
				return dummy()
			end,
		})
	end
	H.Dummy = dummy
	local FALLBACK = {
		__index = function(_, _k)
			return function()
				return dummy()
			end
		end,
	}

	local function y(cb, ...)
		if type(cb) == "function" then
			local ok, err = pcall(cb, ...)
			if not ok then
				warn("[Cat Hub] callback error: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end

	-- persistence -----------------------------------------------------------
	pcall(function()
		if typeof(isfile) == "function" and isfile(CONFIG_FILE) then
			local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(CONFIG_FILE))
			if type(data) == "table" then
				H.Values = data
			end
		end
	end)
	local saveQueued = false
	function H.Save(key, value)
		if key == nil then
			return
		end
		H.Values[key] = value
		if saveQueued or typeof(writefile) ~= "function" then
			return
		end
		saveQueued = true
		task.delay(2, function()
			saveQueued = false
			pcall(function()
				if typeof(makefolder) == "function" and typeof(isfolder) == "function" and not isfolder(CONFIG_DIR) then
					makefolder(CONFIG_DIR)
				end
				writefile(CONFIG_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(H.Values))
			end)
		end)
	end

	-- registry --------------------------------------------------------------
	local function record(ctx, kind, cfg, handle)
		local name = tostring(cfg.Name or "")
		local rec = {
			Tab = ctx._tab, Section = ctx._section, Kind = kind, Name = name, Note = cfg.Note,
			Options = cfg.Options, Min = cfg.Min, Max = cfg.Max, Step = cfg.Increment,
			Unit = cfg.Unit, Default = cfg.Default, Handle = handle, Order = #H.Controls + 1,
		}
		H.Controls[#H.Controls + 1] = rec
		if name ~= "" then
			if H.ByName[name] == nil then
				H.ByName[name] = handle
			end
			H.ByName[name .. "@" .. tostring(ctx._section)] = handle
		end
		return rec
	end
	local function pathOf(ctx, name)
		return tostring(ctx._tab) .. "/" .. tostring(ctx._section) .. "/" .. tostring(name)
	end

	local function baseHandle(getter)
		local el = { Get = getter, GetValue = getter }
		local h = { _el = el, _controller = { GetValue = getter }, Get = getter, GetValue = getter }
		function h.Destroy() end
		function h.JoinExclusiveGroup() end
		return setmetatable(h, FALLBACK)
	end

	-- control builders --------------------------------------------------------
	local function makeToggle(ctx, cfg)
		cfg = cfg or {}
		local key = pathOf(ctx, cfg.Name)
		local value = cfg.Default == true
		if type(H.Values[key]) == "boolean" then
			value = H.Values[key]
		end
		local group
		local h
		h = baseHandle(function()
			return value
		end)
		function h.Set(_, v)
			v = v == true
			if v == value then
				return
			end
			value = v
			H.Save(key, v)
			if v and group then
				for _, m in ipairs(group.members) do
					if m ~= h and m:Get() == true then
						pcall(m.Set, m, false)
					end
				end
			end
			y(cfg.Callback, v)
		end
		h.SetValue = h.Set
		function h.JoinExclusiveGroup(self, g)
			if type(g) == "table" and type(g.members) == "table" then
				group = g
				table.insert(g.members, self)
			end
		end
		record(ctx, "toggle", cfg, h)
		if value == true then
			task.defer(y, cfg.Callback, true)
		end
		return h
	end

	local function makeSlider(ctx, cfg)
		cfg = cfg or {}
		local key = pathOf(ctx, cfg.Name)
		local min = tonumber(cfg.Min) or 0
		local max = tonumber(cfg.Max) or 100
		local step = tonumber(cfg.Increment) or 1
		if cfg.AllowDecimals and step >= 1 then
			step = 0.1
		end
		local value = tonumber(cfg.Default) or min
		if tonumber(H.Values[key]) then
			value = tonumber(H.Values[key])
		end
		value = math.clamp(value, min, max)
		local h = baseHandle(function()
			return value
		end)
		function h.Set(_, v)
			v = tonumber(v)
			if not v then
				return
			end
			v = math.clamp(v, min, max)
			if step > 0 then
				v = math.floor(v / step + 0.5) * step
				v = math.clamp(v, min, max)
			end
			if v == value then
				return
			end
			value = v
			H.Save(key, v)
			y(cfg.Callback, v)
		end
		h.SetValue = h.Set
		local rec = record(ctx, "slider", cfg, h)
		rec.Min, rec.Max, rec.Step = min, max, step
		task.defer(y, cfg.Callback, value)
		return h
	end

	local function makeDropdown(ctx, cfg, multi)
		cfg = cfg or {}
		local key = pathOf(ctx, cfg.Name)
		local saved = cfg.Saved ~= false and H.Values[key] or nil
		local options = {}
		for _, o in ipairs(cfg.Options or {}) do
			options[#options + 1] = tostring(o)
		end
		local value
		if multi then
			value = {}
			local src = type(saved) == "table" and saved or cfg.Default
			if type(src) == "table" then
				for k, v in pairs(src) do
					if v == true and type(k) == "string" then
						value[#value + 1] = k
					elseif type(v) == "string" then
						value[#value + 1] = v
					end
				end
			end
		else
			value = cfg.Default
			if type(saved) == "string" then
				value = saved
			end
			if type(value) == "table" then
				value = value[1]
			end
			if value ~= nil then
				value = tostring(value)
			end
		end
		local h = baseHandle(function()
			if multi then
				local copy = {}
				for i, v in ipairs(value) do
					copy[i] = v
				end
				return copy
			end
			return value
		end)
		local rec
		function h.Set(_, v)
			if multi then
				local list = {}
				if type(v) == "table" then
					for k, x in pairs(v) do
						if x == true and type(k) == "string" then
							list[#list + 1] = k
						elseif type(x) == "string" then
							list[#list + 1] = x
						end
					end
				end
				value = list
			else
				if type(v) == "table" then
					v = v[1]
				end
				value = v ~= nil and tostring(v) or nil
			end
			if cfg.Saved ~= false then
				H.Save(key, value)
			end
			y(cfg.Callback, h.Get())
		end
		h.SetValue = h.Set
		function h.Refresh(_, newOptions, selected)
			options = {}
			for _, o in ipairs(newOptions or {}) do
				options[#options + 1] = tostring(o)
			end
			rec.Options = options
			if selected ~= nil then
				h:Set(selected)
			end
		end
		rec = record(ctx, multi and "multi" or "dropdown", cfg, h)
		rec.Options = options
		task.defer(function()
			y(cfg.Callback, h.Get())
		end)
		return h
	end

	local function makeButton(ctx, cfg)
		cfg = cfg or {}
		local h = baseHandle(function()
			return nil
		end)
		function h.Fire()
			y(cfg.Callback)
		end
		record(ctx, "button", cfg, h)
		return h
	end

	local function makeText(ctx, cfg, kind)
		cfg = cfg or {}
		local text = tostring(cfg.Text or cfg.Content or "")
		local h = baseHandle(function()
			return text
		end)
		function h.Set(_, v)
			text = tostring(v)
		end
		h.SetText = h.Set
		h.SetContent = h.Set
		record(ctx, kind or "text", cfg, h)
		return h
	end

	local function makeInput(ctx, cfg)
		cfg = cfg or {}
		local key = pathOf(ctx, cfg.Name)
		local value = tostring(cfg.Default or "")
		if type(H.Values[key]) == "string" then
			value = H.Values[key]
		end
		local h = baseHandle(function()
			return value
		end)
		function h.Set(_, v)
			value = tostring(v or "")
			H.Save(key, value)
			y(cfg.Callback, value)
		end
		h.SetValue = h.Set
		record(ctx, "input", cfg, h)
		task.defer(y, cfg.Callback, value)
		return h
	end

	local function newContainer(tabName, sectionName)
		local c = { _tab = tabName, _section = sectionName }
		-- off-screen host for legacy custom panels (never parented, so nothing is drawn)
		local host = Instance.new("Frame")
		c._container, c._holder, c._frame = host, host, host
		function c:CreateSection(cfg)
			cfg = cfg or {}
			return newContainer(tabName, tostring(cfg.Name or ""))
		end
		function c:CreateToggle(cfg) return makeToggle(c, cfg) end
		function c:CreateSlider(cfg) return makeSlider(c, cfg) end
		function c:CreateDropdown(cfg) return makeDropdown(c, cfg, false) end
		function c:CreateMultiDropdown(cfg) return makeDropdown(c, cfg, true) end
		function c:CreateButton(cfg) return makeButton(c, cfg) end
		function c:CreateText(cfg) return makeText(c, cfg, "text") end
		function c:CreateLabel(cfg) return makeText(c, cfg, "label") end
		function c:CreateInput(cfg) return makeInput(c, cfg) end
		function c:CreateCanvas(cfg)
			-- custom canvases (Task Priority, predictors) had no UI-free form; Build is not run
			H.Canvases[#H.Canvases + 1] = cfg
			return dummy()
		end
		return setmetatable(c, FALLBACK)
	end

	local function ensureTab(name)
		name = tostring(name or "General")
		if not H.Tabs[name] then
			H.Tabs[name] = newContainer(name, "General")
			H.TabOrder[#H.TabOrder + 1] = name
		end
		return H.Tabs[name]
	end

	-- API object handed to the worker code as `ab` --------------------------------
	local API = {}
	function API.Notify(a, b, c)
		if a == API then
			a, b, c = b, c, nil
		end
		local title, body
		if type(a) == "table" then
			title, body = a.Title or a.Name, a.Content or a.Text or a.Message
		else
			title, body = a, b
		end
		local line = tostring(title or "Cat Hub") .. ((body and body ~= "") and (" - " .. tostring(body)) or "")
		H.LogLines[#H.LogLines + 1] = line
		pcall(function()
			game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
				Title = tostring(title or "Cat Hub"), Text = tostring(body or ""), Duration = tonumber(c) or 4,
			})
		end)
		if type(H.OnToast) == "function" then
			pcall(H.OnToast, line)
		end
	end
	function API.Log(a, b)
		if a == API then
			a = b
		end
		H.LogLines[#H.LogLines + 1] = tostring(a)
		if #H.LogLines > 200 then
			table.remove(H.LogLines, 1)
		end
	end
	function API:Finalize() return true end
	function API:Destroy() end

	local Window = {}
	function Window:CreateTab(cfg)
		return ensureTab(type(cfg) == "table" and cfg.Name or cfg)
	end
	function Window:GetDefaultTab()
		return ensureTab("Farm")
	end
	function Window:CreateState(cfg)
		cfg = cfg or {}
		local key = "State/" .. tostring(cfg.Name)
		local v = cfg.Default
		if H.Values[key] ~= nil then
			v = H.Values[key]
		end
		local subs = {}
		local s = {}
		function s.Get() return v end
		s.GetValue = s.Get
		function s.Set(_, nv)
			v = nv
			H.Save(key, nv)
			for _, f in ipairs(subs) do
				y(f, nv)
			end
		end
		function s.Subscribe(_, f)
			subs[#subs + 1] = f
			return { Disconnect = function()
				for i, g in ipairs(subs) do
					if g == f then
						table.remove(subs, i)
						break
					end
				end
			end }
		end
		function s.Destroy() subs = {} end
		return s
	end
	function Window:CreateExclusiveGroup(cfg)
		cfg = cfg or {}
		return { Name = cfg.Name, MaxActive = cfg.MaxActive or 1, members = {} }
	end
	function Window:Toggle(v)
		if type(H.OnWindowToggle) == "function" then
			pcall(H.OnWindowToggle, v)
		end
	end
	function Window:Open() Window.Toggle(Window, true) end
	function Window:Close() Window.Toggle(Window, false) end
	function Window:Destroy() end
	setmetatable(Window, FALLBACK)

	function API:CreateWindow()
		return Window
	end
	setmetatable(API, FALLBACK)
	H.API = API
	H.Window = Window
end

-- legacy ScreenGuis (old floating panels) are created disabled and kept disabled;
-- only the new Cat Hub window (built while _H.Building is true) is allowed to show.
local Instance = (function()
	local real = Instance
	local wrapper = {}
	function wrapper.new(class, parent)
		local obj = real.new(class)
		if class == "ScreenGui" and not (CatHub and CatHub._H and CatHub._H.Building) then
			obj.Enabled = false
			obj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
				if obj.Enabled then
					obj.Enabled = false
				end
			end)
		end
		if parent ~= nil then
			obj.Parent = parent
		end
		return obj
	end
	return setmetatable(wrapper, { __index = real })
end)()

local aa, ab, ac, ad, ae, af, ag, ah, ai, aj
local ak, al, am, an, ao, ap, aq, ar, as, at
local au, av, aw, ax, ay, az, aA, aB, aC, aD
local aE, aF, aG

CatHub._Report = function(msg)
	CatHub.LastError = tostring(msg)
	warn("[Cat Hub] " .. CatHub.LastError)
	pcall(function()
		game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
			Title = "Cat Hub", Text = string.sub(CatHub.LastError, 1, 180), Duration = 12,
		})
	end)
end
CatHub._Boot = function()
	if CatHub._Booted then
		return
	end
	CatHub._Booted = true

-- ============================================================================
-- CAT HUB  |  CatHub state table (live proxies onto the worker state)
-- ============================================================================
do
	local H = CatHub._H
	local function handle(name)
		return H.ByName[name]
	end
	local function hget(name)
		local h = handle(name)
		if h and type(h.Get) == "function" then
			local ok, v = pcall(h.Get, h)
			if ok then
				return v
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local function hset(name, v)
		local h = handle(name)
		if h and type(h.Set) == "function" then
			pcall(h.Set, h, v)
		end
	end
	local function T(name)
		return {
			get = function() return hget(name) == true end,
			set = function(v) hset(name, v == true) end,
		}
	end
	local function D(name)
		return {
			get = function() return hget(name) end,
			set = function(v) hset(name, v) end,
		}
	end
	local function F(tbl, key, default)
		return {
			get = function()
				local t = tbl()
				if type(t) == "table" and t[key] ~= nil then
					return t[key]
				end
				return default
			end,
			set = function(v)
				local t = tbl()
				if type(t) == "table" then
					t[key] = v
				end
			end,
		}
	end
	local function proxy(map)
		local store = {}
		return setmetatable({}, {
			__index = function(_, k)
				local m = map[k]
				if m then
					return m.get()
				end
				return store[k]
			end,
			__newindex = function(_, k, v)
				local m = map[k]
				if m then
					m.set(v)
				else
					store[k] = v
				end
			end,
		})
	end
	-- proxy over every control of a section/tab matched by pattern, keyed by control name
	local function sectionProxy(match)
		return setmetatable({}, {
			__index = function(_, k)
				for _, rec in ipairs(H.Controls) do
					if rec.Name == k and match(rec) then
						return rec.Handle:Get()
					end
				end
			end,
			__newindex = function(_, k, v)
				for _, rec in ipairs(H.Controls) do
					if rec.Name == k and match(rec) then
						if rec.Kind == "button" then
							if v == true then rec.Handle:Fire() end
						else
							rec.Handle:Set(v)
						end
						return
					end
				end
			end,
		})
	end

	local function steal() return au.Steal end
	local function sc() return au.SafeCarry end
	local function instantMap(tag, field)
		return {
			get = function() return type(au.SafeCarry) == "table" and au.SafeCarry[field] == true end,
			set = function(v)
				local s = au.SafeCarry
				if type(s) ~= "table" or type(s.ApplyInstantChoice) ~= "function" then
					return
				end
				if v == true then
					s.ApplyInstantChoice(tag)
				elseif s[field] == true then
					s.ApplyInstantChoice("Off")
				end
			end,
		}
	end

	CatHub.Steal = proxy({
		Enabled = T("Auto Steal"),
		CarryUid = F(steal, "CarryUid"),
		Active = F(steal, "Active", false),
		Carrying = F(steal, "Carrying", false),
	})
	CatHub.SafeCarry = proxy({
		Enabled = F(sc, "Enabled", true),
		LineDrop = F(sc, "LineDrop", false),
		InstantV1 = instantMap("V1", "InstantV1"),
		InstantV2 = instantMap("V2", "InstantV2"),
		InstantV3 = instantMap("V3", "InstantV3"),
		DeliveryMode = F(sc, "DeliveryMode", "Base (Default)"),
	})
	CatHub.AntiGuard = proxy({
		Enabled = {
			get = function() return type(au.AntiGuard) == "table" and au.AntiGuard.Enabled == true end,
			set = function(v) hset("Anti Guard Mode", v == true and "Anti Guard" or "Off") end,
		},
		Mode = D("Anti Guard Mode"),
		Busy = F(function() return au.AntiGuard end, "Busy", false),
		HitArms = F(function() return au.AntiGuard end, "HitArms", 0),
		ShowPanel = { get = function() return function() end end, set = function() end },
	})
	CatHub.Place = proxy({ Enabled = T("Auto Place Egg") })
	CatHub.Hatch = proxy({ Enabled = T("Auto Hatch") })
	CatHub.Fuse = proxy({ Enabled = T("Auto Fuse Machine") })
	CatHub.Sell = proxy({ PetEnabled = T("Auto Sell Pet"), EggEnabled = T("Auto Sell Egg") })
	CatHub.Favorite = proxy({ Enabled = T("Auto Favorite Pet") })
	CatHub.Treadmill = proxy({
		Wanted = T("Auto Treadmill"),
		Riding = F(function() return au.Treadmill end, "Riding", false),
		Target = D("Treadmill Target"),
	})
	CatHub.Mutation = proxy({ Enabled = T("Auto Use Mutation (Nitro)"), Mutation = D("Mutation To Use") })
	CatHub.Halloween = sectionProxy(function(rec) return rec.Tab == "Event" and string.find(string.lower(rec.Section), "halloween", 1, true) ~= nil end)
	CatHub.Butterfly = sectionProxy(function(rec) return rec.Tab == "Event" and string.find(string.lower(rec.Section), "butterfly", 1, true) ~= nil end)
	CatHub.Webhook = proxy({
		Url = D("Webhook URL"),
		Enabled = T("Enable Steal Webhook Logs"),
		RareSpawns = T("Notify Rare Egg / Pet Spawns (With Image)"),
	})
	CatHub.Filters = proxy({
		MinRarity = D("Min Rarity"),
		MinValue = D("Min Steal Value"),
		Priority = D("Steal Priority"),
	})

	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Auto Reset (stuck / timed) + Death Loop Guard
	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	do
		local LP = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
		local farm = H.Window:CreateTab("Farm")
		local sec = farm:CreateSection({ Name = "Auto Reset" })
		local cfg = { Enabled = false, StuckSec = 30, EveryMin = 0, Guard = true, Limit = 3 }
		sec:CreateToggle({
			Name = "Auto Reset Character", Note = "Resets your character if it gets stuck or on a timer", Default = false,
			Callback = function(v) cfg.Enabled = v == true end,
		})
		sec:CreateSlider({
			Name = "Reset If Stuck (seconds)", Min = 10, Max = 120, Increment = 5, Default = 30, Unit = "s",
			Callback = function(v) cfg.StuckSec = tonumber(v) or 30 end,
		})
		sec:CreateSlider({
			Name = "Reset Every (minutes, 0 = off)", Min = 0, Max = 60, Increment = 1, Default = 0, Unit = "min",
			Callback = function(v) cfg.EveryMin = tonumber(v) or 0 end,
		})
		sec:CreateToggle({
			Name = "Death Loop Guard", Note = "Turns Auto Steal and Halloween stealing off if you keep dying", Default = true,
			Callback = function(v) cfg.Guard = v == true end,
		})
		sec:CreateSlider({
			Name = "Deaths Before Stop (within 60s)", Min = 2, Max = 10, Increment = 1, Default = 3,
			Callback = function(v) cfg.Limit = tonumber(v) or 3 end,
		})

		local function toast(msg)
			if type(H.OnToast) == "function" then pcall(H.OnToast, msg) end
		end
		local lastReset, lastMove, lastProgress = os.clock(), os.clock(), os.clock()
		local lastPos, lastDelivered, lastCarry = nil, 0, false
		local function resetNow()
			local char = LP.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then hum.Health = 0 end
			lastReset, lastMove, lastProgress, lastPos = os.clock(), os.clock(), os.clock(), nil
		end
		sec:CreateButton({ Name = "Reset Character Now", Callback = resetNow })

		local deaths = {}
		local function hook(char)
			local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
			if not hum then return end
			hum.Died:Connect(function()
				local now = os.clock()
				table.insert(deaths, now)
				for i = #deaths, 1, -1 do
					if now - deaths[i] > 60 then table.remove(deaths, i) end
				end
				if cfg.Guard and #deaths >= cfg.Limit then
					deaths = {}
					pcall(function() CatHub.Steal.Enabled = false end)
					pcall(function() CatHub.Set("Auto Steal Halloween Eggs", false) end)
					toast("Death loop: Auto Steal stopped after " .. tostring(cfg.Limit) .. " deaths")
				end
			end)
		end
		LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(hook)
		if LP.Character then task.spawn(hook, LP.Character) end

		task.spawn(function()
			while true do
				task.wait(1)
				pcall(function()
					local now = os.clock()
					local char = LP.Character
					local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if root then
						if not lastPos or (root.Position - lastPos).Magnitude > 4 then
							lastPos, lastMove = root.Position, now
						end
					end
					local delivered, carry = CatHub.Stats.EggsDelivered, CatHub.Steal.Carrying == true
					if delivered ~= lastDelivered or carry ~= lastCarry then
						lastDelivered, lastCarry, lastProgress = delivered, carry, now
					end
					if not cfg.Enabled or not root then return end
					local working = CatHub.Steal.Enabled == true or CatHub.Get("Auto Steal Halloween Eggs") == true
					if working and now - math.max(lastMove, lastProgress) > cfg.StuckSec then
						toast("Auto Reset: stuck, resetting character")
						resetNow()
						return
					end
					if cfg.EveryMin > 0 and now - lastReset > cfg.EveryMin * 60 and not carry then
						toast("Auto Reset: timed reset")
						resetNow()
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
	end

	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Cat Hub webhook (own controls, written straight into the webhook config)
	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	do
		local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
		local tab = H.Window:CreateTab("CatHubWebhook")
		local sec = tab:CreateSection({ Name = "Discord Webhook" })
		local want = { Url = "", Enabled = false, RareOnly = true, SpawnNotify = true, SpawnMinRarity = "Secret+", PingUser = false }
		local pushedUrl
		local function toast(msg)
			if type(H.OnToast) == "function" then pcall(H.OnToast, msg) end
		end
		local function sync()
			local cfg = au.WebhookConfig
			if type(cfg) ~= "table" then return end
			cfg.Enabled, cfg.RareOnly, cfg.SpawnNotify = want.Enabled, want.RareOnly, want.SpawnNotify
			cfg.SpawnMinRarity, cfg.PingUser = want.SpawnMinRarity, want.PingUser
			if cfg.Url ~= want.Url then
				cfg.Url = want.Url
				if type(cfg.Push) == "function" then pcall(cfg.Push, want.Url) end
			end
			if pushedUrl ~= want.Enabled and type(au.WebhookSetStolen) == "function" then
				pushedUrl = want.Enabled
				pcall(au.WebhookSetStolen, want.Enabled)
			end
		end
		sec:CreateInput({
			Name = "Webhook URL", Placeholder = "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...", Default = "",
			Callback = function(v) want.Url = string.gsub(tostring(v or ""), "%s", "") sync() end,
		})
		sec:CreateToggle({
			Name = "Enable Steal Logs", Default = false,
			Callback = function(v) want.Enabled = v == true sync() end,
		})
		sec:CreateToggle({
			Name = "Rare Eggs Only", Default = true,
			Callback = function(v) want.RareOnly = v == true sync() end,
		})
		sec:CreateToggle({
			Name = "Rare Spawn Notify", Default = true,
			Callback = function(v) want.SpawnNotify = v == true sync() end,
		})
		sec:CreateDropdown({
			Name = "Min Spawn Rarity", Options = { "Mythic+", "Secret+", "Eternal+", "Divine Only", "All Tiers" }, Default = "Secret+",
			Callback = function(v) want.SpawnMinRarity = tostring(type(v) == "table" and v[1] or v or "Secret+") sync() end,
		})
		sec:CreateToggle({
			Name = "Ping Me On Steal", Default = false,
			Callback = function(v) want.PingUser = v == true sync() end,
		})
		sec:CreateButton({
			Name = "Send Test Webhook",
			Callback = function()
				local url = want.Url
				if url == "" or not string.find(url, "/api/webhooks/", 1, true) then
					toast("Webhook: paste a valid Discord webhook URL first")
					return
				end
				local req = (typeof(syn) == "table" and syn.request) or request or http_request
				if typeof(req) ~= "function" then
					toast("Webhook: your executor has no request function")
					return
				end
				local ok, res = pcall(req, {
					Url = url, Method = "POST", Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
					Body = HttpService:JSONEncode({
						username = "Cat Hub",
						embeds = { {
							title = "Cat Hub webhook connected",
							description = "Test message from " .. tostring(game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Name),
							color = 3840767,
							footer = { text = "Cat Hub - Steal An Egg" },
						} },
					}),
				})
				local code = ok and type(res) == "table" and tonumber(res.StatusCode) or 0
				toast((code >= 200 and code < 300) and "Webhook: test sent" or ("Webhook: failed (" .. tostring(code) .. ")"))
			end,
		})
		task.spawn(function()
			while true do
				task.wait(2)
				pcall(sync)
			end
		end)
	end

	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Diagnostics (what actually loaded)
	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	do
		local misc = H.Window:CreateTab("Misc")
		local sec = misc:CreateSection({ Name = "Diagnostics" })
		local row = sec:CreateText({ Name = "Loaded", Text = "..." })
		task.spawn(function()
			while true do
				task.wait(2)
				pcall(function()
					local counts, order = {}, {}
					for _, rec in ipairs(H.Controls) do
						if counts[rec.Tab] == nil then
							counts[rec.Tab] = 0
							order[#order + 1] = rec.Tab
						end
						counts[rec.Tab] = counts[rec.Tab] + 1
					end
					local parts = {}
					for _, t in ipairs(order) do parts[#parts + 1] = t .. "=" .. counts[t] end
					local flags = {
						"Halloween=" .. tostring(type(au.Halloween) == "table"),
						"Butterfly=" .. tostring(type(au.CustomButterfly) == "table"),
						"Webhook=" .. tostring(type(au.WebhookConfig) == "table"),
					}
					local hw = au.Halloween
					local state = type(hw) == "table" and tostring(hw.State or "") or ""
					row:Set("Controls: " .. table.concat(parts, ", ") .. "\n" .. table.concat(flags, ", ")
						.. (state ~= "" and ("\nHalloween state: " .. state) or "")
						.. (CatHub.LastError and ("\nLast error: " .. tostring(CatHub.LastError)) or ""))
				end)
			end
		end)
	end

	-- generic accessors: CatHub.Get("Auto Steal"), CatHub.Set("Auto Steal", true), CatHub.Press("Server Hop")
	function CatHub.Get(name) return hget(name) end
	function CatHub.Set(name, v) hset(name, v) end
	function CatHub.Press(name)
		local h = handle(name)
		if h and type(h.Fire) == "function" then
			pcall(h.Fire, h)
		end
	end
	function CatHub.HopServer(_mode) CatHub.Press("Server Hop") end
	function CatHub.TryEmptyServer() CatHub.Press("Try An Empty Server") end
	function CatHub.QuickStart()
		-- Instant Steal is NOT switched on here: it teleports and was getting players killed
		local s = au.SafeCarry
		if type(s) == "table" and type(s.ApplyInstantChoice) == "function" and (s.InstantV1 == true or s.InstantV2 == true) then
			pcall(s.ApplyInstantChoice, "Off")
		end
		CatHub.AntiGuard.Enabled = true
		CatHub.Steal.Enabled = true
		CatHub.Place.Enabled = true
		CatHub.Hatch.Enabled = true
		CatHub.Fuse.Enabled = true
		if type(H.OnToast) == "function" then pcall(H.OnToast, "Quick Start: Steal, Anti Guard, Place, Hatch, Fuse on") end
	end

	if type(au.AntiGuard) == "table" then
		au.AntiGuard.ShowPanel = function() end
	end
	pcall(function()
		local g = (typeof(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
		g.CatHub = CatHub
	end)
end

--[[ CAT HUB UI - Part 1/4: primitives (blue + black, responsive, no emoji)
     Usage: local UI = loadstring(...)()  -- returns the UI table
     Order of use: UI.createWindow(...) first (sets UI.Gui), then cards/toggles/etc.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- THEME (exact RGB from spec)

local T = {
	Background    = Color3.fromRGB(6, 10, 18),
	PanelBg       = Color3.fromRGB(8, 12, 22),
