-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ENVIRONMENT / RESPONSIVE HELPERS
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
UI.IsMobile = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled

function UI.Viewport()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if cam then
		return cam.ViewportSize
	end
	return Vector2.new(1280, 720)
end

function UI.IsCloud()
	local vp = UI.Viewport()
	return UI.IsMobile and math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) <= 720
end

-- font size helper: mobile text is bumped 1.2x
function UI.FS(n)
	if UI.IsMobile then
		return math.floor(n * 1.2 + 0.5)
	end
	return n
end

-- sizing table, recomputed on demand (never hardcode)
function UI.Dim()
	local m = UI.IsMobile
	local c = UI.IsCloud()
	return {
		Row = m and 52 or 40,
		Btn = m and 48 or 32,
		Tab = m and 52 or 44,
		DropRow = m and 44 or 32,
		Thumb = c and 28 or (m and 24 or 18),
		Pad = m and 10 or 16,
		Scroll = m and 6 or 3,
		TopBar = m and 64 or 60,
		MinBtn = m and 48 or 44,
	}
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIG PERSISTENCE
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local CONFIG_PATH = "CatHub_ui.json"
UI.Config = { UIOpen = true, PanelWidth = 240, PanelCollapsed = false }

do
	if typeof(isfile) == "function" and typeof(readfile) == "function" then
		local okExists, exists = pcall(isfile, CONFIG_PATH)
		if okExists and exists then
			local ok, data = pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(CONFIG_PATH))
			end)
			if ok and type(data) == "table" then
				for k, v in pairs(data) do
					UI.Config[k] = v
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function UI.SaveConfig()
	if typeof(writefile) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			writefile(CONFIG_PATH, HttpService:JSONEncode(UI.Config))
		end)
	end
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- LOW LEVEL BUILDERS
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function new(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	if props then
		for k, v in pairs(props) do
			o[k] = v
		end
	end
	if parent then
		o.Parent = parent
	end
	return o
end
UI.new = new

local function tween(obj, props, t, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t or 0.18, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end
UI.tween = tween

local function corner(o, r)
	return new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = r >= 1000 and UDim.new(1, 0) or UDim.new(0, r) }, o)
end

local function stroke(o, color, thickness, transparency)
	return new("UIStroke", {
		Color = color,
		Thickness = thickness or 1,
		Transparency = transparency or 0,
		ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
	}, o)
end

local function gradient(o, c0, c1, rotation)
	return new("UIGradient", {
		Color = ColorSequence.new(c0, c1),
		Rotation = rotation or 0,
	}, o)
end

local function pad(o, l, t, r, b)
	return new("UIPadding", {
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, l), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, t),
		PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, r or l), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, b or t),
	}, o)
end

local function debounce(fn, delay)
	local last = 0
	return function(...)
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - last < (delay or 0.15) then
			return
		end
		last = now
		return fn(...)
	end
end
UI.debounce = debounce

function UI.createLabel(parent, text, size, color, font, align)
	return new("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = text,
		TextSize = UI.FS(size or 13),
		TextColor3 = color or T.Text,
		Font = font or Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		TextXAlignment = align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, UI.FS(size or 13) + 6),
	}, parent)
end

function UI.createSection(parent, text, order)
	local l = UI.createLabel(parent, string.upper(text), 11, T.Muted, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
	l.LayoutOrder = order or 0
	return l
end

function UI.createInfoRow(parent, left, right, order)
	local row = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, UI.FS(12) + 6), LayoutOrder = order or 0 }, parent)
	local l = new("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = left, TextSize = UI.FS(12), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		TextColor3 = T.Muted, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0),
	}, row)
	local r = new("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = right, TextSize = UI.FS(12), Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		TextColor3 = T.Text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0),
	}, row)
	return r, l, row
end

-- toast at bottom center
function UI.Toast(text, duration)
	if not UI.Gui then
		return
	end
	local d = UI.Dim()
	local holder = new("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 24),
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, d.Btn), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		BackgroundColor3 = T.SurfaceActive, ZIndex = 40,
	}, UI.Gui)
	corner(holder, 10)
	stroke(holder, T.Accent, 1, 0.5)
	pad(holder, 14, 0)
	new("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = text, TextSize = UI.FS(12), Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		TextColor3 = T.Text, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
	}, holder)
	tween(holder, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -24) }, 0.18)
	task.delay(duration or 1.5, function()
		if holder.Parent then
			tween(holder, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 24) }, 0.18)
			task.delay(0.2, function()
				holder:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end)
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GLASS CARD
-- returns card (put children inside it), holder (layout participant)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function UI.createGlassCard(parent, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local d = UI.Dim()
	local holder = new("Frame", {
		Name = opts.Name or "CardHolder",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		Size = opts.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		LayoutOrder = opts.LayoutOrder or 0,
	}, parent)
	local shadow = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Glow", BackgroundColor3 = T.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.9,
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 3), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 1,
	}, holder)
	corner(shadow, 14)
	table.insert(UI.Shadows, shadow)

	local card = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Card", BackgroundColor3 = T.Surface, BackgroundTransparency = 0.04,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), ZIndex = 2,
	}, holder)
	corner(card, 14)
	local st = stroke(card, T.Accent, 1, 0.6) -- 1px blue border at 40% opacity
	gradient(card, Color3.fromRGB(16, 24, 40), Color3.fromRGB(10, 16, 28), 90) -- single gradient (frosted look)
	pad(card, d.Pad, d.Pad)
	if not opts.NoLayout then
		new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, UI.IsMobile and 6 or 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, card)
	end

	if opts.Hover and not UI.IsMobile then
		card.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			tween(card, { BackgroundColor3 = T.SurfaceHover }, 0.18)
			tween(st, { Transparency = 0.3 }, 0.18)
			tween(shadow, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2) }, 0.18) -- 1px lift
		end)
		card.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			tween(card, { BackgroundColor3 = T.Surface }, 0.18)
			tween(st, { Transparency = 0.6 }, 0.18)
			tween(shadow, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 3) }, 0.18)
		end)
	end
	return card, holder
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BUTTON
-- opts: Text, Callback, Size (UDim2), Style = "primary" | "outline" | "danger", LayoutOrder
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function UI.createButton(parent, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local d = UI.Dim()
	local style = opts.Style or "primary"
	local btn = new("TextButton", {
		Text = opts.Text or "Button",
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextSize = UI.FS(12),
		TextColor3 = T.Text,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		BackgroundColor3 = (style == "primary") and T.Accent or T.Surface,
		Size = opts.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, d.Btn),
		LayoutOrder = opts.LayoutOrder or 0,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
	}, parent)
	corner(btn, 10)
	local st = stroke(btn, style == "danger" and T.Danger or T.Accent, 1, style == "primary" and 1 or 0.4)
	local grad
	if style == "primary" then
		grad = gradient(btn, T.Accent, T.AccentDeep, 90)
	elseif style == "danger" then
		btn.TextColor3 = T.Danger
	end
	local scale = new("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, btn)
	local hovering = false

	if not UI.IsMobile then
		btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			hovering = true
			tween(scale, { Scale = 1.03 }, 0.15)
			tween(st, { Transparency = 0, Color = T.AccentGlow }, 0.15)
			if style ~= "primary" then
				tween(btn, { BackgroundColor3 = T.SurfaceHover }, 0.15)
			end
		end)
		btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			hovering = false
			tween(scale, { Scale = 1 }, 0.15)
			tween(st, { Transparency = style == "primary" and 1 or 0.4, Color = style == "danger" and T.Danger or T.Accent }, 0.15)
			if style ~= "primary" then
				tween(btn, { BackgroundColor3 = T.Surface }, 0.15)
			end
		end)
	end
	btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		tween(scale, { Scale = 0.96 }, 0.1)
		if style ~= "primary" then
			tween(btn, { BackgroundColor3 = T.SurfaceActive }, 0.1)
		end
	end)
	local function release()
		tween(scale, { Scale = hovering and 1.03 or 1 }, 0.1)
		if style ~= "primary" then
			tween(btn, { BackgroundColor3 = hovering and T.SurfaceHover or T.Surface }, 0.1)
		end
	end
	btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(release)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(release)

	local fire = debounce(function()
		if UI.IsMobile then -- glow pulse on tap
			tween(st, { Transparency = 0, Color = T.AccentGlow }, 0.075)
			task.delay(0.075, function()
				tween(st, { Transparency = style == "primary" and 1 or 0.4 }, 0.075)
			end)
		end
		if opts.Callback then
			task.spawn(opts.Callback)
		end
	end, 0.15)
	btn.Activated:Connect(fire)
	return btn
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TOGGLE (full row tappable)
-- opts: Text, Default, Callback(value), LayoutOrder
-- returns { Row, Set(v, silent), Get() }
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function UI.createToggle(parent, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local d = UI.Dim()
	local state = opts.Default == true
	local row = new("TextButton", {
		Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false,
		BackgroundColor3 = T.SurfaceHover, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, d.Row), LayoutOrder = opts.LayoutOrder or 0,
	}, parent)
	corner(row, 10)
	new("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = opts.Text or "Toggle", TextSize = UI.FS(13), Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		TextColor3 = T.Text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 1, 0),
	}, row)

	local pw, ph = UI.IsMobile and 48 or 40, UI.IsMobile and 26 or 22
	local pill = new("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0, pw, 0, ph), BackgroundColor3 = T.Border,
	}, row)
	corner(pill, 1000)
	local glow = stroke(pill, T.AccentGlow, 1, 1)
	local fill = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, pill)
	corner(fill, 1000)
	gradient(fill, T.Accent, T.AccentGlow, 0)
	local ks = ph - 6
	local knob = new("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0, ks, 0, ks), BackgroundColor3 = T.Text, ZIndex = 2,
	}, pill)
	corner(knob, 1000)

	local obj = { Row = row }
	local function render(animate)
		local t = animate and 0.18 or 0
		local pos = state and UDim2.new(1, -(ks + 3), 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0)
		tween(knob, { Position = pos }, t)
		tween(fill, { BackgroundTransparency = state and 0 or 1 }, t)
		tween(glow, { Transparency = state and 0.6 or 1 }, t)
	end
	function obj.Set(v, silent)
		state = v and true or false
		render(true)
		if not silent and opts.Callback then
			task.spawn(opts.Callback, state)
		end
	end
	function obj.Get()
		return state
	end
	render(false)

	if not UI.IsMobile then
		row.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(row, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.4 }, 0.18) end)
		row.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(row, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.18) end)
	end
	row.Activated:Connect(debounce(function() obj.Set(not state) end, 0.15))
	return obj
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SLIDER
-- opts: Text, Min, Max, Default, Step, Suffix, Callback(value)
-- returns { Row, Set(v, silent), Get() }
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function UI.createSlider(parent, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local d = UI.Dim()
	local min, max = opts.Min or 0, opts.Max or 100
	local step = opts.Step or 1
	local value = math.clamp(opts.Default or min, min, max)
	local suffix = opts.Suffix or ""

	local row = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, d.Row + 22), LayoutOrder = opts.LayoutOrder or 0 }, parent)
	new("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = opts.Text or "Slider", TextSize = UI.FS(13), Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		TextColor3 = T.Text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 4), Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, UI.FS(13) + 6),
	}, row)
	local valLbl = new("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextSize = UI.FS(12), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextColor3 = T.AccentGlow,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Position = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 4), Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, UI.FS(13) + 6),
	}, row)

	local trackH = 6
	local hit = new("TextButton", {
		Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Active = true,
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -(d.Thumb + 14)), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, d.Thumb + 10),
	}, row)
	local track = new("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, trackH), BackgroundColor3 = T.SurfaceActive,
	}, hit)
	corner(track, 1000)
	local fill = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) }, track)
	corner(fill, 1000)
	gradient(fill, T.Accent, T.AccentGlow, 0)
	local thumb = new("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0, d.Thumb, 0, d.Thumb), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), ZIndex = 2,
	}, track)
	corner(thumb, 1000)
	stroke(thumb, T.Accent, 2, 0.3)

	local obj = { Row = row }
	local function fmt(v)
		if step >= 1 then
			return tostring(math.floor(v + 0.5)) .. suffix
		end
		return string.format("%.2f", v) .. suffix
	end
	local function render(animate)
		local a = (max == min) and 0 or (value - min) / (max - min)
		local t = animate and 0.08 or 0
		tween(fill, { Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0) }, t)
		tween(thumb, { Position = UDim2.new(a, 0, 0.5, 0) }, t)
		valLbl.Text = fmt(value)
	end
	local function setFromAlpha(a, silent)
		local v = min + math.clamp(a, 0, 1) * (max - min)
		v = math.floor(v / step + 0.5) * step
		v = math.clamp(v, min, max)
		if v ~= value then
			value = v
			render(true)
			if not silent and opts.Callback then
				task.spawn(opts.Callback, value)
			end
		end
	end
	function obj.Set(v, silent)
		value = math.clamp(v, min, max)
		render(false)
		if not silent and opts.Callback then
			task.spawn(opts.Callback, value)
		end
	end
	function obj.Get()
		return value
	end
	render(false)

	local dragging = false
	local function fromInput(input)
		local w = track.AbsoluteSize.X
		if w <= 0 then
			return
		end
		setFromAlpha((input.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / w)
	end
	hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			fromInput(input)
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			fromInput(input)
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false -- keep last value, never snap back
		end
	end)
	return obj
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- DROPDOWN (desktop: inline expand; mobile: centered modal sheet)
-- opts: Text, Options, Default, Multi, Callback(valueOrList)
-- returns { Row, Set(v, silent), Get(), SetOptions(list) }
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function UI.createDropdown(parent, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local d = UI.Dim()
	local multi = opts.Multi == true
	local options = opts.Options or {}
	local sel = {}
	local selected
	if multi then
		for _, v in ipairs(opts.Default or {}) do
			sel[v] = true
		end
	else
		selected = opts.Default or options[1]
	end

	local holder = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), LayoutOrder = opts.LayoutOrder or 0 }, parent)
	new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, holder)

	local header = new("TextButton", {
		Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = T.Surface,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, d.Row), LayoutOrder = 1,
	}, holder)
	corner(header, 10)
	local hs = stroke(header, T.Border, 1, 0.2)
	new("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = opts.Text or "Dropdown", TextSize = UI.FS(13), Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		TextColor3 = T.Text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -12, 1, 0),
	}, header)
	local valueLbl = new("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextSize = UI.FS(12), Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextColor3 = T.AccentGlow,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -12, 1, 0),
	}, header)

	local function getList()
		local out = {}
		for _, o in ipairs(options) do
			if sel[o] then
				table.insert(out, o)
			end
		end
		return out
	end
	local function display(open)
		local arrow = open and " \226\150\178" or " \226\150\188" -- up / down triangle
		if multi then
			local n = #getList()
			valueLbl.Text = (n == 0 and "None" or (n .. " selected")) .. arrow
		else
			valueLbl.Text = tostring(selected or "-") .. arrow
		end
	end
	display(false)

	local obj = { Row = holder }
	local list, sheetDim, sheetList
	local isOpen = false
	local buildRows

	local function emit()
		if opts.Callback then
			task.spawn(opts.Callback, multi and getList() or selected)
		end
	end
	local function closeAll()
		isOpen = false
		if list then list.Visible = false end
		if sheetDim then sheetDim:Destroy() sheetDim = nil sheetList = nil end
		tween(hs, { Color = T.Border }, 0.18)
		display(false)
	end
	local function choose(opt)
		if multi then
			sel[opt] = not sel[opt] or nil
			display(true)
			emit()
			if list and list.Visible then buildRows(list) end
			if sheetList then buildRows(sheetList) end
		else
			selected = opt
			emit()
			closeAll()
		end
	end
	buildRows = function(container)
		for _, c in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("TextButton") then
				c:Destroy()
			end
		end
		for i, opt in ipairs(options) do
			local isSel = multi and sel[opt] or ((not multi) and selected == opt)
			local text = multi and ((isSel and "[x] " or "[ ] ") .. opt) or opt
			local b = new("TextButton", {
				AutoButtonColor = false, Text = text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = UI.FS(13),
				TextColor3 = isSel and T.AccentGlow or T.Text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
				BackgroundColor3 = T.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, d.DropRow), LayoutOrder = i,
			}, container)
			pad(b, 12, 0)
			if not UI.IsMobile then
				b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.8 }, 0.18) end)
				b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.18) end)
			end
			b.Activated:Connect(function() choose(opt) end)
		end
	end

	local function openSheet()
		local gui = UI.Gui
		if not gui then
			return
		end
		sheetDim = new("TextButton", {
			Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 30,
		}, gui)
		sheetDim.Activated:Connect(closeAll)
		local sheet = new("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(0.86, 0, 0.7, 0), BackgroundColor3 = T.Surface, ZIndex = 31,
		}, sheetDim)
		corner(sheet, 14)
		stroke(sheet, T.Accent, 1, 0.4)
		new("UISizeConstraint", { MaxSize = Vector2.new(420, 520) }, sheet)
		pad(sheet, 10, 10)
		new("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = opts.Text or "Select", TextSize = UI.FS(14), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextColor3 = T.Text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30),
		}, sheet)
		sheetList = new("ScrollingFrame", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 34),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -34 - d.Btn - 8), ScrollBarThickness = d.Scroll,
			ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.Accent, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		}, sheet)
		new("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, sheetList)
		buildRows(sheetList)
		local done = UI.createButton(sheet, { Text = multi and "Done" or "Close", Style = "outline", Callback = closeAll })
		done.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		done.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
		done.ZIndex = 32
	end

	header.Activated:Connect(debounce(function()
		if isOpen then
			closeAll()
			return
		end
		isOpen = true
		tween(hs, { Color = T.BorderHover }, 0.18)
		display(true)
		if UI.IsMobile then
			openSheet()
		else
			if not list then
				list = new("Frame", {
					BackgroundColor3 = T.Surface, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), LayoutOrder = 2, Visible = false,
				}, holder)
				corner(list, 10)
				stroke(list, T.Accent, 1, 0.5)
				new("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, list)
			end
			buildRows(list)
			list.Visible = true
		end
	end, 0.15))

	function obj.Set(v, silent)
		if multi then
			sel = {}
			for _, x in ipairs(v or {}) do sel[x] = true end
		else
			selected = v
		end
		display(isOpen)
		if not silent then emit() end
	end
	function obj.Get()
		return multi and getList() or selected
	end
	function obj.SetOptions(list2)
		options = list2 or {}
		if list and list.Visible then buildRows(list) end
		if sheetList then buildRows(sheetList) end
		display(isOpen)
	end
	return obj
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- MINIMIZE BUTTON (top-center, fixed, never draggable)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function detectTopCenterOverlap(ourGui, size)
	local ok, hit = pcall(function()
		local pg = Players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
		if not pg then return false end
		local vp = UI.Viewport()
		local cx = vp.X / 2
		for _, g in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
			if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and g.Enabled and g ~= ourGui then
				for _, o in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do
					if o:IsA("GuiObject") and o.Visible and o.BackgroundTransparency < 0.95 then
						local p, s = o.AbsolutePosition, o.AbsoluteSize
						local top = p.Y + (g.IgnoreGuiInset and 0 or 36)
						if s.X > 8 and s.Y > 8 and s.X < vp.X * 0.9
							and p.X < cx + size / 2 and p.X + s.X > cx - size / 2
							and top < 12 + size and top + s.Y > 12 then
							return true
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end)
	return ok and hit
end

function UI.createMinimizeButton(gui, onClick)
	local d = UI.Dim()
	local size = d.MinBtn
	local y = detectTopCenterOverlap(gui, size) and 40 or 12

	local holder = new("Frame", {
		Name = "MinimizeButton", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, y),
		Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 20,
	}, gui)
	local scale = new("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, holder)

	-- soft shadow (UIStroke cannot offset, so use a dark circle 2px lower)
	local sh = new("Frame", {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.6, ZIndex = 1,
	}, holder)
	corner(sh, 1000)
	-- glow: duplicated image behind at 30% opacity, scaled 1.15
	local glow = new("ImageLabel", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1.15, 0, 1.15, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = MINIMIZE_IMAGE, ImageTransparency = 0.7, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, ZIndex = 2,
	}, holder)
	corner(glow, 1000)
	local circle = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = T.Surface, ZIndex = 3 }, holder)
	corner(circle, 1000)
	local ring = stroke(circle, T.Accent, 2, 0.4)
	local img = new("ImageLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = MINIMIZE_IMAGE, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
	}, circle)
	corner(img, 1000)

	local hit = new("TextButton", {
		Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Active = true, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 4,
	}, holder)
	local hovering = false
	if not UI.IsMobile then
		hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			hovering = true
			tween(scale, { Scale = 1.08 }, 0.15)
			tween(ring, { Color = T.AccentGlow, Transparency = 0 }, 0.15)
		end)
		hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			hovering = false
			tween(scale, { Scale = 1 }, 0.15)
			tween(ring, { Color = T.Accent, Transparency = 0.4 }, 0.15)
		end)
	end
	hit.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() tween(scale, { Scale = 0.92 }, 0.1) end)
	hit.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() tween(scale, { Scale = hovering and 1.08 or 1 }, 0.1) end)
	hit.Activated:Connect(debounce(function()
		if UI.IsMobile then -- tap pulse 0.92 -> 1.0
			tween(scale, { Scale = 0.92 }, 0.1)
			task.delay(0.1, function() tween(scale, { Scale = 1 }, 0.1) end)
		end
		if onClick then onClick() end
	end, 0.15))
	table.insert(UI.Shadows, sh)
	return holder
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- WINDOW  ("Aurora" layout: floating card, glowing rim, pill tab strip)
-- returns { Gui, Pages, AddPage(name), SetTab(name), SetOpen(bool), Toggle(),
--           IsOpen(), Relayout(), Destroy() }
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function parentGui(gui)
	local ok = pcall(function()
		if typeof(gethui) == "function" then
			gui.Parent = gethui()
		else
			gui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
		end
	end)
	if not ok or not gui.Parent then
		gui.Parent = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	end
end

function UI.createWindow(opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local tabNames = opts.Tabs or { "Home" }
	local cfg = UI.Config
	local mobile = UI.IsMobile
	local d = UI.Dim()
	local HEADER_H = mobile and 52 or 56
	local TAB_H = mobile and 46 or 40
	local FOOT_H = mobile and 0 or 24

	local gui = new("ScreenGui", {
		Name = "CatHubUI", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true,
		ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, DisplayOrder = 100,
	})
	parentGui(gui)
	UI.Gui = gui

	local win = { Gui = gui, Pages = {}, Connections = {} }
	local uiOpen = cfg.UIOpen ~= false
	local busy = false
	local currentTab = tabNames[1]
	local pos = nil -- Vector2 top-left, nil = auto-center

	-- shell: glow + scale + root card ------------------------------------------------
	local shell = new("Frame", { Name = "Shell", BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 5, Visible = uiOpen }, gui)
	local scale = new("UIScale", { Scale = uiOpen and 1 or 0.94 }, shell)
	local glow = new("Frame", {
		BackgroundColor3 = T.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.9, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 4),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 1,
	}, shell)
	corner(glow, 18)
	table.insert(UI.Shadows, glow)

	local root = new("CanvasGroup", {
		Name = "Root", BackgroundColor3 = T.Background, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 2,
		GroupTransparency = uiOpen and 0 or 1,
	}, shell)
	corner(root, 16)
	local rim = stroke(root, T.Accent, 1.5, 0.3)
	local rimGrad = new("UIGradient", {
		Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, T.AccentGlow),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, T.AccentDeep),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, T.AccentGlow),
		}),
		Rotation = 30,
	}, rim)

	-- aurora wash at the top (fake frosted glass)
	local wash = new("Frame", {
		BackgroundColor3 = T.AccentDeep, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 170), ZIndex = 1,
	}, root)
	new("UIGradient", {
		Rotation = 90,
		Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
	}, wash)

	-- header ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local header = new("Frame", { Name = "Header", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, HEADER_H), Active = true, ZIndex = 3 }, root)
	local logo = new("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 32),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.7, ZIndex = 3,
	}, header)
	corner(logo, 10)
	gradient(logo, T.AccentGlow, T.AccentDeep, 45)
	new("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = utf8.char(0x1F431), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = UI.FS(20), TextColor3 = T.Text,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 4,
	}, logo)
	new("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "CAT HUB", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = UI.FS(15), TextColor3 = T.Text,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Position = UDim2.new(0, 54, 0, 8), Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, UI.FS(15) + 2), ZIndex = 3,
	}, header)
	new("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "STEAL AN EGG  /  v" .. UI.Version, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = UI.FS(9),
		TextColor3 = T.Muted, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Position = UDim2.new(0, 54, 0, 8 + UI.FS(15) + 4),
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, UI.FS(9) + 2), ZIndex = 3,
	}, header)

	-- window buttons (right)
	local function headBtn(text, xOff, color, fn)
		local b = new("TextButton", {
			Text = text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = UI.FS(15), TextColor3 = T.Muted, AutoButtonColor = false,
			BackgroundColor3 = T.SurfaceHover, BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, xOff, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, d.Btn, 0, d.Btn), ZIndex = 4,
		}, header)
		corner(b, 10)
		if not mobile then
			b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.2 }, 0.15)
				tween(b, { TextColor3 = color }, 0.15)
			end)
			b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
				tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.15)
				tween(b, { TextColor3 = T.Muted }, 0.15)
			end)
		end
		b.Activated:Connect(debounce(fn, 0.15))
		return b
	end
	headBtn("\195\151", -10, T.Danger, function() win.SetOpen(false) end)
	headBtn("\226\148\128", -10 - (d.Btn + 4), T.Accent, function() win.SetOpen(false) end)

	-- live chips
	local function chip(xOff, color)
		local c = new("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundColor3 = T.Surface, Text = "--", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = UI.FS(10), TextColor3 = color,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, xOff, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, UI.FS(64), 0, UI.FS(10) + 12), ZIndex = 4,
		}, header)
		corner(c, 1000)
		stroke(c, color, 1, 0.65)
		return c
	end
	local chipBase = -10 - (d.Btn + 4) * 2 - 6
	local fpsChip = chip(chipBase, T.Accent)
	local pingChip = chip(chipBase - UI.FS(64) - 6, T.Cyan)

	-- tab strip -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local strip = new("ScrollingFrame", {
		Name = "Tabs", BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, HEADER_H),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TAB_H), CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		ScrollBarThickness = 0, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X, ZIndex = 3,
	}, root)
	new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center }, strip)
	pad(strip, 12, 0)

	local divider = new("Frame", {
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, HEADER_H + TAB_H),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), ZIndex = 3,
	}, root)
	new("UIGradient", {
		Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, T.AccentDeep), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, T.Accent), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, T.AccentDeep),
		}),
		Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.15), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
	}, divider)

	local tabs = {}
	for i, name in ipairs(tabNames) do
		local b = new("TextButton", {
			Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, TAB_H - 10), LayoutOrder = i, ZIndex = 4,
		}, strip)
		corner(b, 1000)
		local fill = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 4 }, b)
		corner(fill, 1000)
		gradient(fill, T.Accent, T.AccentDeep, 0)
		local fillStroke = stroke(fill, T.AccentGlow, 1, 1)
		local txt = new("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = name, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = UI.FS(12), TextColor3 = T.Muted,
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 5,
		}, b)
		pad(txt, 16, 0)
		b.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		tabs[name] = { Fill = fill, Text = txt, Stroke = fillStroke, Button = b }
		if not mobile then
			b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				if currentTab ~= name then tween(txt, { TextColor3 = T.Text }, 0.15) end
			end)
			b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
				if currentTab ~= name then tween(txt, { TextColor3 = T.Muted }, 0.15) end
			end)
		end
		b.Activated:Connect(debounce(function() win.SetTab(name) end, 0.15))
	end

	-- body + footer ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local top = HEADER_H + TAB_H + 1
	local body = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Body", BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(top + FOOT_H)), ZIndex = 3,
	}, root)
	if FOOT_H > 0 then
		local foot = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, FOOT_H), ZIndex = 3 }, root)
		new("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "CAT HUB   |   RightShift hides the window", Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 10,
			TextColor3 = T.Muted, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 4,
		}, foot)
	end

	-- layout: size + position belong to the player (drag header, drag corner) -------------
	local MIN_W, MIN_H = 300, 340
	local winW, winH, winX, winY
	local function clampRect(vp)
		winW = math.clamp(winW, MIN_W, math.max(MIN_W, vp.X - 8))
		winH = math.clamp(winH, MIN_H, math.max(MIN_H, vp.Y - 8))
		winX = math.clamp(winX, 0, math.max(0, vp.X - winW))
		winY = math.clamp(winY, 0, math.max(0, vp.Y - 48))
	end
	function win.Relayout()
		local vp = UI.Viewport()
		d = UI.Dim()
		if not winW then
			-- first look is vertical (taller than wide)
			winW = tonumber(cfg.WinW) or (mobile and math.min(vp.X - 12, 360) or 380)
			winH = tonumber(cfg.WinH) or (mobile and (vp.Y - 76) or 560)
			winX = tonumber(cfg.WinX) or math.max(0, (vp.X - winW) / 2)
			winY = tonumber(cfg.WinY) or (mobile and 66 or math.max(64, (vp.Y - winH) / 2 + 24))
		end
		clampRect(vp)
		shell.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(winW, winH)
		shell.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(winX, winY)
		fpsChip.Visible = winW >= 340
		pingChip.Visible = winW >= 480
		for _, p in pairs(win.Pages) do
			p.ScrollBarThickness = d.Scroll
			local pd = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
			if pd then
				pd.PaddingLeft, pd.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, d.Pad), UDim.new(0, d.Pad)
				pd.PaddingTop, pd.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, d.Pad), UDim.new(0, d.Pad)
			end
		end
	end

	-- resize grip (bottom-right corner) ---------------------------------------------------------
	local gripSize = mobile and 44 or 32
	local grip = new("TextButton", {
		Name = "ResizeGrip", Text = "\226\151\162", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = UI.FS(18), TextColor3 = T.Accent,
		TextTransparency = 0.2, AutoButtonColor = false, Active = true, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1), Position = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2), Size = UDim2.new(0, gripSize, 0, gripSize), ZIndex = 20,
	}, root)

	local drag = nil
	local function isPointer(input)
		return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	end
	local function beginDrag(kind, input)
		drag = {
			kind = kind, input = input, start = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y),
			x = winX or 0, y = winY or 0, w = winW or 0, h = winH or 0,
		}
	end
	header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if isPointer(input) then beginDrag("move", input) end
	end)
	grip.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if isPointer(input) then beginDrag("size", input) end
	end)
	win.Connections[#win.Connections + 1] = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not drag then return end
		local t = input.UserInputType
		if t ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and t ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
		if t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and drag.input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input ~= drag.input then return end
		local delta = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - drag.start
		if drag.kind == "move" then
			winX, winY = drag.x + delta.X, drag.y + delta.Y
		else
			winW, winH = drag.w + delta.X, drag.h + delta.Y
		end
		win.Relayout()
	end)
	win.Connections[#win.Connections + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if not drag or not isPointer(input) then return end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and drag.input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input ~= drag.input then return end
		local token = drag
		task.delay(0.1, function() -- 100ms grace so laggy touch releases never snap back
			if drag == token then
				drag = nil
				cfg.WinX, cfg.WinY, cfg.WinW, cfg.WinH = winX, winY, winW, winH
				UI.SaveConfig()
			end
		end)
	end)

	-- pages / tabs -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	function win.AddPage(name)
		local p = new("ScrollingFrame", {
			Name = name, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			ScrollBarThickness = d.Scroll, ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.Accent, Visible = (name == currentTab),
		}, body)
		new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, mobile and 8 or 12), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, p)
		pad(p, d.Pad, d.Pad)
		win.Pages[name] = p
		return p
	end

	function win.SetTab(name)
		if not tabs[name] then
			return
		end
		currentTab = name
		for n, t in pairs(tabs) do
			local on = (n == name)
			tween(t.Fill, { BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1 }, 0.18)
			tween(t.Stroke, { Transparency = on and 0.4 or 1 }, 0.18)
			tween(t.Text, { TextColor3 = on and T.Text or T.Muted }, 0.18)
		end
		for n, p in pairs(win.Pages) do
			p.Visible = (n == name)
		end
		local t = tabs[name]
		if t and t.Button.Parent then
			local target = t.Button.AbsolutePosition.X - strip.AbsolutePosition.X + strip.CanvasPosition.X - 20
			strip.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(math.max(0, target), 0)
		end
		if opts.OnTab then
			task.spawn(opts.OnTab, name)
		end
	end

	-- minimize / restore --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	function win.SetOpen(open)
		if busy or open == uiOpen then
			return
		end
		busy = true
		uiOpen = open
		cfg.UIOpen = open
		UI.SaveConfig()
		if open then
			shell.Visible = true
			scale.Scale = 0.94
			root.GroupTransparency = 1
			tween(scale, { Scale = 1 }, 0.2)
			tween(root, { GroupTransparency = 0 }, 0.15)
		else
			tween(scale, { Scale = 0.94 }, 0.2)
			tween(root, { GroupTransparency = 1 }, 0.15)
			task.delay(0.2, function()
				if not uiOpen then
					shell.Visible = false
				end
			end)
		end
		task.delay(0.1, function()
			busy = false
		end)
	end
	function win.Toggle()
		win.SetOpen(not uiOpen)
	end
	function win.IsOpen()
		return uiOpen
	end

	win.MinimizeButton = UI.createMinimizeButton(gui, function() win.Toggle() end)

	if not mobile then
		win.Connections[#win.Connections + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
			if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
				win.Toggle()
			end
		end)
	end

	-- monitor: FPS, ping, rim shimmer, shadow auto-disable ------------------------------------------------------
	local frames, acc = 0, 0
	win.Connections[#win.Connections + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		frames = frames + 1
		acc = acc + dt
		if uiOpen and UI.Stats.FPS >= 30 then
			rimGrad.Rotation = (rimGrad.Rotation + dt * 20) % 360
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while gui.Parent do
			task.wait(0.5)
			if acc > 0 then
				UI.Stats.FPS = frames / acc
			end
			frames, acc = 0, 0
			local ok, ping = pcall(function()
				return StatsService.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
			end)
			UI.Stats.Ping = ok and ping or UI.Stats.Ping
			fpsChip.Text = math.floor(UI.Stats.FPS + 0.5) .. " FPS"
			if pingChip then
				pingChip.Text = math.floor(UI.Stats.Ping + 0.5) .. " MS"
			end
			local lowFps = UI.Stats.FPS > 0 and UI.Stats.FPS < 30
			for _, s in ipairs(UI.Shadows) do
				if s.Parent then
					s.Visible = not lowFps
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	-- viewport changes ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local function hookCamera()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if cam then
			win.Connections[#win.Connections + 1] = cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function()
				win.Relayout()
			end)
		end
	end
	hookCamera()
	win.Connections[#win.Connections + 1] = workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
		hookCamera()
		win.Relayout()
	end)

	win.Relayout()
	win.SetTab(currentTab)

	if mobile then
		local vp = UI.Viewport()
		if vp.Y > vp.X then
			task.delay(0.5, function()
				UI.Toast("Rotate to landscape for better layout", 3)
			end)
		end
	end

	function win.Destroy()
		for _, c in ipairs(win.Connections) do
			c:Disconnect()
		end
		gui:Destroy()
	end
	return win
end

return UI

end)()
	local T = UI.Theme
	local new, tween = UI.new, UI.tween
	CatHub.Config = UI.Config

	H.Building = true
	local TAB_NAMES = { "Home", "Farm", "Players", "Events", "Visuals", "Webhook", "Misc" }
	local win = UI.createWindow({ Tabs = TAB_NAMES })
	H.Building = false
	H.OnWindowToggle = function(v)
		if v == nil then win.Toggle() else win.SetOpen(v == true) end
	end
	H.OnToast = function(line)
		UI.Toast(tostring(line), 2)
	end

	local function corner(o, r) return new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = r >= 1000 and UDim.new(1, 0) or UDim.new(0, r) }, o) end
	local function stroke(o, c, t, tr) return new("UIStroke", { Color = c, Thickness = t or 1, Transparency = tr or 0, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, o) end

	-- formatting ----------------------------------------------------------------
	local function formatTime(s)
		s = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(s) or 0))
		local h, m, sec = math.floor(s / 3600), math.floor(s % 3600 / 60), s % 60
		if h > 0 then
			return string.format("%dh %dm %ds", h, m, sec)
		end
		return string.format("%dm %ds", m, sec)
	end
	local function formatMoney(n)
		n = tonumber(n) or 0
		local units = { { 1e15, "Qa" }, { 1e12, "T" }, { 1e9, "B" }, { 1e6, "M" }, { 1e3, "K" } }
		for _, u in ipairs(units) do
			if n >= u[1] then
				return string.format("$%.2f%s/s", n / u[1], u[2])
			end
		end
		return string.format("$%d/s", math.floor(n))
	end
	local function spark(samples, maxv, count)
		local out = {}
		local start = math.max(1, #samples - count + 1)
		for i = start, #samples do
			local a = math.clamp((samples[i] or 0) / maxv, 0, 1)
			out[#out + 1] = utf8.char(0x2581 + math.clamp(math.floor(a * 7 + 0.5), 0, 7))
		end
		return table.concat(out)
	end
	local BAR_ON, BAR_OFF = string.rep(utf8.char(0x2501), 10), string.rep(utf8.char(0x2500), 10)

	local function detectExecutor()
		local g = (typeof(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
		if type(g.syn) == "table" and g.syn.request then return "Synapse X" end
		if g.KRNL_LOADED then return "Krnl" end
		if g.is_sirhurt_closure then return "SirHurt" end
		if g.fluxus then return "Fluxus" end
		if g.secure_load and g.getscriptbytecode then return "Script-Ware" end
		if g.Delta and type(g.Delta) == "table" and g.Delta.ExecutorName then return tostring(g.Delta.ExecutorName) end
		if typeof(identifyexecutor) == "function" then
			local ok, n = pcall(identifyexecutor)
			if ok and n then return tostring(n) end
		end
		return "Unknown"
	end

	-- generic input row ---------------------------------------------------------------
	local function createInput(parent, opts)
		local d = UI.Dim()
		local row = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, d.Row), LayoutOrder = opts.LayoutOrder or 0 }, parent)
		new("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = opts.Text or "Input", TextSize = UI.FS(13), Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
			TextColor3 = T.Text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.45, -10, 1, 0),
		}, row)
		local box = new("TextBox", {
			Text = tostring(opts.Default or ""), PlaceholderText = opts.Placeholder or "", ClearTextOnFocus = false,
			BackgroundColor3 = T.Surface, TextColor3 = T.Text, PlaceholderColor3 = T.Muted, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextSize = UI.FS(12), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.55, -8, 0, d.Btn),
		}, row)
		corner(box, 10)
		new("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10) }, box)
		local st = stroke(box, T.Border, 1, 0.2)
		box.Focused:Connect(function() tween(st, { Color = T.BorderHover }, 0.18) end)
		box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			tween(st, { Color = T.Border }, 0.18)
			if opts.Callback then task.spawn(opts.Callback, box.Text) end
		end)
		return { Row = row, Box = box, Set = function(v) if not box:IsFocused() then box.Text = tostring(v or "") end end }
	end

	local function infoText(parent, name, order)
		local holder = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), LayoutOrder = order }, parent)
		new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, holder)
		if name ~= "" then
			new("TextLabel", {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = name, TextSize = UI.FS(12), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextColor3 = T.Text,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, UI.FS(12) + 4), LayoutOrder = 1,
			}, holder)
		end
		local body = new("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", TextSize = UI.FS(11), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextColor3 = T.Muted,
			TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), LayoutOrder = 2,
		}, holder)
		return body
	end

	-- binders keep UI controls in sync with the worker state -----------------------------
	local binders = {}
	local function bind(tab, fn)
		binders[tab] = binders[tab] or {}
		table.insert(binders[tab], fn)
	end

	-- hide controls that only drove the old floating panels
	local HIDE = {
		["Farm HUD"] = true, ["FPS and Ping"] = true, ["FPS and Ping Size"] = true, ["Hide Game UI"] = true,
		["HUD Scale"] = true, ["Showcase Cards"] = true, ["Card Image"] = true, ["Rare Pet Notifications"] = true,
		["Quick Action Bar (Top Right)"] = true, ["Toggle Cat Hub Egg Panel"] = true, ["Egg Checker"] = true,
		["Egg Spawn Analyst"] = true, ["Open Rare Egg Hop UI"] = true, ["Preview Card"] = true,
		["Add/Remove Hits On Quick Bar 2"] = true, ["Discord"] = true, ["Copy Discord Invite"] = true, ["Copy Discord Link"] = true,
	}

	local TABMAP = {
		Farm = "Farm", ["Steal Players"] = "Players", ["Admin Abuse"] = "Players", Event = "Events",
		Visuals = "Visuals", Discord = "skip", CatHubWebhook = "Webhook", Player = "Misc", Server = "Misc", Predictor = "Misc", Log = "Misc", Misc = "Misc",
	}

	local function renderControl(card, rec, order)
		local h = rec.Handle
		local tabKey = rec.__ui
		if rec.Kind == "toggle" then
			local t = UI.createToggle(card, { Text = rec.Name, Default = h:Get() == true, LayoutOrder = order, Callback = function(v) h:Set(v) end })
			bind(tabKey, function() local v = h:Get() == true if t.Get() ~= v then t.Set(v, true) end end)
		elseif rec.Kind == "slider" then
			local s = UI.createSlider(card, {
				Text = rec.Name, Min = rec.Min, Max = rec.Max, Step = rec.Step, Default = h:Get(),
				Suffix = rec.Unit and (" " .. tostring(rec.Unit)) or "", LayoutOrder = order, Callback = function(v) h:Set(v) end,
			})
			bind(tabKey, function() local v = tonumber(h:Get()) if v and s.Get() ~= v then s.Set(v, true) end end)
		elseif rec.Kind == "dropdown" or rec.Kind == "multi" then
			local multi = rec.Kind == "multi"
			local dd = UI.createDropdown(card, {
				Text = rec.Name, Options = rec.Options or {}, Multi = multi, Default = h:Get(), LayoutOrder = order,
				Callback = function(v) h:Set(v) end,
			})
			local lastCount = #(rec.Options or {})
			bind(tabKey, function()
				if #(rec.Options or {}) ~= lastCount then
					lastCount = #(rec.Options or {})
					dd.SetOptions(rec.Options)
				end
				if not multi and dd.Get() ~= h:Get() then dd.Set(h:Get(), true) end
			end)
		elseif rec.Kind == "button" then
			UI.createButton(card, { Text = rec.Name, Style = "outline", LayoutOrder = order, Callback = function() h:Fire() end })
		elseif rec.Kind == "input" then
			local inp = createInput(card, { Text = rec.Name, Default = h:Get(), LayoutOrder = order, Callback = function(v) h:Set(v) end })
			bind(tabKey, function() inp.Set(h:Get()) end)
		else -- text / label
			local body = infoText(card, rec.Name, order)
			bind(tabKey, function() local v = tostring(h:Get() or "") if body.Text ~= v then body.Text = v end end)
			body.Text = tostring(h:Get() or "")
		end
	end

	-- build generated tabs ----------------------------------------------------------------
	local pages = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(TAB_NAMES) do
		pages[name] = win.AddPage(name)
	end

	-- controls can register at any time (some modules finish loading late), so the
	-- generated tabs are filled incrementally instead of once
	local rendered, cardsByKey = 0, {}
	local function renderPending()
		while rendered < #H.Controls do
			rendered = rendered + 1
			local rec = H.Controls[rendered]
			if not HIDE[rec.Name] then
				local ui = TABMAP[rec.Tab] or "Misc"
				local page = pages[ui]
				if ui ~= "skip" and page then
					rec.__ui = ui
					local key = ui .. "|" .. rec.Tab .. "|" .. rec.Section
					local card = cardsByKey[key]
					if not card then
						card = UI.createGlassCard(page, { LayoutOrder = rec.Order })
						local title = rec.Section ~= "" and rec.Section or rec.Tab
						if ui == "Misc" or ui == "Players" then
							title = (rec.Tab ~= "Misc" and (rec.Tab .. " / ") or "") .. title
						end
						UI.createSection(card, title, 0)
						cardsByKey[key] = card
						local wait = page:FindFirstChild("Waiting")
						if wait then wait:Destroy() end
					end
					local ok, err = pcall(renderControl, card, rec, rec.Order)
					if not ok then warn("[Cat Hub] UI build failed for " .. rec.Name .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function buildGeneratedTabs()
		for _, name in ipairs({ "Farm", "Players", "Events", "Visuals", "Webhook" }) do
			local l = UI.createLabel(pages[name], "Loading controls...", 12, T.Muted, Enum.Font.Gotham)
			l.Name, l.LayoutOrder = "Waiting", -1
		end
		renderPending()
	end

		local function setVital(v, number, formatter)
			if v.Last == number then
				return
			end
			v.Last = number
			table.insert(v.Samples, number)
			if #v.Samples > 3 then table.remove(v.Samples, 1) end
			local mx = 1
			for _, s in ipairs(v.Samples) do mx = math.max(mx, s) end
			v.Spark.Text = spark(v.Samples, mx, 3)
			if v.Conn then v.Conn:Disconnect() end
			v.Conn = v.Num.Changed:Connect(function(x) v.Value.Text = formatter(x) end)
			tween(v.Num, { Value = number }, 0.3)
			tween(v.Stroke, { Transparency = 0 }, 0.1)
			task.delay(0.15, function() tween(v.Stroke, { Transparency = 0.55 }, 0.18) end)
		end

				plLbl.Text = string.format("PLAYERS: %d/%d", #Players:GetPlayers(), Players.MaxPlayers)
				srvLbl.Text = "Server Uptime: " .. formatTime(workspace.DistributedGameTime)
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
		end)

			end
		end)

	-- MISC EXTRA: config profiles ------------------------------------------------------------
	local function buildProfiles()
		local page = pages.Misc
		local card = UI.createGlassCard(page, { LayoutOrder = 0 })
		UI.createSection(card, "Config profiles", 0)
		local DIR = "CatHub/profiles"
		local nameVal = "default"
		local function ensureDir()
			pcall(function()
				if typeof(makefolder) == "function" then
					if not isfolder("CatHub") then makefolder("CatHub") end
					if not isfolder(DIR) then makefolder(DIR) end
				end
			end)
		end
		local function listProfiles()
			local out = {}
			pcall(function()
				for _, f in ipairs(listfiles(DIR)) do
					local n = string.match(tostring(f), "([^/\\]+)%.json$")
					if n then out[#out + 1] = n end
				end
			end)
			table.sort(out)
			return out
		end
		local inp = createInput(card, { Text = "Profile name", Default = nameVal, LayoutOrder = 1, Callback = function(v) nameVal = (string.gsub(v, "[^%w_%-]", "")) end })
		local dd = UI.createDropdown(card, { Text = "Saved profiles", Options = listProfiles(), Default = nil, LayoutOrder = 2, Callback = function(v) if v then nameVal = v inp.Set(v) end end })
		local function refreshList() dd.SetOptions(listProfiles()) end
		local row = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, UI.Dim().Btn), LayoutOrder = 3 }, card)
		new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, row)
		local w = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -4, 1, 0)
		UI.createButton(row, { Text = "Save", Size = w, LayoutOrder = 1, Callback = function()
			ensureDir()
			local snap = {}
			for _, rec in ipairs(H.Controls) do
				if rec.Kind == "toggle" or rec.Kind == "slider" or rec.Kind == "dropdown" or rec.Kind == "multi" or rec.Kind == "input" then
					snap[rec.Tab .. "/" .. rec.Section .. "/" .. rec.Name] = rec.Handle:Get()
				end
			end
			local ok = pcall(function() writefile(DIR .. "/" .. nameVal .. ".json", game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(snap)) end)
			UI.Toast(ok and ("Saved profile " .. nameVal) or "Could not save profile", 1.5)
			refreshList()
		end })
		UI.createButton(row, { Text = "Load", Style = "outline", Size = w, LayoutOrder = 2, Callback = function()
			local ok, data = pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile(DIR .. "/" .. nameVal .. ".json")) end)
			if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then UI.Toast("Profile not found", 1.5) return end
			for _, rec in ipairs(H.Controls) do
				local v = data[rec.Tab .. "/" .. rec.Section .. "/" .. rec.Name]
				if v ~= nil and rec.Kind ~= "button" and rec.Kind ~= "text" and rec.Kind ~= "label" then pcall(rec.Handle.Set, rec.Handle, v) end
			end
			UI.Toast("Loaded profile " .. nameVal, 1.5)
		end })
		UI.createButton(row, { Text = "Delete", Style = "danger", Size = w, LayoutOrder = 3, Callback = function()
			pcall(function() delfile(DIR .. "/" .. nameVal .. ".json") end)
			UI.Toast("Deleted profile " .. nameVal, 1.5)
			refreshList()
		end })
	end

	-- boot ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	for _, step in ipairs({ buildHome, buildGeneratedTabs, buildProfiles }) do
		local ok, err = pcall(step)
		if not ok then
			CatHub._Report("UI section failed: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while win.Gui.Parent do
			task.wait(0.5)
			pcall(renderPending)
			if win.IsOpen() then
				for _, key in ipairs({ "Home", "Farm", "Players", "Events", "Visuals", "Webhook", "Misc" }) do
					local list = binders[key]
					if list and pages[key] and pages[key].Visible then
						for _, fn in ipairs(list) do pcall(fn) end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	win.SetTab("Home")
	CatHub.Window = win
	CatHub.UI = UI
end
end

				ba = true
				local h = pcall(function()
					f.Health = g
				end)
				ba = false
				return h and f.Health >= g
			end
			local function f(g)
				if g == a7 and g and g.Parent then return true end
				bd()
				if not g or not g:IsA("Humanoid") or not g.Parent then return false end
				a7 = g
				a8 = {
					BreakJointsOnDeath = g.BreakJointsOnDeath,
					RequiresNeck = g.RequiresNeck,
					DeadEnabled = g:GetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead),
				}
				if not be(g) then
					bd()
					return false
				end
				e(g)
				a9[#a9 + 1] = g.HealthChanged:Connect(function()
					e(g)
				end)
				a9[#a9 + 1] = g:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MaxHealth"):Connect(function()
					e(g)
				end)
				a9[#a9 + 1] = g.StateChanged:Connect(function(h, i)
					if i == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead and not aL.Paused then
						be(g)
						e(g)
					end
				end)
				bb = os.clock()
				return true
			end
			local function g()
				local h = aj.Character
				return h and h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
			end
			local h = aj.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
				task.defer(function()
					f(g())
				end)
			end)
			local i = af.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				local i = os.clock()
				if aL.Paused or i - bb < a6 then return end
				bb = i
				local j = g()
				if j ~= a7 then
					f(j)
					return
				end
				if j then
					be(j)
					e(j)
				end
			end)
			task.defer(function()
				f(g())
			end)
			ap(function()
				if h then
					h:Disconnect()
				end
				if i then
					i:Disconnect()
				end
				bd()
			end)
		end

		local _ownerToPriorityKey = {
			steal = "StealTop",
			place = "Place",

		au.RaceRank = function(ownerName)
			local prio = au.Priority or au.TaskPriority
			if ownerName == nil or type(prio) ~= "table" or type(prio.Rank) ~= "table" then return nil end
			if ownerName == "capture" then return 0 end
			local key = _ownerToPriorityKey[ownerName]
			if not key then return 99 end
			local rankVal = (key == "StealTop" and type(prio.StealTop) == "function" and prio.StealTop()) or prio.Rank[key] or prio.Rank.StealFilter or 99
			if ownerName == "steal" then
				if type(au.Steal) == "table" and au.Steal.WantedRank then
					rankVal = au.Steal.WantedRank
				end
				if type(au.StealWantNow) == "function" then
					local wantNow = au.StealWantNow()
					if wantNow and wantNow < (rankVal or 99) then
						rankVal = wantNow
					end
				end
			end
			return rankVal or 99
		end
		au.StealDawn = function(vsRank)
			if au.Movement.StealFirst ~= true or au.IsNight() or au.WallSealed() then return false end
			local prio = au.Priority or au.TaskPriority
			if type(prio) ~= "table" or type(prio.Rank) ~= "table" then return false end
			local st = au.Steal or {}
			if st.WispOnly == true then return (prio.Rank.StealWisp or 99) < (vsRank or 99) end
			if st.Wanted ~= true and st.Active ~= true then return false end
			local topRank = st.WantedRank or st.TargetRank or (type(prio.StealTop) == "function" and prio.StealTop()) or prio.Rank.StealFilter or 99
			return topRank < (vsRank or 99)
		end
		au.FieldOpensIn = function()
			local cyc = am.AreaEggCycle
			local nowSrv = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			if type(cyc) == "table" then
				local ok, isNight, nextReset = pcall(function()
					return cyc.IsNightPhase(nowSrv), cyc.NextResetTime(nowSrv)
				end)
				if ok and isNight == true and type(nextReset) == "number" then
					au.FieldOpenAt = nextReset + au.WallOpenDelay()
				end
			end
			if au.WallSealed() then return math.max((au.FieldOpenAt or nowSrv) - nowSrv, 0.3) end
			local rem = (au.FieldOpenAt or 0) - nowSrv
			return rem > 0 and rem or 0
		end
		au.WaitFieldOpen = function(cancelFn, reportFn)
			local waitedAny = false
			while not (cancelFn and cancelFn()) do
				local rem = au.FieldOpensIn()
				if rem <= 0 then
					if waitedAny then
						task.wait(1)
					end
					return true
				end
				waitedAny = true
				if reportFn then
					reportFn(au.IsNight() and string.format("waiting for night to end (%.0fs)", rem) or string.format("waiting for the field wall to open (%.0fs)", rem))
				end
				task.wait(math.min(rem, 0.5))
			end
			return false
		end
		au.StepTo = function(goalFn, cancelFn, reportFn)
			if type(au.UndoSwap) == "function" then
				pcall(au.UndoSwap)
			end
			local startRoot = au.Root()
			if not startRoot then return false end
			local curPos = startRoot.Position
			local lagBackCount = 0
			local holdUntil = 0
			local deadline = os.clock() + 25
			while os.clock() < deadline and not (cancelFn and cancelFn()) do
				local rNow = au.Root()
				if not rNow then return false end
				local goalPos = type(goalFn) == "function" and goalFn() or goalFn
				if not goalPos then return false end
				if (rNow.Position - goalPos).Magnitude <= 12 then
					pcall(function()
						rNow.CFrame = CFrame.new(goalPos) * rNow.CFrame.Rotation
						rNow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						rNow.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
					return true
				end
				if os.clock() < holdUntil then
					pcall(function()
						rNow.CFrame = CFrame.new(curPos) * rNow.CFrame.Rotation
						rNow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						rNow.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
					af.Heartbeat:Wait()
					curPos = rNow.Position
					continue
				end
				if (rNow.Position - curPos).Magnitude > 25 then
					lagBackCount += 1
					if lagBackCount >= 4 then return false end
					holdUntil = os.clock() + 0.1 + 0.08 * lagBackCount
					curPos = rNow.Position
					if reportFn then
						reportFn(string.format("lagged back, waiting (%d/4)", lagBackCount))
					end
					continue
				end
				local maxStep = math.max(18, 42 * (0.75 ^ lagBackCount))
				local diff = goalPos - curPos
				local dist = diff.Magnitude
				curPos = dist <= maxStep and goalPos or (curPos + diff.Unit * maxStep)
				local flatDiff = Vector3.new(diff.X, 0, diff.Z)
				local rot = flatDiff.Magnitude > 0.05 and CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, flatDiff.Unit) or rNow.CFrame.Rotation
				pcall(function()
					rNow.CFrame = CFrame.new(curPos) * rot
					rNow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					rNow.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end)
				if reportFn then
					reportFn(math.floor(dist + 0.5))
				end
				af.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
			return false
		end
		au.GlideTo = function(goalFn, cancelFn, stopDist, reportFn, maxTime)
			if type(au.UndoSwap) == "function" then
				pcall(au.UndoSwap)
			end
			stopDist = stopDist or 12
			local startRoot = au.Root()
			if not startRoot then return false end
			local curPos = startRoot.Position
			local lagBackCount = 0
			local holdUntil = 0
			local deadline = os.clock() + (maxTime or 60)
			while os.clock() < deadline and not (cancelFn and cancelFn()) do
				local rNow = au.Root()
				if not rNow then return false end
				local goalPos = type(goalFn) == "function" and goalFn() or goalFn
				if not goalPos then return false end
				local dist = (rNow.Position - goalPos).Magnitude
				if dist <= stopDist then
					pcall(function()
						rNow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						rNow.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
					return true
				end
				local dt = math.min(af.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
				rNow = au.Root()
				if not rNow then return false end
				if os.clock() < holdUntil then
					pcall(function()
						rNow.CFrame = CFrame.new(curPos) * rNow.CFrame.Rotation
						rNow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						rNow.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
					curPos = rNow.Position
					continue
				end
				if (rNow.Position - curPos).Magnitude > 25 then
					lagBackCount += 1
					holdUntil = os.clock() + math.min(0.25 + 0.25 * lagBackCount, 1)
					curPos = rNow.Position
					if reportFn then
						reportFn(string.format("lagged back, waiting a moment (%d)", lagBackCount))
					end
					continue
				end
				local spd = 250 * (lagBackCount < 2 and 1 or math.max(0.5, 0.8 ^ (lagBackCount - 1)))
				local diff = goalPos - curPos
				local stepD = spd * dt
				curPos = diff.Magnitude <= stepD and goalPos or (curPos + diff.Unit * stepD)
				local flatDiff = Vector3.new(diff.X, 0, diff.Z)
				local rot = flatDiff.Magnitude > 0.05 and CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, flatDiff.Unit) or rNow.CFrame.Rotation
				pcall(function()
					rNow.CFrame = CFrame.new(curPos) * rot
					rNow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					rNow.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end)
				if reportFn then
					reportFn(math.floor(dist + 0.5))
				end
			end
			return false
		end
		do
			local function findGuardRoot(areaName)
				local world = workspace:FindFirstChild("World") or workspace:FindFirstChild("__OBJECTS")
				local areas = world and world:FindFirstChild("Areas")
				local guardAreas = areas and areas:FindFirstChild("GuardAreas")
				local areaFolder = guardAreas and type(areaName) == "string" and guardAreas:FindFirstChild(areaName) or nil
				local guardModel = areaFolder and areaFolder:FindFirstChild("Guard")
				local hrp = guardModel and guardModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart", true)
				if hrp and hrp:IsA("BasePart") then return hrp end
				return nil
			end
			local function findClosestFieldEggForJump(fromPos, skipMap)
				local eggState = am.EggState
				if type(eggState) ~= "table" or type(eggState.ReadFieldEggs) ~= "function" then return nil end
				local ok, res = pcall(eggState.ReadFieldEggs)
				local records = ok and type(res) == "table" and res.Records or nil
				if type(records) ~= "table" then return nil end
				local myFirstPrefix = "FirstAreaEgg_" .. tostring(aj.UserId)
				local anyFirstPrefix = "FirstAreaEgg_"
				local slotsFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("AreaEggSlotsClient")
				local bestModelDist, bestModelEntry = math.huge, nil
				local bestAnyDist, bestAnyEntry = math.huge, nil
				for k, rec in pairs(records) do
					local uid = type(rec) == "table" and (rec.Uid or k) or nil
					if type(uid) == "string" and not (uid == skipMap or (type(skipMap) == "table" and skipMap[uid])) and typeof(rec.BottomCFrame) == "CFrame" and rec.State ~= "Carried" then
						local slotId = nil
						if string.sub(uid, 1, 13) == anyFirstPrefix then
							if string.sub(uid, 1, #myFirstPrefix) == myFirstPrefix then
								slotId = string.match(uid, "_([%w ]+:Slot_%d+)$")
							end
						elseif type(rec.AreaId) == "string" and type(rec.NestId) == "string" then
							slotId = rec.AreaId .. ":" .. rec.NestId
						end
						local guardPart = slotId and findGuardRoot(rec.AreaId) or nil
						if slotId and not guardPart and string.sub(uid, 1, #myFirstPrefix) == myFirstPrefix then
							guardPart = findGuardRoot("Forest")
						end
						if slotId and guardPart and (rec.State == nil or rec.State == "Slot" or rec.State == "Dropped") then
							local pos = rec.BottomCFrame.Position
							local slotModel = slotsFolder and slotsFolder:FindFirstChild(uid) or nil
							if slotModel and slotModel:IsA("Model") then
								local okP, piv = pcall(function()
									return slotModel:GetPivot().Position
								end)
								if okP and typeof(piv) == "Vector3" then
									pos = Vector3.new(piv.X, math.min(piv.Y, pos.Y + 6), piv.Z)
								end
							end
							local flatDist = Vector3.new(pos.X - fromPos.X, 0, pos.Z - fromPos.Z).Magnitude
							local entry = { Uid = uid, Slot = slotId, Guard = guardPart, At = pos }
							if slotModel and flatDist < bestModelDist then
								bestModelDist, bestModelEntry = flatDist, entry
							end
							if flatDist < bestAnyDist then
								bestAnyDist, bestAnyEntry = flatDist, entry
							end
						end
					end
				end
				return bestModelEntry or bestAnyEntry
			end
			local function isHoldingEggUid(uid)
				if au.Steal and au.Steal.Carrying and au.Steal.CarryUid == uid then return true end
				if au.Steal and type(au.Steal.HeldByMe) == "function" then
					local ok, held = pcall(au.Steal.HeldByMe)
					if ok and held == true then return true end
				end
				return false
			end
			local function snapRootTo(pos)
				local rNow = au.Root()
				if not rNow then return false end
				pcall(function()
					rNow.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * rNow.CFrame.Rotation
					rNow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					rNow.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end)
				return true
			end
			au.RagdollTravel = function(goalFn, cancelFn)
				local rNow = au.Root()
				if not rNow or type(goalFn) ~= "function" then return false, "no character" end
				if not findClosestFieldEggForJump(rNow.Position, nil) then return false, "no egg to start the jump" end
				local strikeRem = aq and aq:FindFirstChild("RE/GuardPatrol/ForestStrike")
				if not strikeRem or not strikeRem:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return false, "no guard strike" end
				local eggState = am.EggState
				local skipMap = {}
				local pickedEgg = nil
				for _ = 1, 3 do
					local cand = findClosestFieldEggForJump((au.Root() or rNow).Position, skipMap)
					if not cand or (cancelFn and cancelFn()) then break end
					local hoverAt = cand.At + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
					local elapsed = 0
					while not isHoldingEggUid(cand.Uid) and elapsed < 2.5 and not (cancelFn and cancelFn()) do
						snapRootTo(hoverAt)
						local okC, resC, msgC = pcall(eggState.CarryFieldEgg, cand.Uid, cand.Slot)
						if okC and resC ~= true and type(msgC) == "string" and elapsed > 0.4 and not string.find(string.lower(msgC), "closer", 1, true) then break end
						elapsed += task.wait()
					end
					if isHoldingEggUid(cand.Uid) then
						pickedEgg = cand
						break
					end
					skipMap[cand.Uid] = true
				end
				if not pickedEgg then return false, "no egg would come for the jump" end
				local landed = false
				local ag = au.AntiGuard
				if type(ag) == "table" then
					ag.HitArms = (ag.HitArms or 0) + 1
					ag.HitArmedAt = os.clock()
				end
				local ragConn = aj:GetAttributeChangedSignal("RagdollEndTime"):Connect(function()
					local ragEnd = tonumber(aj:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")) or 0
					if landed or ragEnd <= workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then return end
					local gPos = goalFn()
					if gPos then
						landed = true
						snapRootTo(gPos)
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					strikeRem:FireServer({ EggUid = pickedEgg.Uid, GuardCFrame = pickedEgg.Guard.CFrame })
				end)
				local waited = 0
				while not landed and waited < 3 and not (cancelFn and cancelFn()) do
					waited += task.wait()
				end
				ragConn:Disconnect()
				if type(ag) == "table" then
					ag.HitArms = math.max(0, (ag.HitArms or 1) - 1)
				end
				if isHoldingEggUid(pickedEgg.Uid) and type(eggState.DropFieldEgg) == "function" then
					pcall(eggState.DropFieldEgg, "PlayerRequest")
				end
				if not landed then return false, "the guard strike did not land" end
				while (tonumber(aj:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")) or 0) > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() and not (cancelFn and cancelFn()) do
					local gPos = goalFn()
					if gPos then
						snapRootTo(gPos)
					end
					af.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end
				return true, "landed"
			end
		end

		au.Shield("load", true)
		au.Toggle = function(a8, a9)
			if type(a8) ~= "table" then return a9 == true end
			local el = rawget(a8, "_el")
			if type(el) == "table" then
				local g = rawget(el, "Get")
				if type(g) == "function" then
					local ok, v = pcall(g, el)
					if ok and type(v) == "boolean" then return v end
				end
			end
			local ctrl = rawget(a8, "_controller")
			if type(ctrl) == "table" then
				local gv = rawget(ctrl, "GetValue")
				if type(gv) == "function" then
					local ok, v = pcall(gv)
					if ok and type(v) == "boolean" then return v end
				end
			end
			local fn = rawget(a8, "Get") or rawget(a8, "GetValue")
			if type(fn) == "function" then
				local ok, v = pcall(fn, a8)
				if ok and type(v) == "boolean" then return v end
			end
			return a9 == true
		end
		au.EventLock = {
			Flags = {},
			Runtime = {},
			Seen = {},
			Checks = {},
			Set = function(name, on)
				local key = tostring(name)
				au.EventLock.Flags[key] = on == true
				if on ~= true then
					if au.EventLock.Runtime[key] == true then
						au.EventLock.Live(key, false)
					end
					au.EventLock.Runtime[key] = nil
					au.EventLock.Seen[key] = nil
				end
				au.EventLock.Scan()
				if type(au.EventLockStatus) == "function" then
					pcall(au.EventLockStatus)
				end
			end,
			Register = function(name, check)
				if type(check) == "function" then
					au.EventLock.Checks[tostring(name)] = check
				end
			end,
			Touch = function(name)
				au.EventLock.Seen[tostring(name)] = os.clock()
			end,
			Armed = function()
				for _, on in pairs(au.EventLock.Flags) do
					if on == true then return true end
				end
				return false
			end,
			Check = function(name)
				local key = tostring(name)
				if au.EventLock.Flags[key] ~= true then return false end
				local check = au.EventLock.Checks[key]
				if type(check) == "function" then
					local ok, live = pcall(check)
					if ok and live == true then return true end
				end
				local seen = tonumber(au.EventLock.Seen[key])
				if seen ~= nil and os.clock() - seen <= 20 then return true end
				return false
			end,
			Scan = function()
				for name, armed in pairs(au.EventLock.Flags) do
					if armed == true then
						au.EventLock.Live(name, au.EventLock.Check(name) == true)
					elseif au.EventLock.Runtime[name] == true then
						au.EventLock.Live(name, false)
					end
				end
				if au.EventLock.Active() then
					au.EventLock.Enforce()
				end
			end,
			Active = function()
				for _, live in pairs(au.EventLock.Runtime) do
					if live == true then return true end
				end
				return false
			end,
			Live = function(name, on)
				local key = tostring(name)
				local was = au.EventLock.Runtime[key] == true
				local now = on == true
				if was == now then return end
				au.EventLock.Runtime[key] = now
				if now then
					local changed = au.EventLock.Enforce()
					if type(au.Notify) == "function" then
						local detail = type(changed) == "table" and #changed > 0 and ("turned off " .. table.concat(changed, " + ") .. ". ") or ""
						pcall(au.Notify, "Event Lock", key .. " has started - " .. detail .. "Auto Steal and Instant Steal stay locked until the event ends.")
					end
				else
					au.EventLock.Restore()
					if type(au.Notify) == "function" then
						local reason = au.EventLock.Flags[key] == true and " has ended" or " automation is off"
						pcall(au.Notify, "Event Lock", key .. reason .. " - your steal features are unlocked again.")
					end
				end
				if type(au.EventLockStatus) == "function" then
					pcall(au.EventLockStatus)
				end
			end,
			Restore = function()
				if au.EventLock.WasAutoSteal == true then
					au.EventLock.WasAutoSteal = false
					local steal = au.AutoStealHandle
					if type(steal) == "table" and au.Toggle(steal, false) ~= true and type(steal.Set) == "function" then
						pcall(steal.Set, steal, true)
						if type(au.Notify) == "function" then
							pcall(au.Notify, "Event Lock", "Auto Steal is back on - it was on before the event started.")
						end
					end
				end
				local wasInstant = au.EventLock.WasInstant
				au.EventLock.WasInstant = nil
				if wasInstant ~= nil and tostring(wasInstant) ~= "Off" then
					local drop = type(au.SafeCarry) == "table" and au.SafeCarry.InstantSelect or nil
					if type(drop) == "table" and type(drop.Set) == "function" then
						local current = "Off"
						if type(drop.Get) == "function" then
							pcall(function()
								current = tostring(drop:Get() or "Off")
							end)
						end
						if current == "Off" then
							pcall(drop.Set, drop, wasInstant, false)
							if type(au.Notify) == "function" then
								pcall(au.Notify, "Event Lock", "Instant Steal is back on " .. tostring(wasInstant) .. " - it was on before the event started.")
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end,
			Revert = function(what)
				task.defer(function()
					if tostring(what) == "Instant Steal" then
						local drop = type(au.SafeCarry) == "table" and au.SafeCarry.InstantSelect or nil
						if type(drop) == "table" and type(drop.Set) == "function" then
							pcall(drop.Set, drop, "Off", false)
						end
					else
						local steal = au.AutoStealHandle
						if type(steal) == "table" and type(steal.Set) == "function" then
							pcall(steal.Set, steal, false)
						end
					end
				end)
			end,
			Block = function(what)
				if type(au.Notify) == "function" then
					pcall(au.Notify, "Event Lock", tostring(what) .. " cannot be turned on while an auto event is running. Turn the event automation off first.")
				end
				au.EventLock.Revert(what)
			end,
			Enforce = function()
				local changed = {}
				local steal = au.AutoStealHandle
				if type(steal) == "table" and au.Toggle(steal, false) == true then
					au.EventLock.WasAutoSteal = true
					pcall(steal.Set, steal, false)
					changed[#changed + 1] = "Auto Steal"
				end
				local drop = type(au.SafeCarry) == "table" and au.SafeCarry.InstantSelect or nil
				if type(drop) == "table" and type(drop.Get) == "function" then
					local current = "Off"
					pcall(function()
						current = tostring(drop:Get() or "Off")
					end)
					if current ~= "Off" then
						au.EventLock.WasInstant = current
						pcall(drop.Set, drop, "Off", false)
						changed[#changed + 1] = "Instant Steal"
					end
				end
				return changed
			end,
	}

			local a9 = a8()

		au.Plot = function()
			local a9 = au.OwnPlot()
			if a9 then return a9 end
			local ba = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
			local bb = a8()
			if not ba or not bb then return nil end
			local bc = math.huge
			local bd = nil
			for be, e in ipairs(ba:GetChildren()) do
				local f, g, h = pcall(function()
					return e:GetBoundingBox()
				end)
				if f and g and h then
					local i = g:PointToObjectSpace(bb)
					local j = h.X / 2
					local k = math.abs(i.X) <= j
					if k then
						local l = h.Z / 2
						k = math.abs(i.Z) <= l
					end
					if k then return e end
					local l = (g.Position - bb).Magnitude
					if l < bc then
						bd = e
						bc = l
					end
				end
			end
			if bd and bc <= 60 then return bd end
			return nil
		end
