		au.PlotBelt = function()

			au.TreadmillStateReset = function(cancelFn)
				local function isCancelled()
					return type(cancelFn) == "function" and cancelFn() == true
				end
				local wore = false
				local deadline = os.clock() + 0.7
				while not isCancelled() and os.clock() < deadline do
					local ok, res = au.InvokeWearStill()
					if ok and res ~= false then
						wore = true
						break
					end
					task.wait(0.08)
				end
				if wore then
					local holdUntil = os.clock() + 0.25
					while not isCancelled() and os.clock() < holdUntil do
						task.wait(0.05)
					end
				end
				local doffed = false
				local doffDeadline = os.clock() + 0.7
				while not isCancelled() and os.clock() < doffDeadline do
					local ok, res = au.InvokeDoff()
					if ok and res ~= false then
						doffed = true
						break
					end
					task.wait(0.08)
				end
				if type(au.Treadmill) == "table" then
					au.Treadmill.Riding = false
					au.Treadmill.ActiveBelt = nil
				end
				return wore and doffed
			end

			local be = tonumber(bb) or 6

					return false

				if (k.Position - ba).Magnitude <= be then
					au.StopWalking()
					return true
				end
				g = g and (k.Position - g).Magnitude < 1
				if g then
					h += 0.2
				else
					h = 0
				end
				g = k.Position
				i = math.max(0, i - 0.2)
				if h >= 0.8 and i <= 0 then
					au.LeaveBelt()
					pcall(function()
						j.Jump = true
					end)
					h = 0
					i = 1.5
				end
				j:MoveTo(ba)
				f += task.wait(0.2)
			end
			au.StopWalking()
			return au.DistanceTo(ba) <= be
		end

				if type(o.ApplyV1Tuning) == "function" then
					pcall(o.ApplyV1Tuning)
				end

			end

		end

			local lastMgStealAt = 0
			local function checkMinigameEggs()
				if not au.SafeCarry.MinigameSteal then return end
				if os.clock() - lastMgStealAt < 1.25 then return end
				if type(au.PlayerCarryUid) == "function" and au.PlayerCarryUid(aj.UserId) then return end
				local rlglOn = workspace:GetAttribute("Event_RedLightGreenLight") == true
				local trexOn = workspace:GetAttribute("Event_TrexRun") == true
				if not rlglOn and not trexOn then return end
				if rlglOn then
					local carrier = tonumber(workspace:GetAttribute("RLGL_CarrierUserId")) or 0
					if carrier ~= 0 and carrier ~= aj.UserId then return end
				end
				local targetPos = (rlglOn and workspace:GetAttribute("RLGL_EggPosition")) or (trexOn and workspace:GetAttribute("TrexRun_EggPosition")) or nil
				if typeof(targetPos) ~= "Vector3" then return end
				local slots = workspace:FindFirstChild("AreaEggSlotsClient")
				if not slots then return end
				local bestUid, bestDist = nil, 45
				for _, m in ipairs(slots:GetChildren()) do
					local okP, piv = pcall(function()
						return m:IsA("Model") and m:GetPivot().Position or (m:IsA("BasePart") and m.Position or nil)
					end)
					if okP and typeof(piv) == "Vector3" then
						local d = (piv - targetPos).Magnitude
						if d < bestDist then
							bestDist = d
							bestUid = m:GetAttribute("Uid") or m.Name
						end
					end
				end
				if bestUid and type(au.StealNow) == "function" then
					lastMgStealAt = os.clock()
					pcall(au.StealNow, tostring(bestUid), true)
				end
			end
			for _, attrName in ipairs({
				"Event_RedLightGreenLight",
				"RLGL_EggPosition",
				"RLGL_CarrierUserId",
				"RLGL_Light",
				"Event_TrexRun",
				"TrexRun_EggPosition",
			}) do
				pcall(function()
					ap(workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attrName):Connect(function()
						task.spawn(checkMinigameEggs)
					end))
				end)
			end
		end

		do
			local installFilter = function(host)
	local core = assert(host.Core, "Sources core missing")
	local modules = host.Modules or {}
	local game = host.Game or game
	local require = host.Require or require
	local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local api = { Alive = true, Config = { Mutations = {}, MinWeightKg = 0, Names = {}, Rarities = {} }, Controls = {} }
	core.CustomFilters = api
	local function load(name, path)
		if modules[name] then return modules[name] end
		local ok, value = pcall(function()
			local node = rs
			for _, key in ipairs(path) do node = node:FindFirstChild(key); if not node then return nil end end
			return require(node)
		end)
		if ok and type(value) == "table" then modules[name] = value; return value end
		return nil
	end
	local earnings = load("AssetEarnings", { "Shared", "Util", "AssetEarnings" })
	local mutations = load("Mutations", { "Shared", "Modules", "Mutations" })
	local records = load("EggRecords", { "Shared", "Util", "EggRecords" })
	local assets = load("Assets", { "Data", "Assets" })
	local rankNames = { "Common", "Uncommon", "Rare", "Epic", "Legendary", "Mythic", "Cosmic", "Secret", "Eternal", "Divine" }
	local ranks = {}
	for i, name in ipairs(rankNames) do ranks[name] = i end
	local function finite(value)
		return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0 and value < math.huge
	end
	api.Finite = finite
	function api.ParseNumber(value)
		local text = tostring(value or ""):lower():gsub("[%s,]", ""):gsub("kg$", ""):gsub("/s$", "")
		if text == "" or text == "off" then return 0 end
		local number, suffix = text:match("^(%d*%.?%d+)([kmbt]?)$")
		local multiplier = ({ k = 1e3, m = 1e6, b = 1e9, t = 1e12 })[suffix] or 1
		number = tonumber(number)
		number = number and number * multiplier
		if not finite(number) then return nil end
		return number
	end
	function api.Selection(value)
		local out, seen = {}, {}
		if type(value) == "string" then value = { value } end
		for key, item in pairs(type(value) == "table" and value or {}) do
			local name = type(item) == "string" and item or (item == true and type(key) == "string" and key)
			if name and name ~= "" and name ~= "All" and name ~= "None" and not seen[name] then
				seen[name] = true; out[#out + 1] = name
			end
		end
		table.sort(out)
		return out
	end
	local labels, labelToId = {}, {}
	function api.MutationOptions()
		local seen, out = {}, {}
		local function add(id)
			if type(id) ~= "string" or id == "" or (mutations and id == mutations.NO_MUTATION) then return end
			local label = id
			if mutations and type(mutations.LabelOf) == "function" then
				local ok, result = pcall(mutations.LabelOf, id)
				if ok and type(result) == "string" and result ~= "" then label = result end
			end
			labels[id] = label; labelToId[label] = id; labelToId[id] = id
			if not seen[label] then seen[label] = true; out[#out + 1] = label end
		end
		if mutations then
			local ids = mutations.IdSet
			if type(mutations.Ids) == "function" then
				local ok, result = pcall(mutations.Ids)
				if ok and type(result) == "table" then ids = result end
			end
			for key, value in pairs(type(ids) == "table" and ids or {}) do
				add(type(key) == "string" and key or value)
			end
		end
		if #out == 0 then
			for _, id in ipairs({ "Golden", "Rainbow", "Shocked", "Frozen", "Burnt", "Boss" }) do add(id) end
		end
		table.sort(out)
		return out
	end
	api.MutationOptions()
	local function mutationId(value)
		if type(value) == "table" then value = value.Id or value.id or value.Mutation or value.Name end
		return type(value) == "string" and (labelToId[value] or value) or nil
	end
	function api.SetMutations(value)
		local selected = {}
		for _, label in ipairs(api.Selection(value)) do
			local id = mutationId(label)
			if id then selected[id] = true end
		end
		api.Config.Mutations = selected
		if host.Wake then pcall(host.Wake) end
	end
	function api.SetMinWeight(value)
		local number = api.ParseNumber(value)
		if number == nil then return false, "Use a non-negative weight in kg (for example 12000 or 12k)." end
		api.Config.MinWeightKg = number
		if host.Wake then pcall(host.Wake) end
		return true
	end
	function api.WeightOf(record)
		if type(record) ~= "table" or not records or type(records.WeightKgForScale) ~= "function" then return nil end
		local ok, value = pcall(records.WeightKgForScale, record.AssetCategory or record.Category, tonumber(record.AssetScale or record.Scale) or 1)
		return ok and finite(value) and value or nil
	end
	function api.MatchesMutation(record)
		local selected = api.Config.Mutations
		if next(selected) == nil then return true end
		if type(record) ~= "table" then return false end
		local base = mutationId(record.BaseMutation)
		if base and selected[base] then return true end
		for key, value in pairs(type(record.Mutations) == "table" and record.Mutations or {}) do
			local id = mutationId(value)
			if id and selected[id] then return true end
			if type(key) == "string" and (value == true or (type(value) == "number" and value > 0)) then
				if selected[mutationId(key)] then return true end
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	local labelToCategory, categoryToLabel = {}, {}
	function api.NameOptions()
		local out, seen = {}, {}
		for category, entry in pairs(assets and assets.Directory or {}) do
			local label = type(entry) == "table" and tostring(entry.DisplayName or category) or tostring(category)
			labelToCategory[label] = tostring(category)
			categoryToLabel[tostring(category)] = label
			if label ~= "" and not seen[label] then seen[label] = true; out[#out + 1] = label end
		end
		table.sort(out)
		return out
	end
	function api.SetNames(value)
		local selected = {}
		for _, label in ipairs(api.Selection(value)) do
			selected[tostring(labelToCategory[label] or label)] = true
		end
		api.Config.Names = selected
		if host.Wake then pcall(host.Wake) end
		return true
	end
	function api.SetRarities(value)
		local selected = {}
		for _, label in ipairs(api.Selection(value)) do
			selected[tostring(label)] = true
		end
		api.Config.Rarities = selected
		if host.Wake then pcall(host.Wake) end
		return true
	end
	function api.Passes(record)
		if not api.Alive then return true end
		if not api.MatchesMutation(record) then return false, "mutation" end
		local minimum = api.Config.MinWeightKg
		if minimum > 0 then
			local weight = api.WeightOf(record)
			if not weight or weight < minimum then return false, "weight" end
		end
		if next(api.Config.Names) ~= nil or next(api.Config.Rarities) ~= nil then
			local meta = api.Resolve(record)
			if next(api.Config.Names) ~= nil and api.Config.Names[tostring(meta.category)] ~= true then return false, "name" end
			if next(api.Config.Rarities) ~= nil and api.Config.Rarities[tostring(meta.rarity)] ~= true then return false, "rarity" end
		end
		return true
	end
	function api.NativeMinRank()
		if type(host.GetMinRarity) ~= "function" then return 0 end
		local ok, value = pcall(host.GetMinRarity)
		return ok and tonumber(value) or 0
	end
	function api.Resolve(record)
		record = type(record) == "table" and record or {}
		local category = tostring(record.AssetCategory or record.Category or "Unknown")
		local entry = assets and assets.Directory and assets.Directory[category]
		entry = type(entry) == "table" and entry or {}
		local rarity = entry.Rarity
		local name = type(rarity) == "table" and (rarity.DisplayName or rarity._id or rarity.Name) or rarity
		name = tostring(name or "Unknown")
		return {
			category = category, name = tostring(entry.DisplayName or category), rarity = name,
			rarityRank = type(rarity) == "table" and tonumber(rarity.RarityNumber or rarity.Rank) or ranks[name] or 0,
			rarityColor = type(rarity) == "table" and (rarity.Color or rarity.Color3) or nil,
		}
	end
	function api.RarityOptions()
		local set, out = {}, {}
		for category in pairs(assets and assets.Directory or {}) do
			local meta = api.Resolve({ AssetCategory = category })
			if meta.rarity ~= "Unknown" and not set[meta.rarity] then set[meta.rarity] = meta.rarityRank; out[#out + 1] = meta.rarity end
		end
		if #out == 0 then return table.clone(rankNames) end
		table.sort(out, function(a, b) if set[a] == set[b] then return a < b end; return set[a] < set[b] end)
		return out
	end
	function api.RateOf(record)
		if type(record) ~= "table" then return nil end
		local scale = tonumber(record.AssetScale or record.Scale) or 1
		local category = record.AssetCategory or record.Category
		if not category or not finite(scale) then return nil end
		local input = { Category = category, Scale = scale, AssetScale = scale, BaseMutation = record.BaseMutation, Mutations = record.Mutations or {} }
		if earnings then
			for _, name in ipairs({ "LiveRatePerSecond", "RatePerSecond", "CatalogRatePerSecond" }) do
				if type(earnings[name]) == "function" then
					local ok, value = pcall(earnings[name], input)
					if ok and finite(value) then return value end
				end
			end
		end
		local entry = assets and assets.Directory and assets.Directory[category]
		local base = type(entry) == "table" and tonumber(entry.EarningRate)
		if not finite(base) then return nil end
		local ids = {}
		for _, id in ipairs(record.Mutations or {}) do ids[#ids + 1] = id end
		if record.BaseMutation and not table.find(ids, record.BaseMutation) then ids[#ids + 1] = record.BaseMutation end
		local multiplier = 1
		if #ids > 0 then
			if not mutations or type(mutations.EarningsFor) ~= "function" then return nil end
			local ok, value = pcall(mutations.EarningsFor, ids)
			if not ok or not finite(value) then return nil end
			multiplier = value
		end
		local growth = scale > 5 and (scale / 5) ^ 1.2 * 19.637875755794113 or scale ^ 1.85
		local value = base * growth * multiplier
		return finite(value) and value or nil
	end
	function api.Compact(value)
		if not finite(value) then return "N/A" end
		for _, unit in ipairs({ { 1e15, "Q" }, { 1e12, "T" }, { 1e9, "B" }, { 1e6, "M" }, { 1e3, "K" } }) do
			if value >= unit[1] then return (string.format("%.2f", value / unit[1]):gsub("0+$", ""):gsub("%.$", "")) .. unit[2] end
		end
		return string.format("%.1f", value):gsub("%.0$", "")
	end
	function api.ReadSave()
		local save = modules.Save
		local read = save and (save.Peek or save.Get)
		if type(read) ~= "function" then return {} end
		local ok, value = pcall(read)
		return ok and type(value) == "table" and value or {}
	end
	function api.DisplayName(record)
		if records and type(records.DisplayNameWithWeight) == "function" then
			local ok, value = pcall(records.DisplayNameWithWeight, record)
			if ok and type(value) == "string" then return value end
		end
		return nil
	end

				local walls = au.SafeCarry.ZigzagWalls
				if type(walls) == "table" then return walls end
				walls = {}
				pcall(function()
					local objects = workspace:FindFirstChild("__OBJECTS")
					local build = objects and objects:FindFirstChild("Build")
					if not build then
						build = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
					end
					if not build then return end
					local function sideOf(part)
						local name = string.upper(part.Name)
						if name == "SIDE_WALLS" then return "high" end
						if name == "SIDE_WALLS2" then return "low" end
						local node = part
						while node and node ~= build do
							local upper = string.upper(node.Name)
							if string.find(upper, "WALL LEFT", 1, true) then return "low" end
							if string.find(upper, "WALL RIGHT", 1, true) then return "high" end
							node = node.Parent
						end
						return nil
					end
					for _, node in ipairs(build:GetDescendants()) do
						if node:IsA("BasePart") and node.CanCollide then
							local side = sideOf(node)
							if side then
								local ok, minX, maxX, minZ, maxZ = pcall(function()
									local cf, size = node.CFrame, node.Size
									local lowX, highX = math.huge, -math.huge
									local lowZ, highZ = math.huge, -math.huge
									for sx = -0.5, 0.5, 1 do
										for sy = -0.5, 0.5, 1 do
											for sz = -0.5, 0.5, 1 do
												local corner = cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(size.X * sx, size.Y * sy, size.Z * sz))
												lowX = math.min(lowX, corner.X)
												highX = math.max(highX, corner.X)
												lowZ = math.min(lowZ, corner.Z)
												highZ = math.max(highZ, corner.Z)
											end
										end
									end
									return true, lowX, highX, lowZ, highZ
								end)
								if ok and maxX - minX >= 100 then
									table.insert(walls, {
										side = side,
										minX = minX,
										maxX = maxX,
										innerZ = side == "low" and maxZ or minZ,
									})
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end)
				au.SafeCarry.ZigzagWalls = walls
				return walls
			end
			sc.ZigzagBounds = function(x, z)
				local carry = au.SafeCarry
				local low, high = nil, nil
				for _, wall in ipairs(carry.ZigzagSnapshot()) do
					if wall.minX <= x and x <= wall.maxX then
						if wall.side == "low" then
							if wall.innerZ < z then
								low = math.max(low or -math.huge, wall.innerZ)
							end
						elseif wall.side == "high" and z < wall.innerZ then
							high = math.min(high or math.huge, wall.innerZ)
						end
					end
				end
				low = (low or -425) + carry.ZigzagInset
				high = (high or -300) - carry.ZigzagInset
				low = math.max(low, -425 + carry.ZigzagInset)
				high = math.min(high, -300 - carry.ZigzagInset)
				if high - low < 24 then return nil, nil end
				return low, high
			end

				local carry = au.SafeCarry
				if carry.StealZigzag ~= true or type(x) ~= "number" or type(z) ~= "number" then return z end
				local state = carry.ZigzagState
				if type(state) ~= "table" then
					state = { anchor = z, lastX = x, moved = 0, side = nil }
					carry.ZigzagState = state
				end
				if state.side == nil then
					local low, high = carry.ZigzagBounds(x, z)
					if not low then return z end
					state.low = low
					state.high = high
					state.side = math.abs(z - low) > math.abs(high - z) and 0 or 1
				end
				state.moved += math.abs(x - state.lastX)
				state.lastX = x
				if state.moved >= carry.ZigzagSpan then
					state.moved = 0
					state.side = 1 - state.side
				end
				local amp = carry.ZigzagAmp
				local target = state.side == 0 and (state.anchor - amp) or (state.anchor + amp)
				return math.clamp(target, state.low, state.high)
			end

				carry.ForestDropToken = token

					local root = au.Root()

					local delta = goal.Position - root.Position
					local flat = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
					local distance = flat.Magnitude
					if distance <= 8 and math.abs(delta.Y) <= 14 then
						arrived = true
						break
					end
					local step = math.min(distance, 96)

					pcall(function()
						root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position + flat.Unit * step + Vector3.new(0, math.clamp(delta.Y, -48, 48), 0)) * root.CFrame.Rotation
						root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)

				end

				end

			end
			local function bH(bI, bJ)
				local bK = typeof(bI.CFrame) == "CFrame" and bI.CFrame.Position or nil
				if not bK then return false end
				if au.InsideBase() and not au.InsideBase(bK) then
					local bL = R()
					if bL then
						s = "Leaving the base through the safe zone"
						if not Q(bL + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), bJ, nil, 400) then
							v[bI.Uid] = os.clock() + math.min(w, 2.5)
							return false
						end
					end
				end
				s = "Flying to the egg"
				if not Q(bK + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), bJ, nil, 400) then
					v[bI.Uid] = os.clock() + math.min(w, 2.5)
					return false
				end
				s = "Grabbing the egg now"
				local bL = by(bI, bJ, 0.6, nil)
				if not bL and not y(bJ) then
					bL = I(bI, bJ)
				end
				if not bL and not L(bI.Uid, bJ) then
					v[bI.Uid] = os.clock() + w
					return false
				end
				au.Steal.LastFinishedAt = os.clock()
				return true
			end
			local bI = { Uid = nil, Freed = nil, Token = nil }
			local bJ = 3
			local function bK()
				local bL = workspace:FindFirstChild("World") or workspace:FindFirstChild("__OBJECTS")
				bL = bL and bL:FindFirstChild("Areas")
				bL = bL and bL:FindFirstChild("GuardAreas")
				local bM = au.Root()
				if not bL or not bM then return nil end
				local bN = tostring(aj.UserId)
				local bO = au.Steal.CarryAreaId and bv({ AreaId = tostring(au.Steal.CarryAreaId) }) or nil
				local bP = math.huge
				local bQ = nil
				for bR, bS in ipairs(bL:GetChildren()) do
					local bT = bS:FindFirstChild("Guard")
					if bT then
						if tostring(bT:GetAttribute("TargetPlayer")) == bN or tostring(bT:GetAttribute("WakeTargetPlayer")) == bN then return bT end
						local bU, bV = pcall(function()
							return bT:GetPivot().Position
						end)
						if bU then
							local bW = (bV - bM.Position).Magnitude
							if bW < bP then
								bQ = bT
								bP = bW
							end
						end
					end
				end
				return bO or bQ
			end
			local function bL(bM, bN, bO)
				local bP = bK()
				if not bP then return false end
				local bQ = bx(bM, bO + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
				local bR = 0
				while true do
					if not bQ.Landed and bR < O and not y(bM) then
						local bS, bT = pcall(function()
							return bP:GetPivot().Position
						end)
						local bU = au.Root()
						if not (not bS or not bU) then
							if bw + 5 < (bT - bU.Position).Magnitude then
								local bV = Vector3.new(bU.Position.X - bT.X, 0, bU.Position.Z - bT.Z)
								local bW = bT + (bV.Magnitude > 0.1 and bV.Unit * bw or Vector3.zero)
								Q(Vector3.new(bW.X, bT.Y + 3, bW.Z), bM, nil, 400, true, function()
									if bQ.Landed then return "hit" end
									return nil
								end)
							end
							bR += af.Heartbeat:Wait()
							continue
						end
					end
					break
				end
				bQ.Stop()
				if not bQ.Landed then return false end
				return bG(bM, bN)
			end
			au.SafeCarry.Dangers = {}
			au.SafeCarry.DangerAt = 0
			au.SafeCarry.RefreshDangers = function()
				local bM = au.SafeCarry
				local bN = bM.DangerAt
				if os.clock() - bN < 1 then return bM.Dangers end
				bM.DangerAt = os.clock()
				local bO = {}
				local function bP(bQ)
					local bR, bS, bT = pcall(function()
						if bQ:IsA("Model") then return bQ:GetBoundingBox() end
						if bQ:IsA("BasePart") then return bQ.CFrame, bQ.Size end
					end)
					if bR and bS and bT then
						local bU = math.abs
						local bV = bT.Z
						local bW = Vector3.new(math.abs(bT.X), 0, bU(bV)) * 0.5
						local bX = (bS - bS.Position):VectorToWorldSpace(bW)
						local bY = bW.X
						local bZ = bW.Z
						local b_ = math.max(math.abs(bX.X), bY, bZ)
						local b0 = bW.X
						local b1 = bW.Z
						local b2 = math.max(math.abs(bX.Z), b0, b1)
						table.insert(bO, {
							MinX = bS.Position.X - b_,
							MaxX = bS.Position.X + b_,
							MinZ = bS.Position.Z - b2,
							MaxZ = bS.Position.Z + b2,
							Name = bQ.Name,
						})
					end
				end
				local function bQ(bR)
					return false
				end
				for bR, bS in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
					if (bS:IsA("Model") or bS:IsA("BasePart") or bS:IsA("Folder")) and bQ(bS.Name) then
						if bS:IsA("Folder") then
							for bT, bU in ipairs(bS:GetChildren()) do
								bP(bU)
							end
						else
							bP(bS)
						end
					end
				end
				local bR = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
				local bS = bR and bR:FindFirstChild("Build")
				if bS then
					for bT, bU in ipairs(bS:GetChildren()) do
						if bQ(bU.Name) then
							for bV, bW in ipairs(bU:GetChildren()) do
								bP(bW)
							end
						end
					end
				end
				bM.Dangers = bO
				return bO
			end
			au.SafeCarry.Avoid = function(bM, bN)
				if bM.X < 555 or bN.X < 555 then return bN, nil end
				for bO, bP in ipairs(au.SafeCarry.RefreshDangers()) do
					local bQ = bP.MinX - 12
					local bR = bP.MaxX + 12
					local bS = bP.MinZ - 12
					local bT = bP.MaxZ + 12
					local bU, bV, bW = ipairs({ { bM.X, bN.X - bM.X, bQ, bR }, { bM.Z, bN.Z - bM.Z, bS, bT } })
					local bX = true
					local bY = 0
					local bZ = 1
					for b_, b0 in bU, bV, bW do
						local b1 = b0[1]
						local b2 = b0[2]
						local b3 = b0[3]
						local b4 = b0[4]
						if math.abs(b2) < 1e-06 then
							if b1 < b3 or b1 > b4 then
								bX = false
							end
						else
							local b5 = (b3 - b1) / b2
							local b6 = (b4 - b1) / b2
							if not (b6 < b5) then
								local b7 = b6
								b6 = b5
								b5 = b7
							end
							local b7 = math.max(bY, b6)
							local X = math.min(bZ, b5)
							if not (X < b7) then
								bZ = X
								bY = b7
							else
								bX = false
								bZ = X
								bY = b7
							end
						end
					end
					if bX and not (bM.X >= bQ and bM.X <= bR and bM.Z >= bS and bM.Z <= bT) then
						local b_ = bS - 2
						local b0 = bT + 2
						local b1 = math.abs(bM.Z - b_) <= math.abs(bM.Z - b0) and b_ or b0
						if b1 < -440 or b1 > -290 then
							b1 = b1 == b_ and b0 or b_
						end
						local b2 = math.abs(bM.X - bQ) <= math.abs(bM.X - bR) and bQ or bR
						if math.abs(bM.Z - b1) < 3 then
							b2 = math.abs(bN.X - bQ) <= math.abs(bN.X - bR) and bQ or bR
						end
						return Vector3.new(b2, bN.Y, b1), bP.Name
					end
				end
				return bN, nil
			end
			au.SafeCarry.NewHuman = function(bM)
				local bN = au.SafeCarry
				local bO = bN.LaneOffset
				local bP
				bP = {
					Clock = 0,
					Factor = 1,
					Target = 1,
					NextShift = 0,
					Phase = math.random() * 3.1415926535897931 * 2,
					Period = 2 + math.random() * 2.5,
					PauseUntil = 0,
					Lane = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * bO,
					Step = function(bQ, bR, bS)
						bP.Clock = bP.Clock + bQ
						if bP.NextShift <= bP.Clock then
							bP.NextShift = bP.Clock + 0.5 + math.random()
							local bT = math.max(bN.SpeedJitter, 0)
							if bM then
								bP.Target = 1 - math.random() * bT
							else
								bP.Target = 1 + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * bT
							end
						end
						bP.Factor = bP.Factor + (bP.Target - bP.Factor) * math.min(bQ * 3, 1)
						local bT = bN.Wobble
						local bU = math.sin(bP.Clock * 2 * 3.1415926535897931 / bP.Period + bP.Phase) * bT
						local bV = bS and bR and bN.JumpsPerMinute > 0
						if bV then
							local bW = bN.JumpsPerMinute / 60 * bQ
							bV = math.random() < bW
						end
						if bV then
							pcall(function()
								bR.Jump = true
							end)
						end
						local bW = false
						if not bM then
							if bP.Clock < bP.PauseUntil then
								bW = true
							else
								local bX = bN.PausesPerMinute > 0
								if bX then
									local bY = bN.PausesPerMinute / 60 * bQ
									bX = math.random() < bY
								end
								if bX then
									bP.PauseUntil = bP.Clock + 0.3 + math.random() * 0.9
									bW = true
								end
							end
						end
						return bP.Factor, bP.Lane + bU, bW
					end,
				}
				return bP
			end
			au.SafeCarry.React = function(bM, bN)
				local bO = math.max(0, math.min(bM, bN))
				local bP = math.max(bM, bN, 0)
				return bO + math.random() * (bP - bO)
			end
			au.SafeCarry.RunTo = function(bM, bN)
				local bO = au.SafeCarry
				local bP = typeof(bM.CFrame) == "CFrame" and bM.CFrame.Position or nil
				if not bP then return false end
				bi()
				local bQ = aj.Character
				local bR = bQ and bQ:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if bR then
					bR.PlatformStand = false
					if bQ:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool") then
						pcall(function()
							bR:UnequipTools()
						end)
					end
				end
				local bS = bO.NewHuman(false)
				local bT = workspace:FindFirstChild("World") or workspace:FindFirstChild("__OBJECTS")
				bT = bT and bT:FindFirstChild("Areas")
				bT = bT and bT:FindFirstChild("SeparationLine")
				local bU = bT and bT:IsA("BasePart") and bT.Position.X or 552
				local bV = R()
				local bW = au.Root()
				local bX = "field"
				local bY = bW and bW.Position.Z or bP.Z
				if bW and bV and bW.Position.X < bU - 2 then
					bY = bV.Z
					if (Vector3.new(bW.Position.X, 0, bW.Position.Z) - Vector3.new(bV.X, 0, bV.Z)).Magnitude > 20 then
						bX = "safe"
					end
				end
				local bZ = math.clamp(bY + bS.Lane, -425, -300)
				local b_ = bP.Y + 3
				local function b0(b1)
					local b2 = au.Root()
					local b3 = aj.Character
					local b4 = not b2 or not b3 or math.abs(b2.Position.Y - b1) < 1
					if not b4 then
						local b5 = bO.SnapLimit
						b4 = math.abs(b2.Position.Y - b1) > b5
					end
					if b4 then return false end
					pcall(function()
						local b5 = b2.CFrame.Rotation
						b3:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(b2.Position.X, b1, b2.Position.Z)) * b5)
						b2.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(b2.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, b2.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
					end)
					return true
				end
				local function b1()
					if bO.RunHeight <= 0.5 then return end
					if type(au.StartHoverPad) == "function" then
						pcall(au.StartHoverPad)
					end
					if type(au.StartFlyGrounding) == "function" then
						pcall(au.StartFlyGrounding)
					end
					b0(b_ + bO.RunHeight)
				end
				if bX == "field" then
					b1()
				end
				local b2 = os.clock()
				local b3 = os.clock()
				local b4 = os.clock()
				bW = bW and bW.Position or nil
				local function b5(b6, b7, X, Y)
					local Z = Vector3.new(b7.X - b6.Position.X, 0, b7.Z - b6.Position.Z)
					local _ = Z.Magnitude
					local b8 = _ > 0.01 and Z.Unit or Vector3.zero
					if bO.RunHeight > 0.5 and bX == "field" and (not Y or bO.RunStyle ~= "Walk") then
						local b9 = bO.RunSpeed
						local ca = math.max(au.WalkSpeed() * b9 * X, 8)
						local cb = math.clamp(bO.ClimbShare, 0.1, 0.9)
						local cc = Vector3.new(bP.X - b6.Position.X, 0, bP.Z - b6.Position.Z).Magnitude
						if cc <= 3 then
							if b0(b_) then return end
						end
						local cd = cc <= 3 and b_ or b_ + bO.RunHeight
						local snappedY = math.abs(cd - b6.Position.Y) > 2 and b0(cd)
						local ce = snappedY and 0 or math.clamp((cd - b6.Position.Y) / 0.12, -ca * cb, ca * cb)
						local cf = b8 * math.min(math.sqrt(math.max(ca * ca - ce * ce, 0)), _ / 0.05)
						pcall(function()
							b6.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(cf.X, ce, cf.Z)
						end)
						return
					end
					pcall(function()
						if Y or _ <= 0.01 then
							if bR then
								if bO.RunStyle == "Walk" then
									bR:MoveTo(b6.Position)
								end
								bR:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
							end
							if bO.RunStyle ~= "Walk" then
								b6.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, b6.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
							end
						elseif bO.RunStyle == "Walk" then
							if bR then
								bR:MoveTo(b6.Position + b8 * math.min(_, 30))
							end
						else
							local b9 = bO.RunSpeed
							local ca = b8 * math.min(math.max(au.WalkSpeed() * b9 * X, 8), _ / 0.05)
							b6.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(ca.X, b6.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, ca.Z)
							if bO.RunAnimate and bR then
								bR:Move(b8, false)
							end
						end
					end)
				end
				while os.clock() - b2 < 240 do
					if y(bN) then
						if type(au.StopHoverPad) == "function" then pcall(au.StopHoverPad) end
						if type(au.StopFlyGrounding) == "function" then pcall(au.StopFlyGrounding) end
						return false
					end
					local b6 = au.Root()
					if not b6 then
						if type(au.StopHoverPad) == "function" then pcall(au.StopHoverPad) end
						if type(au.StopFlyGrounding) == "function" then pcall(au.StopFlyGrounding) end
						return false
					end
					local b7 = os.clock()
					local b8 = math.max(b7 - b3, 0.0041666666666666666)
					local b9 = Vector3.new(bP.X - b6.Position.X, 0, bP.Z - b6.Position.Z)
					if bX == "field" and b9.Magnitude <= 2.5 and (bO.RunHeight <= 0.5 or b6.Position.Y - b_ < 4) then break end
					local ca, cb, cc = bS.Step(b8, bR, bR and bR.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air)
					if b9.Magnitude <= 15 then
						cc = false
					end
					local cd = bP
					if bX == "safe" and not bV then
						bX = "field"
						b1()
					end
					if bX == "safe" and bV then
						if (Vector3.new(bV.X, 0, bV.Z) - Vector3.new(b6.Position.X, 0, b6.Position.Z)).Magnitude <= 6 then
							bX = "field"
							b1()
						end
						s = "Walking out to the safe zone"
						cd = bV
					else
						if not bO.StraightRun and bO.RunHeight <= 0.5 and math.abs(bP.X - b6.Position.X) > 25 then
							cd = Vector3.new(bP.X, bP.Y, math.clamp(bZ + cb, -425, -300))
						end
						s = string.format("Closing in, %d studs to the egg", math.floor(b9.Magnitude + 0.5))
					end
					local ce, cf = bO.Avoid(b6.Position, cd)
					if cf then
						s = "Walking around " .. tostring(cf)
					end
					b5(b6, ce, ca, cc)
					if b7 - b4 >= 1.5 then
						if not cc and bW and (b6.Position - bW).Magnitude < 3 and bR then
							pcall(function()
								bR.Jump = true
							end)
						end
						bW = b6.Position
						b4 = b7
					end
					af.Heartbeat:Wait()
					b3 = b7
				end
				local b6 = au.Root()
				if b6 then
					b5(b6, b6.Position, 1, true)
				end
				local b7 = nil
				if b6 then
					local b8 = Vector3.new(b6.Position.X - bP.X, 0, b6.Position.Z - bP.Z)
					local b9 = b8.Magnitude > 0.1 and b8.Unit * 2 or Vector3.zero
					b7 = Vector3.new(bP.X + b9.X, b6.Position.Y, bP.Z + b9.Z)
				end
				local function _pcFlatChase(_a, _b, _c)
					if _c.Magnitude > 1.5 then
						local rot = _a.CFrame.Rotation
						_a.CFrame = CFrame.new(_b.X, _a.Position.Y, _b.Z) * rot
					end
					_a.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.min(_a.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0), 0)
				end
				local b8 = af.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
					local b8 = au.Root()
					if not b8 or not b7 or au.Steal.Carrying or au.AntiGuard.Busy then return end
					local b9 = Vector3.new(b7.X - b8.Position.X, 0, b7.Z - b8.Position.Z)
					pcall(_pcFlatChase, b8, b7, b9)
				end)
				local function b9(ca)
					b8:Disconnect()
					if type(au.StopHoverPad) == "function" then
						pcall(au.StopHoverPad)
					end
					if type(au.StopFlyGrounding) == "function" then
						pcall(au.StopFlyGrounding)
					end
					return ca
				end
				local ca = bv(bM)
				local cb = os.clock()
				local cc = bO.React(bO.ReactMin, bO.ReactMax)
				while true do
					if y(bN) then
						return (b9(false))
					else
						local cd = os.clock() - cb
						local ce = bO.RunWait + cc
						local cf = not bO.WaitGuard or not ca or ca:GetAttribute("GuardState") == "Sleeping"
						if cd >= ce and (cf or cd >= ce + 15) then break end
						s = cd < ce and string.format("Grab in %.1fs", ce - cd) or "Holding until the guard dozes off"
						af.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end
				end
				s = "Grabbing the egg now"
				local cd = by(bM, bN, 0.8, nil)
				if not cd and not y(bN) then
					cd = I(bM, bN)
				end
				b9()
				if not cd then return false end
				au.Steal.LastFinishedAt = os.clock()
				return true
			end
			au.SafeCarry.Pace = function()
				local bM = tonumber(au.SafeCarry.RunSpeed) or 1
				return math.max(au.WalkSpeed() * bM, 16)
			end
			au.SafeCarry.Plan = function(bM, bN, bO)
				local bP = au.SafeCarry
				local bQ = aj.Character
				if bQ then
					bQ:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				end
				local bR = au.WalkSpeed()
				bO = bO or bP.Mult or 1
				if bP.SameSpeedBigEggs then
					bO = math.max(bO, bP.LightMult)
				end
				local bS = bR * bP.CarryRatio * bO
				local bT = bS * bP.SpeedRatio
				local bU = bP.ExcessSeconds * bS
				local bV
				if bN and bN > bU then
					bV = math.min(bT, bS * bN / (bN - bU))
				else
					bV = bT
				end
				local bW = am.Guards
				local bX = type(bW) == "table" and type(bW.Directory) == "table" and bW.Directory[tostring(bM)] or nil
				local bY = type(bX) == "table" and tonumber(bX.WalkSpeed) or 0
				if not bP.BeatGuard then return math.max(math.min(bS * bP.EasyRatio, bV), bS), true, bS, bV, bY end
				local bZ = math.max(bY + bP.GuardMargin, bS * bP.MinRatio)
				local b_ = math.max(bZ, bY * bP.GuardRatio)
				if bV < bZ then
					local b0 = bS * bP.SpeedRatio
					local b1 = bP.StretchSeconds * bS
					local b2
					if bN and bN > b1 then
						b2 = math.min(b0, bS * bN / (bN - b1))
					else
						b2 = b0
					end
					local b3 = bY + math.max(bP.GuardMargin, 1)
					if b3 <= b2 then return b3, true, bS, b2, bY end
				end
				return math.max(math.min(b_, bV), bS), bZ <= bV, bS, bV, bY
			end
			au.SafeCarry.Unsafe = function(bM)
				local bN = au.SafeCarry
				if not bN.Enabled or type(bM) ~= "table" or not bM.Uid or not bN.Blocked[bM.Uid] then return nil end
				return string.format("the guard caught you with this %s before, skipping it", tostring(bM.Category))
			end
			au.SafeCarry.Settle = function(bM, bN)
				local bO = au.SafeCarry
				local bP = aj.Character
				if bP then
					bP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				end
				math.max(au.WalkSpeed() * bO.CarryRatio * (bO.Seen[tostring(bN.Category)] or bO.GuessMult) * bO.WaitRate, 1)
				local bQ = bO.BaseWait
				local bR = bv(bN)
				while true do
					if y(bM) then
						return false
					else
						local bS = os.clock() - (bO.JumpAt or 0)
						local bT = not bO.WaitGuard or not bR or bR:GetAttribute("GuardState") == "Sleeping"
						if bS >= bQ and (bT or bS >= bQ + 15) then break end
						if bS < bQ then
							s = string.format("Letting the jump settle, %.1fs", bQ - bS)
						else
							s = "Holding until the guard dozes off"
						end
						af.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end
				end
				return true
			end
			au.MonitorAction = au.MonitorAction or function(bM)
				local bN, bO = pcall(debug.getconstants, bM)
				if not bN or type(bO) ~= "table" then return false end
				for bP, bQ in pairs(bO) do
					if type(bQ) == "string" and (bQ == "Relocate" or bQ == "SetWalkSpeed" or bQ == "BeginRagdoll" or bQ == "EndRagdoll" or bQ == "BeginImpulse") then return true end
				end
				return false
			end

					["Light Dark"] = "Light Dark",
					["Enchanted Forest"] = "Enchanted Forest",

				local function V2_GetPortal()
					if V2_PortalCached and V2_PortalCached.Parent then return V2_PortalCached end
					local env = workspace:FindFirstChild("Environment")
					local fuse = env and env:FindFirstChild("Fuse-Biome")
					local portal = fuse and fuse:FindFirstChild("Portal")
					if portal and portal:IsA("BasePart") then
						V2_PortalCached = portal
						return portal
					end
					return nil

					if V3_StarCached and V3_StarCached.Parent then return V3_StarCached end

					if part then

					end
					return part

				local function V2_Touch(root, part)
					if not root or not part or type(firetouchinterest) ~= "function" then return false end
					local ok = pcall(function()
						firetouchinterest(root, part, 0)
						firetouchinterest(root, part, 1)
					end)
					return ok
				end
				local function V2_InZone()
					local ok, attr = pcall(aj.GetAttribute, aj, "Zone")
					return ok and attr == "Area7_Biome"
				end

					local rem = ak and ak:FindFirstChild("RE/Zone/Left") or nil
					if rem and rem:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
						pcall(function()
							rem:FireServer("EnchantedForest")
						end)
					end

				local function V2_ZoneFor(rec)
					if type(rec) ~= "table" then return nil end
					local areaKey = tostring(rec.AreaId or rec.Area or "")
					local zName = V2_Zones[areaKey]
					if not zName then
						local pos = (typeof(rec.Position) == "Vector3" and rec.Position) or (typeof(rec.CFrame) == "CFrame" and rec.CFrame.Position) or nil
						if pos then
							if pos.X >= 1800 and pos.Z < 900 then
								zName = "Enchanted Forest"
							elseif pos.Z >= 900 then
								zName = "Titan Temple"
							end
						end
					end
					if not zName then return nil end
					local pick = au.SafeCarry.V2ZonePick
					if type(pick) == "table" and next(pick) ~= nil and not pick[zName] then return nil end
					return zName
				end
				local function V2_CamFree()
					local sc = au.SafeCarry
					if sc and sc.V2CamWatch then
						pcall(function()
							sc.V2CamWatch:Disconnect()
						end)
						sc.V2CamWatch = nil
					end
					local camState = sc and sc.V2Cam
					if not camState then return end
					sc.V2Cam = nil
					local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if cam then
						pcall(function()
							local restoreType = camState.Type
							if not restoreType or restoreType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
								restoreType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
							end
							cam.CameraType = restoreType
							local _, hum = au.CharParts()
							if hum then
								cam.CameraSubject = hum
							end
						end)
					end
				end
				local function V2_CamStart()
					local sc = au.SafeCarry
					if not sc or sc.V2HideCamera ~= true then return end
					local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if not cam then return end
					local maxHold = math.min(tonumber(sc.V2CamMax) or 2.0, 2.5)
					if not sc.V2Cam then
						sc.V2Cam = {
							Type = cam.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable and cam.CameraType or Enum.CameraType.Custom,
							CFrame = cam.CFrame,
							Character = aj.Character,
							Until = os.clock() + maxHold,
						}
					else
						sc.V2Cam.Until = os.clock() + maxHold
					end
					pcall(function()
						cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
						cam.CFrame = sc.V2Cam.CFrame
					end)
					if not sc.V2CamWatch then
						sc.V2CamWatch = af.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
							local st = sc.V2Cam
							if not st then
								V2_CamFree()
								return
							end
							if os.clock() >= st.Until or aj.Character ~= st.Character or not au.Steal.Active then
								V2_CamFree()
							else
								local c = workspace.CurrentCamera
								if c and c.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
									pcall(function()
										c.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
										c.CFrame = st.CFrame
									end)
								end
							end
						end)
					end
				end

				local function V2_PortalToEgg(rec, gen)
					local sc = au.SafeCarry
					local root = au.Root()
					local pos = type(rec) == "table" and ((typeof(rec.Position) == "Vector3" and rec.Position) or (typeof(rec.CFrame) == "CFrame" and rec.CFrame.Position)) or nil
					if not root or not pos then return false end
					local portal = V2_GetPortal()
					if not portal then return false end
					V2_CamStart()
					s = "Instant Steal V2: Entering Portal -> " .. tostring(rec.Category or rec.DisplayName or "Egg")
					if not V2_InZone() then
						V2_Touch(root, portal)
						local deadline = os.clock() + 1.2
						while os.clock() < deadline and not V2_InZone() and not y(gen) do
							V2_Touch(root, portal)
							task.wait(0.05)
						end
					end
					pcall(function()
						root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
						root.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0))
					end)
					task.wait(0.08)
					V2_LeaveZone()
					V2_CamFree()
					return true
				end
				local function V2_ForestResetAndCarry(gen)
					local sc = au.SafeCarry
					local uid = au.Steal and au.Steal.CarryUid
					local root = au.Root()
					if type(uid) ~= "string" or not root then
						V2_CamFree()
						return false
					end
					V2_CamStart()
					local portal = V2_GetPortal()
					if portal then
						s = "Instant Steal V2: Entering Portal for Forest Safe Zone drop"
						V2_Touch(root, portal)
						local waitP = os.clock() + 0.9
						while os.clock() < waitP and not V2_InZone() and not y(gen) do
							V2_Touch(root, portal)
							task.wait(0.05)
						end
					end
					s = "Instant Steal V2: Dropping egg at Enchanted Forest Safe Spot (2333, 66.2, -135.7)"
					pcall(function()
						root.CFrame = CFrame.new(V2_ForestDropPos)
						root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
					task.wait(0.12)
					local dropRem = ak and ak:FindFirstChild("RF/AreaEggs/AskDropEgg") or nil
					if dropRem and dropRem:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
						pcall(function()
							dropRem:InvokeServer()
						end)
					elseif am and am.EggState and type(am.EggState.DropFieldEgg) == "function" then
						pcall(am.EggState.DropFieldEgg, "PlayerRequest")
					end
					pcall(function()
						root.CFrame = V2_ForestWaitCF
						root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
					task.wait(0.22)
					V2_LeaveZone()
					V2_CamFree()
					s = "Instant Steal V2: Re-grabbing egg from Forest Safe Spot"
					pcall(function()
						root.CFrame = CFrame.new(V2_ForestDropPos + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
						root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
					for _ = 1, 8 do
						if y(gen) or au.Steal.Carrying then break end
						task.spawn(bp, uid)
						task.wait(0.08)
					end
					local okHome = au.SafeCarry.LineDropHome(gen)
					V2_CamFree()
					return okHome
				end
				local function V3_TreadmillHome(gen)
					local root = au.Root()
					if not root then return false end
					local starPart = V3_GetStarPart()
					local homePos = starPart and starPart.Position or V3_StarFallback
					s = "Instant Steal V3: Teleporting to StarHandler (540, 70.4, -397)"
					for _ = 1, 6 do

							root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
							root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
							root.CFrame = CFrame.new(homePos + Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0))

						end
						task.wait(0.08)
					end

					if dropRem and dropRem:IsA("RemoteFunction") and au.Steal.Carrying then
						pcall(function()
							dropRem:InvokeServer()
						end)
					end
					return not au.Steal.Carrying or au.InsideBase()
				end

			au.SafeCarry.LineDropHome = function(bM)

					for bW, bX in ipairs({ af.Heartbeat, af.PreSimulation, af.PostSimulation }) do

									s = string.format("Border: zigzagging home, Z %d", math.floor(b4))

										end
										if not (ci - ck <= b5.X) then

											if cp then
												X += 1
												s = string.format("Border: dropping and grabbing the egg again (%d/%d)", X - 1, #cl + 1)

														cq.CFrame = CFrame.new(ci, b5.Y, b4) * CFrame.Angles(0, 1.5707963267948966, 0)
														cq.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero

							b2.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(cm.X, ck, cm.Z)

							b2.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(cf.X, b2.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, cf.Z)

								bT:Move(cd.Unit, false)
							end
						end)

						end

							at.Wake()
						end)
						if bZ and b_ then
							ap(function()
								pcall(function()
									b_:Disconnect()
								end)
							end)
						end
					end
				end
			end
			at.Add(function()
				local bW = nil
				if p then
					bW = type(p.Set) == "function"
				end
				if bW then
					pcall(p.Set, nil, s)
				end
				local bX = nil
				if q then
					bX = type(q.Set) == "function"
				end
				if bX then
					pcall(q.Set, nil, r)
				end

				if not au.Toggle(o, false) and not picked then return false end
				local bY, bZ, b_ = z()
				if bY then

						E()
					end

					au.Steal.Wanted = false
					if t then
						u += 1
						au.Steal.Active = false

						au.StopWalking()
					end

					if bZ == "wall" then
						s = string.format("Field wall up, %ds", b0)
					else
						s = string.format("Night, going again in %ds", b0)
					end
					return false
				end
				if B and C == math.huge then
					C = os.clock() + A
				end
				if t then return true end
				if F() then
					s = "Night over, waiting for the field to reset"
					at.Wake()
					return false
				end
				if type(au.MechFirst) == "function" and au.MechFirst() then
					local b0 = false
					if bS <= os.clock() then
						bS = os.clock() + bQ
						local b1, b2 = pcall(H, false, false)
						if b1 and type(b2) == "table" then
							for b3, b4 in ipairs(b2) do
								if b4.State ~= "Carried" and b4.RiftOnly ~= true and not au.StockWaits(b4) then
									b0 = true
									break
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if not b0 then
						au.Steal.Wanted = false
						s = "Mech boss goes first, stealing after it"
						return false
					end

					au.Steal.Wanted = true
					au.Movement.StealFirst = true
					s = "Filtered egg found, leaving the boss for it"
					at.Wake()
					return false
				end
				local b0 = au.Movement.StealFirst
				local b1 = au.Movement.Owner
				if au.Movement.PlaceWanted and not b0 or b1 ~= nil and b1 ~= "steal" and b1 ~= "treadmill" then
					if bS <= os.clock() then
						bS = os.clock() + bQ
						local b2, b3 = pcall(H, false, false)
						local b4 = b2 and type(b3) == "table" and b3[1] ~= nil and not au.StockWaits(b3[1])
						au.Steal.Wanted = b4
						if b4 then
							au.Movement.StealFirst = true
						else
							au.Steal.BossOverride = false
						end
					end
					if au.Steal.Wanted then
						local b2 = tostring
						b1 = b1 or "Auto Place"
						s = "Egg found, waiting for " .. b2(b1) .. " to stop"
					else
						s = "Waiting for " .. tostring(b1 or "Auto Place")
					end
					return true
				end
				if os.clock() < bT then return true end
				au.Movement.StealFirst = false
				t = true
				task.spawn(function()
					local b2 = pcall(bU)
					au.Steal.BossOverride = false
					if bP then
						bP = false
						au.ReleaseBelt()
					end
					if not b2 then
						bl()
						au.Steal.Active = false
					end

					x = nil

						f[b3] = nil
					end

					bI.Uid = nil
					b5.Freed = nil
					b6.Token = nil

						au.Movement.StealFirst = true
					end

					au.ReleaseMovement("steal")
					t = false
					at.Wake()
				end)
				return true

			au.CancelSteal = function(bt)
				if type(bt) ~= "string" then return end

			au.StealQueue = function()
				local bt = {}
				for bu in pairs(f) do
					table.insert(bt, bu)
				end
				table.sort(bt, function(bu, bv)
					local bw = f[bu].At
					local bx = f[bv].At
					if bw ~= bx then return bw < bx end
					return bu < bv
				end)
				return bt
			end
			au.PrioritizeSteal = function(bt)
				if type(bt) ~= "string" or D() then return end
				local bu = 0
				for bv, bw in pairs(f) do
					if bw.At < bu then
						bu = bw.At
					end
				end
				f[bt] = { At = bu - 1, Once = false }
				h[bt] = nil
				v[bt] = nil
				if bs() and t and not au.Steal.Carrying and x ~= bt then
					br()
				end
				at.Wake()
			end
			au.MoveInPlan = function(bt, bu)
				if type(bt) ~= "string" or bu ~= -1 and bu ~= 1 or D() then return end
				local bv = au.StealPlan()
				local bw = table.find(bv, bt)
				local bx = bw and bw + bu
				if not bx or bx < 1 or bx > #bv then return end
				table.remove(bv, bw)
				table.insert(bv, bx, bt)
				local by = math.max(bw, bx)
				for bz, bA in ipairs(bv) do
					if bz <= by or f[bA] then
						local bB = f[bA]
						if bB then
							bB.At = bz
						else
							f[bA] = { At = bz, Once = false }
						end
						h[bA] = nil
					end
				end
				if t and not au.Steal.Carrying and x and bv[1] ~= x then
					br()
				end
				at.Wake()
			end
			local _stealPlanCache = {}
			local _stealPlanX = nil
			local _stealPlanAt = 0
			au.StealPlan = function()
				if not au.Toggle(o, false) or au.IsNight() then return {}, nil end
				local now = os.clock()
				if now - _stealPlanAt < 0.35 and _stealPlanX == x and type(_stealPlanCache) == "table" then return _stealPlanCache, x end
				local bt = {}
				if x then
					table.insert(bt, x)
				end

					for bw, bx in ipairs(bv) do
						if bx.Uid ~= x then
							table.insert(bt, bx.Uid)
						end
					end
				end
				_stealPlanCache = bt
				_stealPlanX = x
				_stealPlanAt = now
				return bt, x
			end

			ap(uis.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

				local slots = workspace:FindFirstChild("AreaEggSlotsClient")

					local ok, pos, part = pcall(function()
						local p
						if m:IsA("Model") then
							p = m:GetPivot().Position
						elseif m:IsA("BasePart") then
							p = m.Position
						end

					end)

							local sp, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
							if onScreen and sp.Z > 0 then

										bestUid = uid
										bestPart = part
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				if bestUid then
					lastAt = os.clock()
					claim(bestUid, bestPart)
				end
			end))

					while uid == nil and anc and depth < 4 do
						uid = anc:GetAttribute("Uid") or anc:GetAttribute("EggUid")
						anc = anc.Parent
						depth += 1
					end
				end)

				lastAt = os.clock()
				claim(tostring(uid), focus(tostring(uid)))
			end))

		au.StealNow = function(bt, bu)
				if type(bt) ~= "string" or D() then return end

				local bv = bt(bu.AssetCategory)
				bv = bv and tonumber(bv.EarningRate) or 0
				local bw = tonumber(bu.AssetScale) or 0
				if bw <= 0 then return 0 end
				local bx = bw > 5 and (bw / 5) ^ 1.2 * 19.637875755794113 or bw ^ 1.85
				local by = am.Mutations
				local bz = type(by) == "table" and type(by.EarningsFor) == "function"
				local bA = 1
				if bz then
					local bB
					bB, bA = pcall(by.EarningsFor, type(bu.Mutations) == "table" and bu.Mutations or {})
					bB = bB and type(bA) == "number"
					local bC = 1
					if not bB then
						bA = bC
					end
				end
				return bv * bx * bA
			end
			au.RiftShortfall = function()
				local bu = {}
				for bv, bw in ipairs(au.Rift.Requirements) do
					bu[bw] = (bu[bw] or 0) + 1
				end
				if next(bu) == nil then return bu end
				local bv = am.Save
				local bw = type(bv) == "table" and type(bv.Get) == "function"
				local bx = nil

					local by
					by, bx = pcall(bv.Get)
					bx = by and type(bx) == "table" and bx or nil
				end

				local bz = pairs
				local bA = bx.EquippedAssets or {}
				for bB, bC in bz(bA) do
					by[bC] = true
				end
				local bB = pairs
				local bC = bx.Inventory or {}
				for bD, bE in bB(bC) do
					local bF = type(bE) == "table" and tostring(bE.Category) or nil
					local bG
					if bF then
						bG = (bu[bF] or 0) > 0
					else
						bG = bF
					end
					bG = bG and bE.InFuse ~= true and bE.IsFavorite ~= true and not by[bD]
					if bG then
						bu[bF] = bu[bF] - 1
					end
				end
				for bD, bE in pairs(bu) do
					if bE <= 0 then
						bu[bD] = nil
					end
				end

			end

					at.Wake()
				end)

			end)

							bI = "Pen out of reach, stopping this pass"
							break
						else
							local cm, cn = pcall(b6.WearEggTool, cl.Uid)
							if cm and cn ~= false then
								task.wait(0.15)
								local co = 0
								local cp = false
								for cq, cr in ipairs(b_(ch)) do
									if not (ce() or co >= bC) then
										co += 1
										local cs, ct = bO("RF/EggWorld/AskPlaceEgg", { Uid = cl.Uid, LocalCFrame = cr })
										if cs and ct ~= false then
											table.insert(ch, Vector2.new(cr.Position.X, cr.Position.Z))
											ci += 1
											cp = true
											break
										else
											continue
										end
									end
									break
								end
								if cp then
									cj = 0
									continue
								else
									bK[cl.Uid] = true
									cj += 1
									if not (cj >= 2) then continue end
								end
							else
								bK[cl.Uid] = true
								continue
							end
						end
					end
					break
				end
				if type(b6.DoffEggTool) == "function" then
					pcall(b6.DoffEggTool)
				end
				if ci == 0 then
					bD = os.clock() + bB
				end
				return ci > 0
			end
			at.Add(function()
				local b6, b7 = b0()
				if bH and type(bH.Set) == "function" then
					pcall(bH.Set, bH, bI)
				end
				local b8 = tonumber(b7)
				local b9 = b8 ~= nil and bM ~= nil and b8 < bM
				if b8 then
					bM = b8
				end
				if b9 then
					table.clear(bK)
				end
				if not au.Toggle(bG, false) and not au.Lab.PlaceOn then
					au.Movement.PlaceWanted = false
					au.ReleaseMovement("place")
					return false
				end
				if bJ then return false end
				if os.clock() < bD then
					au.Movement.PlaceWanted = false
					return false
				end
				if au.Movement.StealFirst and not au.IsNight() then
					au.Movement.PlaceWanted = false
					return false
				end
				if type(au.MechFirst) == "function" and au.MechFirst() then
					au.Movement.PlaceWanted = false
					return false
				end
				bJ = true
				task.spawn(function()
					local ca, cb = pcall(b5)
					if not (ca and cb == "waiting") then
						au.Movement.PlaceWanted = false
					end
					au.ReleaseMovement("place")
					bJ = false
					at.Wake()
				end)
				return false
			end)
			bG = au.PlaceEggHandle
			bH = au.PlaceEggStatusRow
			au.PlaceEggRestart = function()
				table.clear(bK)
				bL += 1
				au.StopWalking()
				at.Wake()
			end
			au.PlaceEggRefresh = function()
				table.clear(bK)
				at.Wake()
			end
			au.Rift.Restart.Place = function()
				table.clear(bK)
				at.Wake()
			end
		end
		local bz = am.Save
		if type(bz) == "table" and type(bz.FieldSignal) == "function" then
			for bA, bB in ipairs({ "EggInventory", "EquippedAssets", "BaseUpgradeLevel" }) do
				local bC, bD = pcall(bz.FieldSignal, bB)
				if bC and type(bD) == "table" and type(bD.Connect) == "function" then
					local bE, bF = pcall(bD.Connect, bD, function()
						at.Wake()
					end)
					if bE and bF then
						ap(function()
							pcall(function()
								bF:Disconnect()
							end)
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		do
			local _heldCheckAt = 0
			local _heldCheckUid = nil
			local _heldCheckVal = false
			au.Steal.HeldByMe = function()
				local bA = au.Steal.CarryUid
				local bB = aj.Character
				if type(bA) ~= "string" or not bB then
					_heldCheckVal = false
					return false
				end
				local nowH = os.clock()
				if _heldCheckUid == bA and nowH - _heldCheckAt < 0.08 then return _heldCheckVal end
				_heldCheckUid = bA
				_heldCheckAt = nowH
				local bC = workspace:FindFirstChild(bA)
				if not bC then
					_heldCheckVal = false
					return false
				end
				for bD, bE in ipairs(bC:GetDescendants()) do
					if bE:IsA("WeldConstraint") or bE:IsA("JointInstance") then
						local bF, bG, bH = pcall(function()
							return bE.Part0, bE.Part1
						end)
						if bF and (bG and bG:IsDescendantOf(bB) or bH and bH:IsDescendantOf(bB)) then
							_heldCheckVal = true
							return true
						end
					end
			end
				_heldCheckVal = false
				return false
			end
		end
		do
			local bA = 0
			local bB = af.Heartbeat:Connect(function(bB)
				bA += bB
				if bA < 0.2 then return end
				bA = 0
				local bC = au.Steal
				if not bC.Carrying then
					if bC.GuessedDrop then
						local bD, bE = pcall(bC.HeldByMe)
						if bD and bE then
							bC.GuessedDrop = false
							bC.Carrying = true
							bC.HeldSeenAt = os.clock()
						end
					end
					return
				end
				local bD, bE = pcall(bC.HeldByMe)
				if not bD or bE then
					bC.HeldSeenAt = os.clock()
					return
				end
				if os.clock() - (bC.HeldSeenAt or 0) > 0.8 then
					bC.Carrying = false
					bC.GuessedDrop = true
					bC.LastFinishedAt = os.clock()
					at.Wake()
				end
			end)
			ap(function()
				pcall(function()
					bB:Disconnect()
				end)
			end)
		end
		do
			local bA = am.EggState
			local bB = type(bA) == "table" and bA.CarryChanged or nil
			if type(bB) == "table" and type(bB.Connect) == "function" then
				local bC, bD = pcall(bB.Connect, bB, function(bC)
					local bD = type(bC) == "table" and bC.IsCarrying == true
					if au.Steal.Carrying and not bD then
						au.Steal.LastFinishedAt = os.clock()
					end
					au.Steal.GuessedDrop = false
					if bD then
						au.Steal.HeldSeenAt = os.clock()
					end
					if bD and type(bC.Uid) == "string" then
						au.Steal.CarryUid = bC.Uid
						au.Steal.CarryAreaId = bC.AreaId
						local bE = tonumber(bC.SpeedMultiplier)
						if bE and bE > 0 then
							au.SafeCarry.Mult = bE
							au.SafeCarry.Category = bC.AssetCategory
							if bC.AssetCategory ~= nil then
								local bF = tostring(bC.AssetCategory)
								au.SafeCarry.Seen[bF] = math.min(au.SafeCarry.Seen[bF] or bE, bE)
							end
						end
					end
					au.Steal.Carrying = bD
					at.Wake()
				end)
				if bC and bD then
					ap(function()
						pcall(function()
							bD:Disconnect()
						end)
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		pcall(function()
			local bA = ak:FindFirstChild("RE/EggWorld/FieldEggRedeemVerdict")
			local bB = ak:FindFirstChild("RE/Alerts/Raise")
			if bA and bA:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				local bC = bA.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
					au.SafeCarry.LastDelivered = os.clock()
					au.SafeCarry.DeliveredCount = (tonumber(au.SafeCarry.DeliveredCount) or 0) + 1
					local lastRate = tonumber(au.Steal and au.Steal.LastCarryIncome) or 0
					CatHub.Stats.EggsDelivered = CatHub.Stats.EggsDelivered + 1
					CatHub.Stats.TotalEarn = CatHub.Stats.TotalEarn + lastRate
					if lastRate > 0 then
						au.SafeCarry.DeliveredEarnings = (tonumber(au.SafeCarry.DeliveredEarnings) or 0) + lastRate
					end
				end)
				ap(function()
					bC:Disconnect()
				end)
			end
			if bB and bB:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				local bC = bB.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(bC)
					if type(bC) == "table" and type(bC.Text) == "string" and string.find(bC.Text, "Delivery failed", 1, true) then
						au.SafeCarry.LastFailed = os.clock()
					end
				end)
				ap(function()
					bC:Disconnect()
				end)
			end
		end)
		do
			local bH = nil
			local bI = nil
			local bL = false
			local bK = 0
			local bM = au.Treadmill
			bM.IdleGeneration = 0
			bM.EquipPending = false
			bM.UnequipGuardRunning = false
			bM.Traveling = false
			bM.AutoMounted = false
			bM.LastGainAt = 0
			bM.NotGroundedCount = 0
			bM.UndidSwap = false
			bM.AutoUpgrade = false
			bM.AntiTreadmill = false
			bM.Revision = 0
			au.Treadmill = bM
			bM.Wanted = false
			bM.Active = false
			local function isAutomationBlockingBelt()
				if type(au.Halloween) == "table" and type(au.Halloween.Busy) == "function" then
					local hwYieldOk, hwYieldBusy = pcall(au.Halloween.Busy)
					if hwYieldOk and hwYieldBusy == true then return true end
				end
				local mv = au.Movement
				if mv.PlaceWanted or mv.MutationWanted or mv.FracturedWanted or mv.StealFirst then return true end
				if mv.Owner ~= nil and mv.Owner ~= "treadmill" then return true end
				if au.Steal.Active or au.Steal.Carrying or au.Steal.Wanted or au.Flying then return true end
				if type(au.Priority) == "table" and type(au.Priority.TreadmillOver) == "function" then
					local need = au.Steal and au.Steal.TargetRank or 4
					if au.Steal.Carrying == true then need = 0 end
					if au.Priority.TreadmillOver(need) then return true end
				end
				if au.Toggle(ay, false) then
					local fs = au.SafeCarry
					local since = fs and tonumber(fs.NoTargetSince) or nil
					local lastFin = tonumber(au.Steal.LastFinishedAt) or 0
					if os.clock() - lastFin < 2.5 then return true end
					if not au.IsNight() and not au.WallSealed() and (since == nil or os.clock() - since < 3.0) then return true end
				end
				if (not bM.Traveling and (tonumber(au.Driving) or 0) > 0) or au.InMechArena() then return true end
				return false
			end
			local function isDedicatedTreadmillOn()
				return au.Toggle(bH, false) == true
			end
			local function isIdleFallbackWanted()
				local fs = au.SafeCarry
				if bM.AntiTreadmill then return false end
				if not au.Toggle(ay, false) or fs.NoTargetFallback ~= true then return false end
				if fs.NoTargetAt == nil or au.Steal.Carrying == true or au.Steal.Active == true or au.Steal.Wanted == true then return false end
				local since = tonumber(fs.NoTargetSince)
				if since == nil or os.clock() - since < 3.5 then return false end
				return os.clock() - fs.NoTargetAt <= 25
			end
			local function isTreadmillWanted()
				if bM.AntiTreadmill then return false end
				if isAutomationBlockingBelt() then
					bM.Wanted = false
					return false
				end
				local want = isDedicatedTreadmillOn() or isIdleFallbackWanted()
				if want and type(au.Priority) == "table" and type(au.Priority.TreadmillOver) == "function" then
					local need = au.Steal and au.Steal.TargetRank or 4
					if au.Steal.Carrying == true then need = 0 end
					if au.Priority.TreadmillOver(need) then want = false end
				end
				bM.Wanted = want
				return want
			end
			local function evalWearStillResult(okW, r1, r2)
				if okW and r1 ~= false then
					bM.NotGroundedCount = 0
					bM.UndidSwap = false
					return true
				end
				local reason = tostring(r2 or r1 or "")
				if okW and reason == "Already using treadmill" then
					bM.NotGroundedCount = 0
					bM.UndidSwap = false
					return true
				end
				if okW and reason == "Not grounded" and (os.clock() - (bM.LastGainAt or 0) < 6) and au.OnBelt() then
					bM.NotGroundedCount = 0
					bM.UndidSwap = false
					return true
				end
				if okW and reason == "Not grounded" and type(au.Grounded) == "function" and au.Grounded() then
					bM.NotGroundedCount = (bM.NotGroundedCount or 0) + 1
					if bM.NotGroundedCount >= 1 then
						bM.NotGroundedCount = 0
						if type(au.UndoSwap) == "function" then
							pcall(au.UndoSwap)
						end
					end
				end
				return false
			end
			local function startUnequipGuard(forceDoff)
				if not bM.AntiTreadmill and not forceDoff and not bM.AutoMounted then return end
				if bM.UnequipGuardRunning then return end
				bM.UnequipGuardRunning = true
				task.spawn(function()
					bM.AutoMounted = false
					if bM.AntiTreadmill then
						local delayStep = 0.15
						while not bL and bM.AntiTreadmill do
							if bM.ActiveBelt ~= nil or bM.Riding or au.OnBelt() then
								au.InvokeDoff()
								bM.Riding = false
								bM.ActiveBelt = nil
								bM.Mode = "Idle"
								bM.Boost = "Released"
								task.wait(delayStep)
								delayStep = math.min(delayStep * 2, 0.75)
							else
								break
							end
						end
					elseif forceDoff and (bM.ActiveBelt ~= nil or bM.Riding or au.OnBelt()) then
						if type(au.ExitBelt) == "function" then
							pcall(au.ExitBelt)
						else
							au.InvokeDoff()
						end
						bM.Riding = false
						bM.ActiveBelt = nil
						bM.Mode = isAutomationBlockingBelt() and "Automation active" or "Idle"
						bM.Boost = "Released"
					end
					bM.UnequipGuardRunning = false
				end)
			end
			pcall(function()
				local rem = au.TreadmillRemotes()
				if not rem then return end
				local function onBeltShift(state)
					bM.Revision = (bM.Revision or 0) + 1
					bM.ActiveBelt = state
					bM.Riding = state ~= nil
					bM.EquipPending = false
					if state ~= nil and bM.AntiTreadmill then
						startUnequipGuard(true)
					elseif state ~= nil then
						bM.Mode = "Active"
						bM.Boost = "Waiting for gain"
					else
						bM.Mode = isAutomationBlockingBelt() and "Automation active" or "Idle"
						bM.Boost = isTreadmillWanted() and "Re-equipping" or "Disabled"
					end
				end
				if rem.AssignedBeltShifted then
					local c = rem.AssignedBeltShifted.OnClientEvent:Connect(onBeltShift)
					ap(function() c:Disconnect() end)
				elseif rem.RenderStateShifted then
					local c = rem.RenderStateShifted.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(playerName, on)
						if playerName == aj.Name then
							onBeltShift(on and playerName or nil)
						end
					end)
					ap(function() c:Disconnect() end)
				end
				if rem.SpeedGained then
					local c = rem.SpeedGained.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
						bM.LastGainAt = os.clock()
						bM.ActiveBelt = bM.ActiveBelt or "gain"
						bM.Riding = true
						bM.EquipPending = false
						if bM.AntiTreadmill then
							startUnequipGuard(true)
							return
						end
						bM.Mode = "Active"
						bM.Boost = "Gain ticking"
					end)
					ap(function() c:Disconnect() end)
				end
			end)
			local function readTreadmillUpgradeState()
				local ok, lvl, money, nextTier = pcall(function()
					local saveMod = require(ag.Shared.Save)
					local treadData = require(ag.Data.Treadmills)
					local save = (saveMod.Peek or saveMod.Get)()
					if save then
						local cur = tonumber(save.TreadmillUpgradeLevel) or 0
						return cur, save.Money, treadData.GetByUpgradeLevel(cur + 1)
					end
					return nil
				end)
				if ok and lvl ~= nil then return lvl, money, nextTier end
				return nil
			end
			local function raiseTreadmillTier()
				local _, money, nextTier = readTreadmillUpgradeState()
				if not nextTier then return false, "Max tier" end
				if (tonumber(money) or 0) < (tonumber(nextTier.Price) or 0) then return false, "Not enough money" end
				local rem = au.TreadmillRemotes()
				local ok, res, msg = false, nil, nil
				if rem and rem.AskTierRaise then
					ok, res, msg = pcall(function()
						return rem.AskTierRaise:InvokeServer(nextTier._id)
					end)
				else
					local rf = ak:FindFirstChild("RF/Treadmill/AskTierRaise")
					if rf and rf:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
						ok, res, msg = pcall(rf.InvokeServer, rf, nextTier._id)
					end
				end
				if ok and res == true then return true, tostring(nextTier.DisplayName or nextTier._id) end
				return false, tostring(msg or res or "Rejected")
			end
			task.spawn(function()
				pcall(au.SyncActiveTreadmill)
				while not bL do
					if bM.AntiTreadmill then
						if bM.ActiveBelt ~= nil or bM.Riding or au.OnBelt() then
							au.InvokeDoff()
							bM.Riding = false
							bM.ActiveBelt = nil
							bM.AutoMounted = false
						end
						task.wait(0.25)
					elseif not isTreadmillWanted() then
						if bM.AutoMounted and (bM.ActiveBelt ~= nil or bM.Riding) then
							startUnequipGuard(true)
						end
						bM.FallbackRiding = false
						task.wait(0.25)
					else
						local gen = bK
						if au.BeltHeld() then
							au.ResetBelt()
						end
						local beltPart = au.Belt()
						local standCF = au.ResolveTreadmillStandCFrame()
						if not beltPart or not standCF then
							bM.Mode = "Idle"
							bM.Boost = "Position unavailable"
							task.wait(1.5)
						else
							local targetPos = beltPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, beltPart.Size.Y * 0.5, 0)
							local root = au.Root()
							if root and au.ClaimMovement("treadmill") then
								bM.Traveling = true
								bM.FallbackRiding = isIdleFallbackWanted()
								local alreadyOn = au.OnBelt() or (root.Position - (targetPos + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))).Magnitude <= 10
								local reachedBelt = alreadyOn
								if not reachedBelt and type(au.FlyTo) == "function" then
									bM.Mode = "Moving"
									bM.Boost = "Heading to treadmill"
									local okFly, flyRes = pcall(au.FlyTo, targetPos, function()
										return bL or gen ~= bK or au.Movement.Owner ~= "treadmill" or not isTreadmillWanted()
									end, "treadmill")
									reachedBelt = okFly and flyRes == true
								end
								root = au.Root()
								if reachedBelt and root and not bL and gen == bK and au.Movement.Owner == "treadmill" and isTreadmillWanted() then
									if not au.OnBelt() and (root.Position - standCF.Position).Magnitude <= 16 then
										pcall(function()
											root.CFrame = standCF
											root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
											root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
										end)
										task.wait(0.25)
									end
									if not bL and gen == bK and isTreadmillWanted() then
										if type(au.Swapped) == "function" and au.Swapped() and type(au.UndoSwap) == "function" then
											pcall(au.UndoSwap)
											task.wait(0.1)
										end
										bM.EquipPending = true
										local okW, r1, r2 = au.InvokeWearStill()
										if evalWearStillResult(okW, r1, r2) then
											bM.Riding = true
											bM.AutoMounted = true
											bM.ActiveBelt = bM.ActiveBelt or "equipped"
											bM.LastFailed = false
											bM.FailStreak = 0
											bM.Mode = "Active"
											bM.Boost = "Speed power building"
										else
											bM.EquipPending = false
											bM.LastFailed = true
											bM.FailStreak = (tonumber(bM.FailStreak) or 0) + 1
											bM.Mode = "Retrying"
											bM.Boost = tostring(r2 or r1 or "Retry")
										end
									end
								end
								bM.Traveling = false
								au.ReleaseMovement("treadmill")
							end
							local offBeltElapsed = 0
							local nextRemountCheck = os.clock() + 5
							while not bL and gen == bK and isTreadmillWanted() and (bM.Riding or bM.ActiveBelt ~= nil or au.OnBelt()) do
								if not au.Toggle(bI, true) and not isIdleFallbackWanted() then break end
								local dtWait = task.wait(0.25)
								if au.OnBelt() then
									offBeltElapsed = 0
									if os.clock() >= nextRemountCheck and not au.Flying and (os.clock() - (bM.LastGainAt or 0) >= 6) then
										nextRemountCheck = os.clock() + 5
										local okW, r1, r2 = au.InvokeWearStill()
										evalWearStillResult(okW, r1, r2)
									end
								else
									offBeltElapsed = offBeltElapsed + (tonumber(dtWait) or 0.25)
									if offBeltElapsed >= 1.5 then
										bM.Riding = false
										bM.ActiveBelt = nil
										break
									end
								end
							end
							if not isTreadmillWanted() and bM.AutoMounted then
								bM.FallbackRiding = false
								startUnequipGuard(true)
							elseif not bM.Riding then
								task.wait(bM.LastFailed and 2.5 or 1.0)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end)
			task.spawn(function()
				while not bL do
					task.wait(1.5)
					if not bM.AntiTreadmill and not isTreadmillWanted() and not isAutomationBlockingBelt() and not au.Flying and au.OnBelt() then
						if type(au.Swapped) == "function" and au.Swapped() and type(au.UndoSwap) == "function" then
							pcall(au.UndoSwap)
						end
					end
				end
			end)
			ap(function()
				bL = true
				bM.Riding = false
				bM.ActiveBelt = nil
				bM.AutoMounted = false
			end)
			bH = a5:CreateToggle({
				Name = "Auto Treadmill",
				Note = "Locks onto treadmill, runs continuously and generates maximum speed power",
