						local lists = { Monsters = {}, Spirits = {}, Items = {}, Eggs = {}, Landmarks = {} }
						local portals = {}
						pcall(function()
							local w = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
							local dim = workspace:FindFirstChild("HalloweenDimension") or (w and w:FindFirstChild("HalloweenDimension")) or workspace:FindFirstChild("HalloweenDimension", true)
							local monstersFolder = dim and dim:FindFirstChild("Monsters")
							for _, nf in ipairs(NAMED_FINDS) do
								pcall(function()
									local f = (w and w:FindFirstChild(nf[1])) or workspace:FindFirstChild(nf[1]) or workspace:FindFirstChild(nf[1], true)
									if f then nf[2](f) end
								end)
							end
							local taggedAny = false
							pcall(function()
								local CS = game:GetService("CollectionService")
								for _, m in ipairs(CS:GetTagged("HalloweenMonster")) do
									if m:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and m:GetAttribute("KilledBy") == nil then
										local label = monLabel(m.Name)
										if label then
											local pos = nil
											pcall(function()
												local anchor = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m:FindFirstChild("Hitbox") or m:FindFirstChild("CENTER")
												pos = anchor and anchor.Position or (m:IsA("Model") and m:GetPivot().Position) or (m:IsA("BasePart") and m.Position) or nil
											end)
											if pos then
												taggedAny = true
												table.insert(lists.Monsters, { Inst = m, Pos = pos, Label = label, Size = m:GetAttribute("MonsterSize") })
											end
										end
									end
								end
							end)
							if monstersFolder and not taggedAny then
								for _, m in ipairs(monstersFolder:GetChildren()) do
									local label = monLabel(m.Name)
									if label and m:GetAttribute("KilledBy") == nil then
										local pos = nil
										pcall(function()
											local anchor = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m:FindFirstChild("Hitbox") or m:FindFirstChild("CENTER")
											pos = anchor and anchor.Position or (m:IsA("Model") and m:GetPivot().Position) or (m:IsA("BasePart") and m.Position) or nil
										end)
										if pos then
											table.insert(lists.Monsters, { Inst = m, Pos = pos, Label = label })
										end
									end
								end
							end
							local worldEggs = (dim and dim:FindFirstChild("WorldEggs")) or (w and w:FindFirstChild("WorldEggs")) or workspace:FindFirstChild("WorldEggs", true)
							if worldEggs then
								for _, egg in ipairs(worldEggs:GetChildren()) do
									if egg:GetAttribute("HalloweenEggUid") ~= nil then
										local pos = nil
										pcall(function()
											pos = egg:IsA("BasePart") and egg.Position or (egg:IsA("Model") and egg:GetPivot().Position) or nil
										end)
										if pos then
											table.insert(lists.Eggs, { Inst = egg, Pos = pos, Label = "Spooky Egg", Uid = true })
										end
									end
								end
							end
							if hw.InDimension() and (force or os.clock() - (hw.LastSweepAt or 0) >= 10) then
								hw.LastSweepAt = os.clock()
								local roots = {}
								local seenRoot = {}
								local function addRoots(base)
									if not base then return end
									for _, c in ipairs(base:GetChildren()) do
										if c ~= monstersFolder and not seenRoot[c] then
											seenRoot[c] = true
											table.insert(roots, c)
										end
									end
								end
								if dim then addRoots(dim) end
								if not dim then addRoots(w or workspace) end
							for _, r0 in ipairs(roots) do
								for _, inst in ipairs(r0:GetDescendants()) do
									local cls = inst.ClassName
									if cls == "Model" or cls == "ProximityPrompt" or (cls == "BasePart" and #inst.Name <= 28) then
										local kind, label = classify(inst)
										if kind then
											local pos = nil
											pcall(function()
												pos = inst:IsA("BasePart") and inst.Position or (inst:IsA("Model") and inst:GetPivot().Position) or nil
											end)
											if pos then
												if kind == "Landmarks" then
													local n = string.lower(inst.Name)
													if hasKw(n, { "portal", "gateway" }) then
														table.insert(portals, inst)
														hw.Found.Portal = inst
													elseif hasKw(n, { "giant pumpkin" }) or hasKw(n, { "event shop", "halloween shop" }) then hw.Found.GiantPumpkin = inst
													elseif hasKw(n, { "echo", "headlesshorseman", "blackhorseman", "ghost dog", "ghostdog" }) then hw.Found.Echo = inst
													elseif hasKw(n, { "returnspot", "casttarget", "fishingspot", "fishing spot", "fishspot", "pier" }) then hw.Found.FishSpot = inst
													elseif hasKw(n, { "fisherman", "gilbert" }) then hw.Found.Fisherman = inst
													elseif hasKw(n, { "station" }) then hw.Found.Station = inst
													elseif hasKw(n, { "phantom express", "train", "locomotive" }) then hw.Found.Train = inst
													elseif hasKw(n, { "soul trader", "soultrader" }) then hw.Found.SoulTrader = inst
													elseif hasKw(n, { "altar" }) then hw.Found.Altar = inst
													elseif hasKw(n, { "dock", "ferry" }) then hw.Found.Dock = inst
													end
												end
												table.insert(lists[kind], { Inst = inst, Pos = pos, Label = label })
											end
										end
									end
								end
							end
								if #lists.Eggs == 0 then
									pcall(function()
										for _, inst in ipairs((dim or w or workspace):GetDescendants()) do
											if inst:GetAttribute("HalloweenEggUid") ~= nil then
												local pos = nil
												pcall(function()
													pos = inst:IsA("BasePart") and inst.Position or (inst:IsA("Model") and inst:GetPivot().Position) or nil
												end)
												if pos then
													table.insert(lists.Eggs, { Inst = inst, Pos = pos, Label = "Spooky Egg", Uid = true })
												end
											end
										end
									end)
								end
							end
						end)
						hw.Lists = lists
						if #portals > 0 then
							hw.FoundPortals = portals
						end
						hw.Scanning = false
					end)
				end
				local function nearest(list, maxDist, pos)
					local best, bestD = nil, tonumber(maxDist) or 1e9
					pos = pos or (root() and root().Position)
					if not pos then return nil end
					for _, e in ipairs(list or {}) do
						local d = (e.Pos - pos).Magnitude
						if d < bestD then
							bestD = d
							best = e
						end
					end
					return best, bestD
				end
				hw.GoTo = function(target, stopDist)
					if not target then return false end
					local goalPos = nil
					pcall(function()
						goalPos = target:IsA("BasePart") and target.Position or (target:IsA("Model") and target:GetPivot().Position) or target.Pos or (typeof(target) == "Vector3" and target) or nil
					end)
					if not goalPos then return false end
					stopDist = tonumber(stopDist) or 8
					local r = root()
					if not r then return false end
					if (r.Position - goalPos).Magnitude > stopDist then
						pcall(function()
							r.CFrame = CFrame.new(goalPos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
						end)
						task.wait(0.12)
					end
					r = root()
					return r ~= nil and (r.Position - goalPos).Magnitude <= stopDist + 16
				end
				hw.PromptFire = function(target)
					if not target then return false end
					local holder = target.Inst or target
					local best, bestD = nil, 1e9
					pcall(function()
						local anchor = holder:IsA("BasePart") and holder.Position or (holder:IsA("Model") and holder:GetPivot().Position)
						if holder:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
							best = holder
						else
							for _, ch in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
								if ch:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
									local pp = ch.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and ch.Parent.Position or anchor
									if pp then
										local d = (pp - anchor).Magnitude
										if d < bestD then
											bestD = d
											best = ch
										end
									end
								end
							end
							if not best then
								for _, d in ipairs(holder:GetDescendants()) do
									if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
										best = d
										break
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end)
					if best then
						pcall(au.FirePrompt, best)
						return true
					end
					return false
				end
				hw.Touch = function(target)
					local r = root()
					if not r then return false end
					local pos = target.Pos or (target:IsA("BasePart") and target.Position) or nil
					if not pos then return false end
					pcall(function()
						r.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
					end)
					return true
				end
				local lastBatAsk = 0
				local function pickBat()
					local best, bestReady = nil, nil
					pcall(function()
						local boxes = { LocalP.Character, LocalP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }
						for _, box in ipairs(boxes) do
							if box then
								for _, t in ipairs(box:GetChildren()) do
									if t:IsA("Tool") then
										local gear = t:GetAttribute("GearName") or t.Name
										local picked = true
										if next(cfg.WeaponsPick) then
											picked = false
											for k in pairs(cfg.WeaponsPick) do
												if hasKw(gear, { string.lower(tostring(k)) }) then
													picked = true
													break
												end
											end
										end
										if picked and (hasKw(gear, { "bat" }) or next(cfg.WeaponsPick)) then
											local cd = tonumber(t:GetAttribute("CooldownEndTime")) or 0
											if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() >= cd then
												bestReady = bestReady or t
											end
											best = best or t
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end)
					return bestReady or best
				end
				hw.Kill = function(model)
					local holder = model.Inst or model
					local target = nil
					pcall(function()
						target = holder:FindFirstChild("Hitbox") or holder:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or holder:FindFirstChild("CENTER") or nil
						if not target then
							local sub = holder:FindFirstChild("Model")
							target = sub and (sub:FindFirstChild("RootPart") or sub:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")) or nil
						end
						if not target and holder:IsA("BasePart") then target = holder end
					end)
					if not target then return false end
					if os.clock() - lastBatAsk > 3 then
						lastBatAsk = os.clock()
						pcall(au.InvokeRemote, "RF/Codex/AskWearFieldBat")
					end
					local bat = pickBat()
					if bat and LocalP.Character and bat.Parent ~= LocalP.Character then
						local h = hum()
						if h then pcall(h.EquipTool, h, bat) end
					end
					if bat and os.clock() - (hw.TriggerAt or 0) > 0.15 then
						hw.TriggerAt = os.clock()
						local okT = pcall(au.FireRemote, "RE/ToolTrigger/Trigger", bat)
						if okT then
							return true
						end
					end
					hw.SwingSeq = hw.SwingSeq + 1
					local seq = string.format("%d:%d:%d", LocalP.UserId, hw.SwingSeq, math.floor(workspace:GetServerTimeNow() * 1000))
					pcall(au.FireRemote, "RE/BatSwing/Trigger", target, seq)
					return true
				end
				local candyAt = 0
				hw.CandyCorn = function()
					if os.clock() - candyAt < 3 then return hw.Candy end
					candyAt = os.clock()
					local v = nil
					pcall(function()
						local ls = LocalP:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
						if ls then
							for _, ch in ipairs(ls:GetChildren()) do
								if hasKw(ch.Name, { "candy" }) then
									v = tonumber(ch.Value)
									if v then return end
								end
							end
						end
						for _, attr in ipairs({ "HalloweenTokens", "CandyCorn", "CandyCorns", "Candy_Corn", "Candy" }) do
							v = tonumber(LocalP:GetAttribute(attr))
							if v then return end
						end
						local sv = type(au.ReadSave) == "function" and au.ReadSave() or nil
						local function walk(t, d)
							if type(t) ~= "table" or d > 3 or v then return end
							for k, val in pairs(t) do
								if type(k) == "string" and hasKw(k, { "candycorn", "candy_corn", "candy" }) and tonumber(val) then
									v = tonumber(val)
									return
								end
								if type(val) == "table" then walk(val, d + 1) end
							end
						end
						if sv then walk(sv, 0) end
					end)
					hw.Candy = tonumber(v) or hw.Candy
					return hw.Candy
				end
				hw.FindPortal = function()
					local f = hw.Found.HWPortal
					if f and f.Parent then return f end
					local p = nil
					pcall(function()
						local w = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
						p = (w and w:FindFirstChild("HalloweenDimensionPortal")) or workspace:FindFirstChild("HalloweenDimensionPortal") or workspace:FindFirstChild("HalloweenDimensionPortal", true)
					end)
					hw.Found.HWPortal = p
					return p
				end
				hw.SwitchDimension = function()
					if os.clock() < (hw.NoPortalUntil or 0) then return false end
					local portal = hw.FindPortal()
					if not portal then
						noteRare("nop portal", "Halloween", "Halloween portal is not here", 20)
						hw.NoPortalUntil = os.clock() + 15
						return false
					end
					local hitbox = portal:FindFirstChild("Hitbox") or portal:FindFirstChild("Hitbox", true) or portal:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
					if not hitbox then
						noteRare("no hitbox", "Halloween", "Halloween portal is not here", 20)
						hw.NoPortalUntil = os.clock() + 15
						return false
					end
					pcall(au.ExitBelt)
					noteRare("go portal", "Halloween", "Teleporting to the Halloween portal", 8)
					local function settle()
						pcall(au.UndoSwap)
						task.wait(1.5)
						pcall(au.InvokeRemote, "RF/HalloweenDimension/AskTutorialSeen")
						hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 1
						return true
					end
					for attempt = 1, 3 do
						local r = root()
						if not r then return false end
						pcall(function()
							r.CFrame = CFrame.new(hitbox.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
							r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						end)
						hw.PromptFire(portal)
						hw.PromptFire(hitbox)
						local deadline = os.clock() + (attempt < 3 and 4 or 8)
						while os.clock() < deadline do
							if hw.InDimension() then return settle() end
							task.wait(0.25)
						end
						pcall(function()
							local r = root()
							if r then
								r.CFrame = CFrame.new(hitbox.Position)
								r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
							end
						end)
						local t0 = os.clock() + 2
						while os.clock() < t0 do
							if hw.InDimension() then return settle() end
							task.wait(0.2)
						end
					end
					noteRare("enter fail", "Halloween", "The Halloween portal did not take you", 15)
					hw.NoPortalUntil = os.clock() + 10
					return false
				end
				hw.Busy = function()
					return hw.Active == true
				end
				local function jobBuy()
					if not cfg.BuyEgg then return false end
					if os.clock() - (hw.LastBuyRemoteAt or 0) > 5 then
						hw.LastBuyRemoteAt = os.clock()
						local okB, resB = pcall(au.InvokeRemote, "RF/HalloweenDimension/AskBuyEgg")
						if okB and resB == true then
							note("Halloween", "Bought a Halloween Dimension Egg")
							hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 1.2
							return true
						end
					end
					local shop = hw.Found.GiantPumpkin
					if not shop then
						hw.Scan(true)
						shop = hw.Found.GiantPumpkin
					end
					if not shop then return false end
					if hw.GoTo(shop, 10) then
						hw.PromptFire(shop)
						hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 1.2
						note("Halloween", "Bought a Halloween Dimension Egg")
						return true
					end
					return false
				end
				local function findSafeZone()
					local z = hw.Found.SafeZone
					if z and z.Parent then return z end
					z = nil
					pcall(function()
						local w = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
						z = (w and w:FindFirstChild("SafeZone")) or workspace:FindFirstChild("SafeZone") or workspace:FindFirstChild("SafeZone", true) or workspace:FindFirstChild("SpawnedHalloweenEggDelivery", true)
					end)
					hw.Found.SafeZone = z
					return z
				end
				local SIZE_TOKENS = { Small = 12, Medium = 28, Large = 65 }
				local function monTokens(e)
					local t = nil
					pcall(function()
						local sz = e.Inst:GetAttribute("MonsterSize")
						if type(sz) == "string" then
							t = SIZE_TOKENS[sz]
						end
					end)
					return t or MONSTER_TOKENS[e.Label] or 12
				end
				local function jobMonsters()
					if not cfg.Monsters then return false end
					local me = root()
					local pos = me and me.Position
					if not pos then return false end
					if not pickBat() then
						noteRare("nobat", "Halloween", "Get a bat to fight monsters", 20)
						return false
					end
					local h = hum()
					if h and h.MaxHealth > 0 and h.Health < h.MaxHealth * 0.4 then
						local zone = findSafeZone()
						if zone then
							noteRare("lowhp", "Halloween", "Low health, healing in the safe zone", 20)
							hw.GoTo(zone, 8)
							hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 5
							return true
						end
					end
					local zone = findSafeZone()
					local best = nil
					local cur = hw.TargetMonster
					if cur and cur.Inst and cur.Inst.Parent then
						local alive = true
						pcall(function()
							if cur.Inst:GetAttribute("KilledBy") ~= nil then alive = false end
						end)
						if alive then best = cur end
					end
					if not best then
						local bestScore = math.huge
						for _, e in ipairs(hw.Lists.Monsters or {}) do
							local alive = true
							pcall(function()
								if e.Inst:GetAttribute("KilledBy") ~= nil then alive = false end
							end)
							if alive and selHas(cfg.MonsterPick, e.Label) then
								local d = (e.Pos - pos).Magnitude
								local inSafe = false
								if zone then
									pcall(function()
										local zp = zone:IsA("BasePart") and zone.Position or zone:GetPivot().Position
										if (e.Pos - zp).Magnitude < math.max(zone:IsA("BasePart") and zone.Size.X or 100, 60) then inSafe = true end
									end)
								end
								if not inSafe then
									local score
									if cfg.MonsterMode == "Most Tokens" then
										score = d - monTokens(e) * 1000
									else
										score = d
									end
									if score < bestScore then
										bestScore = score
										best = e
									end
								end
							end
						end
						hw.TargetMonster = best
					end
					if not best then return false end
					log("Fighting a " .. tostring((best.Inst and best.Inst:GetAttribute("MonsterSize")) or best.Label) .. " monster")
					local function fightOn()
						if hw.Halt or not cfg.Monsters then return false end
						if LocalP:GetAttribute("HalloweenCarrying") == true then return false end
						if not best.Inst or best.Inst.Parent == nil then return false end
						local okA, alive = pcall(function() return best.Inst:GetAttribute("KilledBy") == nil end)
						if not okA or not alive then return false end
						local hh = hum()
						if hh and hh.MaxHealth > 0 and hh.Health < hh.MaxHealth * 0.4 then return false end
						return true
					end
					local deadline = os.clock() + 15
					while fightOn() and os.clock() < deadline do
						if os.clock() < (hw.PauseUntil or 0) then break end
						pcall(function()
							local anchor = best.Inst:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or best.Inst:FindFirstChild("Hitbox") or best.Inst:FindFirstChild("CENTER")
							if anchor then best.Pos = anchor.Position end
						end)
						local r = root()
						if not r then break end
						local away = r.Position - best.Pos
						local goal = best.Pos + (away.Magnitude > 0.1 and away.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)) * 4
						if (goal - r.Position).Magnitude > 6 then
							pcall(function()
								r.CFrame = CFrame.new(goal + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
								r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
							end)
						end
						local bat = pickBat()
						if bat and LocalP.Character and bat.Parent ~= LocalP.Character then
							local hh = hum()
							if hh then pcall(hh.EquipTool, hh, bat) end
							hw.WeaponAt = os.clock()
						end
						local armed = bat ~= nil and LocalP.Character ~= nil and bat.Parent == LocalP.Character
						if armed then
							local cdOk = true
							pcall(function()
								cdOk = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() >= (tonumber(bat:GetAttribute("CooldownEndTime")) or 0)
							end)
							if cdOk and os.clock() - (hw.TriggerAt or 0) > 0.1 and os.clock() - (hw.WeaponAt or 0) > 0.15 then
								hw.TriggerAt = os.clock()
								pcall(au.FireRemote, "RE/ToolTrigger/Trigger", bat)
							end
						else
							hw.Kill(best)
						end
						task.wait(0.15)
					end
					if hw.TargetMonster == best then hw.TargetMonster = nil end
					hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 0.1
					return true
				end
				local function eggName(e)
					local inst = e.Inst
					local name = tostring(inst.Name) .. " " .. tostring(e.Label)
					local found = nil
					pcall(function()
						for _, attr in ipairs({ "Pet", "PetName", "ContainsPet", "PredictedPet", "Hatch", "HatchPet", "EggName", "DisplayName" }) do
							local v = inst:GetAttribute(attr)
							if type(v) == "string" and v ~= "" then
								found = v
								return
							end
						end
					end)
					if not found then
						for _, p in ipairs(EGG_NAMES) do
							if hasKw(name, { string.lower(p) }) then
								found = p
								break
							end
						end
					end
					return found or name
				end
				local function eggRarity(e)
					local inst = e.Inst
					local rarity = nil
					pcall(function()
						for _, attr in ipairs({ "Rarity", "EggRarity", "Tier" }) do
							local v = inst:GetAttribute(attr)
							if type(v) == "string" and v ~= "" then
								rarity = v
								return
							end
						end
					end)
					if not rarity then
						local name = string.lower(tostring(inst.Name) .. " " .. tostring(e.Label))
						for _, r in ipairs(EGG_RARITIES) do
							if hasKw(name, { string.lower(r) }) then
								rarity = r
								break
							end
						end
					end
					return rarity
				end
				local function eggValue(e)
					local inst = e.Inst
					local v = nil
					pcall(function()
						for _, attr in ipairs({ "Value", "EggValue", "Worth", "SellValue" }) do
							local a = inst:GetAttribute(attr)
							if tonumber(a) then
								v = tonumber(a)
								return
							end
						end
					end)
					return v
				end
				local function eggOk(e)
					if next(cfg.EggNamePick) then
						if not selHas(cfg.EggNamePick, eggName(e)) then return false end
					end
					if next(cfg.RarityPick) then
						local rarity = eggRarity(e)
						if not rarity or not selHas(cfg.RarityPick, rarity) then return false end
					end
					if (tonumber(cfg.MinValue) or 0) > 0 then
						local v = eggValue(e)
						if v and v < cfg.MinValue then return false end
					end
					return true
				end
				local function dropAndConfirm(uid)
					pcall(au.InvokeRemote, "RF/HalloweenDimension/AskDropEgg")
					local sawDrop = false
					local t0 = os.clock()
					while os.clock() - t0 < 3 do
						local carrying = LocalP:GetAttribute("HalloweenCarrying") == true
						if not carrying then
							sawDrop = true
						elseif sawDrop then
							return true
						end
						if sawDrop and uid ~= nil then
							pcall(function()
								local w = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
								local holder = (w and w:FindFirstChild("WorldEggs")) or workspace:FindFirstChild("WorldEggs", true)
								local egg = nil
								for _, c in ipairs(holder and holder:GetChildren() or {}) do
									if c:GetAttribute("HalloweenEggUid") == uid then
										egg = c
										break
									end
								end
								local sp = egg and egg:FindFirstChild("StealPrompt", true)
								if sp then
									local okE, en = pcall(function() return sp.Enabled end)
									if okE and en then
										pcall(function()
											local r = root()
											local ep = egg:IsA("BasePart") and egg.Position or (egg:IsA("Model") and egg:GetPivot().Position)
											if r and ep then
												r.CFrame = CFrame.new(ep + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
											end
										end)
										pcall(au.FirePrompt, sp)
									end
								end
							end)
						end
						task.wait(0.1)
					end
					return false
				end
				local function deliverEgg()
					local before = nil
					pcall(function() before = LocalP:GetAttribute("HalloweenDelivered") end)
					local uid = hw.WantEggUid
					local sz = findSafeZone()
					local goal = nil
					if sz then
						pcall(function()
							if sz:IsA("BasePart") then
								local rr = root()
								local rel = sz.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(rr and rr.Position or sz.Position)
								local expand = cfg.InstantSteal and 10 or -40
								local hx, hz = math.max(sz.Size.X / 2 + expand, 0), math.max(sz.Size.Z / 2 + expand, 0)
								goal = sz.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(math.clamp(rel.X, -hx, hx), 0, math.clamp(rel.Z, -hz, hz)))
							elseif sz:IsA("Model") then
								goal = sz:GetPivot().Position
							end
						end)
						if goal then
							hw.GoTo({ Pos = goal }, 6)
						else
							hw.GoTo(sz, 8)
						end
						if cfg.InstantSteal then
							for _ = 1, 4 do
								local t0 = os.clock() + 0.8
								local pulled = false
								while os.clock() < t0 do
									if LocalP:GetAttribute("HalloweenCarrying") ~= true then break end
									local r = root()
									if r and goal and (r.Position - goal).Magnitude >= 100 then
										pulled = true
										break
									end
									task.wait(0.1)
								end
								if not pulled then break end
								noteRare("pulled", "Halloween", "Pulled back, stepping to the safe zone edge again", 5)
								if goal then
									hw.GoTo({ Pos = goal }, 6)
								end
							end
							if LocalP:GetAttribute("HalloweenCarrying") == true then
								if dropAndConfirm(uid) then
									task.wait(0.5)
								end
							end
						end
					end
					for _ = 1, 12 do
						pcall(au.InvokeRemote, "RF/HalloweenDimension/AskDropEgg")
						task.wait(0.4)
						local carry, deliv = nil, nil
						pcall(function()
							carry = LocalP:GetAttribute("HalloweenCarrying")
							deliv = LocalP:GetAttribute("HalloweenDelivered")
						end)
						if carry ~= true or (before ~= nil and deliv ~= nil and deliv ~= before) then
							break
						end
						pcall(function()
							if sz then hw.GoTo(sz, 4) end
						end)
					end
				end
				local function jobEggs()
					if not cfg.SpookyEggs and LocalP:GetAttribute("HalloweenCarrying") ~= true then return false end
					pcall(function()
						if hw.WantEggUid and hw.InDimension() then
							local stillThere = false
							for _, e in ipairs(hw.Lists.Eggs or {}) do
								if e.Inst:GetAttribute("HalloweenEggUid") == hw.WantEggUid then
									stillThere = true
									break
								end
							end
							if not stillThere then
								local carrying = LocalP:GetAttribute("HalloweenCarrying") == true
								hw.WantEggUid = nil
								if not carrying then
									noteRare("egg miss", "Halloween", "A Halloween egg got away - missed!", 5)
									if cfg.HopOnMiss and os.clock() > (hw.StartedAt or 0) + 120 and os.clock() - (hw.LastMissHopAt or -1e9) > (tonumber(cfg.HopCooldown) or 300) and not (au.Steal and au.Steal.Carrying) then
										hw.LastMissHopAt = os.clock()
										note("Halloween", "Egg missed - hopping to a new server for more eggs")
										task.spawn(function()
											pcall(au.HopServer)
										end)
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end)
					local pos = root() and root().Position
					if not pos then return false end
					local function orderIdx(name)
						if not next(cfg.EggNamePick) then return 1 end
						for i, n in ipairs(EGG_NAMES) do
							if cfg.EggNamePick[n] and hasKw(tostring(name), { string.lower(n) }) then
								return i
							end
						end
						return 1e9
					end
					local pick, pickD = nil, 1e9
					local pickO, pickV = 1e9, -math.huge
					for _, e in ipairs(hw.Lists.Eggs or {}) do
						if (e.Pos - pos).Magnitude <= 6000 and eggOk(e) and (hw.Bad[e.Inst] or 0) < os.clock() then
							local sp = nil
							pcall(function()
								sp = (e.Inst or e):FindFirstChild("StealPrompt", true)
							end)
							local spOk = (sp == nil)
							if sp ~= nil then
								local okE, en = pcall(function() return sp.Enabled end)
								spOk = okE and en == true
							end
							if spOk then
								local d = (e.Pos - pos).Magnitude
								local oi = orderIdx(eggName(e))
								local v = tonumber(eggValue(e)) or 0
								if oi < pickO or (oi == pickO and v > pickV) or (oi == pickO and v == pickV and d < pickD) then
									pickO, pickV, pickD, pick = oi, v, d, e
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if not pick then return false end
					if pick.Uid then
						pcall(function()
							hw.WantEggUid = pick.Inst:GetAttribute("HalloweenEggUid")
						end)
					end
					if pickD > 20 then
						hw.GoTo(pick, 12)
					end
					local deadline = os.clock() + 4
					while os.clock() < deadline do
						if hw.Halt or os.clock() < (hw.PauseUntil or 0) then break end
						pcall(function()
							local eggPos = pick.Pos
							pcall(function()
								local inst = pick.Inst
								if inst then
									eggPos = inst:IsA("BasePart") and inst.Position or (inst:IsA("Model") and inst:GetPivot().Position) or eggPos
								end
							end)
							local r = root()
							if r and eggPos then
								r.CFrame = CFrame.new(eggPos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
							end
						end)
						pcall(function()
							local sp = (pick.Inst or pick):FindFirstChild("StealPrompt", true)
							if sp then
								au.FirePrompt(sp)
							end
						end)
						task.wait(0.1)
						if LocalP:GetAttribute("HalloweenCarrying") == true then
							break
						end
					end
					if LocalP:GetAttribute("HalloweenCarrying") == true then
						pcall(function()
							local h = hum()
							if h then h.WalkSpeed = tonumber(cfg.StealSpeed) or 40 end
						end)
						deliverEgg()
						hw.WantEggUid = nil
					else
						if pick.Inst then
							hw.Bad[pick.Inst] = os.clock() + 30
						end
						hw.WantEggUid = nil
					end
					hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 0.4
					return true
				end
				local STAGE_NAMES = { "Meeting the dog", "Finding the memories", "Asking the fisherman", "Casting at the ripples", "Done" }
				local ECHO_KEYS = { "Collar", "Bone", "Toy", "Photo" }
				local echoStep = 0
				local questDataMod = nil
				local function questData()
					if questDataMod ~= nil then return questDataMod or nil end
					questDataMod = false
					pcall(function()
						local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
						local data = rs:FindFirstChild("Data", true)
						local m = data and data:FindFirstChild("GhostDogQuest")
						if m then questDataMod = require(m) end
					end)
					return questDataMod or nil
				end
				local function questState()
					local sv = type(au.ReadSave) == "function" and au.ReadSave() or nil
					local q = type(sv) == "table" and sv.GhostDogQuest or nil
					return type(q) == "table" and tonumber(q.Stage) or 0, type(q) == "table" and q or {}
				end
				local function questFlags(key, default)
					local out = nil
					pcall(function()
						local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
						local flags = rs:FindFirstChild("Flags", true)
						local mod = flags and flags:FindFirstChild("GhostDogQuestFlags")
						if mod then
							local obj = require(mod)[key]
							if type(obj) == "table" and type(obj.Get) == "function" then
								out = obj:Get()
							end
						end
					end)
					if type(out) == "number" then return out end
					local sv = type(au.ReadSave) == "function" and au.ReadSave() or nil
					local f = type(sv) == "table" and sv.GhostDogQuestFlags or nil
					if type(f) == "table" and type(f[key]) == "number" then return f[key] end
					return default
				end
				local function questMarker(name)
					local out = nil
					pcall(function()
						local dim = workspace:FindFirstChild("HalloweenDimension")
						local gq = dim and dim:FindFirstChild("GhostDogQuest")
						local mk = gq and gq:FindFirstChild("Markers")
						if not mk then
							gq = workspace:FindFirstChild("GhostDogQuest", true)
							mk = gq and gq:FindFirstChild("Markers", true) or nil
						end
						local f = mk and mk:FindFirstChild(name) or nil
						if f and f:IsA("BasePart") then out = f end
					end)
					return out
				end
				local function ghostRod()
					local out = nil
					pcall(function()
						local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
						for _, cont in ipairs({ plr and plr.Character, plr and plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }) do
							if cont then
								for _, t in ipairs(cont:GetChildren()) do
									if t:IsA("Tool") and t:GetAttribute("GhostDogRod") == true then
										out = t
										break
									end
								end
							end
							if out then break end
						end
					end)
					return out
				end
				local function fishRod()
					local r = ghostRod()
					if r then return r end
					local out = nil
					pcall(function()
						local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
						for _, cont in ipairs({ plr and plr.Character, plr and plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }) do
							if cont then
								for _, t in ipairs(cont:GetChildren()) do
									if t:IsA("Tool") then
										local n = string.lower(t.Name or "")
										local gear = ""
										pcall(function() gear = string.lower(tostring(t:GetAttribute("GearName") or "")) end)
										if string.find(n, "fishing rod", 1, true) or string.find(n, "fishrod", 1, true)
											or string.find(n, "fishing pole", 1, true) or string.find(n, "fish pole", 1, true)
											or n == "rod" or string.find(gear, "fishing", 1, true) or gear == "rod" then
											out = t
											break
										end
									end
								end
							end
							if out then break end
						end
					end)
					return out
				end
				local function equipTool(t)
					pcall(function()
						if not t then return end
						local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
						local hum = plr and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						if hum and t.Parent ~= plr.Character then
							hum:EquipTool(t)
						end
					end)
					task.wait(0.35)
				end
				local function qAlive(on)
					return (not hw.Halt) and on == true
				end
				local function waitG(sec, alive)
					local untilAt = os.clock() + (tonumber(sec) or 0)
					while os.clock() < untilAt do
						if not (not alive or alive()) then return false end
						task.wait(0.1)
					end
					return (not alive) or alive()
				end
				local function qWalk(pos, alive)
					local r = root()
					if not r or not pos then return false end
					if (r.Position - pos).Magnitude > 400 then
						pcall(au.FlyTo, pos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), function()
							return not (not alive or alive())
						end, "halloween")
					end
					hw.GoTo({ Pos = pos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) }, 8)
					r = root()
					return r ~= nil and (r.Position - pos).Magnitude <= 24
				end
				local function markerAt(name, alive)
					local mk = questMarker(name)
					if mk then
						qWalk(mk.Position, alive)
						return true
					end
					return false
				end
				local function talkTopic(markerName, topic, alive)
					local res, msg
					for _ = 1, 3 do
						local ok, a, b = au.InvokeRemote("RF/GhostDogQuest/Talk", topic)
						if ok and a ~= nil then return a, b end
						if type(b) == "string" and not string.find(string.lower(b), "closer", 1, true) then return a, b end
						res, msg = a, b
						markerAt(markerName, alive)
						if not waitG(0.4, alive) then break end
					end
					return res, msg
				end
				local function underwaterChase(chaseId, totalSeconds, alive)
					local mod = questData()
					if not (mod and type(mod.ChaseFrame) == "function") then
						pcall(au.InvokeRemote, "RF/GhostDogQuest/Abort")
						return false
					end
					local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
					local pitch = CFrame.Angles(-1.2566, 0, 0)
					local function frameAt(t)
						local cf = nil
						pcall(function()
							cf = mod.ChaseFrame(chaseId, t)
						end)
						return typeof(cf) == "CFrame" and cf or nil
					end
					local function pivot(cf)
						pcall(function()
							local char = plr and plr.Character
							if char and char.Parent then
								char:PivotTo(cf * pitch)
							end
						end)
					end
					if not frameAt(0) then
						pcall(au.InvokeRemote, "RF/GhostDogQuest/Abort")
						return false
					end
					hw.Chase = true
					log("Ghost Dog: underwater chase")
					local approach = os.clock() + 4
					while (not alive or alive()) and os.clock() < approach do
						local cf = frameAt(0)
						if cf then pivot(cf) end
						task.wait()
					end
					local speed = questFlags("ChaseSpeed", 58)
					local started = os.clock()
					local maxT = (tonumber(totalSeconds) or 50) * speed
					while (not alive or alive()) do
						local chaseOn = workspace:GetAttribute("GhostDogChase") ~= nil
						local t = math.min((os.clock() - started) * speed, maxT)
						local cf = frameAt(t)
						if cf then pivot(cf) end
						if not chaseOn and (os.clock() - started) > 2 then break end
						if t >= maxT then break end
						task.wait()
					end
					local claimed = false
					for i = 1, 8 do
						local ok, res = au.InvokeRemote("RF/GhostDogQuest/Claim")
						if ok and res == true then
							claimed = true
							break
						end
						if i == 4 then
							local hold = os.clock() + 5
							while (not alive or alive()) and os.clock() < hold do
								local cf = frameAt(maxT)
								if cf then pivot(cf) end
								task.wait()
							end
						else
							task.wait(0.7)
						end
					end
					task.wait(claimed and 3 or 0.5)
					for i = 1, 3 do
						local ok, res = au.InvokeRemote("RF/GhostDogQuest/Surface")
						if ok and res == true then break end
						task.wait(0.5)
					end
					local back = os.clock() + 6
					while (not alive or alive()) and os.clock() < back do
						local mk = questMarker("ReturnSpot")
						local r = root()
						if not mk then break end
						if r and (r.Position - mk.Position).Magnitude < 25 then break end
						task.wait(0.35)
					end
					pcall(au.InvokeRemote, "RF/GhostDogQuest/Abort")
					hw.Chase = false
					hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 1
					return claimed
				end
				local function ghostFishChase(cast, alive)
					if not waitG((tonumber(cast and cast.Wait) or 3) + 0.45, alive) then
						if cast and cast.Id then pcall(au.FireRemote, "RE/Fishing/Cancel", cast.Id) end
						return false
					end
					local ok, chaseId = au.InvokeRemote("RF/GhostDogQuest/Cast", cast and cast.Id or nil)
					if type(chaseId) ~= "number" then
						pcall(au.InvokeRemote, "RF/GhostDogQuest/Abort")
						return false
					end
					if not waitG(3.5, alive) then
						pcall(au.InvokeRemote, "RF/GhostDogQuest/Abort")
						return false
					end
					pcall(au.InvokeRemote, "RF/GhostDogQuest/Dive")
					if underwaterChase(chaseId, questFlags("FishChaseSeconds", 25), alive) then
						note("Fishing", "Caught a Ghost Fish!")
					end
					return true
				end
				local CAST_CHARGE = { ["x1.5 Perfect"] = 0.875, ["x1.2"] = 1, ["x1.1"] = 0.5, ["x1.0 Fastest"] = 0.02 }
				local function castChargeTime()
					local charge = CAST_CHARGE[cfg.CastLuck] or 0.875
					return 1.2 * charge ^ 0.7142857142857143, charge
				end
				local function fishWaterAt(p)
					local ok, res = pcall(function()
						local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
						local params = RaycastParams.new()
						params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
						local excl = { plr and plr.Character }
						for _ = 1, 6 do
							params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excl
							local rc = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(p.X, p.Y + 40, p.Z), Vector3.new(0, -180, 0), params)
							if not rc then return nil end
							local inst = rc.Instance
							local hit = nil
							if rc.Material == Enum.Material.Water then
								hit = rc.Position
							elseif inst:GetAttribute("TerrainRole") == "Basin" then
								hit = rc.Position
							elseif inst:GetAttribute("FishingWater") then
								hit = rc.Position
							else
								pcall(function()
									if game:GetService("CollectionService"):HasTag(inst, "FishingWater") then
										hit = rc.Position
									end
								end)
							end
							if hit then return hit end
							if inst:IsA("BasePart") and not (inst.Transparency >= 0.95) then return nil end
							table.insert(excl, inst)
						end
						return nil
					end)
					return ok and res or nil
				end
				local function jobEcho(force)
					if not cfg.EchoQuest and not force then return false end
					local function alive() return qAlive(cfg.EchoQuest or force == true) end
					local stage, data = questState()
					if stage >= 4 then
						return false
					end
					log("Ghost Dog quest: " .. (STAGE_NAMES[stage + 1] or "Done"))
					if stage == 0 then
						if markerAt("DogSpot", alive) then
							talkTopic("DogSpot", "Dog", alive)
							local untilAt = os.clock() + 5
							while alive() and os.clock() < untilAt do
								if questState() >= 1 then break end
								task.wait(0.5)
							end
						else
							noteRare("nomarker", 30, "Ghost Dog quest markers not found in the Halloween world")
						end
						hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 0.6
						return true
					end
					if stage == 1 then
						local all = true
						for _, key in ipairs(ECHO_KEYS) do
							local haveIt = type(data.Artifacts) == "table" and data.Artifacts[key] ~= nil
							if not haveIt then
								all = false
								if markerAt("Artifact_" .. key, alive) then
									waitG(0.3, alive)
									au.InvokeRemote("RF/GhostDogQuest/Collect", key)
									waitG(0.5, alive)
									note("Ghost Dog", "Collected " .. key)
									hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 0.4
									return true
								end
							end
						end
						if all then
							if markerAt("DogSpot", alive) then
								talkTopic("DogSpot", "Dog", alive)
								waitG(2, alive)
							end
						end
						hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 0.6
						return true
					end
					local hasRod = ghostRod() ~= nil
					if stage == 2 or (stage == 3 and not hasRod) then
						if markerAt("FishermanSpot", alive) then
							local res, msg = talkTopic("FishermanSpot", "Fisherman", alive)
							if res == "FisherReunion" or res == "FisherHint" then
								waitG(2.5, alive)
								talkTopic("FishermanSpot", "Rod", alive)
								local untilAt = os.clock() + 5
								while alive() and os.clock() < untilAt do
									if ghostRod() then break end
									task.wait(0.5)
								end
							end
						else
							noteRare("nomarker", 30, "Ghost Dog: FishermanSpot marker not found")
						end
						hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 0.6
						return true
					end
					if stage == 3 then
						local target = questMarker("CastTarget")
						if target and markerAt("CastSpot", alive) then
							equipTool(ghostRod())
							waitG(0.5, alive)
							local chargeTime = castChargeTime()
							pcall(au.FireRemote, "RE/Fishing/Hold")
							local cast, castMsg = nil, nil
							do
								local ok, a, b = au.InvokeRemote("RF/Fishing/Cast", chargeTime, target.Position)
								if ok and type(a) == "table" then cast = a else castMsg = b or a end
							end
							if cast and tostring(cast.Mode) == "Quest" then
								waitG((tonumber(cast.Wait) or 3) + 0.45, alive)
								pcall(au.FireRemote, "RE/Fishing/Cancel", cast.Id)
								local ok, chaseId = au.InvokeRemote("RF/GhostDogQuest/Cast")
								if type(chaseId) == "number" then
									if underwaterChase(chaseId, questFlags("ChaseSeconds", 50), alive) then
										note("Ghost Dog", "Phantom Express Ticket unlocked")
									end
								else
									pcall(au.InvokeRemote, "RF/GhostDogQuest/Abort")
								end
							elseif cast and cast.Id then
								pcall(au.FireRemote, "RE/Fishing/Cancel", cast.Id)
							elseif not cast then
								noteRare("fisherr", 20, "Ghost Dog: " .. tostring(castMsg or "cast failed"))
							end
						end
						hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 1
						return true
					end
					hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 20
					return true
				end
				local function jobFish()
					if not cfg.Fish then return false end
					local function alive() return qAlive(cfg.Fish) end
					local stage = questState()
					if stage == 3 and questMarker("CastTarget") then
						log("Ghost Dog quest blocks fishing, casting at the ripples")
						return jobEcho(true)
					end
					if os.clock() < (hw.FishAt or 0) then
						waitG(math.min((hw.FishAt or 0) - os.clock(), 1.2), alive)
						return true
					end
					local r = root()
					if not r then return false end
					local ret = questMarker("ReturnSpot") or hw.Found.FishSpot
					if ret then
						local retPos = ret:IsA("BasePart") and ret.Position or ret.Pos
						if retPos and ((r.Position - retPos).Magnitude > 8 or retPos.Y + 1 > r.Position.Y) then
							log("Going to the fishing spot")
							qWalk(retPos, alive)
							hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 0.3
							return true
						end
					else
						noteRare("nospot", 45, "Fishing spot (ReturnSpot marker) not found in the Halloween world")
						return false
					end
					local rod = fishRod()
					if not rod then
						noteRare("norod", 45, "No fishing rod found - equip any Fishing Rod (or the Ghost Dog Rod from the quest)")
						log("Auto fishing: no rod in your inventory")
						return false
					end
					local castTarget = questMarker("CastTarget")
					local look = nil
					pcall(function()
						local gm = workspace:FindFirstChild("GhostFisherman") or workspace:FindFirstChild("GhostFisherman", true)
						if gm and gm:IsA("Model") then
							look = gm:GetPivot().LookVector
						end
					end)
					if not look and ret and ret:IsA("BasePart") then
						look = ret.CFrame.LookVector
					end
					look = look or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
					local ang0 = math.atan2(look.Z, look.X)
					local chargeTime, charge = castChargeTime()
					local castPos = nil
					for i = 0, 12 do
						local ang = ang0 + (i % 2 == 0 and 1 or -1) * math.ceil(i / 2) * 3.141592653589793 / 18
						local p = r.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(ang), 0, math.sin(ang)) * (10 + 32 * charge)
						local water = fishWaterAt(p)
						if water and not (castTarget and (water - castTarget.Position).Magnitude < 12) then
							castPos = water
							break
						end
					end
					if not castPos then
						log("Looking for water to fish")
						waitG(1, alive)
						return true
					end
					qWalk(Vector3.new(castPos.X, r.Position.Y, castPos.Z), alive)
					equipTool(rod)
					pcall(function()
						local rr = root()
						if rr then
							rr.CFrame = CFrame.new(rr.Position, Vector3.new(castPos.X, rr.Position.Y, castPos.Z))
							rr.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
							rr.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
						end
					end)
					log("Casting (" .. tostring(cfg.CastLuck or "x1.5 Perfect") .. ")")
					pcall(au.FireRemote, "RE/Fishing/Hold")
					local cast, castMsg = nil, nil
					do
						local ok, a, b = au.InvokeRemote("RF/Fishing/Cast", chargeTime, castPos)
						if ok and type(a) == "table" then cast = a else castMsg = b or a end
					end
					hw.FishAt = os.clock() + 1.2
					if not cast then
						local m = tostring(castMsg or "no answer")
						hw.FishAt = os.clock() + (string.find(string.lower(m), "closed", 1, true) and 30 or 3)
						noteRare("fisherr", 20, "Fishing: " .. m)
						log("Fishing: " .. m)
						return true
					end
					log("Waiting for a bite")
					local mode = tostring(cast.Mode or "")
					if mode == "GhostFish" then
						ghostFishChase(cast, alive)
					elseif mode == "Nothing" or mode == "Hint" or mode == "Quest" then
						waitG(tonumber(cast.Wait) or 3, alive)
						pcall(au.FireRemote, "RE/Fishing/Cancel", cast.Id)
					else
						if waitG(tonumber(cast.Wait) or 3, alive) then
							log("Reeling in")
							local ok, res, got = au.InvokeRemote("RF/Fishing/Reel", cast.Id, "Caught", 16)
							local prize = type(got) == "table" and got or (type(res) == "table" and res or nil)
							if ok and prize then
								hw.Fish = (hw.Fish or 0) + 1
								note("Fishing", "Caught " .. tostring(prize.DisplayName or "a fish") .. " x" .. tostring(prize.Amount or 1))
							end
						else
							pcall(au.FireRemote, "RE/Fishing/Cancel", cast.Id)
						end
					end
					hw.FishAt = os.clock()
					hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 0.2
					return true
				end
				local function jobTrain()
					if not (cfg.Train or cfg.Boss or cfg.TradeSouls) then return false end
					hw.Scan(false)
					if cfg.Boss then
						local pos = root() and root().Position
						local best, bestRank, bestD = nil, 99, 1e9
						for _, e in ipairs(hw.Lists.Spirits or {}) do
							local rank
							if cfg.GhostTarget == "Closest" then
								rank = 1
							else
								local rarityRank = { ["Vengeful"] = 1, ["Haunted"] = 2, ["Lost"] = 3 }
								rank = rarityRank[e.Label] or 4
							end
							local d = (e.Pos - pos).Magnitude
							if rank <= 4 and (rank < bestRank or (rank == bestRank and d < bestD)) then
								best, bestRank, bestD = e, rank, d
							end
						end
						if best then
							if bestD > 10 then hw.GoTo(best, 8) end
							pcall(function()
								local r = root()
								if r then
									local dir = (best.Pos + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0) - r.Position)
									if dir.Magnitude > 0.5 then
										pcall(au.FireRemote, "RE/GhostBoss/Suction", true, dir.Unit)
										hw.Sucking = true
									end
								end
							end)
							pcall(function()
								local bp = LocalP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
								local vac = nil
								for _, box in ipairs({ LocalP.Character, bp }) do
									if box then
										for _, t in ipairs(box:GetChildren()) do
											if t:IsA("Tool") and hasKw(t.Name, { "vacuum", "ghost", "soul", "spectral" }) then
												vac = t
												break
											end
										end
									end
									if vac then break end
								end
								if vac and LocalP.Character and vac.Parent ~= LocalP.Character then
									local h = hum()
									if h then pcall(h.EquipTool, h, vac) end
									task.wait(0.25)
								end
								if vac then pcall(function() vac:Activate() end) end
							end)
							hw.PromptFire(best)
							hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 0.35
							return true
						elseif hw.Sucking then
							pcall(au.FireRemote, "RE/GhostBoss/Suction", false)
							hw.Sucking = false
							pcall(au.FireRemote, "RE/GhostBoss/Defeated")
						end
					end
					if cfg.TradeSouls then
						local trader = hw.Found.SoulTrader
						if trader and hw.GoTo(trader, 8) then
							hw.PromptFire(trader)
							hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 2
							note("Halloween", "Traded souls for a Spectral Mutation roll")
							return true
						end
					end
					if cfg.Train then
						local train = hw.Found.Train
						if train then
							pcall(function()
								local seat = nil
								for _, d in ipairs(train:GetDescendants()) do
									if d:IsA("Seat") or d:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
										seat = d
										break
									end
								end
								if seat and hw.GoTo(seat, 4) then
									local h = hum()
									if h and h.SeatPart ~= seat then
										pcall(seat.Sit, seat, h)
										hw.HoldUntil = os.clock() + 2
									end
								else
									hw.PromptFire(train)
								end
							end)
							hw.State = "On the Phantom Express"
							return true
						end
					end
					return false
				end
				local function stepOnce()
					if hw.Halt then return end
					local now = os.clock()
					if now < (hw.PauseUntil or 0) then
						hw.State = "Paused (manual control)"
						return
					end
					if now < hw.HoldUntil then return end
					local inDim = hw.InDimension()
					hw.Active = cfg.Monsters or cfg.SpookyEggs or cfg.BuyEgg or cfg.EchoQuest or cfg.Fish or cfg.Train or cfg.Boss or cfg.TradeSouls
					if not hw.Active then
						hw.State = "Idle"
						return
					end
					hw.Scan(false)
					if not inDim and (cfg.Monsters or cfg.SpookyEggs or cfg.EchoQuest or cfg.Train or cfg.BuyEgg or cfg.Fish or cfg.TradeSouls) then
						if os.clock() > (hw.NoPortalUntil or 0) and os.clock() - (hw.LastEnterTry or 0) > 8 then
							hw.LastEnterTry = os.clock()
							hw.State = "Entering Halloween Dimension..."
							if hw.SwitchDimension() then return end
						end
					end
					local moonUp = cfg.MoonActive == true
					if inDim and LocalP:GetAttribute("HalloweenCarrying") == true and jobEggs() then hw.State = "Delivering Halloween egg" return end
					if inDim and cfg.SpookyEggs and jobEggs() then hw.State = "Stealing Halloween eggs" return end
					if inDim and cfg.BuyEgg and jobBuy() then hw.State = "Buying event egg" return end
					if inDim and moonUp and cfg.PumpkinMoon and cfg.Monsters and jobMonsters() then hw.State = "Pumpkin Moon: fighting monsters" return end
					if inDim and cfg.EchoQuest and jobEcho() then hw.State = "Ghost Dog quest" return end
					if inDim and cfg.Monsters and (cfg.PumpkinMoon or not moonUp) then
						if jobMonsters() then
							hw.State = moonUp and "Pumpkin Moon: fighting monsters" or "Fighting monsters"
							return
						end
					end
					if inDim and cfg.Fish and jobFish() then hw.State = "Fishing" return end
					if inDim and jobTrain() then hw.State = "Phantom Express" return end
					hw.State = inDim and "Watching" or "Standby"
				end
				task.spawn(function()
					while hw do
						pcall(function()
							local portal = hw.FindPortal()
							local hitbox = portal and (portal:FindFirstChild("Hitbox") or portal:FindFirstChild("Hitbox", true))
							if hitbox and hitbox:IsA("BasePart") then
								local blocked = false
								if au.Steal and (au.Steal.Active == true or au.Steal.Carrying == true) then
									blocked = true
								end
								local want = hw.Entering == true or not blocked
								if hitbox.CanTouch ~= want then
									hitbox.CanTouch = want
								end
							end
						end)
						task.wait(0.5)
					end
				end)
				local moonAt = 0
				local function moonTick()
					if os.clock() - moonAt < 10 then return end
					moonAt = os.clock()
					local active = false
					pcall(function()
						local v = workspace:GetAttribute("HalloweenWorldEvent")
						if type(v) == "string" and hasKw(v, { "pumpkinmoon", "pumpkin moon" }) then
							active = true
						end
					end)
					if active and not cfg.MoonActive then
						cfg.MoonSince = os.clock()
						hw.Moon = "Pumpkin Moon"
					elseif not active and cfg.MoonActive then
						hw.Moon = "Idle"
					end
					cfg.MoonActive = active
				end

					UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
						if gp then return end
						if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
							local k = input.KeyCode
							if k == Enum.KeyCode.W or k == Enum.KeyCode.A or k == Enum.KeyCode.S or k == Enum.KeyCode.D or k == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
								hw.PauseUntil = os.clock() + 6
							end

					end)

				task.spawn(function()
					while hw do
						pcall(function()
							trainTick()
							moonTick()
							hw.CandyCorn()
							local waitSec = hw.TrainWait
							local mm = math.floor(waitSec / 60)
							local ss = math.floor(waitSec % 60)
							setRow(hw.TrainRow, string.format("Next train in %d:%02d  (arrives at %s)", mm, ss, os.date("!%H:%M", os.time() + waitSec)))
							if cfg.EchoQuest then
								local stage, qd = questState()
								local have = 0
								if type(qd.Artifacts) == "table" then
									for _, key in ipairs(ECHO_KEYS) do
										if qd.Artifacts[key] ~= nil then
											have = have + 1
										end
									end
								end
								setRow(hw.DogRow, string.format("Ghost Dog: %s  (memories %d/4)", tostring(STAGE_NAMES[stage + 1] or "Done"), have))
							else
								setRow(hw.DogRow, "Off")
							end
							if anyOn() then
								setRow(hw.StatusRow, string.format("Candy Corn: %s  |  %s  |  %s", tostring(hw.Candy), hw.InDimension() and "Halloween Dimension" or "Main World", hw.State))
							else
								setRow(hw.StatusRow, "Off")
							end
						end)
						task.wait(1)
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					local function toPos(g)
						if typeof(g) == "CFrame" then return g.Position end
						return g
					end
					local function tweenTo(goalPos, cancelFn)
						local r = root()
						if not r or typeof(goalPos) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
						local dist = (r.Position - goalPos).Magnitude
						local dur = math.clamp(dist / 220, 0.6, 6)
						pcall(function()
							local ts = game:GetService("TweenService")
							local tw = ts:Create(r, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { CFrame = CFrame.new(goalPos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) })
							tw:Play()
							local t0 = os.clock()
							while os.clock() - t0 < dur + 0.25 do
								if cancelFn and cancelFn() then
									tw:Cancel()
									break
								end
								task.wait(0.1)
							end
						end)
						r = root()
						return r ~= nil and (r.Position - goalPos).Magnitude <= 30
					end
					hw.TweenTo = tweenTo
					local function travelMode()
						local sc = au.SafeCarry
						if type(sc) ~= "table" then return nil end
						if sc.DeliveryTravel ~= nil then return sc.DeliveryTravel end
						return sc.V2Carry
					end
					local function carrying()
						return au.Steal ~= nil and au.Steal.Carrying == true
					end
					local origStep = au.StepTo
					local origFly = au.FlyTo
					if type(origStep) == "function" then
						au.StepTo = function(goalFn, cancelFn, reportFn)
							if travelMode() == "Tween" and carrying() then
								local g = toPos(type(goalFn) == "function" and goalFn() or goalFn)
								if typeof(g) == "Vector3" and tweenTo(g, cancelFn) then return true end
							end
							return origStep(goalFn, cancelFn, reportFn)
						end
					end
					if type(origFly) == "function" then
						au.FlyTo = function(goalFn, cancelFn, label)
							if travelMode() == "Tween" and carrying() then
								local g = toPos(type(goalFn) == "function" and goalFn() or goalFn)
								if typeof(g) == "Vector3" and tweenTo(g, cancelFn) then return true end
							end
							if travelMode() == "Step" and carrying() then
								if type(origStep) == "function" then
									local wrapped = type(goalFn) == "function" and function()
										return toPos(goalFn())
									end or goalFn
									return origStep(wrapped, cancelFn)
								end
							end
							return origFly(goalFn, cancelFn, label)
						end
					end
				end)
				log("Halloween Dimension (Update 9) pack loaded")
			end)
			if not hwOk then
				pcall(function()
					if type(au.Notify) == "function" then au.Notify("Halloween", "Halloween module failed to load: " .. tostring(hwErr)) end
				end)
			end
		end
		local aBiomeSec = aEventTab:CreateSection({ Name = "Enchanted Forest (Update 7)", Expanded = true, Side = "Left" })
		local aBanjoSec = aEventTab:CreateSection({ Name = "Banjo Cricket & Wisp Companion", Expanded = true, Side = "Right" })
		do
			local bwSec = aBanjoSec

				local mods = shared and shared:FindFirstChild("Modules")
				if mods then
					local bp = mods:FindFirstChild("BanjoCricketProgression")
					if bp then
						local ok, mod = pcall(require, bp)
						if ok and type(mod) == "table" then banjoProg = mod end
					end
					local wp = mods:FindFirstChild("WispProgression")

					end

				end

			local function readBanjoState()
				local save = au.ReadSave()
				local bc = type(save) == "table" and save.BanjoCricket or nil
				if type(bc) ~= "table" then return 0, {}, false, 1, 0 end
				local done = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(bc.CompletedStages) or 0), 0, banjoMaxStages)
				local hitMap = type(bc.HitNotes) == "table" and bc.HitNotes or {}
				local claimed = bc.Claimed == true
				local nextStage = done < banjoMaxStages and (done + 1) or nil
				local hitCount = 0
				for i = 1, banjoNotesPerStage do
					if hitMap[tostring(i)] == true or hitMap[i] == true then
						hitCount += 1
					end
				end
				return done, hitMap, claimed, nextStage, hitCount
			end
			local function getMushroomPart(inst)
				if not inst then return nil end
				if inst:IsA("BasePart") then return inst end
				if inst:IsA("Model") then return inst.PrimaryPart or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) end
				return inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			end
			local function findStageMushrooms(stageIdx)
				local list = {}
				pcall(function()
					for _, m in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("BanjoCricketMushroom")) do
						if m and m:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
							local st = tonumber(m:GetAttribute("Stage"))
							local nIdx = tonumber(m:GetAttribute("NoteIndex"))
							local part = getMushroomPart(m)
							if st == stageIdx and nIdx and part then
								list[#list + 1] = { inst = m, note = nIdx, part = part }
							end
						end
					end
				end)
				table.sort(list, function(a, b)
					return a.note < b.note
				end)
				return list
			end
			local function findBanjoNpc()
				local ef = workspace:FindFirstChild("EnchantedForestZone")
				local bcFolder = ef and ef:FindFirstChild("BanjoCricket")
				local npc = bcFolder and (bcFolder:FindFirstChild("Jitterbug") or bcFolder:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")) or nil
				if not npc then
					pcall(function()
						for _, tagged in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("BanjoCricketTalk")) do
							if tagged and tagged:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
								npc = tagged
								break
							end
						end
				end)
				end
				if not npc then return nil, nil end

				if not prompt and bcFolder then
					prompt = bcFolder:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
				end
				return part, prompt

			local function stepBanjoQuest()
				if au.Steal and (au.Steal.Active or au.Steal.Carrying) then return end
				local done, hitMap, claimed, nextStage, hitCount = readBanjoState()
				if claimed then
					setBwStatus(string.format("Banjo Cricket: Reward Claimed (%d/%d)  \226\128\162  Wisp: %s", done, banjoMaxStages, autoWisp and "Active" or "Idle"))
					return
				end
				local root, hum, char = au.CharParts()
				if not root or not hum or not char or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
				if done >= banjoMaxStages or not nextStage then
					local npcPart, npcPrompt = findBanjoNpc()
					if npcPart and (root.Position - npcPart.Position).Magnitude > 10 then
						pcall(function()
							char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(npcPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 3)))
						end)
						task.wait(0.25)
					end
					if npcPrompt then
						au.FirePrompt(npcPrompt)
					end
					au.InvokeRemote("RF/BanjoCricket/AskClaim")
					setBwStatus("Banjo Cricket: All stages complete - claiming reward!")
					return
				end
				setBwStatus(string.format("Banjo Cricket: Stage %d/%d (Notes %d/%d)", nextStage, banjoMaxStages, hitCount, banjoNotesPerStage))
				local mushrooms = findStageMushrooms(nextStage)
				local targetMushroom = nil
				for _, entry in ipairs(mushrooms) do
					local kStr = tostring(entry.note)
					if hitMap[kStr] ~= true and hitMap[entry.note] ~= true then
						targetMushroom = entry
						break
					end
				end
				if targetMushroom and targetMushroom.part then
					local mPos = targetMushroom.part.Position
					if (root.Position - mPos).Magnitude > 7 then
						pcall(function()
							char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(mPos + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 2.5), mPos))
						end)
						task.wait(0.2)
					end
					local bat, equipped = au.FindBat()
					if bat and not equipped then
						pcall(hum.EquipTool, hum, bat)
						task.wait(0.1)
					end
					if bat then
						pcall(bat.Activate, bat)
						local handle = bat:FindFirstChild("Handle") or bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
						if handle and type(firetouchinterest) == "function" then
							pcall(firetouchinterest, handle, targetMushroom.part, 0)
							pcall(firetouchinterest, handle, targetMushroom.part, 1)
						end
					end
					au.FireRemote("RE/BanjoCricket/Aim", nextStage, targetMushroom.note)
					au.FireRemote("RE/BanjoCricket/Aim", targetMushroom.note)
				else
					for noteIdx = 1, banjoNotesPerStage do
						au.FireRemote("RE/BanjoCricket/Aim", nextStage, noteIdx)
						au.FireRemote("RE/BanjoCricket/Aim", noteIdx)
					end
					au.InvokeRemote("RF/BanjoCricket/AskClaim")
				end
			end
			local function stepWispQuest()
				if au.Steal and (au.Steal.Active or au.Steal.Carrying) then return end
				local save = au.ReadSave()
				local wq = type(save) == "table" and save.WispQuests or nil

					au.InvokeRemote("RF/WispQuests/AskAction", "AcceptWisp")
					return

				local returned = wq.ReturnedWisp == true
				local completedMap = type(wq.CompletedQuests) == "table" and wq.CompletedQuests or {}
				local claimedMap = type(wq.ClaimedQuests) == "table" and wq.ClaimedQuests or {}
				local progressMap = type(wq.Progress) == "table" and wq.Progress or {}
				if returned then
					setBwStatus("Wisp Companion: Tree Unlocked! (All Quests Complete)")
					return
				end
				if not accepted then
					local ef = workspace:FindFirstChild("EnchantedForestZone")
					local wispSpawn = ef and ef:FindFirstChild("WispSpawn")

					if root and char and spawnPart and (root.Position - spawnPart.Position).Magnitude > 10 then
						pcall(function()
							char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(spawnPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 3)))
						end)
						task.wait(0.25)
					end
					if wispSpawn then
						local pr = wispSpawn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
						if pr then au.FirePrompt(pr) end
					end
					au.InvokeRemote("RF/WispQuests/AskAction", "AcceptWisp")
					setBwStatus("Wisp Companion: Accepting Wisp at Enchanted Forest...")
					return
				end
				local questsList = type(wispProg) == "table" and type(wispProg.Quests) == "table" and wispProg.Quests or {}
				local allDone = true
				local activeQuestLabel = "All Done"
				for idx, qDef in ipairs(questsList) do
					local qid = tostring(qDef.Id or idx)
					local isDone = completedMap[qid] == true or completedMap[idx] == true
					local isClaimed = claimedMap[qid] == true or claimedMap[idx] == true
					if isDone and not isClaimed then
						au.InvokeRemote("RF/WispQuests/AskAction", "Claim", qid)
						au.InvokeRemote("RF/WispQuests/AskAction", "Claim", idx)
					end
					if not isDone then
						allDone = false
						local curP = tonumber(progressMap[qid] or progressMap[idx] or 0) or 0
						local tgtP = tonumber(qDef.Target or qDef.Goal or 1) or 1
						activeQuestLabel = string.format("%s (%d/%d)", tostring(qDef.Id or qDef.Type or qid), curP, tgtP)
						if tostring(qDef.Id or qDef.Type or ""):find("fusion") then
							pcall(function()
								local inv = type(save) == "table" and save.Inventory or nil
								if type(inv) == "table" then
									local byCat = {}
									for uid, rec in pairs(inv) do
										if type(rec) == "table" and not rec.InFuse then
											local cat = tostring(rec.Category or "")
											if cat ~= "" then
												byCat[cat] = byCat[cat] or {}
												table.insert(byCat[cat], uid)
											end
										end
									end
									for _, uids in pairs(byCat) do
										if #uids >= 3 then
											for i = 1, 3 do
												au.InvokeRemote("RF/FuseMachine/SubmitEgg", uids[i])
											end
											au.InvokeRemote("RF/FuseMachine/StartFusion")
											break
										end
									end
								end
							end)
						end
						break
					end
				end
				if #questsList == 0 then
					for qIdx = 1, 8 do
						au.InvokeRemote("RF/WispQuests/AskAction", "Claim", qIdx)
					end
				end
				if allDone and #questsList > 0 then
					local ef = workspace:FindFirstChild("EnchantedForestZone")
					local tree = ef and (ef:FindFirstChild("EnchantedTree") or ef:FindFirstChild("WispTree"))
					local treePart = getMushroomPart(tree)
					if root and char and treePart and (root.Position - treePart.Position).Magnitude > 12 then
						pcall(function()
							char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(treePart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 5)))
						end)
						task.wait(0.25)
					end
					if tree then
						local pr = tree:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
						if pr then au.FirePrompt(pr) end
					end
					au.InvokeRemote("RF/WispQuests/AskAction", "ReturnWisp")
					setBwStatus("Wisp Companion: Returning Wisp to Enchanted Tree!")
				else
					setBwStatus("Wisp Companion: Active - " .. activeQuestLabel)
				end
			end
			bwSec:CreateToggle({
				Name = "Auto Banjo Cricket Quest",
				Note = "Equips your field bat (via Codex if needed), teleports to each BanjoCricketMushroom note, hits it, and claims the stage reward",
				Default = false,
				Callback = function(v)
					autoBanjo = v == true

				autoBanjo = false
				autoWisp = false
				if banjoThread then pcall(task.cancel, banjoThread); banjoThread = nil end
				if wispThread then pcall(task.cancel, wispThread); wispThread = nil end
			end)

		end
		do
			local installCustomButterfly = function(host)
	local core = assert(host.Core, "Sources core missing")
	local game = host.Game or game
	local workspace = host.Workspace or workspace
	local require = host.Require or require
	local typeof = host.Typeof or typeof
	local Vector3 = host.Vector3 or Vector3
	local Vector2 = host.Vector2 or Vector2
	local CFrame = host.CFrame or CFrame
	local Color3 = host.Color3 or Color3
	local Enum = host.Enum or Enum
	local Instance = host.Instance or Instance
	local RaycastParams = host.RaycastParams or RaycastParams
	local UDim2 = host.UDim2 or UDim2
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local cFrameNew, lookAt = CFrame.new, CFrame.lookAt
	local nativeTask = host.Task or task
	if core.CustomButterfly and type(core.CustomButterfly.Destroy) == "function" then
		core.CustomButterfly.Destroy()
	end
	local port = {
		Alive = true,
		Threads = {},
		Connections = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		Cleanup = {},
		Controls = {},
		Attributes = {},
		Motion = nil,
		Version = "Custom-Butterfly-only-2026-10-10",
	}
	core.CustomButterfly = port
	local function v16()
		return port.Alive and core.CustomButterfly == port
	end
	local function notify(title, message)
		if type(core.Notify) == "function" then
			core.Notify(title, tostring(message))
		else
			warn("[Sources / Sources Butterfly] " .. tostring(title) .. ": " .. tostring(message))
		end
	end
	local function onCleanup(callback)
		port.Cleanup[#port.Cleanup + 1] = callback
	end
	local function connect(signal, callback)
		local connection = signal:Connect(function(...)
			if v16() then return callback(...) end
		end)
		port.Connections[connection] = true
		return connection
	end
	local task = { wait = nativeTask.wait, cancel = nativeTask.cancel }
	local function schedule(mode, seconds, callback, ...)
		if not v16() then return nil end
		local args = table.pack(...)
		local thread = coroutine.create(function()
			if v16() then
				local ok, reason = pcall(callback, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
				if not ok and v16() then
					warn("[Sources / Sources Butterfly] " .. tostring(reason))
				end
			end
			port.Threads[coroutine.running()] = nil
		end)
		port.Threads[thread] = true
		if mode == "delay" then
			nativeTask.delay(seconds, thread)
		elseif mode == "defer" then
			nativeTask.defer(thread)
		else
			nativeTask.spawn(thread)
		end
		return thread
	end
	task.spawn = function(callback, ...) return schedule("spawn", 0, callback, ...) end
	task.defer = function(callback, ...) return schedule("defer", 0, callback, ...) end
	task.delay = function(seconds, callback, ...) return schedule("delay", seconds, callback, ...) end
	local function nativeBossEnabled()
		local mech = core.Mech
		return mech ~= nil and mech.Handle ~= nil and core.Toggle(mech.Handle, false) == true
	end
	local function stealEnabled()
		return host.AutoStealHandle ~= nil and core.Toggle(host.AutoStealHandle, false) == true
	end
	local function stealWantsCharacter()
		local steal = core.Steal or {}
		if steal.Carrying == true or steal.Active == true then return true end
		if not stealEnabled() then return false end
		return steal.Wanted == true or steal.BossOverride == true
			or (core.Movement and core.Movement.StealFirst == true)
	end
	local customV4Config = setmetatable({
		ButterflyAutoNet = false,
		ButterflyAutoCatch = false,
		ButterflyEsp = false,
		ButterflyTiers = {},
		ButterflyAutoTrade = false,
		ButterflyTradeRecipe = "All",
		ButterflyCatchMode = "Tween",
		ButterflyAutoCraft = false,
		TweenSpeedMultiplier = 60,
	}, {
		__index = function(_, key)
			if key == "AutoSteal" then return stealEnabled() end
			if key == "IsPlacing" then return core.Movement and (core.Movement.Owner == "place" or core.Movement.PlaceWanted == true) or false end
			return nil
		end,
	})
	local genv = {
		__CustomV4StealWantsCharacter = stealWantsCharacter,
		__CustomV4TweenRuntimeGeneration = 1,
	}
	local __CustomV4TweenRuntimeGeneration = 1
	port.Config = customV4Config
	port.Runtime = genv
	local function motionOwned()
		local motion = port.Motion
		return v16() and motion ~= nil and core.Movement.Owner == motion.Owner
	end
	local function movementBlocker()
		if not v16() then return "unloaded" end
		if port.Motion and port.Motion.ExtraOwner and port.Motion.Thread ~= coroutine.running() then return port.Motion.ExtraLabel or "Sources addition" end
		if stealWantsCharacter() then return "Auto Steal" end
		if core.AntiGuard and core.AntiGuard.Busy then return "Anti Guard" end
		if core.InMechArena and core.InMechArena() then return "Sources Mech Boss" end
		if core.MechFirst and core.MechFirst() then return "Sources Mech Boss" end
		local movement = core.Movement
		if movement and movement.PlaceWanted then return "Auto Place" end
		if movement and movement.Owner ~= nil and movement.Owner ~= "treadmill"
			and not (port.Motion and movement.Owner == port.Motion.Owner) then
			return tostring(movement.Owner)
		end
		return nil
	end
	local function restoreAttributes()
		for root, prior in pairs(port.Attributes) do
			pcall(function()
				if root.Parent then root:SetAttribute("KillPartIgnore", prior.Value) end
			end)
			port.Attributes[root] = nil
		end
	end
	local function releaseMotion()
		local motion = port.Motion
		if not motion then return end
		port.Motion = nil
		if type(port.StopMovement) == "function" then pcall(port.StopMovement) end
		restoreAttributes()
		if motion.Humanoid and motion.Humanoid.Parent then
			pcall(function() motion.Humanoid.AutoRotate = motion.AutoRotate end)
		end
		if motion.Root and motion.Root.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				motion.Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				motion.Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end)
		end
		if motion.Driving then core.Driving = math.max(0, (core.Driving or 0) - 1) end
		if motion.BeltHeld then pcall(core.ReleaseBelt) end
		pcall(core.ReleaseMovement, motion.Owner)
		if type(host.Wake) == "function" then pcall(host.Wake) end
	end
	local function acquireMotion()
		if port.Motion then
			if motionOwned() and port.Motion.Thread == coroutine.running() then return true end
			return false, "another Butterfly action is running"
		end
		local blocked = movementBlocker()
		if blocked then return false, "Waiting for " .. blocked end
		local character = LocalPlayer.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false, "Character is not ready" end
		local owner = "custom-butterfly"
		if not core.ClaimMovement(owner) then return false, "Sources movement is busy" end
		local wasOnBelt = (core.Treadmill and core.Treadmill.Riding == true)
			or (type(core.OnBelt) == "function" and core.OnBelt())

	local function withMotion(callback, ...)
		local alreadyOwned = motionOwned() and port.Motion.Thread == coroutine.running()
		if not alreadyOwned then
			local deadline = os.clock() + 3
			while v16() and port.Motion and os.clock() < deadline do task.wait(0.05) end
			local setupOK, acquired, reason = pcall(acquireMotion)
			if not setupOK then
				if port.Motion and port.Motion.Thread == coroutine.running() then releaseMotion() end
				return false, tostring(acquired)
			end
			if not acquired then return false, reason end
		end
		local result = table.pack(pcall(callback, ...))
		if not alreadyOwned then releaseMotion() end
		if not result[1] then return false, tostring(result[2]) end
		return table.unpack(result, 2, result.n)
	end
	port.ReleaseMotion = releaseMotion

		end

		for i = #port.Cleanup, 1, -1 do pcall(port.Cleanup[i]) end

		if core.CustomButterfly == port then core.CustomButterfly = nil end
	end

	local function v3001()

			return section:CreateDropdown(args)
		end

		function adapter:AddButton(options)
			return section:CreateButton({
				Name = options.Title, Note = options.Content, Callback = options.Callback,
			})
		end
		function adapter:AddSubSection(title)
			return section:CreateLabel({ Text = title })
		end
		return adapter

		local function _parseSpeed(val)
			if type(val) == "number" then return val end
			if type(val) == "string" then
				val = string.gsub(val, ",", "")
				local num, suffix = string.match(val, "([%d%.]+)%s*([%a]*)")
				num = tonumber(num)
				if not num then return 0 end
				suffix = string.upper(suffix or "")
				if suffix == "K" then return num * 1e3
				elseif suffix == "M" then return num * 1e6
				elseif suffix == "B" then return num * 1e9
				elseif suffix == "T" then return num * 1e12
				elseif suffix == "QA" or suffix == "Q" then return num * 1e15
				elseif suffix == "QI" then return num * 1e18
				else return num
				end
			end
			return 0
		end
		local function _getCurrentSpeed()
			local lp = ae.LocalPlayer or aj
			if not lp then return 0 end
			local ls = lp:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
			local spObj = ls and (ls:FindFirstChild("Speed") or ls:FindFirstChild("SpeedPower"))
			if spObj then return _parseSpeed(spObj.Value) end
			local attr = lp:GetAttribute("Speed") or lp:GetAttribute("SpeedPower")
			if attr then return _parseSpeed(attr) end
			return 0
		end

		local _objCache = {}
		local _objMiss = {}
		local function _findObjectAnywhere(names)
			for _, name in ipairs(names) do
				local cached = _objCache[name]
				if cached and cached.Parent ~= nil and cached:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return cached end
				local missed = _objMiss[name]
				if missed and os.clock() - missed < 8 then continue end
				local containers = { workspace:FindFirstChild("World"), workspace:FindFirstChild("Areas"), workspace:FindFirstChild("Map"), workspace:FindFirstChild("Butterflies"), workspace:FindFirstChild("Event"), workspace:FindFirstChild("Machines") }
				for _, parent in ipairs(containers) do
					if parent then
						local found = parent:FindFirstChild(name, true)
						if found then
							_objCache[name] = found
							_objMiss[name] = nil
							return found
						end
					end
				end
				local found = workspace:FindFirstChild(name, true)
				if found and found:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					_objCache[name] = found
					_objMiss[name] = nil
					return found
				end
				_objMiss[name] = os.clock()
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function _sourcesFlyToTargetRaw(targetPos, maxWait, checkCancel)
			local root = au.Root()
			if not root or not targetPos then return false end
			maxWait = maxWait or 8
			local startTime = os_clock()
			au.BeginFlight()
			local reached = false
			while os_clock() - startTime < maxWait do
				if checkCancel and checkCancel() then break end
				local currentRoot = au.Root()
				if not currentRoot then break end
				local diff = targetPos - currentRoot.Position
				local dist = diff.Magnitude
				if dist <= 6 then
					reached = true
					break
				end
				local speed = 350
				if au.SafeCarry and au.SafeCarry.Mult then
					speed = math.max(350, 350 * au.SafeCarry.Mult)
				end
				local moveVel = diff.Unit * math.min(dist * 8, speed)
				au.SetFlightVelocity(moveVel)
				af.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
			au.EndFlight()
			return reached
		end
		local _sourcesEventFlightBusy = false

			_sourcesEventFlightBusy = true
			au.Driving = (au.Driving or 0) + 1

				return au.Movement.Owner ~= owner or (checkCancel and checkCancel())
			end

			au.ReleaseMovement(owner)
			_sourcesEventFlightBusy = false
			if not ok then warn("[Sources Event movement] " .. tostring(reached)) end
			return ok and reached == true
		end
		local function _getEnchantedForestBiomePos()
