			shootingStar.Status = tostring(status or "Off")

		local function netFind(name)
			local obj = ak and ak:FindFirstChild(name)
			if not obj and ag then
				obj = ag:FindFirstChild(name, true)
			end
			return obj
		end
		local function netInvoke(name, ...)
			local remote = netFind(name)
			if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
				local ok, result = pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, ...)
				return ok, result
			end
			return false, nil
		end
		local function starLanding(payload)
			if type(payload) ~= "table" then return nil end
			local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			local landing = payload.Landing
			if typeof(landing) == "CFrame" then return landing.Position end
			if typeof(landing) == "Vector3" then return landing end
			local leg = payload.Leg
			if type(leg) == "table" and typeof(leg.From) == "Vector3" and typeof(leg.To) == "Vector3" then
				local startAt = tonumber(leg.StartAt) or now
				local arriveAt = tonumber(leg.ArriveAt) or startAt
				local span = arriveAt - startAt
				local alpha = span > 0 and math.clamp((now - startAt) / span, 0, 1) or 1
				return leg.From:Lerp(leg.To, alpha)
			end
			local landAt = tonumber(payload.LandAt)
			if landAt and tonumber(payload.X) then return Vector3.new(tonumber(payload.X), tonumber(payload.Y) or 0, tonumber(payload.Z)) end
			return nil
		end

		local starConnections = {}
		local function starOn(eventName, handler)
			local remote = netFind(eventName)
			if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				local connection = remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(handler)
				table.insert(starConnections, connection)
			end
		end
		local function starSetPayload(payload)
			if type(payload) == "table" and payload.Id ~= nil then
				if not (shootingStar.Payload and shootingStar.Payload.Id == payload.Id) then
					shootingStar.Slipped = 0
				end
				shootingStar.Payload = payload
				shootingStar.Generation = shootingStar.Generation + 1
				local position = starLanding(payload)
				if position then
					starShow("Falling", string.format("landing at %.0f, %.0f", position.X, position.Z))
				else
					starShow("Falling", "calculating landing spot")
				end
			end
		end
		local function starAsk()
			shootingStar.LastAsk = os_clock() + 15
			task_spawn(function()
				local ok, payload = netInvoke("RF/ShootingStar/AskState")
				if ok and type(payload) == "table" then
					starSetPayload(payload)
				end
			end)
		end
		starOn("RE/ShootingStar/Fall", starSetPayload)
		starOn("RE/ShootingStar/Wander", function(id, leg, noticed)
			if shootingStar.Payload and shootingStar.Payload.Id == id and type(leg) == "table" then
				shootingStar.Payload.Leg = leg
				shootingStar.Payload.Noticed = noticed == true
				starShow("Falling", "star is moving")
			end
		end)
		starOn("RE/ShootingStar/Slipped", function(id)
			if shootingStar.Payload and shootingStar.Payload.Id == id then
				shootingStar.Slipped = shootingStar.Slipped + 1
				starShow("Missed", "star slipped away, retrying")
			end
		end)
		starOn("RE/ShootingStar/Claimed", function(id)
			if shootingStar.Payload and shootingStar.Payload.Id == id then
				shootingStar.Caught = shootingStar.Caught + 1
				shootingStar.Payload = nil
				shootingStar.Busy = false
				starShow("Caught", "total " .. tostring(shootingStar.Caught))
			end
		end)
		starOn("RE/ShootingStar/Expired", function(id)
			if shootingStar.Payload and shootingStar.Payload.Id == id then
				shootingStar.Payload = nil
				shootingStar.Busy = false
				starShow("Expired", "star is gone")
			end
		end)
		ap(function()
			for _, connection in ipairs(starConnections) do
				pcall(function()
					connection:Disconnect()
				end)
			end
		end)
		task_spawn(function()
			starAsk()
			while true do
				if starEnabled() and shootingStar.Payload and os_clock() >= shootingStar.LastAsk then
					starAsk()
				end
				task_wait(1.5)
			end
		end)
		task_spawn(function()
			while true do
				local payload = shootingStar.Payload
				if starEnabled() and type(payload) == "table" then
					local ok, position = pcall(starLanding, payload)
					if ok and position and not shootingStar.Busy then
						local root = au.Root()
						if root then
							local distance = (root.Position - position).Magnitude
							if distance > 12 then
								starShow("Flying", string.format("%d studs away", math.floor(distance + 0.5)))
								_flyToTarget(position + Vector3_new(0, 3, 0), 6, function()
									return not starEnabled() or shootingStar.Payload ~= payload
								end)
							else
								starShow("Landing", "grabbing the star")
								shootingStar.Busy = true
								local expiresAt = os_clock() + 12
								while os_clock() < expiresAt and shootingStar.Payload == payload and starEnabled() do
									local currentRoot = au.Root()
									if currentRoot then
										pcall(function()
											currentRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3_new(0, 2, 0))
											currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
											currentRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
										end)
										local nearby = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, 26)
										for _, part in ipairs(nearby) do
											local prompt = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt") or part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
											if prompt and prompt.Enabled then
												_interactPrompt(part)
												break
											end
										end
									end
									task_wait(0.25)
								end
								shootingStar.Busy = false
								if shootingStar.Payload == payload then
									starShow("Waiting", "star not claimed yet")
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				task_wait(1)
			end
		end)
	end
	do
		local installCustomExtras = function(host)
	local core = assert(host.Core, "Sources core missing")
	local filter = assert(host.Filter or core.CustomFilters, "Steal filter/data adapter missing")
	local game, workspace = host.Game or game, host.Workspace or workspace
	local require, typeof = host.Require or require, host.Typeof or typeof
	local Instance, Enum = host.Instance or Instance, host.Enum or Enum
	local Vector3, Vector2 = host.Vector3 or Vector3, host.Vector2 or Vector2
	local CFrame, Color3 = host.CFrame or CFrame, host.Color3 or Color3
	local UDim2, UDim = host.UDim2 or UDim2, host.UDim or UDim
	local nativeTask, clock = host.Task or task, host.Clock or os.clock
	local wallTime = host.Time or os.time
	local services = {
		Players = game:GetService("Players"), Run = game:GetService("RunService"),
		RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), Input = game:GetService("UserInputService"),
	}
	local player = services.Players.LocalPlayer
	local modules = host.Modules or {}
	if core.CustomExtras and core.CustomExtras.Destroy then core.CustomExtras.Destroy() end
	local p = {
		Alive = true, Ready = false, Version = "Sources-Custom-Expansion-2026-10-10",
		Config = {
			AutoStealCapture = false, FlyForCapture = false, AdminBoost = false,
			InstantGrab = false, InfiniteJump = false, Noclip = false, AutoRingEvent = false,
			StealPlayers = false, StealPlayerTarget = "Any Player", StealPlayerRarities = {}, StealPlayerMinValue = 0,
			BackpackRateEsp = false,
		},
		Controls = {}, Threads = {}, Connections = {}, Cleanup = {}, Errors = {},
		PropertyRecords = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), StateRecords = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		Action = nil, Revision = 0,
	}
	core.CustomExtras = p
	local function alive() return p.Alive and core.CustomExtras == p end
	local function notify(title, text)
		if core.Notify then core.Notify(title, tostring(text)) else warn("[Sources additions] " .. tostring(title) .. ": " .. tostring(text)) end
	end
	local function onCleanup(callback) p.Cleanup[#p.Cleanup + 1] = callback end
	local function disconnect(connection)
		if not connection then return end
		p.Connections[connection] = nil
		pcall(connection.Disconnect, connection)
	end
	local function connect(signal, callback, transient)
		local action = transient and p.Action or nil
		local connection = signal:Connect(function(...)
			if alive() and (not action or (p.Action == action and not action.Cancelled)) then return callback(...) end
		end)
		p.Connections[connection] = true
		if action then action.Connections[connection] = true end
		return connection
	end
	local function spawn(callback, ...)
		if not alive() then return nil end
		local args = table.pack(...)
		local thread = coroutine.create(function()
			if alive() then
				local ok, reason = pcall(callback, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
				if not ok and alive() then
					p.Errors.Worker = tostring(reason)
					warn("[Sources additions] " .. tostring(reason))
				end
			end
			p.Threads[coroutine.running()] = nil
		end)
		p.Threads[thread] = true
		nativeTask.spawn(thread)
		return thread
	end
	local function actionSpawn(callback, ...)
		local action = p.Action
		if not action or action.Cancelled then return nil end
		local args = table.pack(...)
		local thread = spawn(function()
			if p.Action == action and not action.Cancelled then callback(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n)) end
		end)
		if thread then action.Threads[thread] = true end
		return thread
	end
	local function load(name, path)
		if modules[name] then return modules[name] end
		local ok, value = pcall(function()
			local node = services.RS
			for _, key in ipairs(path) do node = node:FindFirstChild(key); if not node then return nil end end
			return require(node)
		end)
		if ok and type(value) == "table" then modules[name] = value; return value end
		return nil
	end
	load("Remotes", { "Shared", "Remotes" })
	load("EggState", { "Client", "EggState" })
	load("AreaEggs", { "Shared", "Types", "AreaEggs" })
	local function character()
		local model = player.Character
		return model, model and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	end
	local function fieldEggs()
		local state = modules.EggState
		for _, name in ipairs({ "ReadFieldEggs", "GetAreaEggSnapshot" }) do
			if state and type(state[name]) == "function" then
				local ok, snapshot = pcall(state[name])
				if ok and type(snapshot) == "table" then
					local records = snapshot.Records or snapshot
					if type(records) == "table" then return records end
				end
			end
		end
		return {}
	end
	local function readEgg(uid)
		if uid == nil then return nil end
		local state = modules.EggState
		if state and type(state.ReadFieldEgg) == "function" then
			local ok, record = pcall(state.ReadFieldEgg, uid)
			if ok and type(record) == "table" then return record end
		end
		for _, record in pairs(fieldEggs()) do if type(record) == "table" and record.Uid == uid then return record end end
		return nil
	end
	local function isState(record, name)
		if not record then return false end
		local states = modules.AreaEggs and modules.AreaEggs.States
		return record.State == name or (states and states[name] ~= nil and record.State == states[name]) or false
	end
	local function carrying(record) return isState(record, "Carried") and tonumber(record.CarrierUserId) == player.UserId end
	local function carriedEgg()
		for _, record in pairs(fieldEggs()) do if type(record) == "table" and carrying(record) then return record end end
		return nil
	end
	local function normalStealEnabled()
		return host.AutoStealHandle and core.Toggle(host.AutoStealHandle, false) == true or false
	end
	local function movement()
		local butterfly = core.CustomButterfly
		return butterfly and butterfly.Alive and butterfly.ExtraMotion or nil
	end
	local function motionOwned()
		local bridge = movement()
		return alive() and bridge and bridge.Owned(p) or false
	end
	local function actionValid()
		if not motionOwned() or not p.Action or p.Action.Cancelled then return false end
		if core.AntiGuard and core.AntiGuard.Busy then return false end
		if core.InMechArena and core.InMechArena() then return false end
		local _, root, humanoid = character()
		return root ~= nil and humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
	end
	local function newestClaim(claims)
		local best
		for _, item in pairs(claims) do if not best or item.Order > best.Order then best = item end end
		return best
	end
	local function editProperty(owner, object, key, value)
		if not object then return end
		local store = p.PropertyRecords[object]
		if not store then store = {}; p.PropertyRecords[object] = store end
		local entry = store[key]
		if not entry then entry = { Original = object[key], Applied = object[key], Claims = {} }; store[key] = entry end
		if object[key] ~= entry.Applied then entry.Original = object[key] end
		p.Revision += 1
		entry.Claims[owner] = { Value = value, Order = p.Revision }
		object[key] = value
		entry.Applied = value
	end
	local function editState(owner, humanoid, state, value)
		local store = p.StateRecords[humanoid]
		if not store then store = {}; p.StateRecords[humanoid] = store end
		local entry = store[state]
		if not entry then entry = { Original = humanoid:GetStateEnabled(state), Applied = humanoid:GetStateEnabled(state), Claims = {} }; store[state] = entry end
		p.Revision += 1; entry.Claims[owner] = { Value = value, Order = p.Revision }
		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(state, value); entry.Applied = value
	end
	local function releaseEdits(owner)
		for object, store in pairs(p.PropertyRecords) do
			for key, entry in pairs(store) do
				if entry.Claims[owner] then
					entry.Claims[owner] = nil
					local remaining = newestClaim(entry.Claims)
					pcall(function()
						if object.Parent and (remaining or object[key] == entry.Applied) then
							object[key] = if remaining then remaining.Value else entry.Original
							entry.Applied = object[key]
						end
					end)
					if not remaining then store[key] = nil end
				end
			end
			if next(store) == nil then p.PropertyRecords[object] = nil end
		end
		for humanoid, store in pairs(p.StateRecords) do
			for state, entry in pairs(store) do
				if entry.Claims[owner] then
					entry.Claims[owner] = nil
					local remaining = newestClaim(entry.Claims)
					pcall(function()
						if humanoid.Parent then
							humanoid:SetStateEnabled(state, if remaining then remaining.Value else entry.Original)
							entry.Applied = if remaining then remaining.Value else entry.Original
						end
					end)
					if not remaining then store[state] = nil end
				end
			end
			if next(store) == nil then p.StateRecords[humanoid] = nil end
		end
	end
	local function finishAction(action)
		action.Cancelled = true
		for connection in pairs(action.Connections) do disconnect(connection) end
		for thread in pairs(action.Threads) do
			if thread ~= coroutine.running() then pcall(nativeTask.cancel, thread); p.Threads[thread] = nil end
		end
		for i = #action.Cleanup, 1, -1 do pcall(action.Cleanup[i]) end
		releaseEdits(action)
		if p.Action == action then p.Action = nil end
	end
	local function withMotion(label, callback, ...)
		if not alive() then return false, "Unloaded" end
		if p.Action then return false, "Waiting for " .. p.Action.Label end
		local bridge = movement()
		if not bridge then return false, "Butterfly movement bridge is not ready" end
		local args = table.pack(...)
		local action
		local result = table.pack(bridge.Run(p, label, function()
			action = { Label = label, Cancelled = false, Connections = {}, Threads = {}, Cleanup = {} }
			p.Action = action
			local outcome = table.pack(pcall(callback, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n)))
			finishAction(action)
			if not outcome[1] then error(tostring(outcome[2]), 0) end
			return table.unpack(outcome, 2, outcome.n)
		end))
		if action and p.Action == action then finishAction(action) end
		return table.unpack(result, 1, result.n)
	end
	local function moveTo(target, cancelled, ...)
		local _, root, humanoid = character()
		local bridge = movement()
		if not root or not humanoid or not bridge or not actionValid() then return false end
		if typeof(target) == "Vector3" then target = CFrame.new(target) * root.CFrame.Rotation end
		return bridge.Move(p, root, humanoid, target, function()
			return not actionValid() or (cancelled and cancelled())
		end, ...)
	end
	local function runLoop(name, interval, callback)
		return spawn(function()
			while alive() do
				local ok, reason = pcall(callback)
				if not ok then p.Errors[name] = tostring(reason) else p.Errors[name] = nil end
				nativeTask.wait(interval)
			end
		end)
	end
	function p.Destroy()
		if not p.Alive then return end
		p.Alive = false
		if p.Action then p.Action.Cancelled = true end
		for thread in pairs(p.Threads) do if thread ~= coroutine.running() then pcall(nativeTask.cancel, thread) end end
		table.clear(p.Threads)
		if p.Action then finishAction(p.Action) end
		for i = #p.Cleanup, 1, -1 do pcall(p.Cleanup[i]) end
		table.clear(p.Cleanup)
		for connection in pairs(p.Connections) do disconnect(connection) end
		local owners = {}
		for _, store in pairs(p.PropertyRecords) do for _, entry in pairs(store) do for owner in pairs(entry.Claims) do owners[owner] = true end end end
		for _, store in pairs(p.StateRecords) do for _, entry in pairs(store) do for owner in pairs(entry.Claims) do owners[owner] = true end end end
		for owner in pairs(owners) do releaseEdits(owner) end
		local bridge = movement()
		if bridge then bridge.Stop(p) end
		if core.CustomExtras == p then core.CustomExtras = nil end
		if host.Wake then pcall(host.Wake) end
	end
	host.RegisterCleanup(p.Destroy)
	p.WithMotion, p.ActionValid, p.MoveTo = withMotion, actionValid, moveTo
	p.FieldEggs, p.ReadEgg, p.CarriedEgg = fieldEggs, readEgg, carriedEgg
	p.EditProperty, p.EditState, p.ReleaseEdits = editProperty, editState, releaseEdits
	p.Notify, p.Connect, p.Disconnect, p.Spawn = notify, connect, disconnect, spawn

		local admin = { Status = "Idle", RingStatus = "Idle", Holding = false, Platform = nil, LastJump = -math.huge }
		p.Admin = admin

		local function restorePlatform()
			if admin.Platform then pcall(function() admin.Platform:Destroy() end); admin.Platform = nil end
			admin.Holding = false
		end
		local function cancelCapture(uid, auto)
			if not actionValid() or normalStealEnabled() then return true end
			if auto then return not p.Config.AutoStealCapture or workspace:GetAttribute("Event_CaptureTheEggUid") ~= uid end
			return not p.Config.FlyForCapture
		end
		function admin.EventUid()
			local uid = workspace:GetAttribute("Event_CaptureTheEggUid")
			return uid ~= "" and uid or nil
		end
		local captureRarityRank = {
			Common = 1, Uncommon = 2, Rare = 3, Epic = 4,
			Legendary = 5, Mythic = 6, Secret = 7, Eternal = 8, Divine = 9,
		}
		local captureThresholdRank = {
			["Any"] = 0,
			["Legendary+"] = 5,
			["Mythic+"] = 6,
			["Secret+"] = 7,
			["Eternal+"] = 8,
			["Divine Only"] = 9,
		}
		local function passesCaptureRarity(rec)
			local req = tostring(core.CaptureMinRarity or "Any")
			local minRank = captureThresholdRank[req] or 0
			if minRank <= 0 then return true end
			local meta = filter and type(filter.Resolve) == "function" and filter.Resolve(rec) or nil
			local rar = tostring((meta and meta.rarity) or (rec and rec.Rarity) or "Common")
			return (captureRarityRank[rar] or 0) >= minRank
		end
		function admin.Grab(uid, auto)
			local record = readEgg(uid)
			if not isState(record, "Slot") and not isState(record, "Dropped") then return false, "Egg is not available" end
			local cf = record.BottomCFrame or record.BoundsCFrame
			if typeof(cf) ~= "CFrame" then return false, "Egg position is unavailable" end
			local _, rootNow = character()
			if core.CaptureRagdollJump ~= false and rootNow and rootNow.Position.X < 620 and cf.Position.X > 620 then
				pcall(function()
					local net = services.RS:FindFirstChild("Packages") and services.RS.Packages:FindFirstChild("Net")
					local fs = net and net:FindFirstChild("RE/GuardPatrol/ForestStrike")
					if fs and fs:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
						fs:FireServer()
					end
				end)
			end
			admin.Status = "Flying to capture egg"
			local reached = moveTo(cf.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), function()
				return cancelCapture(uid, auto) or carrying(readEgg(uid))
			end)
			if carrying(readEgg(uid)) then return true end
			if not reached or cancelCapture(uid, auto) then return false, "Travel cancelled" end
			local recordNow = readEgg(uid)
			if not isState(recordNow, "Slot") and not isState(recordNow, "Dropped") then return false, "Egg is no longer available" end
			local remote = modules.Remotes and modules.Remotes.EggWorld and modules.Remotes.EggWorld.AskFieldEggCarry
			if not remote then return false, "AskFieldEggCarry is unavailable" end
			admin.Status = "Grabbing capture egg"
			local done, responseOK, response = false, false, nil
			actionSpawn(function()
				if cancelCapture(uid, auto) then return end
				responseOK, response = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer({ Uid = uid }) end)
				done = true
			end)
			local deadline = clock() + 3
			while clock() < deadline and not cancelCapture(uid, auto) do
				if carrying(readEgg(uid)) then return true end
				if done and (not responseOK or response ~= true) then return false, "Capture request was not accepted" end
				nativeTask.wait(0.08)
			end
			return carrying(readEgg(uid)), "Waiting for confirmed carry"
		end
		function admin.Hold(uid, auto)
			if not actionValid() or not carrying(readEgg(uid)) then return false end
			local action = p.Action
			local _, root = character()
			if not root then return false end
			local cfgHeight = tonumber(core.CaptureHoldHeight) or 85
			local height = p.Config.FlyForCapture and 110 or cfgHeight
			local pin = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, math.max(height, root.Position.Y), root.Position.Z)
			local rotation = root.CFrame.Rotation
			local platform = Instance.new("Part")
			platform.Name = "SourcesCustomCapturePlatform"
			platform.Size = Vector3.new(30, 1, 30)
			platform.Anchored = true; platform.CanCollide = true; platform.Transparency = 0.55
			platform.Material = Enum.Material.Neon; platform.Color = Color3.fromRGB(130, 90, 255)
			platform.CFrame = CFrame.new(pin - Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0))
			platform.Parent = workspace
			admin.Platform = platform
			action.Cleanup[#action.Cleanup + 1] = restorePlatform
			admin.Holding = true
			admin.Status = "Holding capture egg at " .. tostring(math.floor(pin.Y)) .. " studs"
			local connection = connect(services.Run.PreSimulation, function()
				local _, currentRoot = character()
				if currentRoot ~= root or cancelCapture(uid, auto) or not carrying(readEgg(uid)) then return end
				local curCfgH = p.Config.FlyForCapture and 110 or (tonumber(core.CaptureHoldHeight) or 85)
				local keepAway = tonumber(core.CaptureKeepAway) or 65
				local targetX, targetZ = pin.X, pin.Z
				if keepAway > 0 then
					for _, other in ipairs(services.Players:GetPlayers()) do
						if other ~= player and other.Character then
							local oRoot = other.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
							if oRoot then
								local dx = targetX - oRoot.Position.X
								local dz = targetZ - oRoot.Position.Z
								local hDist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
								if hDist > 0.1 and hDist < keepAway then
									local push = (keepAway - hDist) + 8
									targetX = math.clamp(targetX + (dx / hDist) * push, 580, 3600)
									targetZ = math.clamp(targetZ + (dz / hDist) * push, -520, -220)
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				pin = Vector3.new(targetX, math.max(curCfgH, pin.Y), targetZ)
				if platform and platform.Parent then
					platform.CFrame = CFrame.new(pin - Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0))
				end
				root.CFrame = CFrame.new(pin) * rotation
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero; root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end, true)
			while not cancelCapture(uid, auto) and carrying(readEgg(uid)) do
				local _, currentRoot = character()
				if currentRoot ~= root then break end
				nativeTask.wait(0.15)
			end
			disconnect(connection)
			restorePlatform()
			return true
		end
		function admin.CaptureTick()
			if not p.Config.AutoStealCapture and not p.Config.FlyForCapture then admin.Status = "Idle"; return end
			if normalStealEnabled() then admin.Status = "Turn off normal Auto Steal before capture/hover"; return end
			local auto = p.Config.AutoStealCapture
			local record
			local uid = auto and admin.EventUid() or nil
			if auto then record = readEgg(uid) else record = carriedEgg(); uid = record and record.Uid end
			if not uid then
				if auto and admin._hadCaptureUid and core.CaptureAutoHop == true and type(core.HopServer) == "function" then
					admin._hadCaptureUid = nil
					admin.Status = "Capture event ended - Auto Hopping..."
					pcall(core.HopServer)
					return
				end
				admin.Status = auto and "No Capture The Egg event" or "Pick up an egg to hover"
				return
			end
			admin._hadCaptureUid = uid
			if not record then admin.Status = "Waiting for event egg data"; return end
			if auto and not passesCaptureRarity(record) then
				admin.Status = "Capture egg below Rarity To Wait For (" .. tostring(core.CaptureMinRarity or "Any") .. ")"
				if core.CaptureAutoHop == true and type(core.HopServer) == "function" then
					pcall(core.HopServer)
				end
				return
			end
			if auto and not carrying(record) and isState(record, "Carried") and core.CaptureTakeFromHolder ~= false and p.Players then
				local holderId = tonumber(record.CarrierUserId)
				if holderId and holderId ~= player.UserId then
					for _, other in ipairs(services.Players:GetPlayers()) do
						if other.UserId == holderId then
							admin.Status = "Chasing holder @" .. other.Name .. " for Capture Egg"
							pcall(function() p.Players:strike(other) end)
							return
						end
					end
				end
			end
			if not carrying(record) and not (auto and (isState(record, "Slot") or isState(record, "Dropped"))) then
				admin.Status = "Waiting for the capture egg to become available"; return
			end
			local ok, reason = withMotion("Admin Abuse / Capture", function()
				if cancelCapture(uid, auto) then return end
				if not carrying(readEgg(uid)) then
					local got, why = admin.Grab(uid, auto)
					if not got then admin.Status = why or "Capture not confirmed"; return end
				end
				admin.Hold(uid, auto)
			end)
			if not ok then admin.Status = tostring(reason) end
		end
		function admin.RingTick()
			if not p.Config.AutoRingEvent then admin.RingStatus = "Idle"; return end
			if normalStealEnabled() then admin.RingStatus = "Turn off normal Auto Steal before Auto Ring"; return end
			if carriedEgg() then admin.RingStatus = "Finish carrying the egg first"; return end
			local ok, reason = withMotion("Admin Abuse / Ring Event", function()
				local function cancelled() return not p.Config.AutoRingEvent or normalStealEnabled() or not actionValid() end
				local route = {
					{ "Safe zone", CFrame.new(544.76, 71.5, -416.48) },
					{ "Forest", CFrame.new(602, 70.78, -372) },
					{ "Angels & Demons", CFrame.new(5573, 70.77, -363) },
					{ "Forest", CFrame.new(602, 70.78, -372) },
				}
				for _, stop in ipairs(route) do
					if cancelled() then break end
					admin.RingStatus = "Flying to " .. stop[1]
					if not moveTo(stop[2], cancelled, false, nil, true) then break end
				end
			end)
			if not ok then admin.RingStatus = tostring(reason) end
		end
		local function applyPrompt(prompt)
			if not p.Config.InstantGrab or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or prompt.Name ~= "CarryAreaEgg" then return end
			watchedPrompts[prompt] = true
			if prompt.HoldDuration > 0.1 then editProperty("instant-grab", prompt, "HoldDuration", 0.1) end
		end
		function admin.SetInstantGrab(enabled)
			p.Config.InstantGrab = enabled == true
			if not enabled then
				disconnect(promptConnection); promptConnection = nil
				releaseEdits("instant-grab"); table.clear(watchedPrompts); return
			end
			for _, item in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do applyPrompt(item) end
			if not promptConnection then promptConnection = connect(workspace.DescendantAdded, applyPrompt) end
		end
		function admin.Jump()
			if not p.Config.InfiniteJump or services.Input:GetFocusedTextBox() or clock() - admin.LastJump < 0.08 then return false end
			if p.Action or (core.Movement and core.Movement.Owner and core.Movement.Owner ~= "treadmill") then return false end
			local _, root, humanoid = character()
			if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
			admin.LastJump = clock()
			editState("infinite-jump", humanoid, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping); humanoid.Jump = true
			local strength = 55
			if humanoid.UseJumpPower and humanoid.JumpPower > 0 then strength = math.max(strength, humanoid.JumpPower)
			elseif humanoid.JumpHeight and humanoid.JumpHeight > 0 then strength = math.max(strength, math.sqrt(2 * workspace.Gravity * humanoid.JumpHeight)) end
			local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, strength, velocity.Z)
			return true
		end
		function admin.BoostTick()
			if not p.Config.AdminBoost then return end
			local owner = core.Movement and core.Movement.Owner
			if (owner and not motionOwned()) or (core.InMechArena and core.InMechArena()) then
				releaseEdits("admin-boost"); boost.Humanoid, boost.Base, boost.Applied = nil, nil, nil; return
			end
			local _, _, humanoid = character()
			if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
			local speed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
			if boost.Humanoid ~= humanoid or not boost.Base or not boost.Applied or math.abs(speed - boost.Applied) > 0.5 then
				releaseEdits("admin-boost")
				boost.Humanoid, boost.Base = humanoid, speed > 900 and speed / 10 or speed
			end
			if boost.Base and boost.Base > 0 then
				boost.Applied = boost.Base * 10
				editProperty("admin-boost", humanoid, "WalkSpeed", boost.Applied)
			end
		end
		function admin.Set(key, value)
			if key == "InstantGrab" then admin.SetInstantGrab(value); return end
			if p.Config[key] == nil then return end
			value = value == true
			p.Config[key] = value
			if value and (key == "AutoStealCapture" or key == "AutoRingEvent") then
				local other = key == "AutoStealCapture" and "AutoRingEvent" or "AutoStealCapture"
				p.Config[other] = false
				local control = p.Controls[other]
				if control and control.Set then pcall(control.Set, control, false) end
			end
			if not value then
				if key == "Noclip" then releaseEdits("noclip") end
				if key == "InfiniteJump" then releaseEdits("infinite-jump") end
				if key == "AdminBoost" then releaseEdits("admin-boost"); boost.Humanoid, boost.Base, boost.Applied = nil, nil, nil end
			end
		end
		connect(services.Input.JumpRequest, admin.Jump)
		connect(services.Input.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
			if not processed and (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA) then admin.Jump() end
		end)

				if services.Input:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or services.Input:IsGamepadButtonDown(Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA) then admin.Jump() end
			end
		end)
		runLoop("Capture", 0.35, admin.CaptureTick)
		runLoop("Ring", 0.4, admin.RingTick)
		onCleanup(function() disconnect(promptConnection); restorePlatform() end)

	local v2373 = v2149()
		local carryView = setmetatable({}, { __index = function(_, key)
			local carried = carriedEgg()
			if key == "active" then return carried ~= nil end
			if key == "uid" then return carried and carried.Uid end
		end })
		local eggRuntime = setmetatable({ carry = carryView }, { __index = function(_, key)
			if key == "running" then return core.Steal and core.Steal.Active == true end
		end })
		function eggRuntime:_isInSafeArea(root)
			local bridge = movement()
			return bridge and bridge.Home:_isInSafeArea(root) or false
		end
		function eggRuntime:_resolveSafeCFrame(root)
			local bridge = movement()
			return bridge and bridge.Home:_resolveSafeCFrame(root) or nil
		end
		function eggRuntime:_resolveEggDestination(record, root)
			local cf = record.BottomCFrame or record.BoundsCFrame
			return typeof(cf) == "CFrame" and CFrame.new(cf.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)) * root.CFrame.Rotation or nil
		end
		function eggRuntime:_returnToSafe()
			local _, root = character()
			local target = root and self:_resolveSafeCFrame(root)
			return target and moveTo(target, function() return not playerActionActive() end, false, nil, true) or false
		end
		local batAdapter = {}
		function batAdapter:_equipBat()
			if not playerActionActive() or type(core.FindBat) ~= "function" then return nil end
			local model, _, humanoid = character()
			local bat = core.FindBat()
			if not model or not humanoid or not bat then return nil end
			if bat.Parent ~= model then humanoid:EquipTool(bat) end
			return bat.Parent == model and bat or nil
		end
		runtime = v2373.new(eggRuntime, batAdapter, { resolve = filter.Resolve })
		runtime.Generation = 0
		p.Players = runtime
		genv.__CustomV4PlayerSteal = runtime
		local rawPasses, rawChase, rawLog = runtime._passes, runtime._chase, runtime._log
		local rawCarriers = runtime.carriers
		function runtime:carriers()
			for uid, expiry in pairs(self.blacklist) do if expiry <= clock() then self.blacklist[uid] = nil end end
			return rawCarriers(self)
		end
		function runtime:_passes(record)
			if not filter.Passes(record) then return false end
			if #p.Config.StealPlayerRarities == 0 and filter.Resolve(record).rarityRank < filter.NativeMinRank() then return false end
			return rawPasses(self, record)
		end
		function runtime:_pick()
			local target, chosen, rank, value = p.Config.StealPlayerTarget, nil, -math.huge, -math.huge
			for _, candidate in ipairs(self:carriers()) do
				local targetMatch = target == nil or target == "" or target == "Any Player" or candidate.player.Name == target
				if targetMatch and candidate.root.Position.X > safeLine() + 120
					and candidate.player:GetAttribute("InBossArena") ~= true and self:_passes(candidate.record) then
					local meta, rate = filter.Resolve(candidate.record), filter.RateOf(candidate.record) or 0
					if meta.rarityRank > rank or (meta.rarityRank == rank and rate > value) then
						chosen, rank, value = candidate, meta.rarityRank, rate
					end
				end
			end
			return chosen
		end
		function runtime:_mayFollow(other)
			if self.ForcedTargetId and other.UserId ~= self.ForcedTargetId then return false end
			local target = p.Config.StealPlayerTarget
			return target == nil or target == "" or target == "Any Player" or other.Name == target
		end
		local function inventoryHas(uid)
			for key, record in pairs(filter.ReadSave().EggInventory or {}) do
				if tostring(key) == tostring(uid) or (type(record) == "table" and tostring(record.Uid) == tostring(uid)) then return true end
			end
			return false
		end
		function runtime:_log(who, egg, outcome)
			if outcome == "taken" then outcome = inventoryHas(self.CurrentUid) and "banked (inventory confirmed)" or "taken (bank not confirmed)" end
			rawLog(self, who, egg, outcome)
			if self.history[1] then self.history[1].uid = self.CurrentUid end
		end
		function runtime:_chase(candidate, nearby)
			if self.running or not alive() then return false end
			if not candidate or not candidate.player or not candidate.record then return false end
			local current = readEgg(candidate.record.Uid)
			if not isState(current, "Carried") or tonumber(current.CarrierUserId) ~= candidate.player.UserId then
				self:_setStatus("Target no longer carries that egg"); self.forced = false; return false
			end
			candidate.record = current
			if not self:_passes(current) then self:_setStatus("Target egg does not pass the filters"); self.forced = false; return false end
			if candidate.player:GetAttribute("InBossArena") == true or candidate.root.Position.X <= safeLine() then
				self:_setStatus("Target is in a protected area"); self.forced = false; return false
			end
			if carriedEgg() then self:_setStatus("Finish carrying your current egg first"); self.forced = false; return false end
			if type(core.FindBat) ~= "function" or not core.FindBat() then
				self:_setStatus("A bat is required in your backpack"); self.forced = false; return false
			end
			local started = false
			local ok, reason = withMotion("Steal Players", function()
				started = true
				p.Action.PlayerGeneration = self.Generation
				self.CurrentUid = current.Uid
				local model, _, humanoid = character()
				local previous = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
				p.Action.Cleanup[#p.Action.Cleanup + 1] = function()
					local newModel, _, newHumanoid = character()
					if newModel == model and newHumanoid then
						local tool = newModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
						if not tool or (core.IsBatTool and core.IsBatTool(tool)) then
							if previous and previous.Parent and previous.Parent ~= newModel then
								pcall(newHumanoid.EquipTool, newHumanoid, previous)
							elseif not previous then
								pcall(newHumanoid.UnequipTools, newHumanoid)
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local ran, failure = pcall(rawChase, self, candidate, nearby)
				self.running, self.forced, self.ForcedTargetId = false, false, nil
				if not ran then
					self.blacklist[current.Uid] = clock() + 20
					self:_log(candidate.player.DisplayName or candidate.player.Name, filter.Resolve(current).name, "error: " .. tostring(failure))
					self:_setStatus("Attempt failed; movement released")
					error(tostring(failure), 0)
				end
			end)
			if not ok then
				self.running, self.forced, self.ForcedTargetId = false, false, nil
				self:_setStatus(started and "Attempt failed; see history" or tostring(reason))
			end
			self.CurrentUid = nil
			return ok
		end
		function runtime:strike(target, nearby)
			if not target or target == player or self.running or self.forced then return false end
			if services.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(target.UserId) ~= target then self:_setStatus("Player left the server"); return false end
			for _, candidate in ipairs(self:carriers()) do
				if candidate.player == target then
					if not self:_passes(candidate.record) then self:_setStatus("Target egg does not pass the filters"); return false end
					if candidate.root.Position.X <= safeLine() or target:GetAttribute("InBossArena") == true then
						self:_setStatus("Target is in a protected area"); return false
					end
					self.forced, self.ForcedTargetId = true, target.UserId
					spawn(function() if alive() and self.forced then self:_chase(candidate, nearby) end end)
					return true
				end
			end
			self:_setStatus(target.Name .. " has no available carrier egg (or is on retry cooldown)")
			return false
		end
		function runtime:intercept(uid)
			local _, root = character()
			if not root then return false end
			for _, candidate in ipairs(self:carriers()) do
				if candidate.record.Uid == uid and (candidate.root.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= 80 then return self:strike(candidate.player, true) end
			end
			return false
		end
		function runtime:_start()
			if self.loop then return end
			self.loop = spawn(function()
				while alive() do
					nativeTask.wait(0.4)
					for uid, expiry in pairs(self.blacklist) do if expiry <= clock() then self.blacklist[uid] = nil end end
					if self.enabled and not self.running and not self.forced then
						local steal = core.Steal or {}
						if steal.Active or steal.Carrying or carriedEgg() then
							self:_setStatus("Waiting for Sources steal/carry to finish")
						else
							local ok, reason = pcall(function()
								local candidate = self:_pick()
								if candidate then self:_chase(candidate) else self:_setStatus("Looking for a matching carrier") end
							end)
							if not ok then self:_setStatus("Carrier scan error: " .. tostring(reason)) end
						end
					end
				end
				self.loop = nil
			end)
		end
		function runtime:setEnabled(enabled)
			self.enabled = enabled == true
			p.Config.StealPlayers = self.enabled
			if self.enabled then self:_setStatus("Looking for a matching carrier"); self:_start()
			else
				self.Generation += 1; self.forced, self.ForcedTargetId = false, nil
				if p.Action and p.Action.Label == "Steal Players" then p.Action.Cancelled = true end
				self:_setStatus("Stopped")
			end
		end
		function runtime:SetTarget(value)
			if type(value) == "table" then value = value[1] end
			p.Config.StealPlayerTarget = tostring(value or "Any Player")
		end
		function runtime:TargetOptions()
			local options = {}
			for _, other in ipairs(services.Players:GetPlayers()) do if other ~= player then options[#options + 1] = other.Name end end
			table.sort(options); table.insert(options, 1, "Any Player")
			local selected = p.Config.StealPlayerTarget
			if selected ~= "Any Player" and selected ~= "" and not table.find(options, selected) then options[#options + 1] = selected end
			return options
		end
		onCleanup(function() runtime.enabled, runtime.forced, runtime.running = false, false, false; table.clear(runtime.listeners) end)
		end)

	end

		local bag = { Labels = {}, Status = "Disabled", Count = 0 }
		p.Backpack = bag
		local function plain(text) return tostring(text or ""):gsub("<[^>]->", "") end
		function bag.BuildLookup(inventory)
			local byId, byName = {}, {}
			local function add(name, record, rate)
				local bucket = byName[name]
				if not bucket then bucket = { Count = 0, Known = 0, Min = math.huge, Max = 0 }; byName[name] = bucket end
				bucket.Count += 1
				if rate ~= nil then bucket.Known += 1; bucket.Min = math.min(bucket.Min, rate); bucket.Max = math.max(bucket.Max, rate) end
			end
			for key, record in pairs(type(inventory) == "table" and inventory or {}) do
				if type(record) == "table" then
					local rate = filter.RateOf(record)
					local item = { Record = record, Rate = rate }
					if record.Uid ~= nil then byId[tostring(record.Uid)] = item end
					if type(key) == "string" then byId[key] = item end
					local name = filter.DisplayName(record)
					if name then
						add(name, record, rate)
						local stripped = plain(name)
						if stripped ~= name then add(stripped, record, rate) end
					end
				end
			end
			return { ById = byId, ByName = byName }
		end
		function bag.LookupText(lookup, uid, name)
			local item = uid and lookup.ById[tostring(uid)]
			if item and item.Rate ~= nil then return "$" .. filter.Compact(item.Rate) .. "/s", false end
			local bucket = lookup.ByName[tostring(name or "")] or lookup.ByName[plain(name)]
			if not bucket or bucket.Known ~= bucket.Count or bucket.Known == 0 then return nil, false end
			if math.abs(bucket.Max - bucket.Min) <= 0.001 then return "$" .. filter.Compact(bucket.Min) .. "/s", false end
			return "$" .. filter.Compact(bucket.Min) .. "-" .. filter.Compact(bucket.Max) .. "/s", true
		end
		function bag.Clear()
			for button, label in pairs(bag.Labels) do pcall(function() label:Destroy() end); bag.Labels[button] = nil end
			bag.Count = 0
		end
		function bag.Frame()
			local node = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
			for _, name in ipairs({ "BackpackGui", "Backpack", "Main", "Inventory", "ScrollingFrame" }) do
				node = node and node:FindFirstChild(name)
				if not node then return nil end
			end
			return node
		end
		function bag.Refresh()
			if not p.Config.BackpackRateEsp then bag.Clear(); bag.Status = "Disabled"; return end
			local frame = bag.Frame()
			if not frame then bag.Clear(); bag.Status = "Waiting for the game's backpack GUI"; return end
			local lookup = bag.BuildLookup(filter.ReadSave().EggInventory)
			local seen, count, ambiguous = {}, 0, 0
			for _, button in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
				local toolName = button:IsA("GuiButton") and button:FindFirstChild("ToolName")
				if toolName and (toolName:IsA("TextLabel") or toolName:IsA("TextButton")) then
					local uid
					for _, name in ipairs({ "Uid", "EggUid", "ItemUid", "RecordUid" }) do
						local value = button:GetAttribute(name)
						if value ~= nil and lookup.ById[tostring(value)] then uid = value; break end
					end
					if not uid and lookup.ById[button.Name] then uid = button.Name end
					local text, isRange = bag.LookupText(lookup, uid, toolName.Text)
					if text then
						local label = bag.Labels[button]
						if not label or label.Parent ~= button then
							label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
							label.Name = "SourcesCustomBackpackRate"
							label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0); label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35; label.BorderSizePixel = 0
							label.Position = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0, 3); label.Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0.24, 0)
							label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; label.TextScaled = true; label.RichText = false
							label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 224, 170); label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3; label.ZIndex = 40
							local corner = Instance.new("UICorner"); corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6); corner.Parent = label
							local constraint = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint"); constraint.MaxTextSize = 20; constraint.MinTextSize = 8; constraint.Parent = label
							label.Parent = button; bag.Labels[button] = label
						end
						label.Text = text; label:SetAttribute("AmbiguousDuplicate", isRange)
						count += 1; if isRange then ambiguous += 1 end; seen[button] = true
					end
				end
			end
			for button, label in pairs(bag.Labels) do
				if not seen[button] then pcall(function() label:Destroy() end); bag.Labels[button] = nil end
			end
			bag.Count = count
			bag.Status = tostring(count) .. " value labels" .. (ambiguous > 0 and (" \226\128\162 " .. tostring(ambiguous) .. " duplicate-name ranges") or "")

			if not p.Players or not playerScroll then return end

						row.Connection = connect(row.Button.Activated, function() if p.Players then p.Players:strike(captured.Player) end end)
						playerRows[other.UserId] = row
					end
					row.Player, row.Frame.LayoutOrder = other, index
					row.Title.Text = tostring(other.DisplayName or other.Name) .. " (@" .. other.Name .. ")"
					local candidate = carriers[other.UserId]
					if candidate then

						local _, root = character()

				end

	do
		local b5 = { "Highest Value", "Best Rarity", "Biggest Size" }
		local b6 = { idle = "#8C93A6", work = "#FFC857", good = "#57E08A", stop = "#FF6B6B" }
		local b7 = 6
		local b8 = {
			Handle = nil,
			BuyHandle = nil,
			Loop = 0,
			MinRarity = 0,
			MinIncome = 0,
			Priority = b5[1],
			SkipMutated = true,
			Targets = {},
			Cooldown = 0,
			Status = "Idle",
			State = "idle",
			Mutation = "Nitro",

			Ui = {},
			Row = nil,
			Left = 0,
			Pen = 0,
			Match = 0,
			Tries = 0,
			Hits = 0,

		}

		local ca = {}
		if type(b9) == "table" then
			for cb, cc in pairs(b9) do
				local cd = type(cc) == "table" and cc.Rarity or nil
				local ce = type(cd) == "table"
				if ce then
					ce = tonumber(cd.RarityNumber or cd.Rank)
				end
				ce = ce or nil
				if ce then
					table.insert(ca, {
						Category = tostring(cb),
						Name = tostring(cc.DisplayName or cb),
						Rarity = ce,
						RarityName = tostring(cd.DisplayName or cd._id or ce),
					})
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(ca, function(cb, cc)
			if cb.Rarity ~= cc.Rarity then return cb.Rarity > cc.Rarity end
			return cb.Name < cc.Name
		end)
		for cb, cc in ipairs(ca) do
			local cd = string.format("%s [%s]", cc.Name, cc.RarityName)
			if b8.EggCategory[cd] then
				cd = string.format("%s [%s] (%s)", cc.Name, cc.RarityName, cc.Category)
			end
			table.insert(b8.EggOptions, cd)
			b8.EggCategory[cd] = cc.Category
		end
		local function cb(cc)
			local cd = am.Assets and am.Assets.Directory
			return type(cd) == "table" and cd[tostring(cc)] or nil
		end
		local function cc(cd)
			local ce = cb(cd.AssetCategory)
			local cf = type(ce) == "table" and ce.Rarity or nil
			local cg = type(cf) == "table"
			local ch
			if cg then
				ch = tonumber(cf.RarityNumber or cf.Rank)
			else
				ch = cg
			end
			return ch or 0
		end
		local function cd(ce)
			local cf = cb(ce.AssetCategory)
			local cg = type(cf) == "table" and tonumber(cf.EarningRate) or 0
			local ch = tonumber(ce.AssetScale) or 0
			if cg <= 0 or ch <= 0 then return 0 end
			return cg * (ch > 5 and (ch / 5) ^ 1.2 * 19.637875755794113 or ch ^ 1.85)
		end
		local function ce(cf)
			local wanted = b8.Mutation or "Scrambled"
			local function matches(ch)
				if type(ch) ~= "string" then return false end
				if ch == wanted then return true end
				return wanted == "Fractured" and ch == "Boss"
			end
			if matches(cf.BaseMutation) then return true end
			if type(cf.Mutations) == "table" then
				for cg, ch in pairs(cf.Mutations) do
					if matches(ch) then return true end
					if type(cg) == "string" and matches(cg) and ch ~= false then return true end
				end
			end
			return false
		end
		local function cf()
			local cg = am.EggState
			if type(cg) ~= "table" or type(cg.ReadOwnerEggs) ~= "function" then return {} end
			local ch, ci = pcall(cg.ReadOwnerEggs, aj.UserId)
			if not ch or type(ci) ~= "table" then return {} end
			local cj = {}
			for ck, cl in pairs(ci) do
				if type(cl) == "table" and cl.Placement ~= nil then
					cl.Uid = cl.Uid or ck
					cj[#cj + 1] = cl
				end
			end
			return cj
		end
		local function cg(ch)
			ch = ch and ch.Uid
			if ch then
				local ci = workspace:FindFirstChild("AreaEggSlotsClient")
				local cj = ci and ci:FindFirstChild(ch)
				if cj then
					local ck, cl = pcall(function()
						return cj:GetPivot().Position
					end)
					if ck and typeof(cl) == "Vector3" then return cl end
				end
			end
			if type(au.PenAnchor) == "function" then
				local ci, cj = pcall(au.PenAnchor)
				if ci and typeof(cj) == "Vector3" then return cj end
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function ch(ci, cj)
			local ck = cg(ci)
			if ck == nil then return true end
			if au.DistanceTo(ck) <= b7 then return true end
			local function cl()
				if cj ~= b8.Loop or not au.Toggle(b8.Handle, false) then return true end
				if au.Movement.PlaceWanted == true then return true end
				return au.Steal.Wanted == true
			end
			if au.Treadmill.Riding or au.OnBelt() then
				au.ExitBelt()
			end
			au.HoldBelt()
			local cm, cn = pcall(au.FlyTo, ck + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), cl, "mutation")
			au.ReleaseBelt()
			au.LeaveBelt()
			cn = cm and cn
			if cn then
				local co = b7 + 4
				cn = au.DistanceTo(ck) <= co
			end
			return cn
		end
		local function bL(name)
			local want = string.lower(tostring(name or ""))
			if want == "" then return nil end
			for _, box in ipairs({ aj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"), aj.Character }) do
				if box then
					for _, item in ipairs(box:GetChildren()) do
						if item:IsA("Tool") and string.find(string.lower(item.Name), want, 1, true) then
							return item
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return nil
		end
		local ci = function()
			return bL(b8.Mutation or "Scrambled")
		end
		local function cj(ck)
			if not ck then return 0 end
			local cl = tonumber(ck:GetAttribute("Uses"))
			if cl ~= nil then return cl end
			local cm = string.match(ck.Name, "%[X(%d+)%]")
			return tonumber(cm) or 1
		end
		local function ck()
			local list = type(b8.MultiMutations) == "table" and #b8.MultiMutations > 0 and b8.MultiMutations or { b8.Mutation or "Nitro" }
			local chosenTool = nil
			local totalUses = 0
			for _, mName in ipairs(list) do
				local t = bL(mName)
				local u = t and cj(t) or 0
				if u > 0 then
					totalUses += u
					if not chosenTool then
						chosenTool = t
						b8.Mutation = mName
					end
				end
			end
			if chosenTool and totalUses > 0 then return chosenTool, totalUses end
			local cl = ci()
			if not cl then return nil, 0 end
			local cm = cj(cl)
			if cm <= 0 then return nil, 0 end
			return cl, cm
		end
		b8.Grip = function(cl)
			local cm = aj.Character
			local cn = cm and cm:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not cm or not cn or not cl or cl.Parent == nil then return false end
			if cl.Parent ~= cm then
				pcall(function()
					cn:EquipTool(cl)
				end)
				if cl.Parent ~= cm then
					pcall(function()
						cl.Parent = cm
					end)
				end
				task.wait(0.2)
			end
			return cl.Parent == cm
		end
		local function cl()
			if not au.Toggle(b8.BuyHandle, false) or bl then return false end
			bl = true
			local cm = false
			local cn, co = pcall(function()
				cm = b8.Purchase()
			end)
			bl = false
			if not cn then
				b8.Status = "Buy failed: " .. tostring(co)
			end
			return cm
		end
		b8.Purchase = function()
			local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
			local net = rs:FindFirstChild("Packages") and rs.Packages:FindFirstChild("Networking")
			local remote = net and net:FindFirstChild("RF/RaceRally/AskBuy")
			if not (remote and remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")) then
				b8.Status = "Racing Event shop is unavailable"
				return false
			end
			local price = math.huge
			local okData, data = pcall(function()
				return require(rs.Data.RaceRally)
			end)
			if okData and type(data) == "table" and type(data.Shop) == "table" then
				local item = data.Shop["MutationToken"]
				price = tonumber(item and item.Price) or math.huge
			end
			local tokens = 0
			local save = am.Save
			if type(save) == "table" and type(save.Get) == "function" then
				local okSave, snapshot = pcall(save.Get)
				if okSave and type(snapshot) == "table" and type(snapshot.RaceRally) == "table" then
					tokens = tonumber(snapshot.RaceRally.Tokens) or 0
				end
			end
			if tokens < price then
				b8.Status = string.format("Need %s race trophies", tostring(math.floor(price)))
				b8.Short = true
				return false
			end
			local okBuy, result = pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, "MutationToken")
			if okBuy and result then
				b8.Status = "Bought Nitro from the Racing Event shop"
				b8.Short = false
				return true
			end
			b8.Status = "Racing Event shop purchase failed"
			return false
		end
		local function cm()
			local cn = 0
			local co = 0
			local cp = -1
			local cq = nil
			for cr, cs in ipairs(cf()) do
				cn += 1
				local ct = b8.SkipMutated and ce(cs)
				local cu = false
				if ct then
					cu = true
				end
				local cv = not cu
				if cv then
					local cw = b8.MinRarity
					cv = cc(cs) < cw
				end
				if cv then
					cu = true
				end
				local cw = not cu and b8.MinIncome > 0
				if cw then
					local cx = b8.MinIncome
					cw = cd(cs) < cx
				end
				if cw then
					cu = true
				end
				if not cu and next(b8.Targets) ~= nil and b8.Targets[tostring(cs.AssetCategory)] ~= true then
					cu = true
				end
				if not cu then
					co += 1
					local cx
					if b8.Priority == b5[2] then
						cx = cc(cs) * 1000 + (tonumber(cs.AssetScale) or 0)
					elseif b8.Priority == b5[3] then
						cx = tonumber(cs.AssetScale) or 0
					else
						cx = cd(cs)
					end
					local cy = cx > cp
					if not cy and cq ~= nil and cx == cp and cs.Uid == b8.Locked then
						cp = cx
						cq = cs
					elseif cy then
						cp = cx
						cq = cs
					end
				end
			end
			local cr = b8
			b8.Pen = cn
			cr.Match = co
			return cq
		end
		local function cn(co)
			if typeof(co) ~= "Color3" then return "#FFFFFF" end
			return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(co.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(co.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(co.B * 255 + 0.5))
		end
		local function co(cp)
			local cq, cr = pcall(Color3.fromHex, cp)
			if not cq or typeof(cr) ~= "Color3" then return cp end
			local cs, ct, cu = cr:ToHSV()
			return cn(Color3.fromHSV(cs, math.min(ct, 0.78), math.max(cu, 0.82)))
		end
		local function cp(cq)
			local cr = cb(cq and cq.AssetCategory)
			local cs = type(cr) == "table" and cr.Icon or nil
			if cs == nil then return "" end
			if tonumber(cs) then return "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(cs) end
			return tostring(cs)
		end
		local function cq(cr)
			local cs = cb(cr and cr.AssetCategory)
			local ct = type(cs) == "table" and cs.Rarity or nil
			local cu = type(ct) == "table"
			if cu then
				cu = tostring(ct.DisplayName or ct._id or "")
			end
			return cu or "", co(cn(type(ct) == "table" and ct.Color or nil))
		end
		local function cr(cs)
			if type(cs) ~= "table" then return "No egg selected" end
			local ct = cb(cs.AssetCategory)
			local cu = type(ct) == "table"
			if cu then
				cu = tostring(ct.DisplayName or cs.AssetCategory)
			end
			return cu or tostring(cs.AssetCategory)
		end
		local function cs()
			local ct = b6[b8.State] or b6.idle
			if b8.Ui.Accent and type(b8.Ui.Accent.Set) == "function" then
				b8.Ui.Accent.Set({ Background = ct })
			end
			if b8.Ui.Title and type(b8.Ui.Title.Set) == "function" then
				b8.Ui.Title.Set({ Text = b8.Status, Color = ct })
			end
			if b8.Ui.Egg and type(b8.Ui.Egg.Set) == "function" then
				b8.Ui.Egg.Set({ Text = b8.Detail, Color = b8.RarityColor })
			end
			if b8.Ui.Meta and type(b8.Ui.Meta.Set) == "function" then
				b8.Ui.Meta.Set({
					Text = string.format("Charges %d  Eggs %d/%d  Tries %d  Applied %d", b8.Left, b8.Match, b8.Pen, b8.Tries, b8.Hits),
				})
			end
			if b8.Ui.Icon and type(b8.Ui.Icon.Set) == "function" then
				b8.Ui.Icon.Set({ Visible = b8.Icon ~= "", Image = b8.Icon, StrokeColor = b8.RarityColor })
			end
			if b8.Row and type(b8.Row.Set) == "function" then
				pcall(b8.Row.Set, b8.Row, b8.Status .. "  -  " .. b8.Detail)
			end
		end
		local function ct(cu)
			if type(cu) ~= "table" then
				b8.Detail = "Nothing matches your filters yet"
				b8.RarityColor = "#C7CBD6"
				b8.Icon = ""
				return
			end
			local cv, cw = cq(cu)
			local cx = tonumber(cu.AssetScale) or 0
			b8.Detail = string.format("%s   %.2f kg", cr(cu), cx)
			if cv ~= "" then
				b8.Detail = b8.Detail .. "   " .. string.upper(cv)
			end
			b8.RarityColor = cw
			b8.Icon = cp(cu)
		end
		b8.Apply = function(cu, cv)
			if not b8.Grip(cv) then
				b8.State = "work"
				b8.Status = "Could not hold " .. tostring(b8.Mutation or "Nitro")
				b8.Cooldown = os.clock() + 2
				return false
			end
			local cw = ag:FindFirstChild("Packages")
			cw = cw and cw:FindFirstChild("Networking")
			local cx = cw and cw:FindFirstChild("RF/BossMastery/AskUseMutationConsumable")
			if not cx or not cx:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
				b8.State = "stop"
				b8.Status = "Mutation remote is missing"
				b8.Cooldown = os.clock() + 10
				return false
			end
			b8.State = "work"
			b8.Status = "Applying " .. tostring(b8.Mutation or "Nitro")
			b8.Tries = b8.Tries + 1
			local cy, cz = pcall(function()
				return cx:InvokeServer(cu.Uid)
			end)
			if not cy or type(cz) ~= "table" then
				b8.Cooldown = os.clock() + 10
				return false
			end
			if cz.Success == true then
				b8.Status = tostring(b8.Mutation or "Nitro") .. " applied"
				b8.Locked = nil
				b8.State = "good"
				b8.Hits = b8.Hits + 1
				return true
			end
			local cA = tostring(cz.Message or "")
			local cB = string.lower(cA)
			b8.Status = cA ~= "" and cA or "Try failed"
			b8.State = "work"
			if string.find(cB, "not found") or string.find(cB, "invalid") then
				b8.Locked = nil
				b8.Cooldown = os.clock() + 3
				return false
			end
			return true
		end
		b8.Settle = function()
			local cu = os.clock() + 3
			while os.clock() < cu do
				if au.Grounded() then return end
				af.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
		end
		b8.Over = function(cu)
			if cu ~= b8.Loop or not au.Toggle(b8.Handle, false) then return true end
			if au.Movement.PlaceWanted == true then return true end
			if type(au.MechFirst) == "function" and au.MechFirst() then return true end
			return au.Steal.Wanted == true
		end
		b8.Idle = function(cu, cv, cw)
			b8.State = "idle"
			b8.Status = cu
			b8.Left = 0
			b8.Detail = cv
			b8.RarityColor = "#C7CBD6"
			b8.Icon = ""
			b8.Cooldown = os.clock() + (cw or 5)
		end
		b8.PauseInvis = function()
			b8.InvisResumeAt = nil
			if not au.InvisMutate then
				au.InvisMutate = true
				local cu = au.InvisibilityHandle
				if cu ~= nil and au.Toggle(cu, false) then
					au.Notify("Invisibility", "Invisibility is paused while Scrambled is applied and comes back after it.")
				end
			end
			local cu = aj.Character
			return not (cu and cu:GetAttribute("InvisApplied") == true)
		end
		b8.ResumeInvis = function(cu)
			if not au.InvisMutate then return end
			if not cu then
				b8.InvisResumeAt = b8.InvisResumeAt or os.clock() + 5
				local cv = b8.InvisResumeAt
				if os.clock() < cv then return end
			end
			b8.InvisResumeAt = nil
			au.InvisMutate = false
			local cv = au.InvisibilityHandle
			if cv ~= nil and au.Toggle(cv, false) then
				au.Notify("Invisibility", "Scrambled is done, Invisibility is back on.")
			end
		end
		local function cu(cv)
			b8.ResumeInvis(false)
			if au.Steal.Wanted == true then
				b8.State = "work"
				b8.Status = "Auto Steal goes first"
				b8.Cooldown = os.clock() + 2
				return
			end
			local cw = b8.Cooldown
			if os.clock() < cw then return end
			local cx, cy = ck()
			if not cx then
				pcall(cm)
				if cl() then
					b8.Cooldown = os.clock() + 0.5
					return
				end
				if b8.Short then
					b8.Idle("Out of Samples, waiting for more", "Hunt drones to earn Samples", 10)
					return
				end
				if not string.find(b8.Status, "Samples", 1, true) then
					b8.Status = "Need a " .. tostring(b8.Mutation or "Nitro") .. " consumable"
				end
				b8.Idle(b8.Status, "Buy " .. tostring(b8.Mutation or "Nitro") .. " from the Racing Event shop", 5)
				return
			end
			b8.Left = cy
			local cz = cm()
			if not cz or not cz.Uid then
				b8.State = "stop"
				b8.Status = "Waiting"
				ct(nil)
				return
			end
			if au.Movement.PlaceWanted == true then
				b8.State = "work"
				b8.Status = "Auto Place goes first"
				b8.Cooldown = os.clock() + 2
				return
			end
			if not b8.PauseInvis() then
				b8.State = "work"
				b8.Status = "Leaving Invisibility to hold " .. tostring(b8.Mutation or "Nitro")
				b8.Cooldown = os.clock() + 0.5
				return
			end
			if not au.ClaimMovement("mutation") then
				b8.State = "work"
				b8.Status = "Waiting for " .. tostring(au.Movement.Owner or "movement")
				b8.Cooldown = os.clock() + 2
				return
			end
			au.Movement.MutationWanted = true
			local cA, cB = pcall(function()
				while not b8.Over(cv) do
					local cA, cB = ck()
					if cA then
						b8.Left = cB
						local cC = cm()
						if not cC or not cC.Uid then
							b8.State = "stop"
							b8.Status = "Waiting"
							ct(nil)
							break
						else
							if cC.Uid ~= b8.Locked then
								b8.Locked = cC.Uid
								b8.Status = "New target picked"
							end
							ct(cC)
							if not ch(cC, cv) then
								b8.State = "work"
								b8.Status = "Could not reach the egg"
								b8.Cooldown = os.clock() + 3
								break
							elseif not b8.Over(cv) then
								if b8.Apply(cC, cA) then
									pcall(cs)
									task.wait(0.35)
									continue
								end
							end
						end
					end
					break
				end
			end)
			if not cA then
				b8.Status = "Stopped: " .. tostring(cB)
				b8.State = "work"
				b8.Cooldown = os.clock() + 3
			end
			b8.Settle()
			au.Movement.MutationWanted = false
			au.ReleaseMovement("mutation")
			b8.InvisResumeAt = os.clock() + 5
		end
		b8.Handle = aJ:CreateToggle({
			Name = "Auto Use Mutation (Nitro)",
			Note = "Applies the Nitro mutation to the egg you are holding",
			Default = false,
			Callback = function(cv)
				b8.Loop = b8.Loop + 1
				au.Movement.MutationWanted = false
				au.ReleaseMovement("mutation")
				if cv ~= true then
					b8.ResumeInvis(true)
					return
				end
				local cw = b8.Loop
				task.spawn(function()
					while cw == b8.Loop and au.Toggle(b8.Handle, false) do
						pcall(cu, cw)
						pcall(cs)
						task.wait(b8.State == "idle" and 3 or 1)
					end
				end)
			end,
		})
		aJ:CreateDropdown({
			Name = "Mutation To Use",
			Note = "Primary mutation consumable applied to your eggs",
			Options = { "Nitro", "Scrambled", "Enchanted", "Fractured" },
			Default = "Nitro",
			SubOf = b8.Handle,
			Callback = function(cx)
				b8.Mutation = tostring(cx or "Nitro")
				b8.Detail = "Turn it on to start applying " .. b8.Mutation
				b8.Locked = nil
			end,
		})
		as(aJ:CreateMultiDropdown({
			Name = "Mutations To Use",
			Note = "Multi-Mutation selector: cycles across all checked mutation consumables in your inventory (Fractured, Scrambled, Enchanted, Nitro)",
			Options = { "Fractured", "Scrambled", "Enchanted", "Nitro" },
			Default = { "Nitro" },
			SubOf = b8.Handle,
			Callback = function(sel)
				local list = {}
				if type(sel) == "table" then
					for k, v in pairs(sel) do
						if v == true and type(k) == "string" then
							table.insert(list, k)
						elseif type(v) == "string" then
							table.insert(list, v)
						end
					end
				end
				b8.MultiMutations = list
				if #list > 0 then
					b8.Mutation = list[1]
					b8.Detail = "Applying: " .. table.concat(list, ", ")
				end
				b8.Locked = nil
			end,
		}))
		au.MutationState = b8
		if type(aJ.CreateCanvas) == "function" then
			local cv = aJ:CreateCanvas({
				Name = "Mutation Status",
				ShowTitle = false,
				Layout = "free",
				SubOf = b8.Handle,
				Style = {
					TextScale = 1,
					LineHeight = 1.1,
					MinLines = 4,
					MaxLines = 4,
					AutoHeight = true,
					BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
					TextColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
					TextStrokeTransparency = 0.7,
				},
				Build = function(cv)
					b8.Ui.Card = cv:Frame({
						X = 0,
						Y = 0,
						Width = 1,
						Height = 3.6,
						Corner = 0.3,
						Background = "#151821",
						BackgroundTransparency = 0.25,
					})
					b8.Ui.Accent = cv:Frame({
						Parent = b8.Ui.Card,
						X = 0.08,
						Y = 0.18,
						Width = 0.16,
						Height = 3.24,
						Corner = 0.2,
						Background = b6.idle,
					})
					b8.Ui.Icon = cv:Image({
						Parent = b8.Ui.Card,
						X = 0.42,
						Y = 0.3,
						Width = 3,
						Height = 3,
						Corner = 0.3,
						Background = "#242938",
						BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
						StrokeThickness = 0.06,
						StrokeTransparency = 0,
						Visible = false,
					})
					b8.Ui.Title = cv:Text({
						Parent = b8.Ui.Card,
						X = 3.7,
						Y = 0.32,
						Width = 1,
						Height = 1.05,
						Scale = 1.16,
						Wrap = false,
						Text = b8.Status,
						Color = b6.idle,
						TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
					})
					b8.Ui.Egg = cv:Text({
						Parent = b8.Ui.Card,
						X = 3.7,
						Y = 1.42,
						Width = 1,
						Height = 1,
						Scale = 1,
						Wrap = false,
						Text = b8.Detail,
						Color = "#FFFFFF",
						TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
					})
					b8.Ui.Meta = cv:Text({
						Parent = b8.Ui.Card,
						X = 3.7,
						Y = 2.42,
						Width = 1,
						Height = 0.9,
						Scale = 0.86,
						Wrap = false,
						Text = "Charges 0  Eggs 0/0  Tries 0  Applied 0",
						Color = "#AEB4C6",
						TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
					})
					cs()
				end,
			})
			ap(function()
				pcall(function()
					cv:Destroy()
				end)
			end)
		else
			b8.Row = aJ:CreateText({ Name = "Mutation Status", Text = "Idle", SubOf = b8.Handle })
		end
		aJ:CreateDropdown({
			Name = "Mutation Min Rarity",
			Note = "Uses this rarity and anything rarer",
			Options = aM,
			Default = aM[1],
			SubOf = b8.Handle,
			Callback = function(cv)
				b8.MinRarity = aN[cv] or 0
			end,
		})
		local cv = {
			["K/s"] = { Min = 0, Max = 1000, Mult = 1000 },
			["M/s"] = { Min = 0, Max = 1000, Mult = 1000000 },
			["B/s"] = { Min = 0, Max = 100, Mult = 1e9 },
		}
		local cw = { Slider = nil, Value = 0, Unit = "M/s" }
		local function cx(cy, cz)
			if cy ~= nil then
				cw.Value = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(cy) or cw.Value))
			end
			if cz ~= nil then
				cw.Unit = tostring(cz)
			end
			b8.MinIncome = cw.Value * (cv[cw.Unit] or cv["M/s"]).Mult
		end
		cw.Slider = ar(aJ, {
			Name = "Min Mutation Value",
			Note = "Ignores eggs under this value (0 = off)",
			SubOf = b8.Handle,
			Legacy = "Mutation Min Value",
			SectionName = "Auto Mutation",
			OnRaw = function(cy)
				cx(math.floor(cy / 1000), "K/s")
			end,
		})
		aJ:CreateDropdown({
			Name = "Mutation Priority",
			Note = "Which egg receives the consumable first",
			Options = b5,
			Default = b5[1],
			SubOf = b8.Handle,
			Callback = function(cy)
				b8.Priority = tostring(cy)
			end,
		})
		as(aJ:CreateMultiDropdown({
			Name = "Mutation Target Eggs",
			Note = "Use the consumable on these eggs only (empty = any)",
			Options = b8.EggOptions,
			Default = {},
			SubOf = b8.Handle,
			Callback = function(cy)
				local cz = {}
				if type(cy) == "table" then
					for cA, cB in pairs(cy) do
						cA = cB == true and type(cA) == "string" and cA or type(cB) == "string" and cB or nil
						if cA and b8.EggCategory[cA] then
							cz[b8.EggCategory[cA] ] = true
						end
					end
				end
				b8.Targets = cz
			end,
		}))
		b8.BuyHandle = aJ:CreateToggle({
			Name = "Auto Buy Nitro (Racing Event)",
			Note = "Buys the Nitro mutation token with race trophies when you run dry",
			Default = false,

			local flexType = "Pet"
			local flexSelectedName = ""

			local flexHoldHand = true
			local flexAddBackpack = true
			local flexEggNames = {}
			local flexPetNames = {}
			local flexNameMap = {}
			local function buildFlexCatalog()
				if #flexPetNames > 0 or #flexEggNames > 0 then return end
				local dir = am.Assets and am.Assets.Directory
				if type(dir) ~= "table" then return end
				local pets, eggs = {}, {}
				for id, meta in pairs(dir) do
					if type(meta) == "table" then
						local dName = tostring(meta.DisplayName or id)
						local rTab = type(meta.Rarity) == "table" and meta.Rarity or nil
						local rRank = tonumber(rTab and (rTab.RarityNumber or rTab.Rank)) or 0
						local rName = tostring((rTab and (rTab.DisplayName or rTab._id)) or "Common")
						local label = string.format("%s [%s]", dName, rName)
						if flexNameMap[label] then
							label = string.format("%s [%s] (%s)", dName, rName, tostring(id))
						end
						flexNameMap[label] = {
							Id = tostring(id),
							DisplayName = dName,
							RarityName = rName,
							RarityRank = rRank,
							Meta = meta,
						}
						local kind = tostring(meta.AssetType or meta.Type or meta.Kind or ""):lower()
						if kind:find("egg", 1, true) or tostring(id):lower():find("egg", 1, true) then
							table.insert(eggs, { Label = label, Rank = rRank, Name = dName })
						else
							table.insert(pets, { Label = label, Rank = rRank, Name = dName })
						end
					end
				end
				local function sortCatalog(a, b)
					if a.Rank ~= b.Rank then return a.Rank > b.Rank end
					return a.Name < b.Name
				end
				table.sort(pets, sortCatalog)
				table.sort(eggs, sortCatalog)
				for _, it in ipairs(pets) do table.insert(flexPetNames, it.Label) end
				for _, it in ipairs(eggs) do table.insert(flexEggNames, it.Label) end
				if #flexEggNames == 0 then
					for _, it in ipairs(pets) do table.insert(flexEggNames, it.Label) end
				end
			end
			buildFlexCatalog()
			local flexPicker = nil
			fSec:CreateDropdown({
				Name = "Visual Item Type",
				Note = "Choose whether to browse and spawn a visual Egg or Pet",
				Options = { "Pet", "Egg" },
				Default = "Pet",

					buildFlexCatalog()

				end,

			local function findAsset3DTemplate(assetId, displayName)
				local assetsFolder = ag:FindFirstChild("Assets")
				local searchRoots = {
					assetsFolder and assetsFolder:FindFirstChild("Pets"),
					assetsFolder and assetsFolder:FindFirstChild("Eggs"),
					assetsFolder and assetsFolder:FindFirstChild("Models"),
					assetsFolder,
				}
				for _, root in ipairs(searchRoots) do
					if root then
						local found = root:FindFirstChild(assetId, true) or (displayName and root:FindFirstChild(displayName, true))
						if found and (found:IsA("Model") or found:IsA("BasePart") or found:IsA("Tool")) then return found end
					end
				end
				return nil
			end
			local function spawnVisualAsset(forceKind)
				buildFlexCatalog()
				local info = flexNameMap[flexSelectedName]
				if not info then
					local list = (forceKind == "Egg") and flexEggNames or flexPetNames
					info = list[1] and flexNameMap[list[1]] or nil
				end
				local assetId = info and info.Id or "Dragon"

							best = math.min(best, tpRank.StealFilter or 99)
						end
						if item.Wisp == true then
							best = math.min(best, tpRank.StealWisp or 99)
						end
						return best == math.huge and (tpRank.StealFilter or 99) or best
					end,

						return math.min(
							tpRank.StealIndex or 99,
							tpRank.StealFilter or 99,

								Width = 0.45,

								Parent = row,
								X = 0.28,
								Y = 0.62,

								Height = 1.4,

								Height = 1.15,

					tpOrder[idx], tpOrder[target] = tpOrder[target], tpOrder[idx]
					local a, b = tpRows[key], tpRows[tpOrder[idx]]
					tpRows[key], tpRows[tpOrder[idx]] = b, a

					tpTweenRows()

					if type(au.Notify) == "function" then
						au.Notify("Task Priority", string.format("%s is now #%d", tostring(tpLabels[key] or key), target))
					end

		local _noclipStamp = 0
		game:GetService("RunService").Stepped:Connect(function()
			if not _noclip then return end
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - _noclipStamp < 0.3 then return end
			_noclipStamp = now
			local char = aj.Character
			if not char then return end
			for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
					part.CanCollide = false
				end

		b6 = b7:CreateSection({ Name = "Combat", Expanded = true })
		local b9 = nil
		local ca = 350
		local cb = nil
		local cc = false
		local function cd()
			local ce = aj.Character
			local cf = ce and ce:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			ce = ce and ce:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if cf and ce and ce.Health > 0 then return cf, ce end
			return nil, nil
		end
		local function ce()
			if not cc then return end
			cc = false
			local cf, cg = cd()
			if not cf then return end
			local ch = cf.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local ci = cg.MoveDirection
			local cj = Vector3.new(ci.X, 0, ci.Z)
			local ck = cj.Magnitude > 0.001 and cj.Unit * cg.WalkSpeed or Vector3.zero
			pcall(function()
				cf.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(ck.X, ch.Y, ck.Z)
			end)
		end
		local function cf()
			if cb then
				cb:Disconnect()
				cb = nil
			end
			ce()
			au.Shield("speed", false)
		end
		local function cg()
			if cb then return end
			au.Shield("speed", true)
			local function _pcVelY(_a, _b, _c)
				_a.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(_b.X, _c.Y, _b.Z)
			end
			cb = af.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				if au.Steal.Active or au.Flying or au.Driving > 0 or au.Treadmill.Riding then
					cc = false
					return
				end
				local ch, ci = cd()
				if not ch or ci.Sit or ci.PlatformStand then
					cc = false
					return
				end
				local cj = tonumber(aj:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime"))
				if cj and cj > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then
					cc = false
					return
				end
				local ck = ci.MoveDirection
				local cl = Vector3.new(ck.X, 0, ck.Z)
				if cl.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
					ce()
					return
				end
				local cm = cl.Unit * ca
				local cn = ch.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				pcall(_pcVelY, ch, cm, cn)
				cc = true
			end)
		end
		au.SpeedForced = false
		local function ch()
			if au.Toggle(b9, false) or au.SpeedForced then
				cg()
			else
				cf()
			end
		end
		local ci = false
		local cj = false
		local ck = false
		au.SetSpeedForced = function(cl)
			au.SpeedForced = cl == true
			ci = true
			ch()
		end
		local cl = {
			Name = "Speed Boost",
			Default = false,
			Callback = function()
				if au.SpeedForced and not au.Toggle(b9, false) then
					ci = true
					ck = true
				end
				ch()
			end,
		}
		b9 = b8.CreateToggle
		b9 = b9(b8, cl)
		local function _pcIndex(_a, _b)
			return _a[_b]
		end
		local cm = af.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			if ck then
				ck = false
				if type(ab.Notify) == "function" then
					pcall(ab.Notify, "Speed Boost", "Speed Boost must stay on while Invisibility is on.", 5)
				end
			end
			if not ci then return end
			ci = false
			local cm
			if au.SpeedForced and not au.Toggle(b9, false) then
				cj = true
				cm = true
			else
				local cn = not au.SpeedForced and cj
				cm = nil
				if cn then
					cj = false
					cm = nil
					if au.Toggle(b9, false) then
						cm = false
					end
				end
			end
			if cm ~= nil then
