		local b8 = true
		local b9 = {}
		local ca = {}
		local function cb(cc)
			if cc:IsA("BasePart") and b9[cc] == nil then
				b9[cc] = cc.CanTouch
				pcall(function()
					cc.CanTouch = false
				end)
			end
		end
		local function cc(cd)
			if not b8 or not cd.Parent then return end
			local ce = aj.Name
			if cd:GetAttribute("Owner") == ce then return end
			cb(cd)
			for cf, cg in ipairs(cd:GetDescendants()) do
				cb(cg)
			end
			table.insert(ca, cd.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(cf)
				if b8 then
					cb(cf)
				end
			end))
		end
		local function cd()
			for ce, cf in ipairs(aH:GetTagged("PlacedTrap")) do
				cc(cf)
			end
		end
		local function ce()
			for cf, cg in pairs(b9) do
				if cf.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						cf.CanTouch = cg
					end)
				end
			end
			table.clear(b9)
		end
		table.insert(ca, aH:GetInstanceAddedSignal("PlacedTrap"):Connect(function(cf)
			task.defer(cc, cf)
		end))
		b7 = b5:CreateToggle({
			Name = "Anti Trap",
			Note = "Player traps have no effect on you",
			Default = true,
			Callback = function()
				b8 = au.Toggle(b7, true) == true
				if b8 then
					cd()
				else
					ce()
				end
			end,
		})
		cd()
		ap(function()
			b8 = false
			for cf, cg in ipairs(ca) do
				pcall(function()
					cg:Disconnect()
				end)
			end
			table.clear(ca)
			ce()
		end)
	end
	do
		local b7 = nil
		local b8 = "CarryAreaEgg"
		local b9 = { ClaimLostPart = true }
		local ca = {}
		local cb = nil
		local cc = nil
		local function cd(ce)
			if not ce:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or b9[ce.Name] then return end
			if ca[ce] == nil then
				if ce.HoldDuration <= 0 and ce.Name ~= b8 then return end
				ca[ce] = ce.HoldDuration
			end
			if ce.HoldDuration ~= 0 then
				pcall(function()
					ce.HoldDuration = 0
				end)
			end
		end
		local function ce(cf)
			if cf.Name ~= "SmartPromptPart" then return nil end
			local cg = cf:FindFirstChild("CarryAreaEgg")
			return cg and cg:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and cg or nil
		end
		au.PromptHold = function(cf)
			local cg = ca[cf]
			if type(cg) == "number" then return cg end
			return cf.HoldDuration
		end
		local function cf()
			if cb then return end
			cc = aI.PromptShown:Connect(function(cg)
				if au.Toggle(b7, true) then
					cd(cg)
				end
			end)
			for cg, ch in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
				local ci = ce(ch)
				if ci then
					cd(ci)
				end
			end
			cb = workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(cg)
				if cg.Name ~= "SmartPromptPart" then return end
				task.defer(function()
					local ch = cg:FindFirstChild("CarryAreaEgg") or cg:WaitForChild("CarryAreaEgg", 2)
					if ch and ch:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and au.Toggle(b7, true) then
						cd(ch)
					end
				end)
			end)
		end
		local function cg()
			for ch, ci in pairs(ca) do
				if ch and ch.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						ch.HoldDuration = ci
					end)
				end
			end
			table.clear(ca)
			if cb then
				cb:Disconnect()
				cb = nil
			end
			if cc then
				cc:Disconnect()
				cc = nil
			end
		end
		au.PressStealPrompt = function(ch)
			if typeof(fireproximityprompt) ~= "function" or not ch then return false end
			local ci = nil
			local cj = math.huge
			for ck, cl in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
				local cm = ce(cl)
				if cm and cl:IsA("BasePart") then
					local cn = (cl.Position - ch).Magnitude
					if cn < cj then
						ci = cm
						cj = cn
					end
				end
			end
			if not ci or cj > 14 then return false end
			if au.Toggle(b7, true) then
				pcall(function()
					ci.HoldDuration = 0
				end)
			end
			local ck = pcall(fireproximityprompt, ci)
			if ck and ci.HoldDuration > 0 then
				task.wait(ci.HoldDuration + 0.1)
			end
			return ck
		end
		local _promptSweepAt = 0
		at.Add(function()
			if au.Toggle(b7, true) then
				cf()
				local now = os.clock()
				if now >= _promptSweepAt then
					_promptSweepAt = now + 3.0
					for ch in pairs(ca) do
						if not ch.Parent then
							ca[ch] = nil
						elseif ch.HoldDuration ~= 0 then
							pcall(function()
								ch.HoldDuration = 0
							end)
						end
					end
				end
			elseif next(ca) ~= nil or cb then
				cg()
			end
			return false
		end)
		b7 = b5:CreateToggle({
			Name = "Instant Prompts",
			Note = "Hold prompts finish in 0.1s instead of the normal wait",
			Default = true,
			Callback = function()
				at.Wake()
			end,
		})
		ap(cg)
	end
	au.Combat = {}
	local b7
	b7 = au.Combat
	do
		local b8 = 15
		local b9 = 2
		local ca = 0.05
		local cb = 1
		local cc = 0.18
		local cd = -0.275
		local ce = 0.6
		local cf = 6
		local cg = 1.1
		local ch = 0.8
		local ci = 2.5
		local cj = 35
		local ck = 0.12
		local cl = 6
		local cm = 6
		local cn = 3
		local co = { 0.12, 0.2, 0.28, 0.36, 0.46, 0.6 }
		local cp = { ["WALL LEFT"] = true, ["WALL RIGHT"] = true }
		local cq = {
			Trigger = nil,
			LastFire = 0,
			Trace = 0,
			EquipAt = 0,
			Walls = {},
			WallsAt = 0,
			WallSide = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
			Tracks = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
			Stats = {},
			Option = 3,
			Pending = {},
			Holders = {},
			SpawnRagdoll = nil,
		}
		for cr = 1, #co do
			cq.Stats[cr] = { Hits = 0, Shots = 0 }
		end
		local cr = RaycastParams.new()
		cr.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		pcall(function()
			cr.RespectCanCollide = true
		end)
		local function cs()
			return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		end
		local function ct()
			local cu = cq.Trigger
			if cu and cu.Parent then return cu end
			local cv = ak:FindFirstChild("RE/BatSwing/Trigger")
			cq.Trigger = cv
			return cv
		end
		local function cu(cv)
			return tonumber(cv:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")) or 0
		end
		b7.SetLead = function(cv)
			cd = math.clamp((tonumber(cv) or -275) / 1000, -0.4, 0.1)
		end
		b7.SetSweep = function(cv)
			ce = math.clamp((tonumber(cv) or 60) / 100, 0, 2.5)
		end
		b7.Ragdolled = function(cv)
			return cu(cv) > cs()
		end
		b7.SelfRagdolled = function()
			local cv = cu(aj)
			if cv <= cs() then return false end
			return cv ~= cq.SpawnRagdoll
		end
		b7.Humanoid = function(cv)
			if not cv then return nil end
			local cw = nil
			for cx, cy in ipairs(cv:GetChildren()) do
				if cy:IsA("Humanoid") then
					if cy.Health > 0 then return cy end
					cw = cw or cy
				end
			end
			return cw
		end
		local function cv(cw)
			local cx = am.Gears
			local cy = type(cx) == "table" and cx.Directory or nil
			local cz = type(cy) == "table"
			if cz then
				cz = cy[tostring(cw:GetAttribute("GearName") or cw.Name)]
			end
			cz = cz or nil
			local cA = type(cz) == "table" and cz.BatControllerData or nil
			return type(cA) == "table" and tonumber(cA.RangeBonus) or 0
		end
		b7.Range = function(cw)
			local cx = workspace:GetAttribute("DragonEggEventActive") == true and 2.5 or 1
			return (b8 + b9 + (cw and cv(cw) or 0)) * cx
		end
		au.CombatSwap = au.CombatSwap or { Picked = {}, Holds = { 0.3, 0.4 }, Index = 1, Since = 0 }
		local function isScramblerTool(t)
			return tostring(t:GetAttribute("ItemType")) == "Gear" and string.find(string.lower(tostring(t:GetAttribute("GearName") or t.Name or "")), "scrambler", 1, true) ~= nil
		end
		local function collectCombatTools(cw)
			local list = {}
			local rankOf = {}
			for _, container in ipairs({ cw, aj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }) do
				if container then
					for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
						if item:IsA("Tool") and not rankOf[item] then
							if au.IsBatTool(item) then
								rankOf[item] = cv(item)
								table.insert(list, item)
							elseif isScramblerTool(item) then
								rankOf[item] = -1
								table.insert(list, item)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			table.sort(list, function(a, b)
				if rankOf[a] ~= rankOf[b] then return rankOf[a] > rankOf[b] end
				return a.Name < b.Name
			end)
			local swap = au.CombatSwap
			if type(swap) ~= "table" or type(swap.Picked) ~= "table" or #swap.Picked == 0 then return list, false end
			local pickedTools = {}
			for _, wName in ipairs(swap.Picked) do
				for _, tool in ipairs(list) do
					if #pickedTools < 2 and tostring(tool:GetAttribute("GearName") or tool.Name) == wName and not table.find(pickedTools, tool) then
						table.insert(pickedTools, tool)
						break
					end
				end
			end
			return pickedTools, true
		end
		local function isToolOffCooldown(tool)
			return cs() >= (tonumber(tool and tool:GetAttribute("CooldownEndTime")) or 0)
		end
		b7.PickBat = function(cw)
			if not cw then return nil end
			local tools, useSwap = collectCombatTools(cw)
			local count = useSwap and #tools or 1
			if count <= 1 then
				if useSwap and tools[1] then return tools[1] end
				local held = cw:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
				if held and au.IsBatTool(held) then return held end
				for _, tool in ipairs(tools) do
					if not isScramblerTool(tool) then return tool end
				end
				return nil
			end
			local swap = au.CombatSwap
			if swap.Index > count then
				swap.Index = 1
			end
			local now = os.clock()
			local curTool = tools[swap.Index]
			local nextIdx = swap.Index % count + 1
			if now - (swap.Since or 0) >= (swap.Holds[swap.Index] or 0.3) or (not isToolOffCooldown(curTool) and isToolOffCooldown(tools[nextIdx])) then
				swap.Index = nextIdx
				swap.Since = now
			end
			return tools[swap.Index]
		end
		local function cw(cx, cy, cz)
			if cz.Parent == cx then return true end
			local cA = cq.EquipAt
			if os.clock() - cA < 0.2 then return false end
			cq.EquipAt = os.clock()
			pcall(function()
				cy:EquipTool(cz)
			end)
			if cz.Parent ~= cx then
				pcall(function()
					cz.Parent = cx
				end)
			end
			return cz.Parent == cx
		end
		b7.Parts = function(cx)
			cx = cx and cx.Character
			local cy = cx and cx:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local cz = cx and cx:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not cy or not cz or cz.Health <= 0 then return nil, nil end
			return cx, cy
		end
		b7.Hittable = function(cx)
			if not cx or cx == aj or cx.Parent ~= ae then return false end
			local cy, cz = b7.Parts(cx)
			if not cy then return false end
			if cy:GetAttribute("IsTrapped") == true or cx:GetAttribute("InBossArena") then return false end
			return not au.InsideBase(cz.Position)
		end
		local function cx()
			local cy = cq.WallsAt
			if os.clock() < cy then return cq.Walls end
			cq.WallsAt = os.clock() + 5
			local cz = {}
			local cA = workspace:FindFirstChild("World") or workspace:FindFirstChild("__OBJECTS")
			cA = cA and cA:FindFirstChild("Build")
			if cA then
				for cB, cC in ipairs(cA:GetChildren()) do
					local cD = cC:FindFirstChild("COLLISIONS")
					cD = cD and cD:FindFirstChild("GUARD NO COLLIDE")
					if cD then
						for cE, cF in ipairs(cD:GetChildren()) do
							if cp[cF.Name] then
								if cF:IsA("BasePart") then
									table.insert(cz, cF)
								end
								for cG, e in ipairs(cF:GetDescendants()) do
									if e:IsA("BasePart") then
										table.insert(cz, e)
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			cq.Walls = cz
			return cz
		end
		local function cy(cz)
			if cz.X <= cz.Y and cz.X <= cz.Z then return "X", "Y", "Z" end
			if cz.Y <= cz.Z then return "Y", "X", "Z" end
			return "Z", "X", "Y"
		end
		local function cz(cA)
			local cB = math.abs(cA.RightVector.Y)
			local cC = math.abs(cA.UpVector.Y)
			local cD = math.abs(cA.LookVector.Y)
			if cB >= cC and cB >= cD then return "X" end
			if cD <= cC then return "Y" end
			return "Z"
		end
		local function cA(cB, cC, cD, cE)
			if cD == cE then return true end
			local cF = cC[cD] + cl
			return math.abs(cB[cD]) <= cF
		end
		local function cB(cC, cD)
			for cE, cF in ipairs(cx()) do
				if cF.Parent then
					local cG = cF.CFrame
					local e = cF.Size
					local f, g, h = cy(e)
					local i = cz(cG)
					local j = e / 2
					local k = cG:PointToObjectSpace(cD)
					if cA(k, j, g, i) and cA(k, j, h, i) then
						local l = cG:PointToObjectSpace(cC)
						local m = math.abs(l[f])
						local n = cq.WallSide[cF]
						if m >= j[f] + cl * 0.5 or n == nil and m >= j[f] then
							n = l[f] >= 0 and 1 or -1
							cq.WallSide[cF] = n
						elseif n == nil then
							n = l[f] >= 0 and 1 or -1
						end
						local o = j[f] + cl
						if k[f] * n < o then
							local p = { X = k.X, Y = k.Y, Z = k.Z, [f] = n * o }
							cD = cG:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(p.X, p.Y, p.Z))
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return cD
		end
		b7.KeepOffWalls = function(cC, cD)
			local cE = cB(cC, cD)
			local cF = cE - cC
			if cl < cF.Magnitude then
				local cG = cC
				for e = 1, 6 do
					local f = cC + cF * e / cm
					local g = cB(cG, f)
					if (g - f).Magnitude > 0.01 then return cB(cC, g) end
					cG = g
				end
			end
			return cE
		end
		b7.ResetWalls = function()
			table.clear(cq.WallSide)
		end
		local cC = 0
		local cD = nil
		local function cE(cF)
			local cG = aj.Character
			if os.clock() - cC > 0.5 or cG ~= cD then
				cC = os.clock()
				cD = cG
				local e = {}
				for f, g in ipairs(ae:GetPlayers()) do
					if g.Character then
						table.insert(e, g.Character)
					end
				end
				cr.FilterDescendantsInstances = e
			end
			local e = workspace:Raycast(cF + Vector3.new(0, 60, 0), Vector3.new(0, -400, 0), cr)
			if e and cF.Y < e.Position.Y + cn then return Vector3.new(cF.X, e.Position.Y + cn, cF.Z) end
			return cF
		end
		local function cF(cG, e)
			local f = cq.Tracks[cG]
			if not f then
				f = { Samples = {}, Smooth = nil, Heading = nil }
				cq.Tracks[cG] = f
			end
			local g = os.clock()
			local h = f.Samples
			table.insert(h, { Time = g, Position = e.Position })
			while #h > 2 and g - h[1].Time > ck do
				table.remove(h, 1)
			end
			local i = e.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local j = h[1]
			local k = g - j.Time
			local l
			if k >= 0.03 then
				l = (e.Position - j.Position) / k
				if not (l.Magnitude <= 1500 and i.Magnitude <= l.Magnitude * 1.4) then
					l = i
				end
			else
				l = i
			end
			local m = Vector3.new(l.X, 0, l.Z)
			f.Smooth = f.Smooth and f.Smooth:Lerp(m, 0.25) or m
			local n = f.Smooth
			if n.Magnitude > 1 then
				local o = f.Heading and f.Heading:Lerp(n.Unit, 0.25) or n.Unit
				f.Heading = o.Magnitude > 0.01 and o.Unit or n.Unit
			end
			return l, m, n, f
		end
		local function cG()
			local e = 0
			for f, g in ipairs(cq.Stats) do
				e += g.Shots
			end
			local f = cq.Option
			local g = -math.huge
			for h, i in ipairs(cq.Stats) do
				local j = i.Shots + 1
				local k = (i.Hits + 1) / (i.Shots + 2) + math.sqrt(2 * math.log(e + 2) / j) * 0.35
				if k > g then
					g = k
					f = h
				end
			end
			cq.Option = f
			return f
		end
		local function e()
			local f = os.clock()
			for g = #cq.Pending, 1, -1 do
				local h = cq.Pending[g]
				local i = cq.Stats[h.Option]
				if h.RagdollBefore + 0.01 < cu(h.Target) then
					i.Hits = i.Hits + 1
					i.Shots = i.Shots + 1
					table.remove(cq.Pending, g)
				elseif f - h.At > h.Wait then
					if h.CooldownBefore + 0.01 < (h.Tool and tonumber(h.Tool:GetAttribute("CooldownEndTime")) or 0) then
						i.Shots = i.Shots + 1
					end
					table.remove(cq.Pending, g)
				end
			end
		end
		b7.Plan = function(f, g, h, i)
			if not h then
				local j
				j, h = b7.Parts(f)
			end
			if not h or not h.Parent then return nil end
			local j = math.clamp(aj:GetNetworkPing(), 0, 1)
			local k = math.clamp(j + ca, 0.05, 0.35)
			local l, m, n, o = cF(f or h, h)
			local p = cG()
			local q = co[p]
			local r = h.Position
			local s = r + l * math.max(0, q + j - k)
			local t = r + l * (q + j)
			local u = n.Magnitude
			local v = o.Heading
			if not v then
				local w = Vector3.new(g.Position.X - r.X, 0, g.Position.Z - r.Z)
				v = w.Magnitude > 0.1 and w.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			end
			local w = aj.Character
			local x = b7.Range(w and b7.PickBat(w) or nil)
			local y = r + n * (j + q + cc + cd) + (u > 1 and n.Unit * cf * ce or Vector3.zero)
			local z = math.max(5, math.min(x * 0.7, 6 + u * 0.07)) * ce
			local A = os.clock()
			local B = (math.sin(A * 2 * 3.1415926535897931 / cg) * 0.5 + 0.5) * z
			local C = math.sin(A * 2 * 3.1415926535897931 / ch) * ci
			local D = Vector3.new(-v.Z, 0, v.X)
			if D:Dot(g.Position - y) < 0 then
				D = -D
			end
			local E = y + v * B + D * (m.Magnitude < cj and 3 or 1.5) + Vector3.new(0, C, 0)
			local F = g.Position
			if not i then
				F = b7.KeepOffWalls(g.Position, cE(Vector3.new(E.X, E.Y, r.Z)))
			end
			return {
				Goal = F,
				Velocity = Vector3.new(n.X, 0, n.Z),
				Face = t,
				Current = t,
				Historical = s,
				Option = p,
				Distance = (r - g.Position).Magnitude,
			}
		end
		b7.Steer = function(f, g, h, i, j)
			local k = math.max(j, 0.0041666666666666666)
			local l = g.Velocity
			local m = l + (g.Goal - f.Position) / math.max(0.12, k)
			local n = math.min(h + l.Magnitude, i)
			if m.Magnitude > n then
				m = m.Unit * n
			end
			local o = f.Position
			local p = o + m * k
			local q = b7.KeepOffWalls(o, p)
			if (q - p).Magnitude > 0.01 then
				m = (q - o) / k
			end
			local r = b7.KeepOffWalls(o, o)
			if (r - o).Magnitude > 0.01 then
				m = (r - o) / math.max(0.12, k)
			end
			local s = m + Vector3.new(0, workspace.Gravity * k * 0.5, 0)
			pcall(function()
				local t = Vector3.new(g.Face.X - o.X, 0, g.Face.Z - o.Z)
				if t.Magnitude > 0.05 then
					f.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(o, o + t.Unit)
				end
				f.AssemblyLinearVelocity = s
				f.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end)
		end
		b7.TryHit = function(f, g)
			e()
			if workspace:GetAttribute("PvPDisabled") == true then return "Player hits are off right now" end
			local h = aj.Character
			local i = h and h:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local j = b7.Humanoid(h)
			if not i or not j or j.Health <= 0 then return "Character not loaded yet" end
			local k = b7.PickBat(h)
			if not k then return "No bat found" end
			if not cw(h, j, k) then return "Equipping " .. tostring(k:GetAttribute("GearName") or k.Name) end
			if not b7.Hittable(f) or b7.Ragdolled(f) then return nil end
			g = g or b7.Plan(f, i)
			if not g then return nil end
			local l = b7.Range(k) - cb
			local m = i.Position - i.AssemblyLinearVelocity * cc
			if (g.Historical - m).Magnitude > l and (g.Current - m).Magnitude > l then return nil end
			local n = ct()
			if not n then return nil end
			local o = math.clamp(aj:GetNetworkPing(), 0, 1)
			local p = tonumber(k:GetAttribute("CooldownEndTime")) or 0
			if cs() < p - o * 0.5 then return nil end
			local q = cq.LastFire
			if os.clock() - q < math.max(0.12, o * 1.5) then return nil end
			cq.LastFire = os.clock()
			cq.Trace = cq.Trace + 1
			table.insert(cq.Pending, {
				Target = f,
				Option = g.Option,
				At = os.clock(),
				Wait = math.max(0.5, o * 2 + 0.3),
				RagdollBefore = cu(f),
				CooldownBefore = p,
				Tool = k,
			})
			local r = string.format("%d:%d:%d", aj.UserId, cq.Trace, math.floor(cs() * 1000))
			pcall(function()
				n:FireServer(f, r)
			end)
			return "Hitting " .. f.DisplayName
		end
		b7.ReadyBat = function()
			local f = aj.Character
			local g = b7.Humanoid(f)
			if not f or not g or g.Health <= 0 then return false end
			local h = b7.PickBat(f)
			return h ~= nil and cw(f, g, h)
		end
		b7.Swing = function()
			if au.Steal.Active or au.Steal.Carrying then return false end
			local f = cq.LastFire
			local g = os.clock() - f < 0.3
			if not g then
				g = os.clock() - (cq.LastSwing or 0) < 0.15
			end
			if g then return false end
			local h = aj.Character
			local i = b7.Humanoid(h)
			if not h or not i or i.Health <= 0 then return false end
			local j = b7.PickBat(h)
			if not j or not cw(h, i, j) then return false end
			cq.LastSwing = os.clock()
			pcall(function()
				j:Activate()
			end)
			return true
		end
		b7.HolderOf = function(f)
			local g = workspace:FindFirstChild(f)
			if not g then return nil end
			for h, i in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do
				if i:IsA("JointInstance") or i:IsA("WeldConstraint") or i:IsA("RigidConstraint") then
					local j, k, l = pcall(function()
						return i.Part0, i.Part1
					end)
					if j then
						for m, n in ipairs({ k, l }) do
							if typeof(n) == "Instance" and not n:IsDescendantOf(g) then
								local o = n:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
								local p
								if o then
									p = ae:GetPlayerFromCharacter(o) or ae:FindFirstChild(o.Name)
								else
									p = o
								end
								p = p or nil
								if p and p ~= aj and p:IsA("Player") then return p end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return nil
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			while not au.CombatDisposed do
				local f = {}
				if au.CombatWantsHolders then
					local g = am.EggState
					if type(g) == "table" and type(g.ReadFieldEggs) == "function" then
						local h, i = pcall(g.ReadFieldEggs)
						local j = h and type(i) == "table" and i.Records or nil
						if type(j) == "table" then
							for k, l in pairs(j) do
								if type(l) == "table" and l.State == "Carried" and type(l.Uid) == "string" then
									local m = b7.HolderOf(l.Uid)
									if m then
										f[m] = true
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				cq.Holders = f
				task.wait(0.3)
			end
		end)
		b7.IsHolder = function(f)
			return cq.Holders[f] == true
		end
		local f = {}
		b7.OnNewLife = function(g)
			table.insert(f, g)
		end
		local function g()
			table.clear(cq.Pending)
			cq.LastFire = 0
			cq.LastSwing = 0
			cq.EquipAt = 0
			table.clear(cq.Tracks)
			table.clear(cq.WallSide)
			cq.SpawnRagdoll = cu(aj)
			for h, i in ipairs(f) do
				pcall(i)
			end
		end
		local h = aj.CharacterAdded
		local i = h.Connect
		local j = { aj.CharacterRemoving:Connect(g), i(h, g) }
		ap(function()
			au.CombatDisposed = true
			for k, l in ipairs(j) do
				pcall(function()
					l:Disconnect()
				end)
			end
		end)
	end
	do
		local b8 = au.Combat
		local b9 = { "Nearest", "Egg Holders", "Specific Player" }
		local ca = 0.7
		local cb = "No other players"
		local cc = {
			Handles = {},
			AuraHandle = nil,
			Row = nil,
			Picker = nil,
			TargetMode = b9[1],
			Picked = nil,
			LabelToName = {},
			Speed = 400,
			MaxSpeed = 750,
			Target = nil,
			Plan = nil,
			Moving = false,
			Status = "Idle",
			Shown = nil,
			NamesDirty = true,
		}
		local function cd()
			for ce, cf in ipairs(b9) do
				if au.Toggle(cc.Handles[ce], false) then return cf end
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function ce()
			return au.Toggle(cc.AuraHandle, false) == true
		end
		au.CombatActive = function()
			return cd() ~= nil or ce()
		end
		local function cf(cg)
			if not b8.Hittable(cg) then return false end
			if cc.TargetMode == b9[2] then return b8.IsHolder(cg) end
			if cc.TargetMode == b9[3] then return cc.Picked ~= nil and cg.Name == cc.Picked end
			return true
		end
		local function cg(ch)
			local ci = cc.Target
			local cj
			if ci and cf(ci) then
				local ck, cl = b8.Parts(ci)
				cj = (cl.Position - ch).Magnitude
			else
				cj = math.huge
				ci = nil
			end
			local ck = math.huge
			local cl = nil
			for cm, cn in ipairs(ae:GetPlayers()) do
				if cn ~= ci and cf(cn) and not b8.Ragdolled(cn) then
					local co, cp = b8.Parts(cn)
					local cq = (cp.Position - ch).Magnitude
					if cq < ck then
						ck = cq
						cl = cn
					end
				end
			end
			if ci then
				if cl and not b8.Ragdolled(ci) and ck < cj * ca then return cl end
				return ci
			end
			return cl
		end
		local function ch(ci, cj)
			local ck = nil
			for cl, cm in ipairs(ae:GetPlayers()) do
				if cm ~= aj then
					local cn = cm.Character
					local co = cn and cn:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if co then
						local cp = (co.Position - ci).Magnitude
						if cp < cj and b8.Hittable(cm) and not b8.Ragdolled(cm) then
							cj = cp
							ck = cm
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return ck, cj
		end
		local function ci()
			cc.Plan = nil
			if cc.Moving then
				cc.Moving = false
				au.EndFlight()
				au.GodMode(false)
				au.Shield("combat", false)
				b8.ResetWalls()
			end
			au.ReleaseMovement("combat")
		end
		b8.OnNewLife(function()
			cc.AuraVictim = nil
			cc.Target = nil
			cc.Plan = nil
			pcall(ci)
		end)
		local function cj()
			local ck = au.Movement
			return au.Steal.Active or au.Steal.Carrying or au.Steal.Wanted and au.Toggle(ay, false) or ck.Owner ~= nil and ck.Owner ~= "combat" and ck.Owner ~= "treadmill"
		end
		local function ck(cl)
			local cm = aj.Character
			local cn = b8.Range(cm and b8.PickBat(cm) or nil) + 6
			local co, cp = ch(cl.Position, cn + 24)
			if not co or cp > cn then
				cc.AuraVictim = nil
				if co then
					b8.ReadyBat()
				end
				cc.Status = "Aura ready, nobody in reach"
				return
			end
			cc.AuraVictim = co
			cc.Status = b8.TryHit(co, b8.Plan(co, cl, nil, true)) or "Aura on " .. co.DisplayName
		end
		local function cl()
			local cm = cd()
			if cm and cm ~= cc.TargetMode then
				cc.TargetMode = cm
				cc.Target = nil
			end
			au.CombatWantsHolders = cm == b9[2]
			local cn = ce()
			local co = not cm
			if co then
				if cc.Target or cc.Moving then
					cc.Target = nil
					ci()
				end
			end
			if co and not cn then
				cc.Status = "Idle"
				return
			end
			local cp = aj.Character
			local cq = cp and cp:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local cr = b8.Humanoid(cp)
			if not cq or not cr or cr.Health <= 0 then
				cc.Target = nil
				ci()
				cc.Status = "Character not loaded yet"
				return
			end
			if co then
				ck(cq)
				return
			end
			local cs = cg(cq.Position)
			cc.Target = cs
			if not cs then
				ci()
				if cn then
					ck(cq)
					return
				end
				cc.Status = cm == b9[2] and "No one is carrying an egg right now" or cm == b9[3] and "Picked player is not reachable" or "No player to hit"
				return
			end
			local ct = b8.Plan(cs, cq)
			local cu = cm ~= b9[2]
			if not cj() and (cu or not b8.SelfRagdolled()) and au.ClaimMovement("combat") and not au.AntiGuard.Busy then
				if not cc.Moving then
					cc.Moving = true
					au.Shield("combat", true)
					au.GodMode(true)
					au.BeginFlight()
				end
				au.GodTick()
				cc.Plan = ct
			else
				if cc.Moving then
					ci()
				end
				cc.Plan = nil
			end
			local cv = b8.TryHit(cs, ct, cu)
			local cw = ct and math.floor(ct.Distance + 0.5) or 0
			if cv then
				cc.Status = cv .. string.format("  %d studs", cw)
			elseif cj() then
				cc.Status = string.format("Auto Steal running, near %s", cs.DisplayName)
			else
				cc.Status = string.format("Chasing %s  %d studs", cs.DisplayName, cw)
			end
		end
		local function cm()
			local cn = {}
			for co, cp in ipairs(ae:GetPlayers()) do
				if cp ~= aj then
					table.insert(cn, cp)
				end
			end
			table.sort(cn, function(co, cp)
				return string.lower(co.DisplayName) < string.lower(cp.DisplayName)
			end)
			local co = {}
			for cp, cq in ipairs(cn) do
				co[cq.DisplayName] = (co[cq.DisplayName] or 0) + 1
			end
			local cp = {}
			local cq = {}
			for cr, cs in ipairs(cn) do
				local ct = cs.DisplayName
				if co[ct] > 1 then
					ct = string.format("%s (@%s)", cs.DisplayName, cs.Name)
				end
				table.insert(cp, ct)
				cq[ct] = cs.Name
			end
			if #cp == 0 then
				cp[1] = cb
			end
			return cp, cq
		end
		local function cn(co)
			for cp, cq in pairs(cc.LabelToName) do
				if cq == co then return cp end
			end
			return nil
		end
		local co = af.PreSimulation:Connect(function(co)
			local cp = cc.Plan
			if not cp or not cc.Moving then return end
			local cq = au.Root()
			if cq then
				b8.Steer(cq, cp, cc.Speed, math.max(cc.Speed, cc.MaxSpeed), co)
			end
		end)
		local cp = 0.05
		local cq = 0
		local cr = af.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			local cr = cd() ~= nil
			local cs = ce()
			if not cs then
				cc.AuraVictim = nil
			end
			local ct = os.clock()
			if cr or not cs or ct >= cq then
				if cs and not cr then
					cq = ct + cp
				end
				if not pcall(cl) then
					cc.Status = "Retrying"
				end
			end
			if cr or cs and cc.AuraVictim ~= nil then
				pcall(b8.Swing)
			end
			local cu = cc.Row
			if cu and cc.Shown ~= cc.Status and type(cu.Set) == "function" then
				cc.Shown = cc.Status
				pcall(cu.Set, cu, cc.Status)
			end
			local cv = cc.Picker
			if cc.NamesDirty and cv and type(cv.SetOptions) == "function" then
				cc.NamesDirty = false
				local cw, cx = cm()
				cc.LabelToName = cx
				pcall(cv.SetOptions, cv, cw, cc.Picked and cn(cc.Picked) or cw[1], false)
			end
		end)
		local cs = ae.PlayerAdded:Connect(function()
			cc.NamesDirty = true
		end)
		local ct = ae.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(ct)
			cc.NamesDirty = true
			if cc.Target == ct then
				cc.Target = nil
			end
		end)
		ap(function()
			for cu, cv in ipairs({ co, cr, cs, ct }) do
				pcall(function()
					cv:Disconnect()
				end)
			end
			cc.Target = nil
			ci()
		end)
		local function cu(cv, cw)
			if au.Toggle(cv, false) and au.Toggle(au.InvisibilityHandle, false) then
				au.UiDefer(function()
					pcall(cv.Set, cv, false, false)
					au.Notify(cw, "Turn off Invisibility first, both cannot be on at the same time")
				end)
				return true
			end
			return false
		end
		cc.Row = b6:CreateText({ Name = "Hit Status", Text = "Idle" })
		local cv = ac:CreateExclusiveGroup({ Name = "Combat Targets", MaxActive = 1 })
		for cw, cx in ipairs({ "Auto Hit Nearest Player", "Auto Hit Egg Holders", "Auto Hit Specific Player" }) do
			local cy = nil
			cy = b6:CreateToggle({
				Name = cx,
				Default = false,
				Callback = function()
					cu(cy, cx)
				end,
			})
			pcall(cy.JoinExclusiveGroup, cy, cv)
			cc.Handles[cw] = cy
		end
		local cw, cx = cm()
		cc.LabelToName = cx
		cc.Picker = b6:CreateDropdown({
			Name = "Hit Player",
			Note = "Which player the hit / chase feature targets",
			Options = cw,
			Default = cw[1],
			SubOf = cc.Handles[3],
			Callback = function(cy)
				cc.Picked = cc.LabelToName[tostring(cy)]
				cc.Target = nil
			end,
		})
		cc.AuraHandle = b6:CreateToggle({
			Name = "Hit Aura",
			Note = "Automatically hits players that come close (used by Steal Players)",
			Default = false,
			Callback = function()
				cu(cc.AuraHandle, "Hit Aura")
			end,
		})
		pcall(cc.AuraHandle.JoinExclusiveGroup, cc.AuraHandle, cv)
		do
			local gearDir = am.Gears and am.Gears.Directory
			local weaponEntries = {}
			local weaponNames = {}
			for k, info in pairs(type(gearDir) == "table" and gearDir or {}) do
				local batData = type(info) == "table" and info.BatControllerData or nil
				local wId = tostring(type(info) == "table" and info._id or k)
				if type(batData) == "table" then
					table.insert(weaponEntries, { Name = wId, Rank = tonumber(batData.RangeBonus) or 0 })
				elseif string.find(string.lower(wId), "scrambler", 1, true) then
					table.insert(weaponEntries, { Name = wId, Rank = -1 })
				end
			end
			table.sort(weaponEntries, function(a, b)
				if a.Rank ~= b.Rank then return a.Rank > b.Rank end
				return a.Name < b.Name
			end)
			for _, entry in ipairs(weaponEntries) do
				table.insert(weaponNames, entry.Name)
			end
			if #weaponNames == 0 then
				weaponNames = { "BasicBat", "IronBat", "GoldBat", "DiamondBat", "RacingBat", "Scrambler" }
			end
			local swapDrop = as(b6:CreateMultiDropdown({
				Name = "Swap Weapons",
				Note = "Swap Weapons: pick up to 2 weapons you own to switch between while hitting (empty = best bat only)",
				Options = weaponNames,
				Default = {},
				Callback = function(sel)
					local set = {}
					if type(sel) == "table" then
						for k, v in pairs(sel) do
							local key = v == true and type(k) == "string" and k or type(v) == "string" and v or nil
							if key then
								set[key] = true
							end
						end
					end
					local ordered = {}
					for _, wName in ipairs(weaponNames) do
						if set[wName] then
							table.insert(ordered, wName)
						end
					end
					au.CombatSwap.Picked = ordered
					au.CombatSwap.Index = 1
				end,
			}))
			for idx, defHold in ipairs({ 0.3, 0.4 }) do
				b6:CreateSlider({
					Name = "Weapon " .. idx .. " Hold",
					SubOf = swapDrop,
					Min = 0.2,
					Max = 1.5,
					Default = defHold,
					Increment = 0.01,
					Unit = "s",
					Callback = function(val)
						au.CombatSwap.Holds[idx] = math.clamp(tonumber(val) or defHold, 0.2, 1.5)
					end,
				})
			end
		end
		local cy = b6:CreateLabel({ Name = "Chase Settings", Text = "Chase Settings" })
		b6:CreateSlider({
			Name = "Hit Tween Speed",
			SubOf = cy,
			Min = 100,
			Max = 1000,
			Default = 400,
			Increment = 10,
			Unit = "studs/s",
			Callback = function(cz)
				cc.Speed = math.clamp(tonumber(cz) or 400, 100, 1000)
			end,
		})
		b6:CreateSlider({
			Name = "Hit Max Speed",
			SubOf = cy,
			Min = 100,
			Max = 1000,
			Default = 750,
			Increment = 10,
			Unit = "studs/s",
			Callback = function(cz)
				cc.MaxSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(cz) or 750, 100, 1000)
			end,
		})
		b6:CreateSlider({
			Name = "Hit Lead",
			SubOf = cy,
			Note = "Stay further in front of the target (+) or tighter on them (-), measured in studs",
			Unit = " studs",
			Min = -400,
			Max = 100,
			Default = -275,
			Increment = 1,
			Callback = function(cz)
				b8.SetLead(cz)
			end,
		})
		b6:CreateSlider({
			Name = "Hit Sweep",
			SubOf = cy,
			Note = "Distance you sweep side to side in front of the target",
			Min = 0,
			Max = 250,
			Default = 60,
			Increment = 1,
			Unit = "%",
			Callback = function(cz)
				b8.SetSweep(cz)
			end,
		})
		local cz = 2
		local cA = nil
		local function cB()
			local cC = ac.GetState
			return ac:GetState("Quick Pinned Features"), cC(ac, "Quick Pin Groups")
		end
		local function cC()
			local cD = {}
			for cE, cF in ipairs({ cc.Handles[1], cc.Handles[2], cc.AuraHandle }) do
				local cG, e = pcall(function()
					return cF:GetQuickPath()
				end)
				if cG and type(e) == "string" then
					table.insert(cD, e)
				end
			end
			return cD
		end
		local function cD()
			local cE, cF = cB()
			if not cE or not cF then return false end
			local cG = cE:Get()
			local e = cF:Get()
			if type(cG) ~= "table" or type(e) ~= "table" then return false end
			local f = cC()
			if #f == 0 then return false end
			for g, h in ipairs(f) do
				if not table.find(cG, h) or tonumber(e[h]) ~= cz then return false end
			end
			return true
		end
		local function cE()
			if cA and type(cA.SetActionText) == "function" then
				pcall(cA.SetActionText, cA, cD() and "Remove" or "Add")
			end
		end
		local function cF()
			local cG, e = cB()
			if not cG or not e then
				au.Notify("Quick Bar", "The Quick Bar is not ready yet, try again in a moment")
				return
			end
			local f = cD()
			local g = {}
			local h = {}
			local i = cG:Get()
			if type(i) == "table" then
				for j, k in ipairs(i) do
					g[j] = k
				end
			end
			local j = e:Get()
			if type(j) == "table" then
				for k, l in pairs(j) do
					h[k] = l
				end
			end
			for k, l in ipairs(cC()) do
				local m = table.find(g, l)
				if f then
					if m then
						table.remove(g, m)
					end
					h[l] = nil
				else
					h[l] = cz
					if not m then
						table.insert(g, l)
					end
				end
			end
			e:Set(h)
			cG:Set(g)
			cE()
			au.Notify("Quick Bar", f and "Removed the hit toggles from Quick Bar 2" or "Added the hit toggles to Quick Bar 2")
		end
		cA = b6:CreateButton({
			Name = "Add/Remove Hits On Quick Bar 2",
			Note = "Adds or removes the hit toggles from Quick Bar 2",
			ButtonText = "Add",
			ConfirmText = "Done!",
			Callback = function()
				au.UiDefer(cF)
			end,
		})
		task.delay(3, function()
			au.UiDefer(cE)
		end)
	end
	az = au.EspSection
	local function b8(b9, ca)
		local cb, cc = pcall(Font.new, b9, ca, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
		return cb and cc or nil

	local minBurstCash = 0
	local function parseBurstAmount(raw)
		local s = string.lower(string.gsub(tostring(raw or "0"), "%s+", ""))
		local num, suf = string.match(s, "^([%d%.]+)([kmbt]?)$")
		local n = tonumber(num) or 0
		if suf == "k" then n = n * 1e3
		elseif suf == "m" then n = n * 1e6
		elseif suf == "b" then n = n * 1e9
		elseif suf == "t" then n = n * 1e12
		end
		return n
	end

			end

				local ok2 = aJ.Invoke("RF/AwayEarnings/AskCollect")
				claimed = (ok1 == true) or (ok2 == true)
			end
		end)
		return claimed
	end

local aN

		end)

				pcall(function()
					local plrs = ae:GetPlayers()
					local maxP = ae.MaxPlayers or 12
					local ping = math.floor(aj:GetNetworkPing() * 1000 + 0.5)
					local dgt = math.floor(workspace.DistributedGameTime or 0)
					local hrs = math.floor(dgt / 3600)
					local mins = math.floor((dgt % 3600) / 60)
					local totalFieldVal = 0
					local bestEggStr = "None"
					local bestEggVal = 0
					local eggState = am.EggState
					local dir = am.Assets and am.Assets.Directory
					if type(eggState) == "table" and type(eggState.ReadFieldEggs) == "function" and type(dir) == "table" then
						local ok, snap = pcall(eggState.ReadFieldEggs)
						local recs = ok and type(snap) == "table" and snap.Records or nil
						if type(recs) == "table" then
							for _, rec in pairs(recs) do
								if type(rec) == "table" and (rec.State == "Slot" or rec.State == "Dropped") then
									local cat = tostring(rec.AssetCategory or "")
									local meta = dir[cat]
									local sc = tonumber(rec.AssetScale) or 1
									local rate = (tonumber(meta and meta.EarningRate) or 1) * sc
									totalFieldVal = totalFieldVal + rate
									if rate > bestEggVal then
										bestEggVal = rate
										bestEggStr = string.format("%s ($%d/s)", tostring(meta and meta.DisplayName or cat), math.floor(rate + 0.5))
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if srvInfoCard and type(srvInfoCard.Set) == "function" then
						srvInfoCard:Set(string.format(
							"Players: %d/%d  \226\128\162  Ping: %d ms  \226\128\162  Server Age: %dh %02dm\nField Wealth: $%d/s  \226\128\162  Best on Map: %s",
							#plrs, maxP, ping, hrs, mins, math.floor(totalFieldVal + 0.5), bestEggStr
						))
					end
				end)
				task.wait(2.0)
			end
		end)
		local aFinderSec = aJ:CreateSection({ Name = "Egg Finder & Server Scanner", Expanded = true })
		local _finderActive = false
		local _finderHopMode = "Until An Egg Matches"
		local _finderSyncSteal = true
		local _finderDelay = 5
		local _finderRareSeen = false
		local finderStatusRow = aFinderSec:CreateText({

				_finderActive = val == true
				au.EggFinderEnabled = _finderActive

				if not _finderActive then
					setFinderStatus("Idle - turn on Auto Hop / Egg Finder to scan servers")
					return
				end
				task.spawn(function()
					for rem = _finderDelay, 1, -1 do
						if not _finderActive then return end
						setFinderStatus(string.format("First hop scan in %ds (%s)...", rem, _finderHopMode))
						task.wait(1)
					end
					while _finderActive do
						local hasMatch = false
						if type(au.HasMatchingTargetEgg) == "function" then
							local ok, res = pcall(au.HasMatchingTargetEgg, _finderSyncSteal)
							hasMatch = ok and res == true
						end
						if _finderHopMode == "Until An Egg Matches" then
							if hasMatch then
								setFinderStatus("Match found on this server! Staying here.")
								task.wait(3)
							else
								setFinderStatus("No matching egg found - hopping to next server...")
								pcall(au.HopServer)
								break
							end
						elseif _finderHopMode == "Steal Then Hop" then
							if hasMatch or (au.Steal and (au.Steal.Active or au.Steal.Carrying)) then
								setFinderStatus("Stealing matching egg first before hopping...")
								task.wait(2)
							else
								setFinderStatus("Field cleared - hopping to next server...")
								pcall(au.HopServer)
								break
							end
						elseif _finderHopMode == "After A Rare Spawns" then
							if hasMatch then
								_finderRareSeen = true
								setFinderStatus("Rare egg active on field - waiting for it to be claimed...")
								task.wait(2)
							elseif _finderRareSeen then
								setFinderStatus("Rare egg finished - hopping to next server...")
								pcall(au.HopServer)
								break
							else
								setFinderStatus("Waiting for a rare egg spawn...")

				end)
			end

				while true do
					if hopState.Active then

									break
								end
								setHopGuiSubtitle(string.format("No match - hopping in %ds...", rem), Color3.fromRGB(215, 195, 145))
								task.wait(1)
							end
							if hopState.Active then

										if promptLbl then promptLbl.Text = string.format("Continue? (%ds)", sec) end
										task.wait(1)
									end
									promptFrame.Visible = false

										hopState.Hops = 0

									end
								end

									hopState.Hops += 1

									pcall(au.HopServer, "Random")
									task.wait(8)
								end
							end
						end
					end
					task.wait(1.0)
				end
			end)

				hopState.Active = false
				if hopWorkerThread then pcall(task.cancel, hopWorkerThread) end
				if hopGui then pcall(hopGui.Destroy, hopGui); hopGui = nil end
			end)
		end
	end

			bg()
		end,
	})
	ap(bh)
end
do
	local aQ = false
	local aR = nil
	local function aS(aT)
		if aR then
			pcall(function()
				aR:Destroy()
			end)
			aR = nil
		end
		au.RenderBackdrop = nil
		if not aT then return end
		local aU = aj:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
		if not aU then return end
		local aV = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		aV.Name = ao()
		aV.DisplayOrder = -1000
		aV.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		aV.ResetOnSpawn = false
		local aW = Instance.new("Frame")
		aW.Name = ao()
		aW.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		aW.BorderSizePixel = 0
		aW.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		aW.Parent = aV
		au.RenderBackdrop = aV
		aV.Parent = aU
		aR = aV
	end
	local function aT(aU)
		pcall(function()
			af:Set3dRenderingEnabled(aU)
		end)
		pcall(aS, not aU)
	end
	au.Perf3DSet = function(allow3D)
		aQ = allow3D ~= true
		aT(allow3D == true)
	end
	au.PerfMode = aO:CreateDropdown({
		Name = "Performance Mode",
		Note = "Off / FPS Boost (removes particles, shadows and effects) / AFK Mode (FPS Boost plus 3D rendering off, screen covered in black)",
		Options = { "Off", "FPS Boost", "AFK Mode" },
		Default = "Off",
		Callback = function(mode)
			local pick = tostring(mode or "Off")
			if type(au.PerfOptimizerSet) == "function" then
				pcall(au.PerfOptimizerSet, pick ~= "Off")
			end
			if type(au.Perf3DSet) == "function" then
				pcall(au.Perf3DSet, pick ~= "AFK Mode")
			end
		end,
	})
	do
		local startupBoostOn = false
		local startupSnap = nil
		local startupParts = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local startupDecals = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local function applyStartupBoost(enable)
			local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
			if enable then
				if not startupSnap then
					startupSnap = {}
					pcall(function()
						startupSnap.quality = settings().Rendering.QualityLevel
						startupSnap.throttle = settings().Physics.PhysicsEnvironmentalThrottle
						startupSnap.shadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows
						startupSnap.fogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd
						startupSnap.brightness = Lighting.Brightness
					end)
				end
				pcall(function()
					settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
					settings().Physics.PhysicsEnvironmentalThrottle = Enum.EnviromentalPhysicsThrottle.Always
					Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
					Lighting.FogEnd = 9e9
					Lighting.Brightness = 2
				end)
				pcall(function()
					local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
					if terrain then
						terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0
						terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
						terrain.WaterReflectance = 0
						terrain.WaterTransparency = 1
						terrain.Decoration = false
						local clouds = terrain:FindFirstChildOfClass("Clouds")
						if clouds then
							clouds.Enabled = false
						end
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					local shared = ag:FindFirstChild("Shared")
					local prefs = shared and shared:FindFirstChild("Preferences")
					if prefs then
						local pm = require(prefs)
						pm.Set("HideOtherPets", true)
						pm.Set("DisableVideos", true)
					end
				end)
				task.spawn(function()
					local t0 = os.clock()
					for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
						if not startupBoostOn then break end
						if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
							pcall(function()
								if not startupParts[desc] then
									startupParts[desc] = { desc.Material, desc.CastShadow }
								end
								desc.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
								desc.CastShadow = false
							end)
						elseif desc:IsA("Decal") or desc:IsA("Texture") then
							pcall(function()
								if desc.Texture ~= "" and not startupDecals[desc] then
									startupDecals[desc] = desc.Texture
								end
								desc.Texture = ""
							end)
						end
						if os.clock() - t0 > 0.004 then
							task.wait()
							t0 = os.clock()
						end
					end
				end)
			else
				if startupSnap then
					pcall(function()
						settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = startupSnap.quality or Enum.QualityLevel.Automatic
						if startupSnap.throttle then
							settings().Physics.PhysicsEnvironmentalThrottle = startupSnap.throttle
						end
						Lighting.GlobalShadows = startupSnap.shadows ~= false
						if startupSnap.fogEnd then
							Lighting.FogEnd = startupSnap.fogEnd
						end
						if startupSnap.brightness then
							Lighting.Brightness = startupSnap.brightness
						end
					end)
				end
				for part, orig in pairs(startupParts) do
					if part and part.Parent then
						pcall(function()
							part.Material = orig[1]
							part.CastShadow = orig[2]
						end)
					end
				end
				for dec, tex in pairs(startupDecals) do
					if dec and dec.Parent then
						pcall(function()
							dec.Texture = tex
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		au.StartupBoostHandle = aO:CreateToggle({
			Name = "Startup Boost (Declutter Map)",
			Note = "Strips map textures, decals, water waves, other players' pets and video boards for maximum FPS",
			Default = false,
			Callback = function(on)
				startupBoostOn = on == true
				applyStartupBoost(startupBoostOn)
			end,
		})
	end
	do
		local antiCutsceneOn = false
		local guardOrig = nil
		local function applyGuardSuppress(suppress)
			pcall(function()
				local gpc = require(ag.Shared.Modules.GuardAreas.GuardPresentationComponent)
				if type(gpc) ~= "table" then return end
				if suppress then
					guardOrig = guardOrig or {
						PlayWake = gpc.PlayWake,
						PlayHit = gpc.PlayHit,
						PlayAfterWake = gpc.PlayAfterWake,
						ScheduleAfterWake = gpc.ScheduleAfterWake,
					}
					local noop = function() end
					gpc.PlayWake = noop
					gpc.PlayHit = function() return 0 end
					gpc.PlayAfterWake = noop
					gpc.ScheduleAfterWake = noop
				elseif type(guardOrig) == "table" then
					for k, fn in pairs(guardOrig) do
						gpc[k] = fn
					end
				end
			end)
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			while true do
				if antiCutsceneOn then
					pcall(function()
						local pg = aj:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
						if pg then
							for _, ch in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
								if ch:IsA("ScreenGui") then
									local nm = string.lower(ch.Name)
									if string.find(nm, "cutscene", 1, true) or ch.Name == "Intro" or ch.Name == "DropHeldEgg" then
										if ch.Enabled then
											ch.Enabled = false
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end)
					task.wait(0.75)
				else
					task.wait(2.0)
				end
			end
		end)
		au.AntiCutsceneHandle = aO:CreateToggle({
			Name = "Anti Cutscene",
			Note = "Blocks hatch, intro, and guard knockback cutscene overlays from interrupting your screen",
			Default = false,
			Callback = function(on)
				antiCutsceneOn = on == true
				applyGuardSuppress(antiCutsceneOn)
			end,
		})
	end
	do
		local hideVisualsOn = false
		local hiddenParts = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local hiddenEffects = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local visualConn = nil
		local function isEggOrPetVisualNode(inst)
			local cur = inst
			while cur and cur ~= workspace do
				local nm = cur.Name
				if nm == "PlacedEggRenders"
					or nm == "AreaEggSlotsClient"
					or nm == "ActivePets"
					or nm == "Pets"
					or nm == "PetVisuals"
					or nm == "EggVisuals"
					or nm == "CarriedEggs"
					or string.find(nm, "EggRender", 1, true)
					or string.find(nm, "PetRender", 1, true)
				then
					return true
				end
				cur = cur.Parent
			end
			return false
		end
		local function hideVisualDescendant(inst)
			if not hideVisualsOn or not inst or not inst.Parent then return end
			if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
				local nm = inst.Name
				if nm == "HumanoidRootPart" or nm == "RootPart" or nm == "PromptPart" or nm == "Hitbox" then return end
				if isEggOrPetVisualNode(inst) then
					if hiddenParts[inst] == nil then
						hiddenParts[inst] = inst.LocalTransparencyModifier
					end
					pcall(function()
						inst.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
						inst.CastShadow = false
					end)
				end
			elseif inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or inst:IsA("Beam") or inst:IsA("Trail") or inst:IsA("Highlight") or inst:IsA("Decal") or inst:IsA("Texture") then
				if isEggOrPetVisualNode(inst) then
					if inst:IsA("Decal") or inst:IsA("Texture") then
						if hiddenEffects[inst] == nil then
							hiddenEffects[inst] = inst.Transparency
						end
						pcall(function()
							inst.Transparency = 1
						end)
					else
						if hiddenEffects[inst] == nil then
							hiddenEffects[inst] = inst.Enabled
						end
						pcall(function()
							inst.Enabled = false
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local function applyHideEggPetVisuals(enable)
			if enable then
				for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
					hideVisualDescendant(desc)
				end
				if not visualConn then
					visualConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
						if hideVisualsOn then
							task.defer(hideVisualDescendant, desc)
						end
					end)
				end
			else
				if visualConn then
					pcall(visualConn.Disconnect, visualConn)
					visualConn = nil
				end
				for part, origLtm in pairs(hiddenParts) do
					if part and part.Parent then
						pcall(function()
							part.LocalTransparencyModifier = origLtm or 0
						end)
					end
				end
				for eff, origVal in pairs(hiddenEffects) do
					if eff and eff.Parent then
						pcall(function()
							if eff:IsA("Decal") or eff:IsA("Texture") then
								eff.Transparency = type(origVal) == "number" and origVal or 0
							else
								eff.Enabled = origVal == true
							end
						end)
					end
				end
				table.clear(hiddenParts)
				table.clear(hiddenEffects)
			end
		end
		au.RemoveEggPetVisualsHandle = aO:CreateToggle({
			Name = "Remove Egg / Pet Visuals",

			Default = false,
			Callback = function(on)
				hideVisualsOn = on == true
				applyHideEggPetVisuals(hideVisualsOn)
			end,
		})

		local function parseSpawnAlert(msg)
			if type(msg) ~= "string" or not string.find(msg, "spawned in", 1, true) then return nil end
			local clean = msg:gsub("<[^>]+>", ""):gsub("[%c]", "")
			local rar, pet, area = clean:match("A%s+(%a+)%s+(.-)%s+Egg%s+spawned%s+in%s+([^!]+)")
			if not rar then
				pet, rar, area = clean:match("([%w%s]+)%s*%((%a+)%)%s+has%s+spawned%s+in%s+([^!]+)")
			end
			if rar and pet and area then
				local key = string.lower(pet .. "_" .. area .. "_" .. tostring(math.floor(os.time() / 120)))
				if not seenAlerts[key] then
					seenAlerts[key] = true
					table.insert(spawnHistory, 1, {
						name = pet:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""),
						area = area:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""),
						rarity = rar:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""),
						ts = os.time(),
						reporter = "Live Chat Alert",
					})
					if type(analystRefresh) == "function" then
						pcall(analystRefresh)
					end
				end
			end
		end

			game:GetService("TextChatService").MessageReceived:Connect(function(m)
				if m and m.Text then

		end)

			btnHist.TextColor3 = goldTheme.text

			local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")

			list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			list.BorderSizePixel = 0
			list.ScrollBarThickness = 3
			list.ScrollBarImageColor3 = goldTheme.accent

			listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
			listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

				{
					title = "Eternal Cycle (45 - 90m)",

				},
				{
					title = "Divine Cycle (1.5 - 3h)",
					sub = "Kitsune (Cherry Blossom 20%)  |  ArchAngel (Heaven 20%)  |  Godzilla (Prehistoric 20%)  |  Pegasus (Fantasy 20%)  |  Unicorn (Magical Forest 20%)",
				},

				for _, ch in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do

						ch:Destroy()

				btnTargets.TextColor3 = tabMode == "targets" and goldTheme.bgLow or goldTheme.text

						dLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 54)
						dLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
						dLbl.TextSize = 11
						dLbl.TextWrapped = true
						dLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
						dLbl.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
						dLbl.TextColor3 = goldTheme.text
						dLbl.Text = cyc.sub
						dLbl.Parent = card
					end
					list.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, #cycles * 100 + 8)
				else
					for idx, hItem in ipairs(spawnHistory) do
						local row = Instance.new("Frame")
						row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 48)
						row.BackgroundColor3 = goldTheme.surface
						row.BorderSizePixel = 0
						row.LayoutOrder = idx
						row.Parent = list
						Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
						Instance.new("UIStroke", row).Color = goldTheme.stroke
						local nm = Instance.new("TextLabel")
						nm.BackgroundTransparency = 1

						sub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium

						sub.TextColor3 = goldTheme.muted
						sub.Text = string.format("Area: %s  |  %s", tostring(hItem.area), tostring(hItem.reporter))
						sub.Parent = row
						local mins = math.max(0, math.floor((os.time() - (tonumber(hItem.ts) or os.time())) / 60))

	ap(function()
		if aQ then
			aT(true)
		end
	end)

do
	local aQ = aN:CreateSection({ Name = "Utility", Expanded = true })
	local aR = { Enabled = true, Alive = true, Silenced = {} }
	local function aS()
		if type(getconnections) ~= "function" then return {} end
		local aT, aU = pcall(getconnections, aj.Idled)
		return aT and type(aU) == "table" and aU or {}
	end
	local function aT()
		for aU, aV in ipairs(aS()) do
			if pcall(function()
				aV:Disable()
			end) then
				aR.Silenced[#aR.Silenced + 1] = aV
			end
		end
	end
	local function aU()
		local aV = aR.Silenced
		if #aV == 0 then
			aV = aS()
		end
		for aW, aX in ipairs(aV) do
			pcall(function()
				aX:Enable()
			end)
		end
		table.clear(aR.Silenced)
	end
	local aV = setmetatable({}, { __index = function()
		return function()
		end
	end })
	local aW = {}
	local function aX()
		local aY = {}
		if type(getgc) ~= "function" or type(debug) ~= "table" or type(debug.getupvalues) ~= "function" then return aY end
		local aZ, a_ = pcall(getgc, false)
		if not aZ or type(a_) ~= "table" then return aY end
		for a0, a1 in ipairs(a_) do
			if type(a1) == "function" and islclosure(a1) then
				local a2, a3 = pcall(debug.info, a1, "s")
				if a2 and type(a3) == "string" and string.find(a3, "AntiAFK", 1, true) then
					local a4, a5 = pcall(debug.getupvalues, a1)
					if a4 and type(a5) == "table" then
						for a6, a7 in pairs(a5) do
							if typeof(a7) == "Instance" and a7.ClassName == "TeleportService" then
								aY[#aY + 1] = { Fn = a1, Index = a6, Original = a7 }
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return aY
	end
	local function aY()
		for aZ, a_ in ipairs(aX()) do
			local a0, a1 = pcall(debug.getupvalue, a_.Fn, a_.Index)
			if a0 and typeof(a1) == "Instance" then
				if pcall(debug.setupvalue, a_.Fn, a_.Index, aV) then
					aW[#aW + 1] = a_
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function aZ()
		for a_, a0 in ipairs(aW) do
			pcall(debug.setupvalue, a0.Fn, a0.Index, a0.Original)
		end
		table.clear(aW)
	end
	local function a_()
		aT()
		if #aW == 0 then
			aY()
		end
	end
	local a0 = aj.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.delay(1, function()
			if aR.Alive and aR.Enabled then
				table.clear(aR.Silenced)
				pcall(a_)
			end
		end)
	end)
	ap(function()
		pcall(function()
			a0:Disconnect()
		end)
	end)
	ap(function()
		aR.Alive = false
		aU()
		aZ()
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while aR.Alive do
			if aR.Enabled then
				a_()
			end
			task.wait(600)
		end
	end)
	au.AntiAfkHandle = aQ:CreateToggle({
		Name = "Anti AFK",
		Note = "Keeps you in the server when you idle",
		Default = true,
		Callback = function(a1)
			aR.Enabled = a1 ~= false
			if aR.Enabled then
				a_()
			else
				aU()
				aZ()
			end
		end,
	})
	task.defer(function()
		if type(au.AntiAfkHandle) == "table" and au.Toggle(au.AntiAfkHandle, false) ~= true then
			pcall(au.AntiAfkHandle.Set, au.AntiAfkHandle, true)
			if type(au.Notify) == "function" then
				pcall(au.Notify, "Anti AFK", "Anti AFK is on by default, so it was switched back on.")
			end
		end
	end)
end
do
	local function enforceAntiGuardDefault()
		if type(au.AntiGuard) == "table" then
			au.AntiGuard.Mode = "Anti Guard + Panel"
			au.AntiGuard.Enabled = true
			au.AntiGuard.PanelShown = true
			if au.AntiGuard.Handle and type(au.AntiGuard.Handle.Set) == "function" then
				pcall(au.AntiGuard.Handle.Set, au.AntiGuard.Handle, true)
			end
			if au.AntiGuard.PanelHandle and type(au.AntiGuard.PanelHandle.Set) == "function" then
				pcall(au.AntiGuard.PanelHandle.Set, au.AntiGuard.PanelHandle, true)
			end
			if au.AntiGuard.ShowPanel then
				pcall(au.AntiGuard.ShowPanel, true)
			end
			if au.AntiGuard.Render then
				pcall(au.AntiGuard.Render, false)
			end
		end
		if type(au.AntiGuardMode) == "table" and type(au.AntiGuardMode.Set) == "function" then
			pcall(au.AntiGuardMode.Set, au.AntiGuardMode, "Anti Guard + Panel")
		end
	end
	task.defer(enforceAntiGuardDefault)
	task.delay(1.2, function()
		if type(au.AntiGuard) == "table" and au.AntiGuard.Mode ~= "Anti Guard + Panel" then
			enforceAntiGuardDefault()
		end
	end)
end
do
	local presetSec = am.QuickStartSection or au.MiscMainTab:CreateSection({ Name = "Quick Start", Expanded = true })
	local lockRow = presetSec:CreateText({ Name = "Event Lock Status", Text = "Event Lock: free - no auto event running" })
	au.EventLockStatus = function()
		local lock = au.EventLock
		local active, armed = nil, nil
		if type(lock) == "table" then
			for name, live in pairs(lock.Runtime or {}) do
				if live == true then
					active = tostring(name)
					break
				end
			end
			for name, on in pairs(lock.Flags or {}) do
				if on == true then
					armed = tostring(name)
					break
				end
			end
		end
		local text
		if active then
			text = "Event Lock: ACTIVE (" .. active .. ") - Auto Steal and Instant Steal are locked"
		elseif armed then
			text = "Event Lock: armed (" .. armed .. ") - waiting for the event to start"
		else
			text = "Event Lock: free - no auto event automation is on"
		end
		pcall(function()
			lockRow.Set(lockRow, text)
		end)
	end
	do
		local lock = au.EventLock
		if type(lock) == "table" and type(lock.Register) == "function" then
			lock.Register("Shooting Star", function()
				local star = au.ShootingStar
				return type(star) == "table" and star.Payload ~= nil
			end)
			lock.Register("Butterfly Bloom", function()
				local endsAt = workspace:GetAttribute("ButterflyBloomEndsAt")
				return type(endsAt) == "number" and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() < endsAt
			end)
		end
	end
	local lockScanStop = false
	ap(function()
		lockScanStop = true
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while not lockScanStop do
			task.wait(1)
			pcall(function()
				if type(au.EventLock) == "table" and type(au.EventLock.Scan) == "function" then
					au.EventLock.Scan()
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	local function presetSet(handle, on)
		if type(handle) ~= "table" then return end
		for _, method in ipairs({ "Set", "SetValue" }) do
			if type(handle[method]) == "function" then
				pcall(handle[method], handle, on == true)
				return
			end
		end
	end
	local function presetChoice(handle, value)
		if type(handle) ~= "table" then return end
		for _, method in ipairs({ "Set", "SetValue", "Select" }) do
			if type(handle[method]) == "function" and pcall(handle[method], handle, value) then return end
		end
	end
	au.StopAll = function()
		presetSet(au.AutoStealHandle, false)
		presetSet(au.PlaceEggHandle, false)
		presetChoice(au.SafeCarry.InstantSelect, "Off")
		presetSet(au.AntiGuard.Handle, false)
		presetChoice(au.AntiGuardMode, "Off")
		presetSet(au.AdminTreadmillHandle, false)
		presetSet(au.RallyDriveHandle, false)
		presetChoice(au.PerfMode, "Off")
		presetSet(au.GCHandle, false)
		presetSet(au.AntiAfkHandle, false)
		if type(au.Notify) == "function" then
			pcall(au.Notify, "Preset", "Everything stopped (Stop All applied)")
		end
	end
	local panicUIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local panicConn = nil
	local function panicBind()
		if panicConn then
			pcall(function()
				panicConn:Disconnect()
			end)
			panicConn = nil
		end
		local keyName = tostring(au.PanicKey or "Off")
		if keyName == "Off" then return end
		local key = Enum.KeyCode[keyName]
		if not key then return end
		panicConn = panicUIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
			if processed or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
			if input.KeyCode ~= key then return end
			local focused = nil
			pcall(function()
				focused = panicUIS:GetFocusedTextBox()
			end)
			if focused then return end
			if type(au.StopAll) == "function" then
				au.StopAll()
				if type(au.Notify) == "function" then
					pcall(au.Notify, "Panic key", "Stop All fired from the " .. keyName .. " key - every farming feature is off.")
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	if type(ap) == "function" then
		pcall(ap, function()
			if panicConn then
				pcall(function()
					panicConn:Disconnect()
				end)
				panicConn = nil
			end
		end)
	end
	au.PanicKey = "End"
	local panicHandle = presetSec:CreateDropdown({
		Name = "Panic Key (Stop All)",
		Note = "Press this key anytime to stop every farming feature at once. Pick Off to disable the hotkey.",
		Options = { "Off", "End", "Home", "Insert", "Delete", "F9", "F10", "F11", "F12" },
		Default = "End",
		Callback = function(picked)
			au.PanicKey = tostring(picked or "Off")
			panicBind()
		end,
	})
	if type(panicHandle) == "table" and type(panicHandle.Get) == "function" then
		local currentKey = nil
		pcall(function()
			currentKey = panicHandle:Get()
		end)
		if currentKey ~= nil then
			au.PanicKey = tostring(currentKey)
		end
	end
	panicBind()
	local selectedQuickPreset = "Full Farm"
	presetSec:CreateDropdown({

				for be, bf in ipairs(bd:GetDescendants()) do
					if bf:IsA("JointInstance") or bf:IsA("WeldConstraint") or bf:IsA("RigidConstraint") then
						local bg, bh, bi = pcall(function()
							return bf.Part0, bf.Part1
						end)
						local bj
						if bg then
							bj = bh == bb or bi == bb
						else
							bj = bg
						end
						if bj then return bd end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local function bb(bc, bd)
		local be = {}
		for bf, bg in ipairs(bc:GetDescendants()) do
			be[bg] = bg.Archivable
			pcall(function()
				bg.Archivable = true
			end)
		end
		local bf = bc.Archivable
		bc.Archivable = true
		local bg, bh = pcall(function()
			return bc:Clone()
		end)
		bc.Archivable = bf
		for bi, bj in pairs(be) do
			pcall(function()
				bi.Archivable = bj
			end)
		end
		if not bg or not bh then return nil end
		bh.Name = a0()
		for bi, bj in ipairs(bh:GetDescendants()) do
			if bj:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or bj:IsA("Sound") or bj:IsA("ForceField") or bj:IsA("JointInstance") or bj:IsA("Constraint") or bj:IsA("WeldConstraint") or bj:IsA("BodyMover") or bj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or bj:IsA("BillboardGui") then
				pcall(function()
					bj:Destroy()
				end)
			elseif bj:IsA("BasePart") then
				bj.Anchored = true
				bj.CanCollide = false
				bj.CanQuery = false
				bj.CanTouch = false
			elseif bj:IsA("Humanoid") then
				bj.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
				bj.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
			end
		end
		bh.Parent = bd
		return bh
	end
	local function bc(bd, be)
		local curCam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not bd or not curCam or a_.Disguise then return end
		be = be or Vector3.zero
		local bg = { Camera = curCam, CameraType = curCam.CameraType, CameraCFrame = curCam.CFrame, Copies = {}, Hidden = {} }
		a_.Disguise = bg
		local bh = { bd }
		local bi, bj = pcall(ba)
		if bi and bj then
			bh[#bh + 1] = bj
		end
		for bk, bl in ipairs(bh) do
			for bm, bn in ipairs(bl:GetDescendants()) do
				if bn:IsA("BasePart") or bn:IsA("Decal") or bn:IsA("Texture") then
					bg.Hidden[#bg.Hidden + 1] = bn
				end
			end
		end
		local function bk()
			for bl, bm in ipairs(bg.Hidden) do
				pcall(function()
					bm.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
				end)
			end
			pcall(function()
				if curCam.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
					curCam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
				end
				curCam.CFrame = bg.CameraCFrame
			end)
		end
		bk()
		bg.BindName = a0()
		if not pcall(function()
			af:BindToRenderStep(bg.BindName, Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 1, bk)
		end) then
			bg.BindName = nil
			local linkOk, link = pcall(function()
				return af.RenderStepped:Connect(bk)
			end)
			if linkOk and link then
				bg.Link = link
			else
				bg.Beat = af.Heartbeat:Connect(bk)
			end
		end
		for bl, bm in ipairs(bh) do
			local bn, bo = pcall(bb, bm, curCam)
			if bn and bo then
				if be.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					for bp, bq in ipairs(bo:GetDescendants()) do
						if bq:IsA("BasePart") then
							pcall(function()
								bq.CFrame = bq.CFrame + be
							end)
						end
					end
				end
				bg.Copies[#bg.Copies + 1] = bo
			end
		end
	end
	local function bd()
		local be = a_.Disguise
		if not be then return end
		a_.Disguise = nil
		if be.BindName then
			pcall(function()
				af:UnbindFromRenderStep(be.BindName)
			end)
		end
		if be.Link then
			pcall(function()
				be.Link:Disconnect()
			end)
		end
		if be.Beat then
			pcall(function()
				be.Beat:Disconnect()
			end)
		end
		for bf, bg in ipairs(be.Hidden) do
			pcall(function()
				bg.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
			end)
		end
		pcall(function()
			be.Camera.CameraType = be.CameraType
		end)
		for bf, bg in ipairs(be.Copies) do
			pcall(function()
				bg:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end
	local function be()
		for bf, bg in ipairs(aW) do
			local bh = workspace
			for bi, bj in ipairs(bg.Path) do
				bh = bh and bh:FindFirstChild(bj) or nil
			end
			if bh and bh:IsA("BasePart") then return bh.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(bg.Offset) end
		end
		return Vector3.new(528.7, 70.57, -364.11)
	end
	local function bf(bg, bh, bi, bj, bk)
		local bl = CFrame.new(bi) * bj
		pcall(function()
			bg:PivotTo(bl)
		end)
		if (bh.Position - bi).Magnitude > 3 then
			pcall(function()
				bh.CFrame = bl
			end)
		end
		if bk == false then return end
		for bm, bn in ipairs(bg:GetDescendants()) do
			if bn:IsA("BasePart") then
				pcall(function()
					bn.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					bn.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end)
			end
		end
	end
	local function bg()
		local bh = a_.AreaId
		if type(bh) ~= "string" or bh == "" then
			bh = type(au.Steal) == "table" and au.Steal.CarryAreaId or nil
		end
		if type(bh) ~= "string" or bh == "" then
			local bi = aj:GetAttribute("AreaId")
			bh = type(bi) == "string" and bi or nil
		end
		return bh
	end
	local bh = { lightdark = "LightDark" }
	local function bi(bj)
		if type(bj) ~= "string" then return "Default" end
		local bk = string.lower
		local bl = string.gsub(bj, "[^%a]", "")
		return bh[bk(bl)] or "Default"
	end
	local function bj()
		local bk, bl = pcall(function()
			return getgenv().SourcesHubAntiGuard
		end)
		if bk and type(bl) == "table" then
			if type(bl.Steps) == "table" then return bl end
			local bm = bl[bi(bg())] or bl.Default
			if type(bm) == "table" then return bm end
		end
		return aU[bi(bg())] or aT
	end
	local function bk()
		local bl = bj()
		local bm = aS.Options
		if type(bm) ~= "table" or bm.Destination == "Safe Zone" and not bm.Stay then return bl end
		local bn = {}
		for bo, bp in pairs(bl) do
			bn[bo] = bp
		end
		if bm.Destination == "Next To Line" then
			bn.Target = "edge"
			bn.LineOffset = 6
			bn.Height = 0
			bn.OffsetX = 0
			bn.OffsetZ = 0
		elseif bm.Destination == "Saved Spot" and typeof(bm.Spot) == "Vector3" then
			bn.Target = "point"
			bn.Point = bm.Spot
			bn.Height = 0
			bn.OffsetX = 0
			bn.OffsetZ = 0
		end
		if bm.Stay and type(bl.Steps) == "table" then
			local bo = {}
			for bp, bq in ipairs(bl.Steps) do
				if type(bq) == "table" and bq.To ~= "start" then
					bo[#bo + 1] = bq
				end
			end
			bn.Steps = bo
		end
		return bn
	end
	local function bl(bm, bn)
		local bo = workspace:FindFirstChild("World") or workspace:FindFirstChild("__OBJECTS")
		bo = bo and bo:FindFirstChild("Areas")
		local bp = bo and bo:FindFirstChild("SeparationLine")
		if bp and bp:IsA("BasePart") then
			local bq = bp.CFrame
			local br = (Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)):Cross(bp.Size.X >= bp.Size.Z and bq.RightVector or bq.LookVector)
			local bs = Vector3.new(br.X, 0, br.Z)
			if bs.Magnitude > 0.001 then
				local bt = bs.Unit
				local bu = bq.Position + ((bn - bq.Position):Dot(bt) >= 0 and -bt or bt) * (tonumber(bm.LineOffset) or 8)
				return Vector3.new(bu.X, bn.Y + 0.5, bu.Z)
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local function bm(bn, bo)
		local bp = tostring(bn.Target or "home")
		if bp == "sky" then return bo end
		if bp == "point" then
			if typeof(bn.Point) == "Vector3" then return bn.Point end
			return bo
		end
		if bp == "line" then
			local bq = bl(bn, bo)
			if bq then return bq end
		end
		if bp == "edge" then
			local bq = workspace:FindFirstChild("World") or workspace:FindFirstChild("__OBJECTS")
			bq = bq and bq:FindFirstChild("Areas")
			bq = bq and bq:FindFirstChild("SeparationLine")
			if bq and bq:IsA("BasePart") then
				local br = bq.CFrame
				local bs = bq.Size.X >= bq.Size.Z and br.RightVector or br.LookVector
				local bt = Vector3.new(bs.X, 0, bs.Z)
				local bu = (Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)):Cross(bt)
				local bv = Vector3.new(bu.X, 0, bu.Z)
				if bv.Magnitude > 0.001 and bt.Magnitude > 0.001 then
					local bw = bt.Unit
					local bx = bv.Unit
					local by = bo - br.Position
					local bz = -bq.Size.Magnitude / 2
					local bA = bq.Size.Magnitude / 2
					local bB = br.Position + bw * math.clamp(by:Dot(bw), bz, bA) + (by:Dot(bx) >= 0 and bx or -bx) * (tonumber(bn.LineOffset) or 6)
					local bC = be()
					return Vector3.new(bB.X, (bC and bC.Y or bo.Y) + 3, bB.Z)
				end
			end
		end
		return be()
	end
	local function bn(bo, bp)
		return bm(bo, bp) + Vector3.new(tonumber(bo.OffsetX) or 0, tonumber(bo.Height) or 0, tonumber(bo.OffsetZ) or 0)
	end
	local function bo()
		a_.Active = false
		aS.Busy = false
	end
	local function bp(bq)
		local br = math.max(tonumber(bq) or 0, 0)
		if br <= 0 then return 0 end
		return (math.random() * 2 - 1) * br
	end
	local function bq(br)
		local bs = type(br.Steps) == "table" and br.Steps or {}
		local bt = tonumber(br.ReleaseAt) or 0
		local bu = math.max(tonumber(br.StartAt) or 0, 0)
		local bv = math.max(tonumber(br.StartRandom) or 0, 0)
		local bw = math.max(tonumber(br.HopRandom) or 0, 0)
		local bx = math.max(tonumber(br.HoldRandom) or 0, 0)
		if bv <= 0 and bw <= 0 and bx <= 0 then return bs, bt, bu end
		local by = math.max(bu + bp(bv), 0)
		local bz = {}
		local bA, bB, bC = ipairs(bs)
		local bD = 0
		local bE = 0
		for bF, bG in bA, bB, bC do
			if type(bG) == "table" then
				local bH = math.max(tonumber(bG.At) or 0, 0)
				bE = math.max(bE + math.max(bH - bD, 0) + bp(bG.To == "start" and bx or bw), by)
				bz[bF] = { At = bE, To = bG.To, Glide = bG.Glide }
				bD = bH
				continue
			end
			break
		end
		return bz, bE + math.max(bt - bD, 0), by
	end
	local function br(bs)
		local bt = aj.Character
		local bu = au.Root()
		local bv = bt and bt:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not bu or not bv or bv.Health <= 0 then
			bo()
			a9(aV.Bad, 1.6)
			return
		end
		local function bw()
			return aY and bu.Parent ~= nil and bv.Parent ~= nil and bv.Health > 0
		end
		local bx = bv.PlatformStand
		local by = bu.CFrame
		local bz = by.Position
		local bA = bk()
		local bB, bC, bD = bq(bA)
		local bE = bA.Freeze ~= false
		local bF = tostring(bA.Facing or "Keep")
		local bG = math.max(tonumber(bA.Jitter) or 0, 0)
		local bH = bF == "Zero" and CFrame.new() or by.Rotation
		local function bI()
			if bF == "Spin" then return CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(math.random(0, 359)), 0) end
			return bH
		end
		local function bJ(bK)
			if bG <= 0 then return bK end
			return bK + Vector3.new((math.random() * 2 - 1) * bG, 0, (math.random() * 2 - 1) * bG)
		end
		local bK = bn(bA, bz)
		local function bL(bM)
			while bw() and os.clock() - bs < bM do
				af.Heartbeat:Wait()
				if bE then
					pcall(function()
						bu.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						bu.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
				end
			end
			return bw()
		end
		local function bM(bN, bO)
			bf(bt, bu, bN, bO, bE)
			af.PreSimulation:Wait()
			if bw() and (bu.Position - bN).Magnitude > 3 then
				bf(bt, bu, bN, bO, bE)
			end
		end
		pcall(function()
			bv.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
		end)
		if bA.Disguise ~= false then
			pcall(bc, bt, Vector3.zero)
		end
		a9(aV.Work)
		if bL(bD) and bA.Limp ~= false then
			bv.PlatformStand = true
		end
		local bN = bz
		for bO, bP in ipairs(bB) do
			local bQ = type(bP) ~= "table"
			if not bQ then
				bQ = not bL(tonumber(bP.At) or 0)
			end
			if not bQ then
				local bR = bP.To == "start" and bz or bJ(bK)
				local bS = bI()
				if type(bP.Glide) == "table" and #bP.Glide > 0 then
					for bT, bU in ipairs(bP.Glide) do
						if bw() then
							local bV = math.clamp
							local bW = tonumber(bU) or 1
							local bX = bf
							local bY = bN.Lerp
							local bZ = bV(bW, 0, 1)
							bX(bt, bu, bY(bN, bR, bZ), bS, bE)
							af.Heartbeat:Wait()
							continue
						end
						break
					end
					bN = bR
				else
					bM(bR, bS)
					bN = bR
				end
				continue
			end
			break
		end
		bL(bC)
		pcall(function()
			bv.PlatformStand = bx
		end)
		bd()
		bo()
		if bw() and a_.Carrying then
			a9(aV.Good, 1.6)
		else
			a9(aV.Bad, 1.6)
		end
	end
	local function bs(bt)
		if not pcall(br, bt) then
			pcall(function()
				local bu = aj.Character
				bu = bu and bu:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if bu then
					bu.PlatformStand = false
				end
			end)
			bd()
			bo()
			a9(aV.Bad, 1.6)
		end
	end
	local bt = 25
	local function bu()
		if aS.HitArms <= 0 then return false end
		if bt < os.clock() - (aS.HitArmedAt or 0) then
			aS.HitArms = 0
			return false
		end
		return true
	end
	local function bv()
		local bw = a_.Carrying
		a_.Carrying = a_.SignalCarrying or a_.WeldCarrying or (type(au.Steal) == "table" and au.Steal.Carrying == true)
		local bx = a_.Carrying and aY and aS.Enabled
		if bx then
			bx = not (type(au.Steal) == "table" and au.Steal.Active and au.BossPortalUp())
		end
		if bx and not a_.Active and not bu() then
			a_.Active = true
			aS.Busy = true
			aS.BusySince = os.clock()
			task.spawn(bs, os.clock())
		end
	end
	local bw = am.EggState
	local bx = type(bw) == "table" and bw.CarryChanged or nil
	if type(bx) == "table" and type(bx.Connect) == "function" then
		local by, bz = pcall(bx.Connect, bx, function(by)
			local bz = type(by) == "table" and by.IsCarrying == true
			if bz and by.GuardDisabled == true then
				bz = false
			end
			if bz and type(by.AreaId) == "string" then
				a_.AreaId = by.AreaId
			end
			if not bz then
				a_.AreaId = nil
			end
			a_.SignalCarrying = bz
			bv()
		end)
		if by and bz then
			aZ[#aZ + 1] = bz
		end
	end
	local by = 0
	local function _pcStand(_a)
		_a.PlatformStand = false
	end
	aZ[#aZ + 1] = af.Heartbeat:Connect(function(bz)
		local bA = aS.Busy or a_.Active
		if bA then
			local bB = aS.BusySince
			bA = os.clock() - bB > math.max(tonumber(bk().BusyLimit) or aT.BusyLimit, (tonumber(bk().ReleaseAt) or 0) + 1)
		end
		if bA then
			bd()
			local _, bB = au.CharParts()
			if bB and bB.PlatformStand then
				pcall(_pcStand, bB)
			end
			bo()
		end
		bu()
		by += bz
		if by < aT.WeldScanGap then return end
		by = 0
		local bB = ba() ~= nil
		if bB ~= a_.WeldCarrying then
			a_.WeldCarrying = bB
			bv()
		end
	end)
	ap(function()
		aY = false
		for bz, bA in ipairs(aZ) do
			pcall(function()
				bA:Disconnect()
			end)
		end
		table.clear(aZ)
		bd()
		bo()
		aS.Render = nil
		aS.ShowPanel = nil
		pcall(function()
			a3:Destroy()
		end)
	end)
end

			Note = "Only logs high-tier, Mythic, Secret, or 100% Enchanted eggs",
			Default = true,
			Callback = function(val)
				_webhookConfig.RareOnly = val == true
			end,
		})
		local function _sendDiscordEmbed(title, description, color, fields)
			if _webhookConfig.Url == "" then return end
			local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
			local payload = {
				username = "Cat Hub Notifier",
				avatar_url = "",
				embeds = {
					{
						title = title,

						timestamp = os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
					}
				}
			}
			pcall(function()
				if typeof(request) == "function" or typeof(http_request) == "function" or typeof(syn and syn.request) == "function" then
					local req = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request)
					req({
						Url = _webhookConfig.Url,
						Method = "POST",
						Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
						Body = http:JSONEncode(payload)
					})
				end
			end)
		end

		aHookSec:CreateButton({
			Name = "Send Test Notification (With Pet Picture)",
