		local function fmtCompact(n)
			local v = tonumber(n) or 0
			local u = { "", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi" }
			local i = 1
			while math.abs(v) >= 1000 and i < #u do
				v /= 1000
				i += 1
			end
			return string.format(i == 1 and "%.0f%s" or "%.2f%s", v, u[i])
		end
		local function sendStatusHeartbeatNow()
			if _webhookConfig.Url == "" then return false end
			local cashStr, speedStr, rebirthStr = "0", "0", "0"
			pcall(function()
				local saveMod = am and am.Save
				local snap = type(saveMod) == "table" and type(saveMod.Get) == "function" and saveMod.Get() or nil
				if type(snap) == "table" then
					cashStr = "$" .. fmtCompact(snap.Money or snap.Cash or 0)
					speedStr = fmtCompact(snap.SpeedPower or 0)
					rebirthStr = tostring(snap.Rebirths or 0)
				end
			end)
			local walkSpd = math.floor((type(au.WalkSpeed) == "function" and au.WalkSpeed() or 16) + 0.5)
			local stolenCnt = tonumber(au.SafeCarry and au.SafeCarry.DeliveredCount) or 0
			local elapsed = math.max(1, os.clock() - hbStartAt)
			local upStr = string.format("%02dh %02dm", math.floor(elapsed / 3600), math.floor((elapsed % 3600) / 60))
			local activeMode = (type(au.Steal) == "table" and au.Steal.Carrying and "Carrying Egg")
				or (au.AutoStealHandle and au.Toggle(au.AutoStealHandle, false) and "Auto Steal ON")
				or (type(au.Treadmill) == "table" and au.Treadmill.Riding and "Running Treadmill")
				or "Idle / Standby"
			local bestField = "None"
			pcall(function()
				local eggState = am and am.EggState
				local dir = am and am.Assets and am.Assets.Directory
				if type(eggState) == "table" and type(eggState.ReadFieldEggs) == "function" then
					local ok, s = pcall(eggState.ReadFieldEggs)
					local recs = ok and type(s) == "table" and s.Records or nil
					if type(recs) == "table" then
						local topRate = -1
						for _, rec in pairs(recs) do
							if type(rec) == "table" and (rec.State == "Slot" or rec.State == "Dropped") then
								local cat = tostring(rec.AssetCategory or "")
								local meta = type(dir) == "table" and dir[cat] or nil
								local sc = tonumber(rec.AssetScale) or 1
								local r = (tonumber(meta and meta.EarningRate) or 1) * sc
								if r > topRate then
									topRate = r
									bestField = string.format("%s (x%.2f \226\128\162 $%s/s)", tostring(meta and meta.DisplayName or cat), sc, fmtCompact(r))
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end)
			_sendDiscordEmbed(
				"Cat Hub AFK Status Heartbeat",
				string.format("Live account & farming report for **%s (@%s)**", tostring(aj.DisplayName), tostring(aj.Name)),
				16098851,
				{
					{ name = "Cash & Rebirths", value = string.format("%s  |  R%s", cashStr, rebirthStr), inline = true },
					{ name = "Speed Power", value = string.format("%s (WalkSpeed %d)", speedStr, walkSpd), inline = true },
					{ name = "Session Stolen", value = string.format("%d eggs (%s)", stolenCnt, upStr), inline = true },
					{ name = "Active Mode", value = activeMode, inline = true },
					{ name = "Best Field Egg", value = bestField, inline = true },
					{ name = "Server Players", value = string.format("%d / %d", #ae:GetPlayers(), ae.MaxPlayers or 12), inline = true },
				}
			)
			return true

				elseif type(toclipboard) == "function" then
					toclipboard(value)
				end
			end)
			if type(au.Notify) == "function" then
				pcall(au.Notify, "Discord", label .. " copied to clipboard!")
			end
		end
		_support:CreateText({
			Name = "Cat Hub is keyless and free",
			Text = "Join the Discord for updates, support, and free builds.",
		})
		_support:CreateText({ Name = "Invite", Text = "discord.gg/sourceshubs" })

			Name = "Copy Discord Link",

			Note = "Copies https://discord.gg/sourceshubs to clipboard",
			Callback = function()
				_copy("Discord link", "https://discord.gg/sourceshubs")
			end,
		})
	end)
	if not _discordOk then
		pcall(au.Notify, "Discord", "Discord tab had an issue: " .. tostring(_discordErr))
	end
end
local function _buildPredictor(a)
	if type(a) ~= "table" then
		if type(_passedArg) == "table" and (_passedArg.heldSeatNest or _passedArg.Window or _passedArg.Players) then
			a = _passedArg
		else
			a = {}
		end
	end
	if getgenv then getgenv().SourcesHubLoaded = true end
	if shared then shared.SourcesHubLoaded = true end
	pcall(function() _G.SourcesHubLoaded = true end)

			local function hist(tag, count)
				local sizes = {}

				for key, n in pairs(sizes) do
					table.insert(list, { key = key, n = n })
				end
				table.sort(list, function(left, right)
					return left.n > right.n
				end)
				local parts = {}
				for index = 1, math.min(count or 4, #list) do

				end

			end

	G.SecretRotation = 90
	G.Paint = function(as, at)
		return string.format("<font color=\"%s\">%s</font>", as, at)
	end
	G.Bold = function(as)
		return "<b>" .. tostring(as) .. "</b>"
	end
	G.Escape = function(as)
		return (string.gsub(tostring(as), "[<>&]", { ["<"] = "&lt;", [">"] = "&gt;", ["&"] = "&amp;" }))
	end
	G.Separator = function()
		return G.Paint(G.Color.Separator, "  " .. G.Bullet .. "  ")
	end
	G.FormatRate = function(as)
		local at = tonumber(as) or 0
		if at >= 1e12 then return string.format("%.2fT/s", at / 1e12) end
		if at >= 1e9 then return string.format("%.2fB/s", at / 1e9) end
		if at >= 1000000 then return string.format("%.2fM/s", at / 1000000) end
		if at >= 1000 then return string.format("%.1fK/s", at / 1000) end
		return string.format("%d/s", math.floor(at))
	end
	G.FormatWeight = function(as)
		local at = tonumber(as) or 0
		local au = at >= 1000 and string.format("%.0f", at) or string.format("%.2f", at)
		local av, aw = string.match(au, "^(%-?%d+)(%.%d+)$")
		av = av or au
		local ax
		while true do
			local ay
			ax, ay = string.gsub(av, "^(%-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
			if ay == 0 then
				break
			else
				av = ax
			end
		end
		return ax .. (aw or "") .. " Kg"
	end
	G.FormatClock = function(as)
		local at = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(as) or 0))
		return string.format("%02dh %02dm %02ds", math.floor(at / 3600), math.floor(at % 3600 / 60), at % 60)
	end
	G.ScaleFactor = function(as)
		if as > 5 then return (as / 5) ^ 1.2 * 19.637875755794113 end
		return as ^ 1.85
	end
	G.MutationMultiplier = function(as)
		as = type(as) == "table" and as or {}
		local at = l.Mutations
		if type(at) == "table" and type(at.EarningsFor) == "function" then
			local au, av = pcall(at.EarningsFor, as)
			if au and type(av) == "number" then return av end
		end
		return 1
	end

			local bn = math.max(1, bm)

			end
		end

	end

		end

		ao.Url = ap
	end)
	for ap = 0, 255 do
		local aq = ap
		for ar = 1, 8 do
			if bit32.band(aq, 1) == 1 then
				aq = bit32.bxor(3988292384, bit32.rshift(aq, 1))
			else
				aq = bit32.rshift(aq, 1)
			end
		end
		ao.Crc[ap] = aq
	end
	local function ap(aq)
		if type(aq) ~= "string" then return false end
		for ar, as in ipairs({ "discord%.com", "discordapp%.com", "ptb%.discord%.com", "canary%.discord%.com" }) do
			if string.match(aq, "^https://" .. as .. "/api/webhooks/%d+/[%w%-_]+$") then return true end
		end
		return false
	end
	local function aq(ar)
		if type(an) ~= "function" then return nil end
		local as, at = pcall(an, { Url = ar, Method = "GET" })
		if not as or type(at) ~= "table" or tonumber(at.StatusCode) ~= 200 then return nil end
		local au, av = pcall(h.JSONDecode, h, tostring(at.Body))
		return au and av or nil
	end
	local function ar(as, at)
		local au = type(as) == "table" and type(as.data) == "table" and as.data[1] or nil
		if type(au) ~= "table" or au.state ~= "Completed" or type(au.imageUrl) ~= "string" or au.imageUrl == "" then return nil end
		if at and not string.find(au.imageUrl, "/Image/", 1, true) then return nil end

	end

	local function au(av, aw, ax)
		local ay = ao.Crc
		local az = 4294967295
		for aA = aw, ax do
			local aB = bit32.rshift
			az = bit32.bxor(ay[bit32.band(bit32.bxor(az, buffer.readu8(av, aA)), 255)], aB(az, 8))
		end
		return bit32.bxor(az, 4294967295)
	end
	local function av(aw, ax, ay)
		if not ax or not ay or ax <= 0 or ay <= 0 then return nil end
		local az = ax * 4 + 1
		local aA = az * ay
		if aA <= 0 or aA > 16777216 then return nil end
		local aB = 2 + math.ceil(aA / 65535) * 5 + aA + 4
		local bufSize = math.clamp(45 + aB + 12, 1, 33554432)
		local aC = buffer.create(bufSize)
		local aD = 0
		local function aE(aF)
			buffer.writeu8(aC, aD, aF)
			aD += 1
		end
		local function aF(aG)
			aE(bit32.band(bit32.rshift(aG, 24), 255))
			aE(bit32.band(bit32.rshift(aG, 16), 255))
			aE(bit32.band(bit32.rshift(aG, 8), 255))
			aE(bit32.band(aG, 255))
		end
		local function aG(aH, aI, aJ, aK)
			aE(aH)
			aE(aI)
			aE(aJ)
			aE(aK)
		end
		for aH, aI in ipairs({ 137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10 }) do
			aE(aI)
		end
		aF(13)
		aG(73, 72, 68, 82)
		aF(ax)
		aF(ay)
		aE(8)
		aE(6)
		aE(0)
		aE(0)
		aE(0)
		aF(au(aC, aD, aD - 1))
		local aH = buffer.create(aA)
		for aI = 0, ay - 1 do
			buffer.writeu8(aH, aI * az, 0)
			buffer.copy(aH, aI * az + 1, aw, aI * ax * 4, ax * 4)
		end
		aF(aB)
		local aI = aD
		aG(73, 68, 65, 84)
		aE(120)
		aE(1)
		local aJ = 0
		while aJ < aA do
			local aK = math.min(65535, aA - aJ)
			aE(aJ + aK >= aA and 1 or 0)
			aE(bit32.band(aK, 255))
			aE(bit32.rshift(aK, 8))
			local aL = bit32.band(bit32.bnot(aK), 65535)
			aE(bit32.band(aL, 255))
			aE(bit32.rshift(aL, 8))
			buffer.copy(aC, aD, aH, aJ, aK)
			aD += aK
			aJ += aK
		end
		local aK = 1
		local aL = 0
		for aM = 0, aA - 1 do
			aK = (aK + buffer.readu8(aH, aM)) % 65521
			aL = (aL + aK) % 65521
		end
		aF(aL * 65536 + aK)
		aF(au(aC, aI, aD - 1))
		aF(0)
		aG(73, 69, 78, 68)
		aF(au(aC, aD, aD - 1))
		return buffer.tostring(aC)
	end
	local function aw(ax)
		if ao.Pngs[ax] ~= nil then return ao.Pngs[ax] or nil end
		local ay, az = pcall(function()
			local ay = am:CreateEditableImageAsync(Content.fromUri("rbxassetid://" .. ax))
			local az = ay.Size
			local aA = math.floor(az.X)
			local aB = math.floor(az.Y)
			local aC = ay:ReadPixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, az)
			pcall(function()
				ay:Destroy()
			end)
			local maxD = math.max(aA, aB)
			if maxD <= 0 then return nil end
			local aD = math.min(1, ao.MaxSide / maxD)
			local aE = math.max(1, math.floor(aA * aD))
			local aF = math.max(1, math.floor(aB * aD))
			local totalPix = aE * aF * 4
			if totalPix <= 0 or totalPix > 16777216 then return nil end
			local aG = buffer.create(totalPix)
			for aH = 0, aF - 1 do
				local aI = math.min(aB - 1, math.floor(aH / aD))
				for aJ = 0, aE - 1 do
					buffer.copy(aG, (aH * aE + aJ) * 4, aC, (aI * aA + math.min(aA - 1, math.floor(aJ / aD))) * 4, 4)
				end
			end
			return av(aG, aE, aF)
		end)
		ao.Pngs[ax] = ay and type(az) == "string" and az or false
		return ao.Pngs[ax] or nil
	end
	local function ax(ay, az)

	end

						if uid ~= "" and not seenWebhookSpawnUids[uid] and (rec.State == "Slot" or rec.State == "Dropped") then
							seenWebhookSpawnUids[uid] = true
							local cat = tostring(rec.AssetCategory or "")
							local info = G.AssetInfo(cat)
							local rUp = string.upper(tostring(info and info.Rarity or ""))
							local match = false
							if minMode == "All Tiers" then
								match = true
							elseif minMode == "Divine Only" then
								match = (rUp == "DIVINE")
							elseif minMode == "Eternal+" then
								match = (rUp == "ETERNAL" or rUp == "DIVINE")
							elseif minMode == "Mythic+" then
								match = (rUp == "MYTHIC" or rUp == "GODLY" or rUp == "SECRET" or rUp == "ETERNAL" or rUp == "DIVINE")
							else
								match = (rUp == "SECRET" or rUp == "GODLY" or rUp == "ETERNAL" or rUp == "DIVINE")
							end
							if match then
								local sc = tonumber(rec.AssetScale) or 1
								local muts = type(rec.Mutations) == "table" and rec.Mutations or {}
								local areaId = tostring(rec.AreaId or "Field")
								task.spawn(function()
									if aC() then
										aD(aA("Rare Egg / Pet Spawned!", cat, sc, muts, areaId, false))
									end
								end)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			task.wait(1.5)
		end
	end)
	D:CreateDropdown({
		Name = "Summary Every",
		Note = "How often the Discord webhook posts a farm summary",
		Options = { "15 min", "30 min", "60 min", "120 min" },
		Default = "30 min",
		Callback = function(aL)
			ao.SummaryEvery = tonumber(string.match(tostring(aL), "%d+")) or 30
		end,
	})
end
return true
end
if type(_passedArg) == "table" and (_passedArg.heldSeatNest or _passedArg.Window or _passedArg.Players) then return _buildPredictor(_passedArg) end
return _buildPredictor
end)
	local ba = {
		heldSeatNest = ac,
		Window = ac,
		hardTokenFrame = ab,
		Library = ab,
		Players = ae,
		RunService = af,
		ReplicatedStorage = ag,
		UserInputService = ai,
		HttpService = aL or game:GetService("HttpService"),
		localPlayer = aj,
		networking = ak,
		primeEggCrate = al,
		crateBank = am,
		baseHatchHop = an,
		refreshCarryHop = ao,
		clearQueue = ap,
		scanHatch = ar,
		seedToken = as,
		baseValue = au,
		gatherGuardFuse = av,
		droneMapOrbit = aw,
		coldEgg = ay,
		espSection = az or au.EspSection,
		hasHopFree = aA,
		n = aB,
		droneStoreBoss = aC,
		beaconBuffer = aD,
		slotSetTimer = aE,
		orbitBuffer = aF,
		spareSnapshotOrbit = aG,
		GetPriority = function()
			return ax
		end,
		SetPriority = function(val)
			ax = val
		end,
	}
	local bb, bc = pcall(function()
		local bd = __PRED_MODULE__
		if type(bd) == "function" then
			bd(ba)
		end
	end)
	if not bb then
		pcall(au.Notify, "Predictor", "Predictor load failed. Other features active.")
		if type(ab) == "table" and type(ab.Log) == "function" then
			pcall(ab.Log, "Predictor load failed: " .. tostring(bc))
		end
	end
end
task.defer(function()
	if #aq == 0 or type(readfile) ~= "function" then return end
	local ba = game:GetService("HttpService")
	local function bb(bc)
		if type(isfile) == "function" then
			local bd, be = pcall(isfile, bc)
			if bd and not be then return nil end
		end
		local bd, be = pcall(readfile, bc)
		if not bd or type(be) ~= "string" or be == "" then return nil end
		local bf, bg = pcall(ba.JSONDecode, ba, be)
		return bf and type(bg) == "table" and bg or nil
	end
	local bc = bb("SourcesHubLibrary/config_state.json") or {}
	if true then return end
	local bd = type(bc.StartupConfig) == "string" and bc.StartupConfig ~= "" and bc.StartupConfig
	local be
	if bd then
		be = bd
	else
		be = type(bc.SelectedConfig) == "string" and bc.SelectedConfig ~= "" and bc.SelectedConfig
	end
	local bf = bb("SourcesHubLibrary/configs/" .. (be or "Default") .. ".json")
	if type(bf) ~= "table" or type(bf.Values) ~= "table" then return end
	local bg = { ["K/s"] = 1000, ["M/s"] = 1000000, ["B/s"] = 1e9 }
	local bh = {}
	for bi, bj in ipairs(aq) do
		local bk = false
		local bl = nil
		for bm, bn in pairs(bf.Values) do
			local bo = type(bn) == "table" and bn[bj.Section] or nil
			if type(bo) == "table" then
				if bo[bj.Name] ~= nil then
					bk = true
				end
				local bp = bo[bj.Legacy]
				if type(bp) == "table" and tonumber(bp.Value) then
					bl = bp
				end
			end
		end
		if bl and not bk then
			local bm = math.max(0, tonumber(bl.Value)) * (bg[tostring(bl.Unit)] or 1000000)
			if bm > 0 then
				table.insert(bh, { Handle = bj.Handle, Step = bj.StepOf(bm) })
			end
		end
	end
	for bi, bj in ipairs({ 0.1, 1, 2 }) do
		if #bh == 0 then return end
		task.wait(bj)
		for bk, bl in ipairs(bh) do
			local bm, bn = pcall(bl.Handle.Get, bl.Handle)
			local bo
			if bm then
				bo = (tonumber(bn) or 0) <= 0
			else
				bo = bm
			end
			if bo then
				pcall(bl.Handle.Set, bl.Handle, bl.Step)
			end
		end
	end
end)
